text_en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, when I was in the midst of the captives by the river Chobar, the heavens were opened, and I saw the visions of God .
text_la: Et factum est in trigesimo anno, in quarto, in quinta mensis, cum essem in medio captivorum juxta fluvium Chobar, aperti sunt cæli, et vidi visiones Dei.
text_pt: E aconteceu no trigésimo ano, no quarto mês, no quinto dia do mês, que estando eu no meio dos cativos, junto ao rio Quebar, se abriram os céus, e eu tive visões de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ τριακοστῷ ἔτει ἐν τῷ τετάρτῳ μηνὶ πέμπτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς καὶ ἐγὼ ἤμην ἐν μέσῳ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ Χοβαρ καὶ ἠνοίχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί καὶ εἶδον ὁράσεις θεοῦ

text_en: On the fifth day of the month, the same was the fifth year of the captivity of King Joachin,
text_la: In quinta mensis, ipse est annus quintus transmigrationis regis Joachin,
text_pt: No quinto dia do mês, no quinto ano do cativeiro do rei Jeoiaquim,
text_el: πέμπτῃ τοῦ μηνός τοῦτο τὸ ἔτος τὸ πέμπτον τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας τοῦ βασιλέως Ιωακιμ

text_en: the word of the Lord came to Ezechiel the priest the son of Buzi in the land of the Chaldeans , by the river Chobar: and the hand of the Lord was there upon him.
text_la: factum est verbum Domini ad Ezechielem filium Buzi sacerdotem, in terra Chaldæorum, secus flumen Chobar : et facta est super eum ibi manus Domini.
text_pt: Veio expressamente a palavra do Senhor a Ezequiel, filho de Buzi, o sacerdote, na terra dos caldeus, junto ao rio Quebar, e ali esteve sobre ele a mão do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ιεζεκιηλ υἱὸν Βουζι τὸν ἱερέα ἐν γῇ Χαλδαίων ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ Χοβαρ καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπ' ἐμὲ χεὶρ κυρίου

text_en: And I saw, and behold a whirlwind came out of the north: and a great cloud, and a fire infolding it, and brightness was about it: and out of the midst thereof, that is, out of the midst of the fire, as it were the resemblance of amber:
text_la: Et vidi, et ecce ventus turbinis veniebat ab aquilone, et nubes magna, et ignis involvens, et splendor in circuitu ejus : et de medio ejus, quasi species electri, id est, de medio ignis:
text_pt: Olhei, e eis que um vento tempestuoso vinha do norte, uma grande nuvem, com um fogo revolvendo-se nela, e um resplendor ao redor, e no meio dela havia uma coisa, como de cor de âmbar, que saía do meio do fogo.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ πνεῦμα ἐξαῖρον ἤρχετο ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ νεφέλη μεγάλη ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ φέγγος κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ πῦρ ἐξαστράπτον καὶ ἐν τῷ μέσῳ αὐτοῦ ὡς ὅρασις ἠλέκτρου ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ φέγγος ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: And in the midst thereof the likeness of four living creatures: and this was their appearance: there was the likeness of a man in them.
text_la: et in medio ejus similitudo quatuor animalium. Et hic aspectus eorum, similitudo hominis in eis.
text_pt: E do meio dela saía a semelhança de quatro seres viventes. E esta era a sua aparência: tinham a semelhança de homem.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ μέσῳ ὡς ὁμοίωμα τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ αὕτη ἡ ὅρασις αὐτῶν ὁμοίωμα ἀνθρώπου ἐπ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings.
text_la: Quatuor facies uni, et quatuor pennæ uni.
text_pt: E cada um tinha quatro rostos, como também cada um deles quatro asas.
text_el: καὶ τέσσαρα πρόσωπα τῷ ἑνί καὶ τέσσαρες πτέρυγες τῷ ἑνί

text_en: Their feet were straight feet, and the sole of their foot was like the sole of a calf's foot, and they sparkled like the appearance of glowing brass.
text_la: Pedes eorum, pedes recti, et planta pedis eorum quasi planta pedis vituli : et scintillæ quasi aspectus æris candentis.
text_pt: E os seus pés eram pés direitos; e as plantas dos seus pés como a planta do pé de uma bezerra, e luziam como a cor de cobre polido.
text_el: καὶ τὰ σκέλη αὐτῶν ὀρθά καὶ πτερωτοὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτῶν καὶ σπινθῆρες ὡς ἐξαστράπτων χαλκός καὶ ἐλαφραὶ αἱ πτέρυγες αὐτῶν

text_en: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides: and they had faces, and wings on the four sides,
text_la: Et manus hominis sub pennis eorum, in quatuor partibus : et facies et pennas per quatuor partes habebant.
text_pt: E tinham mãos de homem debaixo das suas asas, aos quatro lados; e assim todos quatro tinham seus rostos e suas asas.
text_el: καὶ χεὶρ ἀνθρώπου ὑποκάτωθεν τῶν πτερύγων αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰ τέσσαρα μέρη αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν τῶν τεσσάρων

text_en: and the wings of one were joined to the wings of another. They turned not when they went: but every one went straight forward.
text_la: Junctæque erant pennæ eorum alterius ad alterum : non revertebantur cum incederent, sed unumquodque ante faciem suam gradiebatur.
text_pt: Uniam-se as suas asas uma à outra; não se viravam quando andavam, e cada qual andava continuamente em frente.
text_el: οὐκ ἐπεστρέφοντο ἐν τῷ βαδίζειν αὐτά ἕκαστον κατέναντι τοῦ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἐπορεύοντο

text_en: And as for the likeness of their faces: there was the face of a man , and the face of a lion on the right side of all the four: and the face of an ox, on the left side of all the four: and the face of an eagle over all the four.
text_la: Similitudo autem vultus eorum, facies hominis et facies leonis a dextris ipsorum quatuor, facies autem bovis a sinistris ipsorum quatuor, et facies aquilæ desuper ipsorum quatuor.
text_pt: E a semelhança dos seus rostos era como o rosto de homem; e do lado direito todos os quatro tinham rosto de leão, e do lado esquerdo todos os quatro tinham rosto de boi; e também tinham rosto de águia todos os quatro.
text_el: καὶ ὁμοίωσις τῶν προσώπων αὐτῶν πρόσωπον ἀνθρώπου καὶ πρόσωπον λέοντος ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῖς τέσσαρσιν καὶ πρόσωπον μόσχου ἐξ ἀριστερῶν τοῖς τέσσαρσιν καὶ πρόσωπον ἀετοῦ τοῖς τέσσαρσιν

text_en: And their faces, and their wings were stretched upward: two wings of every one were joined, and two covered their bodies:
text_la: Facies eorum et pennæ eorum extentæ desuper : duæ pennæ singulorum jungebantur, et duæ tegebant corpora eorum.
text_pt: Assim eram os seus rostos. As suas asas estavam estendidas por cima; cada qual tinha duas asas juntas uma a outra, e duas cobriam os corpos deles.
text_el: καὶ αἱ πτέρυγες αὐτῶν ἐκτεταμέναι ἄνωθεν τοῖς τέσσαρσιν ἑκατέρῳ δύο συνεζευγμέναι πρὸς ἀλλήλας καὶ δύο ἐπεκάλυπτον ἐπάνω τοῦ σώματος αὐτῶν

text_en: And every one of them went straight forward: whither the impulse of the spirit was to go, thither they went: and they turned not when they went.
text_la: Et unumquodque eorum coram facie sua ambulabat : ubi erat impetus spiritus, illuc gradiebantur, nec revertebantur cum ambularent.
text_pt: E cada qual andava para adiante de si; para onde o espírito havia de ir, iam; não se viravam quando andavam.
text_el: καὶ ἑκάτερον κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐπορεύετο οὗ ἂν ἦν τὸ πνεῦμα πορευόμενον ἐπορεύοντο καὶ οὐκ ἐπέστρεφον

text_en: And as for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like that of burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps. This was the vision running to and fro in the midst of the living creatures, a bright fire, and lightning going forth from the fire.
text_la: Et similitudo animalium, aspectus eorum quasi carbonum ignis ardentium, et quasi aspectus lampadarum : hæc erat visio discurrens in medio animalium, splendor ignis, et de igne fulgur egrediens.
text_pt: E, quanto à semelhança dos seres viventes, o seu aspecto era como ardentes brasas de fogo, com uma aparência de lâmpadas; o fogo subia e descia por entre os seres viventes, e o fogo resplandecia, e do fogo saíam relâmpagos;
text_el: καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ζῴων ὅρασις ὡς ἀνθράκων πυρὸς καιομένων ὡς ὄψις λαμπάδων συστρεφομένων ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ζῴων καὶ φέγγος τοῦ πυρός καὶ ἐκ τοῦ πυρὸς ἐξεπορεύετο ἀστραπή

text_en: And the living creatures ran and returned like flashes of lightning.
text_la: Et animalia ibant et revertebantur, in similitudinem fulguris coruscantis.
text_pt: E os seres viventes corriam, e voltavam, à semelhança de um clarão de relâmpago.

text_en: Now as I beheld the living creatures, there appeared upon the earth by the living creatures one wheel with four faces.
text_la: Cumque aspicerem animalia, apparuit rota una super terram juxta animalia, habens quatuor facies.
text_pt: E vi os seres viventes; e eis que havia uma roda sobre a terra junto aos seres viventes, uma para cada um dos quatro rostos.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ τροχὸς εἷς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐχόμενος τῶν ζῴων τοῖς τέσσαρσιν

text_en: And the appearance of the wheels, and the work of them was like the appearance of the sea: and the four had all one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the midst of a wheel.
text_la: Et aspectus rotarum et opus earum quasi visio maris : et una similitudo ipsarum quatuor : et aspectus earum et opera quasi sit rota in medio rotæ.
text_pt: O aspecto das rodas, e a obra delas, era como a cor de berilo; e as quatro tinham uma mesma semelhança; e o seu aspecto, e a sua obra, era como se estivera uma roda no meio de outra roda.
text_el: καὶ τὸ εἶδος τῶν τροχῶν ὡς εἶδος θαρσις καὶ ὁμοίωμα ἓν τοῖς τέσσαρσιν καὶ τὸ ἔργον αὐτῶν ἦν καθὼς ἂν εἴη τροχὸς ἐν τροχῷ

text_en: When they went, they went by their four parts: and they turned not when they went.
text_la: Per quatuor partes earum euntes ibant, et non revertebantur cum ambularent.
text_pt: Andando elas, andavam pelos seus quatro lados; não se viravam quando andavam.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὰ τέσσαρα μέρη αὐτῶν ἐπορεύοντο οὐκ ἐπέστρεφον ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτὰ

text_en: The wheels had also a size, and a height, and a dreadful appearance: and the whole body was full of eyes round about all the four.
text_la: Statura quoque erat rotis, et altitudo, et horribilis aspectus : et totum corpus oculis plenum in circuitu ipsarum quatuor.
text_pt: E os seus aros eram tão altos, que faziam medo; e estas quatro tinham as suas cambotas cheias de olhos ao redor.
text_el: οὐδ' οἱ νῶτοι αὐτῶν καὶ ὕψος ἦν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶδον αὐτά καὶ οἱ νῶτοι αὐτῶν πλήρεις ὀφθαλμῶν κυκλόθεν τοῖς τέσσαρσιν

text_en: And, when the living creatures went, the wheels also went together by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels also were lifted up with them.
text_la: Cumque ambularent animalia, ambulabant pariter et rotæ juxta ea : et cum elevarentur animalia de terra, elevabantur simul et rotæ.
text_pt: E, andando os seres viventes, andavam as rodas ao lado deles; e, elevando-se os seres viventes da terra, elevavam-se também as rodas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι τὰ ζῷα ἐπορεύοντο οἱ τροχοὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν τὰ ζῷα ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἐξῄροντο οἱ τροχοί

text_en: Whithersoever the spirit went, thither as the spirit went the wheels also were lifted up withal, and followed it: for the spirit of life was in the wheels.
text_la: Quocumque ibat spiritus, illuc, eunte spiritu, et rotæ pariter elevabantur sequentes eum : spiritus enim vitæ erat in rotis.
text_pt: Para onde o espírito queria ir, eles iam; para onde o espírito tinha de ir; e as rodas se elevavam defronte deles, porque o espírito do ser vivente estava nas rodas.
text_el: οὗ ἂν ἦν ἡ νεφέλη ἐκεῖ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ἐπορεύοντο τὰ ζῷα καὶ οἱ τροχοὶ καὶ ἐξῄροντο σὺν αὐτοῖς διότι πνεῦμα ζωῆς ἦν ἐν τοῖς τροχοῖς

text_en: When those went these went, and when those stood these stood, and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up together, and followed them: for the spirit of life was in the wheels.
text_la: Cum euntibus ibant, et cum stantibus stabant : et cum elevatis a terra, pariter elevabantur et rotæ sequentes ea, quia spiritus vitæ erat in rotis.
text_pt: Andando eles, andavam elas e, parando eles, paravam elas e, elevando-se eles da terra, elevavam-se também as rodas defronte deles; porque o espírito do ser vivente estava nas rodas.
text_el: ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτὰ ἐπορεύοντο καὶ ἐν τῷ ἑστάναι αὐτὰ εἱστήκεισαν καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν αὐτὰ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἐξῄροντο σὺν αὐτοῖς ὅτι πνεῦμα ζωῆς ἦν ἐν τοῖς τροχοῖς

text_en: And over the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of the firmament , the appearance of crystal terrible to behold, and stretched out over their heads above.
text_la: Et similitudo super capita animalium firmamenti, quasi aspectus crystalli horribilis, et extenti super capita eorum desuper.
text_pt: E sobre as cabeças dos seres viventes havia uma semelhança de firmamento, com a aparência de cristal terrível, estendido por cima, sobre as suas cabeças.
text_el: καὶ ὁμοίωμα ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς αὐτοῖς τῶν ζῴων ὡσεὶ στερέωμα ὡς ὅρασις κρυστάλλου ἐκτεταμένον ἐπὶ τῶν πτερύγων αὐτῶν ἐπάνωθεν

text_en: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other, every one with two wings covered his body, and the other was covered in like manner.
text_la: Sub firmamento autem pennæ eorum rectæ alterius ad alterum : unumquodque duabus alis velabat corpus suum, et alterum similiter velabatur.
text_pt: E debaixo do firmamento estavam as suas asas direitas uma em direção à outra; cada um tinha duas, que lhe cobriam o corpo de um lado; e cada um tinha outras duas asas, que os cobriam do outro lado.
text_el: καὶ ὑποκάτω τοῦ στερεώματος αἱ πτέρυγες αὐτῶν ἐκτεταμέναι πτερυσσόμεναι ἑτέρα τῇ ἑτέρᾳ ἑκάστῳ δύο συνεζευγμέναι ἐπικαλύπτουσαι τὰ σώματα αὐτῶν

text_en: And I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of many waters, as it were the voice of the most high God : when they walked, it was like the voice of a multitude, like the noise of an army, and when they stood, their wings were let down.
text_la: Et audiebam sonum alarum, quasi sonum aquarum multarum, quasi sonum sublimis Dei : cum ambularent, quasi sonus erat multitudinis ut sonus castrorum : cumque starent, demittebantur pennæ eorum.
text_pt: E, andando eles, ouvi o ruído das suas asas, como o ruído de muitas águas, como a voz do Onipotente, um tumulto como o estrépito de um exército; parando eles, abaixavam as suas asas.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουον τὴν φωνὴν τῶν πτερύγων αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτὰ ὡς φωνὴν ὕδατος πολλοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἑστάναι αὐτὰ κατέπαυον αἱ πτέρυγες αὐτῶν

text_en: For when a voice came from above the firmament , that was over their heads, they stood, and let down their wings.
text_la: Nam cum fieret vox super firmamentum quod erat super caput eorum, stabant, et submittebant alas suas.
text_pt: E ouviu-se uma voz vinda do firmamento, que estava por cima das suas cabeças; parando eles, abaixavam as suas asas.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ὑπεράνωθεν τοῦ στερεώματος τοῦ ὄντος ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: And above the firmament that was over their heads, was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of the sapphire stone, and upon the likeness of the throne, was the likeness of the appearance of a man above upon it.
text_la: Et super firmamentum quod erat imminens capiti eorum, quasi aspectus lapidis sapphiri similitudo throni : et super similitudinem throni similitudo quasi aspectus hominis desuper.
text_pt: E por cima do firmamento, que estava por cima das suas cabeças, havia algo semelhante a um trono que parecia de pedra de safira; e sobre esta espécie de trono havia uma figura semelhante a de um homem, na parte de cima, sobre ele.
text_el: ὡς ὅρασις λίθου σαπφείρου ὁμοίωμα θρόνου ἐπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὁμοιώματος τοῦ θρόνου ὁμοίωμα ὡς εἶδος ἀνθρώπου ἄνωθεν

text_en: And I saw as it were the resemblance of amber as the appearance of fire within it round about: from his loins and upward, and from his loins downward, I saw as it were the resemblance of fire shining round about.
text_la: Et vidi quasi speciem electri, velut aspectum ignis, intrinsecus ejus per circuitum : a lumbis ejus et desuper, et a lumbis ejus usque deorsum, vidi quasi speciem ignis splendentis in circuitu,
text_pt: E vi-a como a cor de âmbar, como a aparência do fogo pelo interior dele ao redor, desde o aspecto dos seus lombos, e daí para cima; e, desde o aspecto dos seus lombos e daí para baixo, vi como a semelhança de fogo, e um resplendor ao redor dele.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ὡς ὄψιν ἠλέκτρου ἀπὸ ὁράσεως ὀσφύος καὶ ἐπάνω καὶ ἀπὸ ὁράσεως ὀσφύος καὶ ἕως κάτω εἶδον ὡς ὅρασιν πυρὸς καὶ τὸ φέγγος αὐτοῦ κύκλῳ

text_en: As the appearance of the rainbow when it is in a cloud on a rainy day: this was the appearance of the brightness round about.
text_la: velut aspectum arcus cum fuerit in nube in die pluviæ. Hic erat aspectus splendoris per gyrum.
text_pt: Como o aspecto do arco que aparece na nuvem no dia da chuva, assim era o aspecto do resplendor em redor. Este era o aspecto da semelhança da glória do Senhor; e, vendo isto, caí sobre o meu rosto, e ouvi a voz de quem falava.
text_el: ὡς ὅρασις τόξου ὅταν ᾖ ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὑετοῦ οὕτως ἡ στάσις τοῦ φέγγους κυκλόθεν αὕτη ἡ ὅρασις ὁμοιώματος δόξης κυρίου καὶ εἶδον καὶ πίπτω ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν λαλοῦντος

text_en: This was the vision of the likeness of the glory of the Lord , and I saw, and I fell upon my face, and I heard the voice of one that spoke, and he said to me: Son of man , stand upon your feet, and I will speak to you.
text_la: Hæc visio similitudinis gloriæ Domini. Et vidi, et cecidi in faciem meam, et audivi vocem loquentis, et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, sta super pedes tuos, et loquar tecum.
text_pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, põe-te em pé, e falarei contigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στῆθι ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας σου καὶ λαλήσω πρὸς σέ

text_en: And the spirit entered into me after that he spoke to me, and he set me upon my feet: and I heard him speaking to me,
text_la: Et ingressus est in me spiritus postquam locutus est mihi, et statuit me supra pedes meos : et audivi loquentem ad me,
text_pt: Então entrou em mim o Espírito, quando ele falava comigo, e me pôs em pé, e ouvi o que me falava.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ πνεῦμα καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με καὶ ἐξῆρέν με καὶ ἔστησέν με ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας μου καὶ ἤκουον αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος πρός με

text_en: and saying: Son of man , I send you to the children of Israel , to a rebellious people, that has revolted from me, they, and their fathers, have transgressed my covenant even unto this day.
text_la: et dicentem : Fili hominis, mitto ego te ad filios Israël, ad gentes apostatrices quæ recesserunt a me : ipsi et patres eorum prævaricati sunt pactum meum usque ad diem hanc:
text_pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, eu te envio aos filhos de Israel, às nações rebeldes que se rebelaram contra mim; eles e seus pais transgrediram contra mim até este mesmo dia.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἐξαποστέλλω ἐγώ σε πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ τοὺς παραπικραίνοντάς με οἵτινες παρεπίκρανάν με αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: And they to whom I send you are children of a hard face, and of an obstinate heart: and you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord God :
text_la: et filii dura facie et indomabili corde sunt, ad quos ego mitto te. Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
text_pt: E os filhos são de semblante duro, e obstinados de coração; eu te envio a eles, e lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος

text_en: If so be they at least will hear, and if so be they will forbear, for they are a provoking house: and they shall know that there has been a prophet in the midst of them.
text_la: si forte vel ipsi audiant, et si forte quiescant, quoniam domus exasperans est : et scient quia propheta fuerit in medio eorum.
text_pt: E eles, quer ouçam quer deixem de ouvir (porque eles são casa rebelde), hão de saber, contudo, que esteve no meio deles um profeta.
text_el: ἐὰν ἄρα ἀκούσωσιν ἢ πτοηθῶσιν διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι προφήτης εἶ σὺ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: And you, O son of man , fear not, neither be afraid of their words: for you are among unbelievers and destroyers, and you dwell with scorpions. Fear not their words, neither be dismayed at their looks: for they are a provoking house.
text_la: Tu ergo, fili hominis, ne timeas eos, neque sermones eorum metuas, quoniam increduli et subversores sunt tecum, et cum scorpionibus habitas. Verba eorum ne timeas, et vultus eorum ne formides, quia domus exasperans est.
text_pt: E tu, ó filho do homem, não os temas, nem temas as suas palavras; ainda que estejam contigo sarças e espinhos, e tu habites entre escorpiões, não temas as suas palavras, nem te assustes com os seus semblantes, porque são casa rebelde.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου μὴ φοβηθῇς αὐτοὺς μηδὲ ἐκστῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν διότι παροιστρήσουσι καὶ ἐπισυστήσονται ἐπὶ σὲ κύκλῳ καὶ ἐν μέσῳ σκορπίων σὺ κατοικεῖς τοὺς λόγους αὐτῶν μὴ φοβηθῇς καὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν μὴ ἐκστῇς διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν

text_en: And you shall speak my words to them, if perhaps they will hear, and forbear: for they provoke me to anger .
text_la: Loqueris ergo verba mea ad eos, si forte audiant, et quiescant : quoniam irritatores sunt.
text_pt: Mas tu lhes dirás as minhas palavras, quer ouçam quer deixem de ouvir, pois são rebeldes.
text_el: καὶ λαλήσεις τοὺς λόγους μου πρὸς αὐτούς ἐὰν ἄρα ἀκούσωσιν ἢ πτοηθῶσιν διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν

text_en: But you, O son of man , hear all that I say to you: and do not provoke me, as that house provokes me: open your mouth, and eat what I give you.
text_la: Tu autem, fili hominis, audi quæcumque loquor ad te, et noli esse exasperans, sicut domus exasperatrix est : aperi os tuum, et comede quæcumque ego do tibi.
text_pt: Mas tu, ó filho do homem, ouve o que eu te falo, não sejas rebelde como a casa rebelde; abre a tua boca, e come o que eu te dou.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἄκουε τοῦ λαλοῦντος πρὸς σέ μὴ γίνου παραπικραίνων καθὼς ὁ οἶκος ὁ παραπικραίνων χάνε τὸ στόμα σου καὶ φάγε ἃ ἐγὼ δίδωμί σοι

text_en: And I looked, and behold, a hand was sent to me, wherein was a book rolled up:
text_la: Et vidi : et ecce manus missa ad me, in qua erat involutus liber:
text_pt: Então vi, e eis que uma mão se estendia para mim, e eis que nela havia um rolo de livro.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ χεὶρ ἐκτεταμένη πρός με καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ κεφαλὶς βιβλίου

text_en: and he spread it before me, and it was written within and without: and there were written in it lamentations, and canticles , and woe.
text_la: et expandit illum coram me, qui erat scriptus intus et foris : et scriptæ erant in eo lamentationes, et carmen, et væ.
text_pt: E estendeu-o diante de mim, e ele estava escrito por dentro e por fora; e nele estavam escritas lamentações, e suspiros e ais.
text_el: καὶ ἀνείλησεν αὐτὴν ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ γεγραμμένα ἦν τὰ ὄπισθεν καὶ τὰ ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ἐγέγραπτο εἰς αὐτὴν θρῆνος καὶ μέλος καὶ οὐαί

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , eat all that you shall find: eat this book, and go speak to the children of Israel .
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, quodcumque inveneris, comede : comede volumen istud, et vadens loquere ad filios Israël.
text_pt: Depois me disse: Filho do homem, come o que achares; come este rolo, e vai, fala à casa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου κατάφαγε τὴν κεφαλίδα ταύτην καὶ πορεύθητι καὶ λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that book:
text_la: Et aperui os meum, et cibavit me volumine illo:
text_pt: Então abri a minha boca, e me deu a comer o rolo.
text_el: καὶ διήνοιξα τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ἐψώμισέν με τὴν κεφαλίδα

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , your belly shall eat, and your bowels shall be filled with this book, which I give you, and I ate it: and it was sweet as honey in my mouth.
text_la: et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, venter tuus comedet, et viscera tua complebuntur volumine isto quod ego do tibi. Et comedi illud, et factum est in ore meo sicut mel dulce.
text_pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, dá de comer ao teu ventre, e enche as tuas entranhas deste rolo que eu te dou. Então o comi, e era na minha boca doce como o mel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τὸ στόμα σου φάγεται καὶ ἡ κοιλία σου πλησθήσεται τῆς κεφαλίδος ταύτης τῆς δεδομένης εἰς σέ καὶ ἔφαγον αὐτήν καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ στόματί μου ὡς μέλι γλυκάζον

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , go to the house of Israel , and you shall speak my words to them.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, vade ad domum Israël, et loqueris verba mea ad eos.
text_pt: E disse-me ainda: Filho do homem, vai, entra na casa de Israel, e dize-lhe as minhas palavras.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου βάδιζε εἴσελθε πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ λάλησον τοὺς λόγους μου πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: For you are not sent to a people of a profound speech, and of an unknown tongue, but to the house of Israel :
text_la: Non enim ad populum profundi sermonis et ignotæ linguæ tu mitteris ad domum Israël:
text_pt: Porque tu não és enviado a um povo de estranha fala, nem de língua difícil, mas à casa de Israel;
text_el: διότι οὐ πρὸς λαὸν βαθύχειλον καὶ βαρύγλωσσον σὺ ἐξαποστέλλῃ πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Nor to many nations of a strange speech, and of an unknown tongue, whose words you can not understand: and if you were sent to them, they would hearken to you.
text_la: neque ad populos multos profundi sermonis et ignotæ linguæ, quorum non possis audire sermones : et si ad illos mittereris, ipsi audirent te:
text_pt: Nem a muitos povos de estranha fala, e de língua difícil, cujas palavras não possas entender; se eu aos tais te enviara, certamente te dariam ouvidos.
text_el: οὐδὲ πρὸς λαοὺς πολλοὺς ἀλλοφώνους ἢ ἀλλογλώσσους οὐδὲ στιβαροὺς τῇ γλώσσῃ ὄντας ὧν οὐκ ἀκούσῃ τοὺς λόγους αὐτῶν καὶ εἰ πρὸς τοιούτους ἐξαπέστειλά σε οὗτοι ἂν εἰσήκουσάν σου

text_en: But the house of Israel will not hearken to you: because they will not hearken to me: for all the house of Israel are of a hard forehead and an obstinate heart.
text_la: domus autem Israël nolunt audire te, quia nolunt audire me : omnis quippe domus Israël attrita fronte est, et duro corde.
text_pt: Mas a casa de Israel não te quererá dar ouvidos, porque não me querem dar ouvidos a mim; pois toda a casa de Israel é de fronte obstinada e dura de coração.
text_el: ὁ δὲ οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ οὐ μὴ θελήσωσιν εἰσακοῦσαί σου διότι οὐ βούλονται εἰσακούειν μου ὅτι πᾶς ὁ οἶκος Ισραηλ φιλόνεικοί εἰσιν καὶ σκληροκάρδιοι

text_en: Behold I have made your face stronger than their faces: and your forehead harder than their foreheads.
text_la: Ecce dedi faciem tuam valentiorem faciebus eorum, et frontem tuam duriorem frontibus eorum:
text_pt: Eis que fiz duro o teu rosto contra os seus rostos, e forte a tua fronte contra a sua fronte.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ δέδωκα τὸ πρόσωπόν σου δυνατὸν κατέναντι τῶν προσώπων αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ νεῖκός σου κατισχύσω κατέναντι τοῦ νείκους αὐτῶν

text_en: I have made your face like an adamant and like flint: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their presence: for they are a provoking house.
text_la: ut adamantem et ut silicem dedi faciem tuam : ne timeas eos, neque metuas a facie eorum, quia domus exasperans est.
text_pt: Fiz como diamante a tua fronte, mais forte do que a pederneira; não os temas, pois, nem te assombres com os seus rostos, porque são casa rebelde.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται διὰ παντὸς κραταιότερον πέτρας μὴ φοβηθῇς ἀπ' αὐτῶν μηδὲ πτοηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , receive in your heart, and hear with your ears, all the words that I speak to you:
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, omnes sermones meos quos ego loquor ad te, assume in corde tuo, et auribus tuis audi:
text_pt: Disse-me mais: Filho do homem, recebe no teu coração todas as minhas palavras que te hei de dizer, e ouve-as com os teus ouvidos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς λελάληκα μετὰ σοῦ λαβὲ εἰς τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ τοῖς ὠσίν σου ἄκουε

text_en: And go get you in to them of the captivity , to the children of your people, and you shall speak to them, and shall say to them: Thus says the Lord : If so be they will hear, and will forbear.
text_la: et vade, ingredere ad transmigrationem, ad filios populi tui, et loqueris ad eos : et dices eis : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : si forte audiant et quiescant.
text_pt: Eia, pois, vai aos do cativeiro, aos filhos do teu povo, e lhes falarás e lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS, quer ouçam quer deixem de ouvir.
text_el: καὶ βάδιζε εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς τοῦ λαοῦ σου καὶ λαλήσεις πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐὰν ἄρα ἀκούσωσιν ἐὰν ἄρα ἐνδῶσιν

text_en: And the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great commotion, saying: Blessed be the glory of the Lord , from his place.
text_la: Et assumpsit me spiritus, et audivi post me vocem commotionis magnæ : Benedicta gloria Domini de loco suo:
text_pt: E levantou-me o Espírito, e ouvi por detrás de mim uma voz de grande estrondo, que dizia: Bendita seja a glória do SENHOR, desde o seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με πνεῦμα καὶ ἤκουσα κατόπισθέν μου φωνὴν σεισμοῦ μεγάλου εὐλογημένη ἡ δόξα κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: The noise of the wings of the living creatures striking one against another, and the noise of the wheels following the living creatures, and the noise of a great commotion.
text_la: et vocem alarum animalium percutientium alteram ad alteram, et vocem rotarum sequentium animalia, et vocem commotionis magnæ.
text_pt: E ouvi o ruído das asas dos seres viventes, que tocavam umas nas outras, e o ruído das rodas defronte deles, e o sonido de um grande estrondo.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον φωνὴν πτερύγων τῶν ζῴων πτερυσσομένων ἑτέρα πρὸς τὴν ἑτέραν καὶ φωνὴ τῶν τροχῶν ἐχομένη αὐτῶν καὶ φωνὴ τοῦ σεισμοῦ

text_en: The spirit also lifted me, and took me up: and I went away in bitterness in the indignation of my spirit : for the hand of the Lord was with me, strengthening me.
text_la: Spiritus quoque levavit me, et assumpsit me : et abii amarus in indignatione spiritus mei : manus enim Domini erat mecum, confortans me.
text_pt: Então o espírito me levantou, e me levou; e eu me fui amargurado, na indignação do meu Espírito; porém a mão do SENHOR era forte sobre mim.
text_el: καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα ἐξῆρέν με καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με καὶ ἐπορεύθην ἐν ὁρμῇ τοῦ πνεύματός μου καὶ χεὶρ κυρίου ἐγένετο ἐπ' ἐμὲ κραταιά

text_en: And I came to them of the captivity , to the heap of new corn, to them that dwelt by the river Chobar, and I sat where they sat: and I remained there seven days mourning in the midst of them.
text_la: Et veni ad transmigrationem, ad acervum novarum frugum, ad eos qui habitabant juxta flumen Chobar : et sedi ubi illi sedebant, et mansi ibi septem diebus mœrens in medio eorum.
text_pt: E fui a Tel-Abibe, aos do cativeiro, que moravam junto ao rio Quebar, e eu morava onde eles moravam; e fiquei ali sete dias, pasmado no meio deles.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν μετέωρος καὶ περιῆλθον τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ Χοβαρ τοὺς ὄντας ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐκάθισα ἐκεῖ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἀναστρεφόμενος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: And at the end of seven days the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Cum autem pertransissent septem dies, factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ao fim de sete dias, veio a palavra do Senhor a mim, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὰς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel : and you shall hear the word out of my mouth, and shall tell it them from me.
text_la: Fili hominis, speculatorem dedi te domui Israël, et audies de ore meo verbum, et annuntiabis eis ex me.
text_pt: Filho do homem: Eu te dei por atalaia sobre a casa de Israel; e tu da minha boca ouvirás a palavra e avisá-los-ás da minha parte.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου σκοπὸν δέδωκά σε τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀκούσῃ ἐκ στόματός μου λόγον καὶ διαπειλήσῃ αὐτοῖς παρ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: If, when I say to the wicked , You shall surely die: you declare it not to him, nor speak to him, that he may be converted from his wicked way, and live: the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity , but I will require his blood at your hand.
text_la: Si, dicente me ad impium : Morte morieris, non annuntiaveris ei, neque locutus fueris ut avertatur a via sua impia et vivat, ipse impius in iniquitate sua morietur, sanguinem autem ejus de manu tua requiram.
text_pt: Quando eu disser ao ímpio: Certamente morrerás; e tu não o avisares, nem falares para avisar o ímpio acerca do seu mau caminho, para salvar a sua vida, aquele ímpio morrerá na sua iniqüidade, mas o seu sangue, da tua mão o requererei.
text_el: ἐν τῷ λέγειν με τῷ ἀνόμῳ θανάτῳ θανατωθήσῃ καὶ οὐ διεστείλω αὐτῷ οὐδὲ ἐλάλησας τοῦ διαστείλασθαι τῷ ἀνόμῳ ἀποστρέψαι ἀπὸ τῶν ὁδῶν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ζῆσαι αὐτόν ὁ ἄνομος ἐκεῖνος τῇ ἀδικίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀποθανεῖται καὶ τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρός σου ἐκζητήσω

text_en: But if you give warning to the wicked , and he be not converted from his wickedness , and from his evil way: he indeed shall die in his iniquity , but you have delivered your soul .
text_la: Si autem tu annuntiaveris impio, et ille non fuerit conversus ab impietate sua et a via sua impia, ipse quidem in iniquitate sua morietur : tu autem animam tuam liberasti.
text_pt: Mas, se avisares ao ímpio, e ele não se converter da sua impiedade e do seu mau caminho, ele morrerá na sua iniqüidade, mas tu livraste a tua alma.
text_el: καὶ σὺ ἐὰν διαστείλῃ τῷ ἀνόμῳ καὶ μὴ ἀποστρέψῃ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀνομίας αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἄνομος ἐκεῖνος ἐν τῇ ἀδικίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀποθανεῖται καὶ σὺ τὴν ψυχήν σου ῥύσῃ

text_en: Moreover if the just man shall turn away from his justice , and shall commit iniquity : I will lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die, because you have not given him warning: he shall die in his sin , and his justices which he has done, shall not be remembered: but I will require his blood at your hand.
text_la: Sed et si conversus justus a justitia sua fuerit, et fecerit iniquitatem, ponam offendiculum coram eo : ipse morietur quia non annuntiasti ei. In peccato suo morietur, et non erunt in memoria justitiæ ejus quas fecit : sanguinem vero ejus de manu tua requiram.
text_pt: Semelhantemente, quando o justo se desviar da sua justiça, e cometer a iniqüidade, e eu puser diante dele um tropeço, ele morrerá: porque tu não o avisaste, no seu pecado morrerá; e suas justiças, que tiver praticado, não serão lembradas, mas o seu sangue, da tua mão o requererei.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέφειν δίκαιον ἀπὸ τῶν δικαιοσυνῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιήσῃ παράπτωμα καὶ δώσω τὴν βάσανον εἰς πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς ἀποθανεῖται ὅτι οὐ διεστείλω αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτοῦ ἀποθανεῖται διότι οὐ μὴ μνησθῶσιν αἱ δικαιοσύναι αὐτοῦ ἃς ἐποίησεν καὶ τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς χειρός σου ἐκζητήσω

text_en: But if you warn the just man , that the just may not sin , and he does not sin : living he shall live, because you have warned him, and you have delivered your soul .
text_la: Si autem tu annuntiaveris justo ut non peccet justus, et ille non peccaverit, vivens vivet, quia annuntiasti ei, et tu animam tuam liberasti.
text_pt: Mas, avisando tu o justo, para que não peque, e ele não pecar, certamente viverá; porque foi avisado; e tu livraste a tua alma.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἐὰν διαστείλῃ τῷ δικαίῳ τοῦ μὴ ἁμαρτεῖν καὶ αὐτὸς μὴ ἁμάρτῃ ὁ δίκαιος ζωῇ ζήσεται ὅτι διεστείλω αὐτῷ καὶ σὺ τὴν σεαυτοῦ ψυχὴν ῥύσῃ

text_en: And the hand of the Lord was upon me, and he said to me: Rise and go forth into the plain, and there I will speak to you.
text_la: Et facta est super me manus Domini, et dixit ad me : Surgens egredere in campum, et ibi loquar tecum.
text_pt: E a mão do Senhor estava sobre mim ali, e ele me disse: Levanta-te, e sai ao vale, e ali falarei contigo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπ' ἐμὲ χεὶρ κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ἀνάστηθι καὶ ἔξελθε εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ἐκεῖ λαληθήσεται πρὸς σέ

text_en: And I rose up, and went forth into the plain: and behold the glory of the Lord stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chobar: and I fell upon my face.
text_la: Et surgens egressus sum in campum : et ecce ibi gloria Domini stabat, quasi gloria quam vidi juxta fluvium Chobar : et cecidi in faciem meam.
text_pt: E levantei-me, e saí ao vale, e eis que a glória do Senhor estava ali, como a glória que vi junto ao rio Quebar; e caí sobre o meu rosto.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστην καὶ ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐκεῖ δόξα κυρίου εἱστήκει καθὼς ἡ ὅρασις καὶ καθὼς ἡ δόξα ἣν εἶδον ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ Χοβαρ καὶ πίπτω ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου

text_en: And the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet: and he spoke to me, and said to me: Go in; and shut yourself up in the midst of your house.
text_la: Et ingressus est in me spiritus, et statuit me super pedes meos, et locutus est mihi, et dixit ad me : Ingredere, et includere in medio domus tuæ.
text_pt: Então entrou em mim o Espírito, e me pôs em pé, e falou comigo, e me disse: Entra, encerra-te dentro da tua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ πνεῦμα καὶ ἔστησέν με ἐπὶ πόδας μου καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρός με καὶ εἶπέν μοι εἴσελθε καὶ ἐγκλείσθητι ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου σου

text_en: And you, O son of man , behold they shall put bands upon you, and they shall bind you with them: and you shall not go forth from the midst of them.
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, ecce data sunt super te vincula, et ligabunt te in eis, et non egredieris de medio eorum.
text_pt: E quanto a ti, ó filho do homem, eis que porão cordas sobre ti, e te ligarão com elas; não sairás, pois, ao meio deles.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἰδοὺ δέδονται ἐπὶ σὲ δεσμοί καὶ δήσουσίν σε ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will make your tongue stick fast to the roof of your mouth, and you shall be dumb, and not as a man that reproves: because they are a provoking house.
text_la: Et linguam tuam adhærere faciam palato tuo, et eris mutus, nec quasi vir objurgans, quia domus exasperans est.
text_pt: E eu farei que a tua língua se pegue ao teu paladar, e ficarás mudo, e não lhes servirás de repreendedor; porque eles são casa rebelde.
text_el: καὶ τὴν γλῶσσάν σου συνδήσω καὶ ἀποκωφωθήσῃ καὶ οὐκ ἔσῃ αὐτοῖς εἰς ἄνδρα ἐλέγχοντα διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν

text_en: But when I shall speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord God : He that hears, let him hear: and he that forbears, let him forbear: for they are a provoking house.
text_la: Cum autem locutus fuero tibi, aperiam os tuum, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Qui audit, audiat, et qui quiescit, quiescat : quia domus exasperans est.
text_pt: Mas, quando eu falar contigo, abrirei a tua boca, e lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quem ouvir ouça, e quem deixar de ouvir, deixe; porque eles são casa rebelde.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ λαλεῖν με πρὸς σὲ ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα σου καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ ἀκούων ἀκουέτω καὶ ὁ ἀπειθῶν ἀπειθείτω διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν

text_en: And you, O son of man , take you a tile, and lay it before you: and draw upon it the plan of the city of Jerusalem .
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, sume tibi laterem, et pones eum coram te, et describes in eo civitatem Jerusalem.
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, toma um tijolo, e pô-lo-ás diante de ti, e grava nele a cidade de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου λαβὲ σεαυτῷ πλίνθον καὶ θήσεις αὐτὴν πρὸ προσώπου σου καὶ διαγράψεις ἐπ' αὐτὴν πόλιν τὴν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And lay siege against it, and build forts, and cast up a mount, and set a camp against it, and place battering rams round about it.
text_la: Et ordinabis adversus eam obsidionem, et ædificabis munitiones, et comportabis aggerem, et dabis contra eam castra, et pones arietes in gyro.
text_pt: E põe contra ela um cerco, e edifica contra ela uma fortificação, e levanta contra ela uma trincheira, e põe contra ela arraiais, e põe-lhe aríetes em redor.
text_el: καὶ δώσεις ἐπ' αὐτὴν περιοχὴν καὶ οἰκοδομήσεις ἐπ' αὐτὴν προμαχῶνας καὶ περιβαλεῖς ἐπ' αὐτὴν χάρακα καὶ δώσεις ἐπ' αὐτὴν παρεμβολὰς καὶ τάξεις τὰς βελοστάσεις κύκλῳ

text_en: And take unto you an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city: and set your face resolutely against it, and it shall be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it: it is a sign to the house of Israel .
text_la: Et tu sume tibi sartaginem ferream, et pones eam in murum ferreum inter te et inter civitatem : et obfirmabis faciem tuam ad eam, et erit in obsidionem, et circumdabis eam : signum est domui Israël.
text_pt: E tu toma uma sertã de ferro, e põe-na por muro de ferro entre ti e a cidade; e dirige para ela o teu rosto, e assim será cercada, e a cercarás; isto servirá de sinal à casa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ σὺ λαβὲ σεαυτῷ τήγανον σιδηροῦν καὶ θήσεις αὐτὸ τοῖχον σιδηροῦν ἀνὰ μέσον σοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἑτοιμάσεις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπ' αὐτήν καὶ ἔσται ἐν συγκλεισμῷ καὶ συγκλείσεις αὐτήν σημεῖόν ἐστιν τοῦτο τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And you shall sleep upon your left side, and shall lay the iniquities of the house of Israel upon it, according to the number of the days that you shall sleep upon it, and you shall take upon you their iniquity .
text_la: Et tu dormies super latus tuum sinistrum, et pones iniquitates domus Israël super eo, numero dierum quibus dormies super illud : et assumes iniquitatem eorum.
text_pt: Tu também deita-te sobre o teu lado esquerdo, e põe a iniqüidade da casa de Israel sobre ele; conforme o número dos dias que te deitares sobre ele, levarás as suas iniqüidades.
text_el: καὶ σὺ κοιμηθήσῃ ἐπὶ τὸ πλευρόν σου τὸ ἀριστερὸν καὶ θήσεις τὰς ἀδικίας τοῦ οἴκου Ισραηλ ἐπ' αὐτοῦ κατὰ ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἡμερῶν πεντήκοντα καὶ ἑκατόν ἃς κοιμηθήσῃ ἐπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ λήμψῃ τὰς ἀδικίας αὐτῶν

text_en: And I have laid upon you the years of their iniquity , according to the number of the days three hundred and ninety days: and you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel .
text_la: Ego autem dedi tibi annos iniquitatis eorum, numero dierum trecentos et nonaginta dies : et portabis iniquitatem domus Israël.
text_pt: Porque eu já te tenho fixado os anos da sua iniqüidade, conforme o número dos dias, trezentos e noventa dias; e levarás a iniqüidade da casa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ δέδωκά σοι τὰς δύο ἀδικίας αὐτῶν εἰς ἀριθμὸν ἡμερῶν ἐνενήκοντα καὶ ἑκατὸν ἡμέρας καὶ λήμψῃ τὰς ἀδικίας τοῦ οἴκου Ισραηλ

text_en: And when you have accomplished this, you shall sleep again upon your right side, and you shall take upon you the iniquity of the house of Juda forty days: a day for a year, yea, a day for a year I have appointed to you.
text_la: Et cum compleveris hæc, dormies super latus tuum dexterum secundo, et assumes iniquitatem domus Juda quadraginta diebus : diem pro anno, diem, inquam, pro anno, dedi tibi.
text_pt: E, quando tiveres cumprido estes dias, tornar-te-ás a deitar sobre o teu lado direito, e levarás a iniqüidade da casa de Judá quarenta dias; um dia te dei para cada ano.
text_el: καὶ συντελέσεις ταῦτα πάντα καὶ κοιμηθήσῃ ἐπὶ τὸ πλευρόν σου τὸ δεξιὸν καὶ λήμψῃ τὰς ἀδικίας τοῦ οἴκου Ιουδα τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας ἡμέραν εἰς ἐνιαυτὸν τέθεικά σοι

text_en: And you shall turn your face to the siege of Jerusalem and your arm shall be stretched out: and you shall prophesy against it.
text_la: Et ad obsidionem Jerusalem convertes faciem tuam, et brachium tuum erit extentum : et prophetabis adversus eam.
text_pt: Dirigirás, pois, o teu rosto para o cerco de Jerusalém, com o teu braço descoberto, e profetizarás contra ela.
text_el: καὶ εἰς τὸν συγκλεισμὸν Ιερουσαλημ ἑτοιμάσεις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ τὸν βραχίονά σου στερεώσεις καὶ προφητεύσεις ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: Behold I have encompassed you with bands: and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, till you have ended the days of your siege.
text_la: Ecce circumdedi te vinculis : et non te convertes a latere tuo in latus aliud, donec compleas dies obsidionis tuæ.
text_pt: E eis que porei sobre ti cordas; assim tu não te voltarás de um lado para o outro, até que cumpras os dias do teu cerco.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ἐπὶ σὲ δεσμούς καὶ μὴ στραφῇς ἀπὸ τοῦ πλευροῦ σου ἐπὶ τὸ πλευρόν σου ἕως οὗ συντελεσθῶσιν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ συγκλεισμοῦ σου

text_en: And take to you wheat and barley, and beans, and lentils, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make you bread thereof according to the number of the days that you shall lie upon your side: three hundred and ninety days shall you eat thereof.
text_la: Et tu, sume tibi frumentum, et hordeum, et fabam, et lentem, et milium, et viciam : et mittes ea in vas unum, et facies tibi panes numero dierum quibus dormies super latus tuum : trecentis et nonaginta diebus comedes illud.
text_pt: E tu, toma trigo, e cevada, e favas, e lentilhas, e milho e aveia, e coloca-os numa vasilha, e faze deles pão; conforme o número dos dias que tu te deitares sobre o teu lado, trezentos e noventa dias, comerás disso.
text_el: καὶ σὺ λαβὲ σεαυτῷ πυροὺς καὶ κριθὰς καὶ κύαμον καὶ φακὸν καὶ κέγχρον καὶ ὄλυραν καὶ ἐμβαλεῖς αὐτὰ εἰς ἄγγος ἓν ὀστράκινον καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτὰ σαυτῷ εἰς ἄρτους καὶ κατ' ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἡμερῶν ἃς σὺ καθεύδεις ἐπὶ τοῦ πλευροῦ σου ἐνενήκοντα καὶ ἑκατὸν ἡμέρας φάγεσαι αὐτά

text_en: And your meat that you shall eat, shall be in weight twenty staters a day: from time to time you shall eat it.
text_la: Cibus autem tuus, quo vesceris, erit in pondere viginti stateres in die : a tempore usque ad tempus comedes illud.
text_pt: E a tua comida, que hás de comer, será do peso de vinte siclos por dia; de tempo em tempo a comerás.
text_el: καὶ τὸ βρῶμά σου ὃ φάγεσαι ἐν σταθμῷ εἴκοσι σίκλους τὴν ἡμέραν ἀπὸ καιροῦ ἕως καιροῦ φάγεσαι αὐτά

text_en: And you shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin: from time to time you shall drink it,
text_la: Et aquam in mensura bibes, sextam partem hin : a tempore usque ad tempus bibes illud.
text_pt: Também beberás a água por medida, a saber, a sexta parte de um him; de tempo em tempo beberás.
text_el: καὶ ὕδωρ ἐν μέτρῳ πίεσαι τὸ ἕκτον τοῦ ιν ἀπὸ καιροῦ ἕως καιροῦ πίεσαι

text_en: and you shall eat it as barley bread baked under the ashes: and you shall cover it, in their sight, with the dung that comes out of a man .
text_la: Et quasi subcinericium hordeaceum comedes illud, et stercore quod egreditur de homine operies illud in oculis eorum.
text_pt: E o que comeres será como bolos de cevada, e cozê-los-ás sobre o esterco que sai do homem, diante dos olhos deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐγκρυφίαν κρίθινον φάγεσαι αὐτά ἐν βολβίτοις κόπρου ἀνθρωπίνης ἐγκρύψεις αὐτὰ κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Lord said: So shall the children of Israel eat their bread all filthy among the nations whither I will cast them out.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus : Sic comedent filii Israël panem suum pollutum inter gentes ad quas ejiciam eos. Et dixi:
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Assim comerão os filhos de Israel o seu pão imundo, entre os gentios para onde os lançarei.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ισραηλ οὕτως φάγονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀκάθαρτα ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: And I said: Ah, ah, ah, O Lord God , behold my soul has not been defiled, and from my infancy even till now, I have not eaten anything that died of itself, or was torn by beasts, and no unclean flesh has entered into my mouth.
text_la: A, a, a, Domine Deus, ecce anima mea non est polluta : et morticinum, et laceratum a bestiis non comedi ab infantia mea usque nunc, et non est ingressa in os meum omnis caro immunda.
text_pt: Então disse eu: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Eis que a minha alma não foi contaminada, pois desde a minha mocidade até agora, nunca comi daquilo que morrer de si mesmo, ou que é despedaçado por feras; nem carne abominável entrou na minha boca.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα μηδαμῶς κύριε θεὲ τοῦ Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἡ ψυχή μου οὐ μεμίανται ἐν ἀκαθαρσίᾳ καὶ θνησιμαῖον καὶ θηριάλωτον οὐ βέβρωκα ἀπὸ γενέσεώς μου ἕως τοῦ νῦν οὐδὲ εἰσελήλυθεν εἰς τὸ στόμα μου πᾶν κρέας ἕωλον

text_en: And he said to me: Behold I have given you neat's dung for man's dung, and you shall make your bread therewith.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Ecce dedi tibi fimum boum pro stercoribus humanis, et facies panem tuum in eo.
text_pt: E disse-me: Vê, dei-te esterco de vacas, em lugar de esterco de homem; e sobre ele prepararás o teu pão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ἰδοὺ δέδωκά σοι βόλβιτα βοῶν ἀντὶ τῶν βολβίτων τῶν ἀνθρωπίνων καὶ ποιήσεις τοὺς ἄρτους σου ἐπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man : Behold, I will break in pieces the staff of bread in Jerusalem : and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care: and they shall drink water by measure, and in distress.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, ecce ego conteram baculum panis in Jerusalem, et comedent panem in pondere et in sollicitudine, et aquam in mensura et in angustia bibent,
text_pt: Disse-me ainda: Filho do homem, eis que eu quebrarei o sustento de pão em Jerusalém, e comerão o pão por peso, e com ansiedade; e a água beberão por medida, e com espanto;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ συντρίβω στήριγμα ἄρτου ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ φάγονται ἄρτον ἐν σταθμῷ καὶ ἐν ἐνδείᾳ καὶ ὕδωρ ἐν μέτρῳ καὶ ἐν ἀφανισμῷ πίονται

text_en: So that when bread and water fail, every man may fall against his brother, and they may pine away in their iniquities .
text_la: ut deficientibus pane et aqua, corruat unusquisque ad fratrem suum, et contabescant in iniquitatibus suis.
text_pt: Para que lhes falte o pão e a água, e se espantem uns com os outros, e se consumam nas suas iniqüidades.
text_el: ὅπως ἐνδεεῖς γένωνται ἄρτου καὶ ὕδατος καὶ ἀφανισθήσεται ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τακήσονται ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: And you, son of man , take you a sharp knife that shaves the hair: and cause it to pass over your head, and over your beard : and take you a balance to weigh in, and divide the hair.
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, sume tibi gladium acutum, radentem pilos, et assumes eum et duces per caput tuum et per barbam tuam, et assumes tibi stateram ponderis et divides eos.
text_pt: E tu, ó filho do homem, toma uma faca afiada, como navalha de barbeiro, e a farás passar pela tua cabeça e pela tua barba; então tomarás uma balança de peso, e repartirás os cabelos.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου λαβὲ σεαυτῷ ῥομφαίαν ὀξεῖαν ὑπὲρ ξυρὸν κουρέως κτήσῃ αὐτὴν σεαυτῷ καὶ ἐπάξεις αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν πώγωνά σου καὶ λήμψῃ ζυγὸν σταθμίων καὶ διαστήσεις αὐτούς

text_en: A third part you shall burn with fire in the midst of the city, according to the fulfilling of the days of the siege: and you shall take a third part, and cut it in pieces with the knife all round about: and the other third part you shall scatter in the wind, and I will draw out the sword after them.
text_la: Tertiam partem igni combures in medio civitatis, juxta completionem dierum obsidionis, et assumes tertiam partem, et concides gladio in circuitu ejus : tertiam vero aliam disperges in ventum, et gladium nudabo post eos.
text_pt: Uma terça parte queimarás no fogo, no meio da cidade, quando se cumprirem os dias do cerco; então tomarás outra terça parte, e feri-la-ás com uma faca ao redor dela; e a outra terça parte espalharás ao vento; porque desembainharei a espada atrás deles.
text_el: τὸ τέταρτον ἐν πυρὶ ἀνακαύσεις ἐν μέσῃ τῇ πόλει κατὰ τὴν πλήρωσιν τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῦ συγκλεισμοῦ καὶ λήμψῃ τὸ τέταρτον καὶ κατακαύσεις αὐτὸ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ τέταρτον κατακόψεις ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ τέταρτον διασκορπίσεις τῷ πνεύματι καὶ μάχαιραν ἐκκενώσω ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall take thereof a small number: and shall bind them in the skirt of your cloak.
text_la: Et sumes inde parvum numerum, et ligabis eos in summitate pallii tui:
text_pt: Também tomarás dali um pequeno número, e atá-los-ás nas bordas do teu manto.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ ἐκεῖθεν ὀλίγους ἐν ἀριθμῷ καὶ συμπεριλήμψῃ αὐτοὺς τῇ ἀναβολῇ σου

text_en: And you shall take of them again, and shall cast them in the midst of the fire, and shall burn them with fire: and out of it shall come forth a fire into all the house of Israel .
text_la: et ex eis rursum tolles, et projicies eos in medio ignis, et combures eos igni, et ex eo egredietur ignis in omnem domum Israël.
text_pt: E ainda destes tomarás alguns, e os lançarás no meio do fogo e os queimarás a fogo; e dali sairá um fogo contra toda a casa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τούτων λήμψῃ ἔτι καὶ ῥίψεις αὐτοὺς εἰς μέσον τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ κατακαύσεις αὐτοὺς ἐν πυρί ἐξ αὐτῆς ἐξελεύσεται πῦρ καὶ ἐρεῖς παντὶ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : This is Jerusalem , I have set her in the midst of the nations, and the countries round about her.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ista est Jerusalem : in medio gentium posui eam, et in circuitu ejus terras.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Esta é Jerusalém; coloquei-a no meio das nações e das terras que estão ao redor dela.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος αὕτη ἡ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἐθνῶν τέθεικα αὐτὴν καὶ τὰς κύκλῳ αὐτῆς χώρας

text_en: And she has despised my judgments, so as to be more wicked than the Gentiles ; and my commandments , more than the countries that are round about her: for they have cast off my judgments, and have not walked in my commandments .
text_la: Et contempsit judicia mea, ut plus esset impia quam gentes, et præcepta mea ultra quam terræ quæ in circuitu ejus sunt : judicia enim mea projecerunt, et in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt.
text_pt: Ela, porém, mudou em impiedade os meus juízos, mais do que as nações, e os meus estatutos mais do que as terras que estão ao redor dela; porque rejeitaram os meus juízos e os meus estatutos, e não andaram neles.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τὰ δικαιώματά μου τῇ ἀνόμῳ ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ τὰ νόμιμά μου ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν τῶν κύκλῳ αὐτῆς διότι τὰ δικαιώματά μου ἀπώσαντο καὶ ἐν τοῖς νομίμοις μου οὐκ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have surpassed the Gentiles that are round about you, and have not walked in my commandments , and have not kept my judgments, and have not done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you:
text_la: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia superastis gentes quæ in circuitu vestro sunt, et in præceptis meis non ambulastis, et judicia mea non fecistis, et juxta judicia gentium quæ in circuitu vestro sunt non estis operati,
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porque multiplicastes mais do que as nações, que estão ao redor de vós, e não andastes nos meus estatutos, nem guardastes os meus juízos, nem ainda procedestes segundo os juízos das nações que estão ao redor de vós;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἡ ἀφορμὴ ὑμῶν ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν κύκλῳ ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς νομίμοις μου οὐκ ἐπορεύθητε καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου οὐκ ἐποιήσατε ἀλλ' οὐδὲ κατὰ τὰ δικαιώματα τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν κύκλῳ ὑμῶν οὐ πεποιήκατε

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold I come against you, and I myself will execute judgments in the midst of you in the sight of the Gentiles .
text_la: ideo hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad te, et ipse ego faciam in medio tui judicia in oculis gentium:
text_pt: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu, sim eu, estou contra ti; e executarei juízos no meio de ti aos olhos das nações.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ποιήσω ἐν μέσῳ σου κρίμα ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: And I will do in you that which I have not done: and the like to which I will do no more, because of all your abominations .
text_la: et faciam in te quod non feci, et quibus similia ultra non faciam, propter omnes abominationes tuas.
text_pt: E farei em ti o que nunca fiz, e o que jamais farei, por causa de todas as tuas abominações.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσω ἐν σοὶ ἃ οὐ πεποίηκα καὶ ἃ οὐ ποιήσω ὅμοια αὐτοῖς ἔτι κατὰ πάντα τὰ βδελύγματά σου

text_en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of you, and the sons shall eat their fathers: and I will execute judgments in you, and I will scatter your whole remnant into every wind.
text_la: Ideo patres comedent filios in medio tui, et filii comedent patres suos : et faciam in te judicia, et ventilabo universas reliquias tuas in omnem ventum.
text_pt: Portanto os pais comerão a seus filhos no meio de ti, e os filhos comerão a seus pais; e executarei em ti juízos, e tudo o que restar de ti, espalharei a todos os ventos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πατέρες φάγονται τέκνα ἐν μέσῳ σου καὶ τέκνα φάγονται πατέρας καὶ ποιήσω ἐν σοὶ κρίματα καὶ διασκορπιῶ πάντας τοὺς καταλοίπους σου εἰς πάντα ἄνεμον

text_en: Therefore as I live, says the Lord God : Because you have violated my sanctuary with all your offences , and with all your abominations: I will also break you in pieces, and my eye shall not spare, and I will not have any pity.
text_la: Idcirco vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, nisi pro eo quod sanctum meum violasti in omnibus offensionibus tuis et in cunctis abominationibus tuis, ego quoque confringam : et non parcet oculus meus, et non miserebor.
text_pt: Portanto, como eu vivo, diz o Senhor DEUS, certamente, porquanto profanaste o meu santuário com todas as tuas coisas detestáveis, e com todas as tuas abominações, também eu te diminuirei, e o meu olho não te perdoará, nem também terei piedade.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος εἰ μὴ ἀνθ' ὧν τὰ ἅγιά μου ἐμίανας ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς βδελύγμασίν σου κἀγὼ ἀπώσομαί σε οὐ φείσεταί μου ὁ ὀφθαλμός κἀγὼ οὐκ ἐλεήσω

text_en: A third part of you shall die with the pestilence, and shall be consumed with famine in the midst of you: and a third part of you shall fall by the sword round about you: and a third part of you will I scatter into every wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
text_la: Tertia pars tui peste morietur, et fame consumetur in medio tui, et tertia pars tui in gladio cadet in circuitu tuo : tertiam vero partem tuam in omnem ventum dispergam, et gladium evaginabo post eos.
text_pt: Uma terça parte de ti morrerá de peste, e se consumirá de fome no meio de ti; e outra terça parte cairá à espada em redor de ti; e a outra terça parte espalharei a todos os ventos, e desembainharei a espada atrás deles.
text_el: τὸ τέταρτόν σου ἐν θανάτῳ ἀναλωθήσεται καὶ τὸ τέταρτόν σου ἐν λιμῷ συντελεσθήσεται ἐν μέσῳ σου καὶ τὸ τέταρτόν σου εἰς πάντα ἄνεμον σκορπιῶ αὐτούς καὶ τὸ τέταρτόν σου ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσοῦνται κύκλῳ σου καὶ μάχαιραν ἐκκενώσω ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will accomplish my fury , and will cause my indignation to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the Lord have spoken it in my zeal , when I shall have accomplished my indignation in them.
text_la: Et complebo furorem meum, et requiescere faciam indignationem meam in eis, et consolabor : et scient quia ego Dominus locutus sum in zelo meo, cum implevero indignationem meam in eis.
text_pt: Assim se cumprirá a minha ira, e satisfarei neles o meu furor, e me consolarei; e saberão que eu, o Senhor, tenho falado no meu zelo, quando eu cumprir neles o meu furor.
text_el: καὶ συντελεσθήσεται ὁ θυμός μου καὶ ἡ ὀργή μου ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ διότι ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα ἐν ζήλῳ μου ἐν τῷ συντελέσαι με τὴν ὀργήν μου ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And I will make you desolate, and a reproach among the nations that are round about you, in the sight of every one that passes by.
text_la: Et dabo te in desertum, et in opprobrium gentibus quæ in circuitu tuo sunt, in conspectu omnis prætereuntis:
text_pt: E pôr-te-ei em desolação, e por objeto de opróbrio entre as nações que estão em redor de ti, aos olhos de todos os que passarem.
text_el: καὶ θήσομαί σε εἰς ἔρημον καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας σου κύκλῳ σου ἐνώπιον παντὸς διοδεύοντος

text_en: And you shall be a reproach, and a scoff, an example, and an astonishment amongst the nations that are round about you, when I shall have executed judgments in you in anger , and in indignation, and in wrathful rebukes.
text_la: et eris opprobrium et blasphemia, exemplum et stupor in gentibus quæ in circuitu tuo sunt, cum fecero in te judicia in furore, et in indignatione, et in increpationibus iræ.
text_pt: E será objeto de opróbrio e blasfêmia, instrução e espanto às nações que estão em redor de ti, quando eu executar em ti juízos com ira, e com furor, e com terríveis castigos. Eu, o Senhor, falei.
text_el: καὶ ἔσῃ στενακτὴ καὶ δηλαϊστὴ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τοῖς κύκλῳ σου ἐν τῷ ποιῆσαί με ἐν σοὶ κρίματα ἐν ἐκδικήσει θυμοῦ μου ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα

text_en: I the Lord have spoken it: When I shall send upon them the grievous arrows of famine, which shall bring death, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will gather together famine against you: and I will break among you the staff of bread.
text_la: Ego Dominus locutus sum : quando misero sagittas famis pessimas in eos, quæ erunt mortiferæ, et quas mittam ut disperdam vos : et famem congregabo super vos, et conteram in vobis baculum panis:
text_pt: Quando eu enviar as malignas flechas da fome contra eles, que servirão para destruição, as quais eu mandarei para vos destruir, então aumentarei a fome sobre vós, e vos quebrarei o sustento do pão.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐξαποστεῖλαί με τὰς βολίδας μου τοῦ λιμοῦ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔσονται εἰς ἔκλειψιν καὶ συντρίψω στήριγμα ἄρτου σου

text_en: And I will send in upon you famine, and evil beasts unto utter destruction: and pestilence, and blood shall pass through you, and I will bring in the sword upon you. I the Lord have spoken it.
text_la: et immittam in vos famem et bestias pessimas, usque ad internecionem : et pestilentia et sanguis transibunt per te, et gladium inducam super te. Ego Dominus locutus sum.
text_pt: E enviarei sobre vós a fome, e as feras que te desfilharão; e a peste e o sangue passarão por ti; e trarei a espada sobre ti. Eu, o Senhor, falei.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ ἐπὶ σὲ λιμὸν καὶ θηρία πονηρὰ καὶ τιμωρήσομαί σε καὶ θάνατος καὶ αἷμα διελεύσονται ἐπὶ σέ καὶ ῥομφαίαν ἐπάξω ἐπὶ σὲ κυκλόθεν ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man set your face towards the mountains of Israel , and prophesy against them.
text_la: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam ad montes Israël, et prophetabis ad eos,
text_pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto para os montes de Israel, e profetiza contra eles.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη Ισραηλ καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ' αὐτὰ

text_en: And say: You mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord God : Thus says the Lord God to the mountains, and to the hills, and to the rocks, and the valleys: Behold, I will bring upon you the sword, and I will destroy your high places.
text_la: et dices : Montes Israël, audite verbum Domini Dei. Hæc dicit Dominus Deus montibus et collibus, rupibus et vallibus : Ecce ego inducam super vos gladium, et disperdam excelsa vestra,
text_pt: E dirás: Montes de Israel, ouvi a palavra do Senhor DEUS: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS aos montes, aos outeiros, aos ribeiros e aos vales: Eis que eu, sim eu, trarei a espada sobre vós, e destruirei os vossos lugares altos.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τὰ ὄρη Ισραηλ ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου τάδε λέγει κύριος τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς καὶ ταῖς φάραγξιν καὶ ταῖς νάπαις ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ῥομφαίαν καὶ ἐξολεθρευθήσεται τὰ ὑψηλὰ ὑμῶν

text_en: And I will throw down your altars , and your idols shall be broken in pieces: and I will cast down your slain before your idols .
text_la: et demoliar aras vestras, et confringentur simulacra vestra, et dejiciam interfectos vestros ante idola vestra :
text_pt: E serão assolados os vossos altares, e quebradas as vossas imagens do sol e derrubarei os vossos mortos, diante dos vossos ídolos.
text_el: καὶ συντριβήσονται τὰ θυσιαστήρια ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ τεμένη ὑμῶν καὶ καταβαλῶ τραυματίας ὑμῶν ἐνώπιον τῶν εἰδώλων ὑμῶν

text_en: And I will lay the dead carcasses of the children of Israel before your idols : and I will scatter your bones round about your altars ,
text_la: et dabo cadavera filiorum Israël ante faciem simulacrorum vestrorum, et dispergam ossa vestra circum aras vestras :
text_pt: E porei os cadáveres dos filhos de Israel diante dos seus ídolos; e espalharei os vossos ossos em redor dos vossos altares.
text_el: καὶ διασκορπιῶ τὰ ὀστᾶ ὑμῶν κύκλῳ τῶν θυσιαστηρίων ὑμῶν

text_en: in all your dwelling places. The cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be thrown down, and destroyed, and your altars shall be abolished, and shall be broken in pieces: and your idols shall be no more, and your temples shall be destroyed, and your works shall be defaced.
text_la: in omnibus habitationibus vestris urbes desertæ erunt, et excelsa demolientur et dissipabuntur : et interibunt aræ vestræ, et confringentur, et cessabunt idola vestra, et conterentur delubra vestra, et delebuntur opera vestra :
text_pt: Em todos os vossos lugares habitáveis, as cidades serão destruídas, e os lugares altos assolados; para que os vossos altares sejam destruídos e assolados, e os vossos ídolos se quebrem e se acabem, e as vossas imagens sejam cortadas, e desfeitas as vossas obras.
text_el: ἐν πάσῃ τῇ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν αἱ πόλεις ἐξερημωθήσονται καὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἀφανισθήσεται ὅπως ἐξολεθρευθῇ τὰ θυσιαστήρια ὑμῶν καὶ συντριβήσονται τὰ εἴδωλα ὑμῶν καὶ ἐξαρθήσεται τὰ τεμένη ὑμῶν

text_en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: et cadet interfectus in medio vestri, et scietis quia ego sum Dominus.
text_pt: E os mortos cairão no meio de vós, para que saibais que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πεσοῦνται τραυματίαι ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And I will leave in you some that shall escape the sword among the nations , when I shall have scattered you through the countries.
text_la: Et relinquam in vobis eos qui fugerint gladium in gentibus, cum dispersero vos in terris :
text_pt: Porém deixarei um remanescente, para que tenhais entre as nações alguns que escaparem da espada, quando fordes espalhados pelas terras.
text_el: ἐν τῷ γενέσθαι ἐξ ὑμῶν ἀνασῳζομένους ἐκ ῥομφαίας ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐν τῷ διασκορπισμῷ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς χώραις

text_en: And they that are saved of you shall remember me amongst the nations , to which they are carried captives : because I have broken their heart that was faithless, and revolted from me: and their eyes that went a fornicating after their idols : and they shall be displeased with themselves because of the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
text_la: et recordabuntur mei liberati vestri in gentibus ad quas captivi ducti sunt : quia contrivi cor eorum fornicans et recedens a me, et oculos eorum fornicantes post idola sua : et displicebunt sibimet super malis quæ fecerunt in universis abominationibus suis.
text_pt: Então os que dentre vós escaparem se lembrarão de mim entre as nações para onde foram levados em cativeiro; porquanto me quebrantei por causa do seu coração corrompido, que se desviou de mim, e por causa dos seus olhos, que andaram se corrompendo após os seus ídolos; e terão nojo de si mesmos, por causa das maldades que fizeram em todas as suas abominações.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσονταί μου οἱ ἀνασῳζόμενοι ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὗ ᾐχμαλωτεύθησαν ἐκεῖ ὀμώμοκα τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν τῇ ἐκπορνευούσῃ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν τοῖς πορνεύουσιν ὀπίσω τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν καὶ κόψονται πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς βδελύγμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall know that I the Lord have not spoken in vain that I would do this evil to them.
text_la: Et scient quia ego Dominus non frustra locutus sum, ut facerem eis malum hoc.
text_pt: E saberão que eu sou o Senhor, e que não disse debalde que lhes faria este mal.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Strike with your hand and stamp with your foot, and say: Alas, for all the abominations of the evils of the house of Israel : for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Percute manum tuam et allide pedem tuum, et dic : Heu! ad omnes abominationes malorum domus Israël : quia gladio, fame et peste ruituri sunt.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Bate com a mão, e bate com o teu pé, e dize: Ah! Por todas as grandes abominações da casa de Israel! Porque cairão à espada, e de fome, e de peste.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κρότησον τῇ χειρὶ καὶ ψόφησον τῷ ποδὶ καὶ εἰπόν εὖγε εὖγε ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς βδελύγμασιν οἴκου Ισραηλ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ πεσοῦνται

text_en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence: and he that is near, shall fall by the sword: and he that remains, and is besieged, shall die by the famine: and I will accomplish my indignation upon them.
text_la: Qui longe est, peste morietur : qui autem prope, gladio corruet : et qui relictus fuerit et obsessus, fame morietur : et complebo indignationem meam in eis.
text_pt: O que estiver longe morrerá de peste, e o que está perto cairá à espada; e o que restar e ficar cercado morrerá de fome; assim cumprirei o meu furor sobre eles.
text_el: ὁ ἐγγὺς ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσεῖται ὁ δὲ μακρὰν ἐν θανάτῳ τελευτήσει καὶ ὁ περιεχόμενος ἐν λιμῷ συντελεσθήσεται καὶ συντελέσω τὴν ὀργήν μου ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when your slain shall be amongst your idols , round about your altars , in every high hill, and on all the tops of mountains, and under every woody tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they burnt sweet smelling frankincense to all their idols .
text_la: Et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum fuerint interfecti vestri in medio idolorum vestrorum, in circuitu ararum vestrarum, in omni colle excelso, et in cunctis summitatibus montium, et subtus omne lignum nemorosum, et subtus universam quercum frondosam, locum ubi accenderunt thura redolentia universis idolis suis.
text_pt: Então sabereis que eu sou o Senhor, quando os seus mortos estiverem no meio dos seus ídolos, em redor dos seus altares, em todo o outeiro alto, em todos os cumes dos montes, e debaixo de toda a árvore verde, e debaixo de todo o carvalho frondoso, no lugar onde ofereciam cheiro suave a todos os seus ídolos.
text_el: καὶ γνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐν τῷ εἶναι τοὺς τραυματίας ὑμῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν εἰδώλων ὑμῶν κύκλῳ τῶν θυσιαστηρίων ὑμῶν ἐπὶ πάντα βουνὸν ὑψηλὸν καὶ ὑποκάτω δένδρου συσκίου οὗ ἔδωκαν ἐκεῖ ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας πᾶσι τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will stretch forth my hand upon them: and I will make the land desolate, and abandoned from the desert of Deblatha in all their dwelling places: and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et extendam manum meam super eos : et faciam terram desolatam et destitutam, a deserto Deblatha, in omnibus habitationibus eorum : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E estenderei a minha mão sobre eles, e farei a terra desolada, e mais devastada do que o deserto do lado de Dibla, em todas as suas habitações; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ θήσομαι τὴν γῆν εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ εἰς ὄλεθρον ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου Δεβλαθα ἐκ πάσης τῆς κατοικίας καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Depois veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: And you son of man , thus says the Lord God to the land of Israel : The end has come, the end has come upon the four quarters of the land.
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, hæc dicit Dominus Deus terræ Israël : Finis venit : venit finis super quatuor plagas terræ.
text_pt: E tu, ó filho do homem, assim diz o Senhor DEUS acerca da terra de Israel: Vem o fim, o fim vem sobre os quatro cantos da terra.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος τῇ γῇ τοῦ Ισραηλ πέρας ἥκει τὸ πέρας ἥκει ἐπὶ τὰς τέσσαρας πτέρυγας τῆς γῆς

text_en: Now is an end come upon you, and I will send my wrath upon you, and I will judge you according to your ways: and I will set all your abominations against you.
text_la: Nunc finis super te, et immittam furorem meum in te : et judicabo te juxta vias tuas, et ponam contra te omnes abominationes tuas.
text_pt: Agora vem o fim sobre ti, e enviarei sobre ti a minha ira, e te julgarei conforme os teus caminhos, e trarei sobre ti todas as tuas abominações.
text_el: ἥκει τὸ πέρας

text_en: And my eye shall not spare you, and I will show you no pity: but I will lay your ways upon you, and your abominations shall be in the midst of you: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et non parcet oculus meus super te, et non miserebor : sed vias tuas ponam super te, et abominationes tuæ in medio tui erunt, et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E não te poupará o meu olho, nem terei piedade de ti, mas porei sobre ti os teus caminhos, e as tuas abominações estarão no meio de ti; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ἐπὶ σὲ τὸν κατοικοῦντα τὴν γῆν ἥκει ὁ καιρός ἤγγικεν ἡ ἡμέρα οὐ μετὰ θορύβων οὐδὲ μετὰ ὠδίνων

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : One affliction, behold an affliction has come.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Afflictio una, afflictio ecce venit.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Um mal, eis que um só mal vem.
text_el: νῦν ἐγγύθεν ἐκχεῶ τὴν ὀργήν μου ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ συντελέσω τὸν θυμόν μου ἐν σοὶ καὶ κρινῶ σε ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς σου καὶ δώσω ἐπὶ σὲ πάντα τὰ βδελύγματά σου

text_en: An end has come, the end has come, it has awaked against you: behold it has come.
text_la: Finis venit, venit finis : evigilavit adversum te, ecce venit.
text_pt: Vem o fim, o fim vem, despertou-se contra ti; eis que vem.
text_el: οὐ φείσεται ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου οὐδὲ μὴ ἐλεήσω διότι τὰς ὁδούς σου ἐπὶ σὲ δώσω καὶ τὰ βδελύγματά σου ἐν μέσῳ σου ἔσονται καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ διότι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ τύπτων

text_en: Destruction has come upon you that dwell in the land: the time has come, the day of slaughter is near, and not of the joy of mountains.
text_la: Venit contritio super te, qui habitas in terra : venit tempus, prope est dies occisionis, et non gloriæ montium.
text_pt: A manhà vem para ti, ó habitante da terra. Vem o tempo; chegado é o dia da turbação, e não mais o sonido de alegria dos montes.
text_el: νῦν τὸ πέρας πρὸς σέ καὶ ἀποστελῶ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐκδικήσω σε ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς σου καὶ δώσω ἐπὶ σὲ πάντα τὰ βδελύγματά σου

text_en: Now very shortly I will pour out my wrath upon you, and I will accomplish my anger in you: and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will lay upon you all your crimes.
text_la: Nunc de propinquo effundam iram meam super te, et complebo furorem meum in te : et judicabo te juxta vias tuas, et imponam tibi omnia scelera tua,
text_pt: Agora depressa derramarei o meu furor sobre ti, e cumprirei a minha ira contra ti, e te julgarei conforme os teus caminhos, e porei sobre ti todas as tuas abominações.
text_el: οὐ φείσεται ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπὶ σέ οὐδὲ μὴ ἐλεήσω διότι τὴν ὁδόν σου ἐπὶ σὲ δώσω καὶ τὰ βδελύγματά σου ἐν μέσῳ σου ἔσται καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And my eye shall not spare, neither will I show mercy: but I will lay your ways upon you, and your abominations shall be in the midst of you: and you shall know that I am the Lord that strike.
text_la: et non parcet oculus meus, nec miserebor : sed vias tuas imponam tibi, et abominationes tuæ in medio tui erunt, et scietis quia ego sum Dominus percutiens.
text_pt: E não te poupará o meu olho, nem terei piedade de ti; conforme os teus caminhos, assim te punirei, e as tuas abominações estarão no meio de ti; e sabereis que eu, o Senhor, é que firo.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος

text_en: Behold the day, behold it has come: destruction has gone forth, the rod has blossomed, pride has budded.
text_la: Ecce dies, ecce venit : egressa est contritio, floruit virga, germinavit superbia,
text_pt: Eis aqui o dia, eis que vem; veio a manhà, já floresceu a vara, já reverdeceu a soberba.
text_el: ἰδοὺ τὸ πέρας ἥκει ἰδοὺ ἡμέρα κυρίου εἰ καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος ἤνθηκεν ἡ ὕβρις ἐξανέστηκεν

text_en: Iniquity is risen up into a rod of impiety: nothing of them shall remain, nor of their people, nor of the noise of them: and there shall be no rest among them.
text_la: iniquitas surrexit in virga impietatis : non ex eis, et non ex populo, neque ex sonitu eorum : et non erit requies in eis.
text_pt: A violência se levantou em vara de impiedade; nada restará deles, nem da sua multidão, nem do seu rumor, nem haverá lamentação por eles.
text_el: καὶ συντρίψει στήριγμα ἀνόμου καὶ οὐ μετὰ θορύβου οὐδὲ μετὰ σπουδῆς

text_en: The time has come, the day is at hand: let not the buyer rejoice: nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the people thereof.
text_la: Venit tempus, appropinquavit dies : qui emit, non lætetur, et qui vendit, non lugeat : quia ira super omnem populum ejus.
text_pt: Vem o tempo, é chegado o dia; o que compra não se alegre, e o que vende não se entristeça; porque a ira ardente está sobre toda a multidão deles.
text_el: ἥκει ὁ καιρός ἰδοὺ ἡ ἡμέρα ὁ κτώμενος μὴ χαιρέτω καὶ ὁ πωλῶν μὴ θρηνείτω

text_en: For the seller shall not return to that which he has sold, although their life be yet among the living. For the vision which regards all the multitude thereof, shall not go back: neither shall man be strengthened in the iniquity of his life.
text_la: Quia qui vendit, ad id quod vendidit non revertetur : et adhuc in viventibus vita eorum : visio enim ad omnem multitudinem ejus non regredietur, et vir in iniquitate vitæ suæ non confortabitur.
text_pt: Porque o que vende não tornará a possuir o que vendeu, ainda que esteja entre os viventes; porque a visão, sobre toda a sua multidão, não tornará para trás, nem ninguém fortalecerá a sua vida com a sua iniqüidade.
text_el: διότι ὁ κτώμενος πρὸς τὸν πωλοῦντα οὐκέτι μὴ ἐπιστρέψῃ καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἐν ὀφθαλμῷ ζωῆς αὐτοῦ οὐ κρατήσει

text_en: Blow the trumpet, let all be made ready, yet there is none to go to the battle: for my wrath shall be upon all the people thereof.
text_la: Canite tuba, præparentur omnes : et non est qui vadat ad prælium : ira enim mea super universum populum ejus.
text_pt: Já tocaram a trombeta, e tudo prepararam, mas não há quem vá à peleja, porque a minha ardente ira está sobre toda a sua multidão.
text_el: σαλπίσατε ἐν σάλπιγγι καὶ κρίνατε τὰ σύμπαντα

text_en: The sword without: and the pestilence, and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die by the sword: and they that are in the city, shall be devoured by the pestilence, and the famine.
text_la: Gladium foris, et pestis et fames intrinsecus : qui in agro est, gladio morietur, et qui in civitate, pestilentia et fame devorabuntur.
text_pt: Fora está a espada, e dentro a peste e a fome; o que estiver no campo morrerá à espada, e o que estiver na cidade a fome e a peste o consumirão.
text_el: ὁ πόλεμος ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ ἔξωθεν καὶ ὁ λιμὸς καὶ ὁ θάνατος ἔσωθεν ὁ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ τελευτήσει τοὺς δὲ ἐν τῇ πόλει λιμὸς καὶ θάνατος συντελέσει

text_en: And such of them as shall flee shall escape: and they shall be in the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them trembling, every one for his iniquity .
text_la: Et salvabuntur qui fugerint ex eis : et erunt in montibus quasi columbæ convallium omnes trepidi, unusquisque in iniquitate sua.
text_pt: E escaparão os que fugirem deles, mas estarão pelos montes, como pombas dos vales, todos gemendo, cada um por causa da sua iniqüidade.
text_el: καὶ ἀνασωθήσονται οἱ ἀνασῳζόμενοι ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσονται ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων πάντας ἀποκτενῶ ἕκαστον ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτοῦ

text_en: All hands shall be made feeble, and all knees shall run with water.
text_la: Omnes manus dissolventur, et omnia genua fluent aquis.
text_pt: Todas as mãos se enfraquecerão, e todos os joelhos serão débeis como água.
text_el: πᾶσαι χεῖρες ἐκλυθήσονται καὶ πάντες μηροὶ μολυνθήσονται ὑγρασίᾳ

text_en: And they shall gird themselves with haircloth , and fear shall cover them and shame shall be upon every face, and baldness upon all their heads.
text_la: Et accingent se ciliciis, et operiet eos formido : et in omni facie confusio, et in universis capitibus eorum calvitium.
text_pt: E cingir-se-ão de sacos, e o terror os cobrirá; e sobre todos os rostos haverá vergonha, e sobre todas as suas cabeças, calva.
text_el: καὶ περιζώσονται σάκκους καὶ καλύψει αὐτοὺς θάμβος καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν πρόσωπον αἰσχύνη ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν κεφαλὴν φαλάκρωμα
