text_en: Their silver shall be cast forth, and their gold shall become a dunghill. Their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord . They shall not satisfy their soul , and their bellies shall not be filled: because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity .
text_la: Argentum eorum foras projicietur, et aurum eorum in sterquilinium erit : argentum eorum et aurum eorum non valebit liberare eos in die furoris Domini : animam suam non saturabunt, et ventres eorum non implebuntur, quia scandalum iniquitatis eorum factum est.
text_pt: A sua prata lançarão pelas ruas, e o seu ouro será removido; nem a sua prata nem o seu ouro os poderá livrar no dia do furor do Senhor; eles não fartarão a sua alma, nem lhes encherão o estômago, porque isto foi o tropeço da sua iniqüidade.
text_el: τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτῶν ῥιφήσεται ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις καὶ τὸ χρυσίον αὐτῶν ὑπεροφθήσεται αἱ ψυχαὶ αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ ἐμπλησθῶσιν καὶ αἱ κοιλίαι αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ πληρωθῶσιν διότι βάσανος τῶν ἀδικιῶν αὐτῶν ἐγένετο

text_en: And they have turned the ornament of their jewels into pride , and have made of it the images of their abominations , and idols : therefore I have made it an uncleanness to them.
text_la: Et ornamentum monilium suorum in superbiam posuerunt, et imagines abominationum suarum et simulacrorum fecerunt ex eo : propter hoc dedi eis illud in immunditiam.
text_pt: E a glória do seu ornamento ele a pôs em magnificência, mas eles fizeram nela imagens das suas abominações e coisas detestáveis; por isso eu lha tenho feito coisa imunda.
text_el: ἐκλεκτὰ κόσμου εἰς ὑπερηφανίαν ἔθεντο αὐτὰ καὶ εἰκόνας τῶν βδελυγμάτων αὐτῶν ἐποίησαν ἐξ αὐτῶν ἕνεκεν τούτου δέδωκα αὐτὰ αὐτοῖς εἰς ἀκαθαρσίαν

text_en: And I will give it into the hands of strangers for spoil, and to the wicked of the earth for a prey, and they shall defile it.
text_la: Et dabo illud in manus alienorum ad diripiendum, et impiis terræ in prædam, et contaminabunt illud.
text_pt: E entregá-la-ei por presa, na mão dos estrangeiros, e aos ímpios da terra por despojo; e a profanarão.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσω αὐτὰ εἰς χεῖρας ἀλλοτρίων τοῦ διαρπάσαι αὐτὰ καὶ τοῖς λοιμοῖς τῆς γῆς εἰς σκῦλα καὶ βεβηλώσουσιν αὐτά

text_en: And I will turn away my face from them, and they shall violate my secret place: and robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
text_la: Et avertam faciem meam ab eis, et violabunt arcanum meum : et introibunt in illud emissarii, et contaminabunt illud.
text_pt: E desviarei deles o meu rosto, e profanarão o meu lugar oculto; porque entrarão nele saqueadores, e o profanarão.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ μιανοῦσιν τὴν ἐπισκοπήν μου καὶ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς αὐτὰ ἀφυλάκτως καὶ βεβηλώσουσιν αὐτά

text_en: Make a shutting up: for the land is full of the judgment of blood, and the city is full of iniquity .
text_la: Fac conclusionem, quoniam terra plena est judicio sanguinum, et civitas plena iniquitate.
text_pt: Faze uma cadeia, porque a terra está cheia de crimes de sangue, e a cidade está cheia de violência.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσουσι φυρμόν διότι ἡ γῆ πλήρης λαῶν καὶ ἡ πόλις πλήρης ἀνομίας

text_en: And I will bring the worst of the nations , and they shall possess their houses: and I will make the pride of the mighty to cease, and they shall possess their sanctuary .
text_la: Et adducam pessimos de gentibus, et possidebunt domos eorum : et quiescere faciam superbiam potentium, et possidebunt sanctuaria eorum.
text_pt: E farei vir os piores dentre os gentios e possuirão as suas casas; e farei cessar a arrogância dos fortes, e os seus lugares santos serão profanados.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὸ φρύαγμα τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτῶν καὶ μιανθήσεται τὰ ἅγια αὐτῶν

text_en: When distress comes upon them, they will seek for peace and there shall be none.
text_la: Angustia superveniente, requirent pacem, et non erit.
text_pt: Vem a destruição; eles buscarão a paz, mas não há nenhuma.
text_el: ἐξιλασμὸς ἥξει καὶ ζητήσει εἰρήνην καὶ οὐκ ἔσται

text_en: Trouble shall come upon trouble, and rumour upon rumour, and they shall seek a vision of the prophet , and the law shall perish from the priest , and counsel from the ancients.
text_la: Conturbatio super conturbationem veniet, et auditus super auditum : et quærent visionem de propheta, et lex peribit a sacerdote, et consilium a senioribus.
text_pt: Miséria sobre miséria virá, e se levantará rumor sobre rumor; então buscarão do profeta uma visão, mas do sacerdote perecerá a lei e dos anciãos o conselho.
text_el: οὐαὶ ἐπὶ οὐαὶ ἔσται καὶ ἀγγελία ἐπ' ἀγγελίαν ἔσται καὶ ζητηθήσεται ὅρασις ἐκ προφήτου καὶ νόμος ἀπολεῖται ἐξ ἱερέως καὶ βουλὴ ἐκ πρεσβυτέρων

text_en: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with sorrow, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled. I will do to them according to their way, and will judge them according to their judgments: and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Rex lugebit, et princeps induetur mœrore, et manus populi terræ conturbabuntur : secundum viam eorum faciam eis, et secundum judicia eorum judicabo eos, et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: O rei lamentará, e o príncipe se vestirá de desolação, e as mãos do povo da terra se conturbarão; conforme o seu caminho lhes farei, e conforme os seus merecimentos os julgarei; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ἄρχων ἐνδύσεται ἀφανισμόν καὶ αἱ χεῖρες τοῦ λαοῦ τῆς γῆς παραλυθήσονται κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν ποιήσω αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐν τοῖς κρίμασιν αὐτῶν ἐκδικήσω αὐτούς καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the ancients of Juda sat before me, that the hand of the Lord God fell there upon me.
text_la: Et factum est in anno sexto, in sexto mense, in quinta mensis, ego sedebam in domo mea, et senes Juda sedebant coram me, et cecidit ibi super me manus Domini Dei.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, no sexto ano, no sexto mês, no quinto dia do mês, estando eu assentado na minha casa, e os anciãos de Judá assentados diante de mim, que ali a mão do Senhor DEUS caiu sobre mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἕκτῳ ἔτει ἐν τῷ πέμπτῳ μηνὶ πέμπτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐγὼ ἐκαθήμην ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ιουδα ἐκάθηντο ἐνώπιόν μου καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπ' ἐμὲ χεὶρ κυρίου

text_en: And I saw, and behold a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins, and downward, fire: and from his loins, and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the appearance of amber.
text_la: Et vidi : et ecce similitudo quasi aspectus ignis : ab aspectu lumborum ejus et deorsum, ignis : et a lumbis ejus et sursum, quasi aspectus splendoris, ut visio electri.
text_pt: E olhei, e eis uma semelhança como o aspecto de fogo; desde o aspecto dos seus lombos, e daí para baixo, era fogo; e dos seus lombos e daí para cima como o aspecto de um resplendor como a cor de âmbar.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁμοίωμα ἀνδρός ἀπὸ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕως κάτω πῦρ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ ὑπεράνω ὡς ὅρασις ἠλέκτρου

text_en: And the likeness of a hand was put forth and took me by a lock of my head: and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven , and brought me in the vision of God into Jerusalem , near the inner gate, that looked toward the north, where was set the idol of jealousy to provoke to jealousy .
text_la: Et emissa similitudo manus apprehendit me in cincinno capitis mei, et elevavit me spiritus inter terram et cælum : et adduxit me in Jerusalem, in visione Dei, juxta ostium interius quod respiciebat ad aquilonem, ubi erat statutum idolum zeli ad provocandam æmulationem.
text_pt: E estendeu a forma de uma mão, e tomou-me pelos cabelos da minha cabeça; e o Espírito me levantou entre a terra e o céu, e levou-me a Jerusalém em visões de Deus, até à entrada da porta do pátio de dentro, que olha para o norte, onde estava o assento da imagem do ciúmes, que provoca ciúmes.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν ὁμοίωμα χειρὸς καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με τῆς κορυφῆς μου καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με πνεῦμα ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἤγαγέν με εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ὁράσει θεοῦ ἐπὶ τὰ πρόθυρα τῆς πύλης τῆς ἐσωτέρας τῆς βλεπούσης πρὸς βορρᾶν οὗ ἦν ἡ στήλη τοῦ κτωμένου

text_en: And behold the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision which I had seen in the plain.
text_la: Et ecce ibi gloria Dei Israël, secundum visionem quam videram in campo.
text_pt: E eis que a glória do Deus de Israel estava ali, conforme o aspecto que eu tinha visto no vale.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐκεῖ ἦν δόξα κυρίου θεοῦ Ισραηλ κατὰ τὴν ὅρασιν ἣν εἶδον ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , lift up your eyes towards the way of the north, and I lifted up my eyes towards the way of the north: and behold on the north side of the gate of the altar the idol of jealousy in the very entry.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, leva oculos tuos ad viam aquilonis. Et levavi oculos meos ad viam aquilonis, et ecce ab aquilone portæ altaris idolum zeli in ipso introitu.
text_pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, levanta agora os teus olhos para o caminho do norte. E levantei os meus olhos para o caminho do norte, e eis que ao norte da porta do altar, estava esta imagem de ciúmes na entrada.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἀνάβλεψον τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου πρὸς βορρᾶν καὶ ἀνέβλεψα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς μου πρὸς βορρᾶν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην τὴν πρὸς ἀνατολάς

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , do you see, do you think, what these are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel commits here, that I should depart far off from my sanctuary? And turn you yet again and you shall see greater abominations .
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, putasne vides tu quid isti faciunt, abominationes magnas quas domus Israël facit hic, ut procul recedam a sanctuario meo? et adhuc conversus videbis abominationes majores.
text_pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, vês tu o que eles estão fazendo? As grandes abominações que a casa de Israel faz aqui, para que me afaste do meu santuário? Mas ainda tornarás a ver maiores abominações.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἑώρακας τί οὗτοι ποιοῦσιν ἀνομίας μεγάλας ποιοῦσιν ὧδε τοῦ ἀπέχεσθαι ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων μου καὶ ἔτι ὄψει ἀνομίας μείζονας

text_en: And he brought me in to the door of the court : and I saw, and behold a hole in the wall.
text_la: Et introduxit me ad ostium atrii, et vidi, et ecce foramen unum in pariete.
text_pt: E levou-me à porta do átrio; então olhei, e eis que havia um buraco na parede.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με ἐπὶ τὰ πρόθυρα τῆς αὐλῆς

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , dig in the wall. And when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, fode parietem. Et cum fodissem parietem, apparuit ostium unum.
text_pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, cava agora naquela parede. E cavei na parede, e eis que havia uma porta.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ὄρυξον καὶ ὤρυξα καὶ ἰδοὺ θύρα μία

text_en: And he said to me: Go in, and see the wicked abominations which they commit here.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Ingredere, et vide abominationes pessimas quas isti faciunt hic.
text_pt: Então me disse: Entra, e vê as malignas abominações que eles fazem aqui.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με εἴσελθε καὶ ἰδὲ τὰς ἀνομίας ἃς οὗτοι ποιοῦσιν ὧδε

text_en: And I went in and saw, and behold every form of creeping things, and of living creatures, the abominations , and all the idols of the house of Israel , were painted on the wall all round about.
text_la: Et ingressus vidi, et ecce omnis similitudo reptilium et animalium, abominatio, et universa idola domus Israël, depicta erant in pariete in circuitu per totum:
text_pt: E entrei, e olhei, e eis que toda a forma de répteis, e animais abomináveis, e de todos os ídolos da casa de Israel, estavam pintados na parede em todo o redor.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ μάταια βδελύγματα καὶ πάντα τὰ εἴδωλα οἴκου Ισραηλ διαγεγραμμένα ἐπ' αὐτοῦ κύκλῳ

text_en: And seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel , and Jezonias the son of Saaphan stood in the midst of them, that stood before the pictures: and every one had a censer in his hand: and a cloud of smoke went up from the incense .
text_la: et septuaginta viri de senioribus domus Israël : et Jezonias filius Saphan stabat in medio eorum stantium ante picturas : et unusquisque habebat thuribulum in manu sua, et vapor nebulæ de thure consurgebat.
text_pt: E estavam em pé diante deles setenta homens dos anciãos da casa de Israel, e Jaazanias, filho de Safã, em pé, no meio deles, e cada um tinha na mão o seu incensário; e subia uma espessa nuvem de incenso.
text_el: καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρες ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων οἴκου Ισραηλ καὶ Ιεζονιας ὁ τοῦ Σαφαν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν εἱστήκει πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ ἕκαστος θυμιατήριον αὐτοῦ εἶχεν ἐν τῇ χειρί καὶ ἡ ἀτμὶς τοῦ θυμιάματος ἀνέβαινεν

text_en: And he said to me: Surely you see, O son of man , what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every one in private in his chamber: for they say: The Lord sees us not, the Lord has forsaken the earth.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Certe vides, fili hominis, quæ seniores domus Israël faciunt in tenebris, unusquisque in abscondito cubiculi sui : dicunt enim : Non videt Dominus nos; dereliquit Dominus terram.
text_pt: Então me disse: Viste, filho do homem, o que os anciãos da casa de Israel fazem nas trevas, cada um nas suas câmaras pintadas de imagens? Pois dizem: O Senhor não nos vê; o Senhor abandonou a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἑώρακας ἃ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ οἴκου Ισραηλ ποιοῦσιν ἕκαστος αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ κοιτῶνι τῷ κρυπτῷ αὐτῶν διότι εἶπαν οὐχ ὁρᾷ ὁ κύριος ἐγκαταλέλοιπεν κύριος τὴν γῆν

text_en: And he said to me: If you turn you again, you shall see greater abominations which these commit.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Adhuc conversus videbis abominationes majores, quas isti faciunt.
text_pt: E disse-me: Ainda tornarás a ver maiores abominações, que estes fazem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ἔτι ὄψει ἀνομίας μείζονας ἃς οὗτοι ποιοῦσιν

text_en: And he brought me in by the door of the gate of the Lord's house , which looked to the north: and behold women sat there mourning for Adonis.
text_la: Et introduxit me per ostium portæ domus Domini quod respiciebat ad aquilonem, et ecce ibi mulieres sedebant plangentes Adonidem.
text_pt: E levou-me à entrada da porta da casa do Senhor, que está do lado norte, e eis que estavam ali mulheres assentadas chorando a Tamuz.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με ἐπὶ τὰ πρόθυρα τῆς πύλης οἴκου κυρίου τῆς βλεπούσης πρὸς βορρᾶν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐκεῖ γυναῖκες καθήμεναι θρηνοῦσαι τὸν Θαμμουζ

text_en: And he said to me: Surely you have seen, O son of man : but turn you again, and you shall see greater abominations than these.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Certe vidisti, fili hominis : adhuc conversus videbis abominationes majores his.
text_pt: E disse-me: Vês isto, filho do homem? Ainda tornarás a ver abominações maiores do que estas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἑώρακας καὶ ἔτι ὄψει ἐπιτηδεύματα μείζονα τούτων

text_en: And he brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord : and behold at the door of the temple of the Lord , between the porch and the altar , were about five and twenty men having their backs towards the temple of the Lord , and their faces to the east: and they adored towards the rising of the sun.
text_la: Et introduxit me in atrium domus Domini interius, et ecce in ostio templi Domini, inter vestibulum et altare, quasi viginti quinque viri dorsa habentes contra templum Domini, et facies ad orientem : et adorabant ad ortum solis.
text_pt: E levou-me para o átrio interior da casa do Senhor, e eis que estavam à entrada do templo do Senhor, entre o pórtico e o altar, cerca de vinte e cinco homens, de costas para o templo do Senhor, e com os rostos para o oriente; e eles, virados para o oriente adoravam o sol.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν οἴκου κυρίου τὴν ἐσωτέραν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐπὶ τῶν προθύρων τοῦ ναοῦ κυρίου ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν αιλαμ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ὡς εἴκοσι ἄνδρες τὰ ὀπίσθια αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ κυρίου καὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ἀπέναντι καὶ οὗτοι προσκυνοῦσιν τῷ ἡλίῳ

text_en: And he said to me: Surely you have seen, O son of man : is this a light thing to the house of Juda , that they should commit these abominations which they have committed here: because they have filled the land with iniquity , and have turned to provoke me to anger ? And behold they put a branch to their nose.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Certe vidisti, fili hominis : numquid leve est hoc domui Juda, ut facerent abominationes istas quas fecerunt hic, quia replentes terram iniquitate, conversi sunt ad irritandum me? et ecce applicant ramum ad nares suas.
text_pt: Então me disse: Vês isto, filho do homem? Há porventura coisa mais leviana para a casa de Judá, do que tais abominações, que fazem aqui? Havendo enchido a terra de violência, tornam a irritar-me; e ei-los a chegar o ramo ao seu nariz.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ἑώρακας υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου μὴ μικρὰ τῷ οἴκῳ Ιουδα τοῦ ποιεῖν τὰς ἀνομίας ἃς πεποιήκασιν ὧδε διότι ἔπλησαν τὴν γῆν ἀνομίας καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτοὶ ὡς μυκτηρίζοντες

text_en: Therefore I also will deal with them in my wrath : my eye shall not spare them, neither will I show mercy: and when they shall cry to my ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them.
text_la: Ergo et ego faciam in furore : non parcet oculus meus, nec miserebor : et cum clamaverint ad aures meas voce magna, non exaudiam eos.
text_pt: Por isso também eu os tratarei com furor; o meu olho não poupará, nem terei piedade; ainda que me gritem aos ouvidos com grande voz, contudo não os ouvirei.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ποιήσω αὐτοῖς μετὰ θυμοῦ οὐ φείσεται ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου οὐδὲ μὴ ἐλεήσω

text_en: And he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying: The visitations of the city are at hand, and every one has a destroying weapon in his hand.
text_la: Et clamavit in auribus meis voce magna, dicens : Appropinquaverunt visitationes urbis, et unusquisque vas interfectionis habet in manu sua.
text_pt: Então me gritou aos ouvidos com grande voz, dizendo: Fazei chegar os intendentes da cidade, cada um com as suas armas destruidoras na mão.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέκραγεν εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων ἤγγικεν ἡ ἐκδίκησις τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἕκαστος εἶχεν τὰ σκεύη τῆς ἐξολεθρεύσεως ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And behold six men came from the way of the upper gate, which looks to the north: and each one had his weapon of destruction in his hand: and there was one man in the midst of them clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn at his reins: and they went in, and stood by the brazen altar .
text_la: Et ecce sex viri veniebant de via portæ superioris, quæ respicit ad aquilonem, et uniuscujusque vas interitus in manu ejus : vir quoque unus in medio eorum vestitus erat lineis, et atramentarium scriptoris ad renes ejus : et ingressi sunt, et steterunt juxta altare æreum.
text_pt: E eis que vinham seis homens a caminho da porta superior, que olha para o norte, e cada um com a sua arma destruidora na mão, e entre eles um homem vestido de linho, com um tinteiro de escrivão à sua cintura; e entraram, e se puseram junto ao altar de bronze.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἓξ ἄνδρες ἤρχοντο ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ τῆς πύλης τῆς ὑψηλῆς τῆς βλεπούσης πρὸς βορρᾶν καὶ ἑκάστου πέλυξ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἷς ἀνὴρ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν ἐνδεδυκὼς ποδήρη καὶ ζώνη σαπφείρου ἐπὶ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσήλθοσαν καὶ ἔστησαν ἐχόμενοι τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ χαλκοῦ

text_en: And the glory of the Lord of Israel went up from the cherub , upon which he was, to the threshold of the house: and he called to the man that was clothed with linen, and had a writer's inkhorn at his loins.
text_la: Et gloria Domini Israël assumpta est de cherub, quæ erat super eum ad limen domus : et vocavit virum qui indutus erat lineis, et atramentarium scriptoris habebat in lumbis suis:
text_pt: E a glória do Deus de Israel se levantou de sobre o querubim, sobre o qual estava, indo até a entrada da casa; e clamou ao homem vestido de linho, que tinha o tinteiro de escrivão à sua cintura.
text_el: καὶ δόξα θεοῦ τοῦ Ισραηλ ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τῶν χερουβιν ἡ οὖσα ἐπ' αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ αἴθριον τοῦ οἴκου καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν ἄνδρα τὸν ἐνδεδυκότα τὸν ποδήρη ὃς εἶχεν ἐπὶ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ τὴν ζώνην

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem : and mark Thau upon the foreheads of the men that sigh, and mourn for all the abominations that are committed in the midst thereof.
text_la: et dixit Dominus ad eum : Transi per mediam civitatem, in medio Jerusalem, et signa thau super frontes virorum gementium et dolentium super cunctis abominationibus quæ fiunt in medio ejus.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Passa pelo meio da cidade, pelo meio de Jerusalém, e marca com um sinal as testas dos homens que suspiram e que gemem por causa de todas as abominações que se cometem no meio dela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν δίελθε μέσην τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ δὸς τὸ σημεῖον ἐπὶ τὰ μέτωπα τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν καταστεναζόντων καὶ τῶν κατωδυνωμένων ἐπὶ πάσαις ταῖς ἀνομίαις ταῖς γινομέναις ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: And to the others he said in my hearing: Go after him through the city, and strike: let not your eyes spare, nor be moved with pity.
text_la: Et illis dixit, audiente me : Transite per civitatem sequentes eum, et percutite : non parcat oculus vester, neque misereamini:
text_pt: E aos outros disse ele, ouvindo eu: Passai pela cidade após ele, e feri; não poupe o vosso olho, nem vos compadeçais.
text_el: καὶ τούτοις εἶπεν ἀκούοντός μου πορεύεσθε ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ κόπτετε καὶ μὴ φείδεσθε τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ μὴ ἐλεήσητε

text_en: Utterly destroy old and young, maidens, children and women : but upon whomsoever you shall see Thau, kill him not, and begin at my sanctuary. So they began at the ancient men who were before the house.
text_la: senem, adolescentulum et virginem, parvulum et mulieres interficite usque ad internecionem : omnem autem super quem videritis thau, ne occidatis : et a sanctuario meo incipite. Cœperunt ergo a viris senioribus, qui erant ante faciem domus.
text_pt: Matai velhos, jovens, virgens, meninos e mulheres, até exterminá-los; mas a todo o homem que tiver o sinal não vos chegueis; e começai pelo meu santuário. E começaram pelos homens mais velhos que estavam diante da casa.
text_el: πρεσβύτερον καὶ νεανίσκον καὶ παρθένον καὶ νήπια καὶ γυναῖκας ἀποκτείνατε εἰς ἐξάλειψιν ἐπὶ δὲ πάντας ἐφ' οὕς ἐστιν τὸ σημεῖον μὴ ἐγγίσητε καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων μου ἄρξασθε καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων οἳ ἦσαν ἔσω ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ

text_en: And he said to them: Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go forth. And they went forth, and slew them that were in the city.
text_la: Et dixit ad eos : Contaminate domum, et implete atria interfectis; egredimini. Et egressi sunt, et percutiebant eos qui erant in civitate.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Contaminai a casa e enchei os átrios de mortos; saí. E saíram, e feriram na cidade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς μιάνατε τὸν οἶκον καὶ πλήσατε τὰς ὁδοὺς νεκρῶν ἐκπορευόμενοι καὶ κόπτετε

text_en: And the slaughter being ended I was left; and I fell upon my face, and crying, I said: Alas, alas, alas, O Lord God , will you then destroy all the remnant of Israel , by pouring out your fury upon Jerusalem ?
text_la: Et cæde completa, remansi ego, ruique super faciem meam, et clamans aio : Heu! heu! heu! Domine Deus : ergone disperdes omnes reliquias Israël, effundens furorem tuum super Jerusalem?
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, havendo-os ferido, e ficando eu sozinho, caí sobre a minha face, e clamei, e disse: Ah! Senhor DEUS! dar-se-á caso que destruas todo o restante de Israel, derramando a tua indignação sobre Jerusalém?
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ κόπτειν αὐτοὺς καὶ πίπτω ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου καὶ ἀνεβόησα καὶ εἶπα οἴμμοι κύριε ἐξαλείφεις σὺ τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ἐκχέαι σε τὸν θυμόν σου ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And he said to me: The iniquity of the house of Israel , and of Juda , is exceeding great, and the land is filled with blood, and the city is filled with perverseness: for they have said: The Lord has forsaken the earth, and the Lord sees not.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Iniquitas domus Israël et Juda magna est nimis valde, et repleta est terra sanguinibus, et civitas repleta est aversione : dixerunt enim : Dereliquit Dominus terram, et Dominus non videt.
text_pt: Então me disse: A maldade da casa de Israel e de Judá é grandíssima, e a terra se encheu de sangue e a cidade se encheu de perversidade; porque dizem: O Senhor abandonou a terra, e o Senhor não vê.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ἀδικία τοῦ οἴκου Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα μεμεγάλυνται σφόδρα σφόδρα ὅτι ἐπλήσθη ἡ γῆ λαῶν πολλῶν καὶ ἡ πόλις ἐπλήσθη ἀδικίας καὶ ἀκαθαρσίας ὅτι εἶπαν ἐγκαταλέλοιπεν κύριος τὴν γῆν οὐκ ἐφορᾷ ὁ κύριος

text_en: Therefore neither shall my eye spare, nor will I have pity: I will requite their way upon their head.
text_la: Igitur et meus non parcet oculus, neque miserebor : viam eorum super caput eorum reddam.
text_pt: Pois, também, quanto a mim, não poupará o meu olho, nem me compadecerei; sobre a cabeça deles farei recair o seu caminho.
text_el: καὶ οὐ φείσεταί μου ὁ ὀφθαλμός οὐδὲ μὴ ἐλεήσω τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν εἰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν δέδωκα

text_en: And behold the man that was clothed with linen, that had the inkhorn at his back, returned the word, saying: I have done as you have commanded me.
text_la: Et ecce vir qui erat indutus lineis, qui habebat atramentarium in dorso suo, respondit verbum, dicens : Feci sicut præcepisti mihi.
text_pt: Eis que o homem que estava vestido de linho, a cuja cintura estava o tinteiro, tornou com a resposta, dizendo: Fiz como me mandaste.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἐνδεδυκὼς τὸν ποδήρη καὶ ἐζωσμένος τῇ ζώνῃ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεκρίνατο λέγων πεποίηκα καθὼς ἐνετείλω μοι

text_en: And I saw and behold in the firmament that was over the heads of the cherubims , there appeared over them as it were the sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
text_la: Et vidi : et ecce in firmamento quod erat super caput cherubim, quasi lapis sapphirus, quasi species similitudinis solii, apparuit super ea.
text_pt: Depois olhei, e eis que no firmamento, que estava por cima da cabeça dos querubins, apareceu sobre eles uma como pedra de safira, semelhante a forma de um trono.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐπάνω τοῦ στερεώματος τοῦ ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς τῶν χερουβιν ὡς λίθος σαπφείρου ὁμοίωμα θρόνου ἐπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And he spoke to the man , that was clothed with linen, and said: Go in between the wheels that are under the cherubims and fill your hand with the coals of fire that are between the cherubims , and pour them out upon the city. And he went in, in my sight:
text_la: Et dixit ad virum qui indutus erat lineis, et ait : Ingredere in medio rotarum quæ sunt subtus cherubim, et imple manum tuam prunis ignis quæ sunt inter cherubim, et effunde super civitatem. Ingressusque est in conspectu meo.
text_pt: E falou ao homem vestido de linho, dizendo: Vai por entre as rodas, até debaixo do querubim, e enche as tuas mãos de brasas acesas dentre os querubins e espalha-as sobre a cidade. E ele entrou à minha vista.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα τὸν ἐνδεδυκότα τὴν στολήν εἴσελθε εἰς τὸ μέσον τῶν τροχῶν τῶν ὑποκάτω τῶν χερουβιν καὶ πλῆσον τὰς δράκας σου ἀνθράκων πυρὸς ἐκ μέσου τῶν χερουβιν καὶ διασκόρπισον ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἐνώπιόν μου

text_en: And the cherubims stood on the right side of the house , when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court .
text_la: Cherubim autem stabant a dextris domus cum ingrederetur vir, et nubes implevit atrium interius.
text_pt: E os querubins estavam ao lado direito da casa, quando entrou aquele homem; e uma nuvem encheu o átrio interior.
text_el: καὶ τὰ χερουβιν εἱστήκει ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ οἴκου ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι τὸν ἄνδρα καὶ ἡ νεφέλη ἔπλησεν τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐσωτέραν

text_en: And the glory of the Lord was lifted up from above the cherub to the threshold of the house : and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord .
text_la: Et elevata est gloria Domini desuper cherub ad limen domus : et repleta est domus nube, et atrium repletum est splendore gloriæ Domini.
text_pt: Então se levantou a glória do Senhor de sobre o querubim indo para a entrada da casa; e encheu-se a casa de uma nuvem, e o átrio se encheu do resplendor da glória do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν ἡ δόξα κυρίου ἀπὸ τῶν χερουβιν εἰς τὸ αἴθριον τοῦ οἴκου καὶ ἔπλησεν τὸν οἶκον ἡ νεφέλη καὶ ἡ αὐλὴ ἐπλήσθη τοῦ φέγγους τῆς δόξης κυρίου

text_en: And the sound of the wings of the cherubims was heard even to the outward court as the voice of God Almighty speaking.
text_la: Et sonitus alarum cherubim audiebatur usque ad atrium exterius, quasi vox Dei omnipotentis loquentis.
text_pt: E o ruído das asas dos querubins se ouviu até ao átrio exterior, como a voz do Deus Todo-Poderoso, quando fala.
text_el: καὶ φωνὴ τῶν πτερύγων τῶν χερουβιν ἠκούετο ἕως τῆς αὐλῆς τῆς ἐξωτέρας ὡς φωνὴ θεοῦ Σαδδαι λαλοῦντος

text_en: And when he had commanded the man that was clothed with linen, saying: Take fire from the midst of the wheels that are between the cherubims : he went in and stood beside the wheel.
text_la: Cumque præcepisset viro qui indutus erat lineis, dicens : Sume ignem de medio rotarum quæ sunt inter cherubim : ingressus ille stetit juxta rotam.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, dando ele ordem ao homem vestido de linho, dizendo: Toma fogo dentre as rodas, dentre os querubins, entrou ele, e parou junto às rodas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐντέλλεσθαι αὐτὸν τῷ ἀνδρὶ τῷ ἐνδεδυκότι τὴν στολὴν τὴν ἁγίαν λέγων λαβὲ πῦρ ἐκ μέσου τῶν τροχῶν ἐκ μέσου τῶν χερουβιν καὶ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἔστη ἐχόμενος τῶν τροχῶν

text_en: And one cherub stretched out his arm from the midst of the cherubims to the fire that was between the cherubims : and he took, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it and went forth.
text_la: Et extendit cherub manum de medio cherubim ad ignem qui erat inter cherubim, et sumpsit, et dedit in manus ejus qui indutus erat lineis : qui accipiens egressus est.
text_pt: Então estendeu um querubim a sua mão dentre os querubins para o fogo que estava entre os querubins; e tomou dele, e o pôs nas mãos do que estava vestido de linho; o qual o tomou, e saiu.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ εἰς μέσον τοῦ πυρὸς τοῦ ὄντος ἐν μέσῳ τῶν χερουβιν καὶ ἔλαβεν καὶ ἔδωκεν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας τοῦ ἐνδεδυκότος τὴν στολὴν τὴν ἁγίαν καὶ ἔλαβεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν

text_en: And there appeared in the cherubims the likeness of a man's hand under their wings.
text_la: Et apparuit in cherubim similitudo manus hominis subtus pennas eorum.
text_pt: E apareceu nos querubins uma semelhança de mão de homem debaixo das suas asas.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τὰ χερουβιν ὁμοίωμα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων ὑποκάτωθεν τῶν πτερύγων αὐτῶν

text_en: And I saw, and behold there were four wheels by the cherubims : one wheel by one cherub , and another wheel by another cherub : and the appearance of the wheels was to the sight like the chrysolite stone:
text_la: Et vidi : et ecce quatuor rotæ juxta cherubim : rota una juxta cherub unum, et rota alia juxta cherub unum : species autem rotarum erat quasi visio lapidis chrysolithi:
text_pt: Então olhei, e eis quatro rodas junto aos querubins, uma roda junto a um querubim, e outra roda junto a outro querubim; e o aspecto das rodas era como a cor da pedra de berilo.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ τροχοὶ τέσσαρες εἱστήκεισαν ἐχόμενοι τῶν χερουβιν τροχὸς εἷς ἐχόμενος χερουβ ἑνός καὶ ἡ ὄψις τῶν τροχῶν ὡς ὄψις λίθου ἄνθρακος

text_en: And as to their appearance, all four were alike: as if a wheel were in the midst of a wheel.
text_la: et aspectus earum similitudo una quatuor, quasi sit rota in medio rotæ.
text_pt: E, quanto ao seu aspecto, as quatro tinham uma mesma semelhança; como se estivesse uma roda no meio de outra roda.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτῶν ὁμοίωμα ἓν τοῖς τέσσαρσιν ὃν τρόπον ὅταν ᾖ τροχὸς ἐν μέσῳ τροχοῦ

text_en: And when they went, they went by four ways: and they turned not when they went: but to the place whither they first turned, the rest also followed, and did not turn back.
text_la: Cumque ambularent, in quatuor partes gradiebantur, et non revertebantur ambulantes : sed ad locum ad quem ire declinabat quæ prima erat, sequebantur et ceteræ, nec convertebantur.
text_pt: Andando estes, andavam para os quatro lados deles; não se viravam quando andavam, mas para o lugar para onde olhava a cabeça, para esse seguiam; não se viravam quando andavam.
text_el: ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτὰ εἰς τὰ τέσσαρα μέρη αὐτῶν ἐπορεύοντο οὐκ ἐπέστρεφον ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτά ὅτι εἰς ὃν ἂν τόπον ἐπέβλεψεν ἡ ἀρχὴ ἡ μία ἐπορεύοντο καὶ οὐκ ἐπέστρεφον ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτά

text_en: And their whole body, and their necks, and their hands, and their wings, and the circles were full of eyes, round about the four wheels.
text_la: Et omne corpus earum, et colla, et manus, et pennæ, et circuli, plena erant oculis in circuitu quatuor rotarum.
text_pt: E todo o seu corpo, as suas costas, as suas mãos, as suas asas e as rodas, as rodas que os quatro tinham, estavam cheias de olhos ao redor.
text_el: καὶ οἱ νῶτοι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ χεῖρες αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ πτέρυγες αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ τροχοὶ πλήρεις ὀφθαλμῶν κυκλόθεν τοῖς τέσσαρσιν τροχοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: And these wheels he called voluble, in my hearing.
text_la: Et rotas istas vocavit volubiles, audiente me.
text_pt: E, quanto às rodas, ouvindo eu, se lhes gritava: Roda!
text_el: τοῖς δὲ τροχοῖς τούτοις ἐπεκλήθη Γελγελ ἀκούοντός μου

text_en: And every one had four faces: one face was the face of a cherub , and the second face, the face of a man : and in the third was the face of a lion: and in the fourth the face of an eagle.
text_la: Quatuor autem facies habebat unum : facies una, facies cherub, et facies secunda, facies hominis : et in tertio facies leonis, et in quarto facies aquilæ.
text_pt: E cada um tinha quatro rostos; o rosto do primeiro era rosto de querubim, e o rosto do segundo, rosto de homem, e do terceiro era rosto de leão, e do quarto, rosto de águia.

text_en: And the cherubims were lifted up: this is the living creature that I had seen by the river Chobar.
text_la: Et elevata sunt cherubim : ipsum est animal quod videram juxta fluvium Chobar.
text_pt: E os querubins se elevaram ao alto; estes são os mesmos seres viventes que vi junto ao rio Quebar.
text_el: καὶ ἦραν τὰ χερουβιν τοῦτο τὸ ζῷον ὃ εἶδον ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ Χοβαρ

text_en: And when the cherubims went, the wheels also went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings, to mount up from the earth, the wheels stayed not behind, but were by them.
text_la: Cumque ambularent cherubim, ibant pariter et rotæ juxta ea : et cum elevarent cherubim alas suas ut exaltarentur de terra, non residebant rotæ, sed et ipsæ juxta erant.
text_pt: E, andando os querubins, andavam as rodas juntamente com eles; e, levantando os querubins as suas asas, para se elevarem de sobre a terra, também as rodas não se separavam deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι τὰ χερουβιν ἐπορεύοντο οἱ τροχοί καὶ οὗτοι ἐχόμενοι αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐξαίρειν τὰ χερουβιν τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτῶν τοῦ μετεωρίζεσθαι ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς οὐκ ἐπέστρεφον οἱ τροχοὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: When they stood, these stood: and when they were lifted up, these were lifted up: for the spirit of life was in them.
text_la: Stantibus illis stabant, et cum elevatis elevabantur : spiritus enim vitæ erat in eis.
text_pt: Parando eles, paravam elas; e, elevando-se eles elevavam-se elas, porque o espírito do ser vivente estava nelas.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἑστάναι αὐτὰ εἱστήκεισαν καὶ ἐν τῷ μετεωρίζεσθαι αὐτὰ ἐμετεωρίζοντο μετ' αὐτῶν διότι πνεῦμα ζωῆς ἐν αὐτοῖς ἦν

text_en: And the glory of the Lord went forth from the threshold of the temple : and stood over the cherubims .
text_la: Et egressa est gloria Domini a limine templi, et stetit super cherubim.
text_pt: Então saiu a glória do Senhor de sobre a entrada da casa, e parou sobre os querubins.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν δόξα κυρίου ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου καὶ ἐπέβη ἐπὶ τὰ χερουβιν

text_en: And the cherubims lifting up their wings, were raised from the earth before me: and as they went out, the wheels also followed: and it stood in the entry of the east gate of the house of the Lord : and the glory of the God of Israel was over them.
text_la: Et elevantia cherubim alas suas, exaltata sunt a terra coram me : et illis egredientibus, rotæ quoque subsecutæ sunt : et stetit in introitu portæ domus Domini orientalis, et gloria Dei Israël erat super ea.
text_pt: E os querubins alçaram as suas asas, e se elevaram da terra aos meus olhos, quando saíram; e as rodas os acompanhavam; e cada um parou à entrada da porta oriental da casa do Senhor; e a glória do Deus de Israel estava em cima, sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέλαβον τὰ χερουβιν τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐμετεωρίσθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ ἐξελθεῖν αὐτὰ καὶ οἱ τροχοὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῶν καὶ ἔστησαν ἐπὶ τὰ πρόθυρα τῆς πύλης οἴκου κυρίου τῆς ἀπέναντι καὶ δόξα θεοῦ Ισραηλ ἦν ἐπ' αὐτῶν ὑπεράνω

text_en: This is the living creature, which I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chobar: and I understood that they were cherubims .
text_la: Ipsum est animal quod vidi subter Deum Israël juxta fluvium Chobar, et intellexi quia cherubim essent.
text_pt: Estes são os seres viventes que vi debaixo do Deus de Israel, junto ao rio Quebar, e conheci que eram querubins.
text_el: τοῦτο τὸ ζῷόν ἐστιν ὃ εἶδον ὑποκάτω θεοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ Χοβαρ καὶ ἔγνων ὅτι χερουβιν ἐστίν

text_en: Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings: and the likeness of a man's hand was under their wings.
text_la: Quatuor vultus uni, et quatuor alæ uni : et similitudo manus hominis sub alis eorum.
text_pt: Cada um tinha quatro rostos e cada um quatro asas, e a semelhança de mãos de homem debaixo das suas asas.
text_el: τέσσαρα πρόσωπα τῷ ἑνί καὶ ὀκτὼ πτέρυγες τῷ ἑνί καὶ ὁμοίωμα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπου ὑποκάτωθεν τῶν πτερύγων αὐτῶν

text_en: And as to the likeness of their faces, they were the same faces which I had seen by the river Chobar, and their looks, and the impulse of every one to go straight forward.
text_la: Et similitudo vultuum eorum, ipsi vultus quos videram juxta fluvium Chobar, et intuitus eorum, et impetus singulorum ante faciem suam ingredi.
text_pt: E a semelhança dos seus rostos era a dos rostos que eu tinha visto junto ao rio Quebar, o aspecto deles, e eles mesmos; cada um andava para diante do seu rosto.
text_el: καὶ ὁμοίωσις τῶν προσώπων αὐτῶν ταῦτα τὰ πρόσωπά ἐστιν ἃ εἶδον ὑποκάτω τῆς δόξης θεοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ Χοβαρ καὶ αὐτὰ ἕκαστον κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ἐπορεύοντο

text_en: And the spirit lifted me up, and brought me into the east gate of the house of the Lord , which looks towards the rising of the sun: and behold in the entry of the gate five and twenty men: and I saw in the midst of them Jezonias the son of Azur, and Pheltias the son of Banaias , princes of the people.
text_la: Et elevavit me spiritus, et introduxit me ad portam domus Domini orientalem, quæ respicit ad solis ortum : et ecce in introitu portæ viginti quinque viri : et vidi in medio eorum Jezoniam filium Azur, et Pheltiam filium Banaiæ, principes populi.
text_pt: Então me levantou o Espírito, e me levou à porta oriental da casa do SENHOR, a qual olha para o oriente; e eis que estavam à entrada da porta vinte e cinco homens; e no meio deles vi a Jaazanias, filho de Azur, e a Pelatias, filho de Benaia, príncipes do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με πνεῦμα καὶ ἤγαγέν με ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην τοῦ οἴκου κυρίου τὴν κατέναντι τὴν βλέπουσαν κατὰ ἀνατολάς καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐπὶ τῶν προθύρων τῆς πύλης ὡς εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἄνδρες καὶ εἶδον ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν τὸν Ιεζονιαν τὸν τοῦ Εζερ καὶ Φαλτιαν τὸν τοῦ Βαναιου τοὺς ἀφηγουμένους τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , these are the men that study iniquity , and frame a wicked counsel in this city,
text_la: Dixitque ad me : Fili hominis, hi sunt viri qui cogitant iniquitatem, et tractant consilium pessimum in urbe ista,
text_pt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, estes são os homens que maquinam perversidade, e dão mau conselho nesta cidade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου οὗτοι οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ λογιζόμενοι μάταια καὶ βουλευόμενοι βουλὴν πονηρὰν ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ

text_en: saying: Were not houses lately built? This city is the caldron, and we the flesh.
text_la: dicentes : Nonne dudum ædificatæ sunt domus? hæc est lebes, nos autem carnes.
text_pt: Os quais dizem: Não está próximo o tempo de edificar casas; esta cidade é o caldeirão, e nós a carne.
text_el: οἱ λέγοντες οὐχὶ προσφάτως ᾠκοδόμηνται αἱ οἰκίαι αὕτη ἐστὶν ὁ λέβης ἡμεῖς δὲ τὰ κρέα

text_en: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy , you son of man .
text_la: Idcirco vaticinare de eis, vaticinare, fili hominis.
text_pt: Portanto, profetiza contra eles; profetiza, ó filho do homem.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο προφήτευσον ἐπ' αὐτούς προφήτευσον υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου

text_en: And the spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and said to me: Speak: Thus says the Lord : Thus have you spoken, O house of Israel , for I know the thoughts of your heart.
text_la: Et irruit in me spiritus Domini, et dixit ad me : Loquere : Hæc dicit Dominus : Sic locuti estis, domus Israël, et cogitationes cordis vestri ego novi.
text_pt: Caiu, pois, sobre mim o Espírito do Senhor, e disse-me: Fala: Assim diz o Senhor: Assim haveis falado, ó casa de Israel, porque, quanto às coisas que vos sobem ao espírito, eu as conheço.
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ πνεῦμα κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν πρός με λέγε τάδε λέγει κύριος οὕτως εἴπατε οἶκος Ισραηλ καὶ τὰ διαβούλια τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν ἐγὼ ἐπίσταμαι

text_en: You have killed a great many in this city, and you have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
text_la: Plurimos occidistis in urbe hac, et implestis vias ejus interfectis.
text_pt: Multiplicastes os vossos mortos nesta cidade, e enchestes as suas ruas de mortos.
text_el: ἐπληθύνατε νεκροὺς ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ καὶ ἐνεπλήσατε τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς τραυματιῶν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Your slain, whom you have laid in the midst thereof, they are the flesh, and this is the caldron: and I will bring you forth out of the midst thereof.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Interfecti vestri, quos posuistis in medio ejus, hi sunt carnes, et hæc est lebes : et educam vos de medio ejus.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Vossos mortos, que deitastes no meio dela, esses são a carne e ela é o caldeirão; a vós, porém, vos tirarei do meio dela.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος τοὺς νεκροὺς ὑμῶν οὓς ἐπατάξατε ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς οὗτοί εἰσιν τὰ κρέα αὐτὴ δὲ ὁ λέβης ἐστίν καὶ ὑμᾶς ἐξάξω ἐκ μέσου αὐτῆς

text_en: You have feared the sword, and I will bring the sword upon you, says the Lord God .
text_la: Gladium metuistis, et gladium inducam super vos, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Temestes a espada, e a espada trarei sobre vós, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ῥομφαίαν φοβεῖσθε καὶ ῥομφαίαν ἐπάξω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will cast you out of the midst thereof, and I will deliver you into the hand of the enemies, and I will execute judgments upon you.
text_la: Et ejiciam vos de medio ejus, daboque vos in manu hostium, et faciam in vobis judicia.
text_pt: E vos farei sair do meio dela, e vos entregarei na mão de estrangeiros, e exercerei os meus juízos entre vós.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάξω ὑμᾶς ἐκ μέσου αὐτῆς καὶ παραδώσω ὑμᾶς εἰς χεῖρας ἀλλοτρίων καὶ ποιήσω ἐν ὑμῖν κρίματα

text_en: You shall fall by the sword: I will judge you in the borders of Israel , and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Gladio cadetis : in finibus Israël judicabo vos, et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Caireis à espada, e nos confins de Israel vos julgarei; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσεῖσθε ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων τοῦ Ισραηλ κρινῶ ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: This shall not be as a caldron to you, and you shall not be as flesh in the midst thereof: I will judge you in the borders of Israel .
text_la: Hæc non erit vobis in lebetem, et vos non eritis in medio ejus in carnes : in finibus Israël judicabo vos,
text_pt: Esta cidade não vos servirá de caldeirão, nem vós servireis de carne no meio dela; nos confins de Israel vos julgarei.
text_el: αὐτὴ ὑμῖν οὐκ ἔσται εἰς λέβητα καὶ ὑμεῖς οὐ μὴ γένησθε ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς εἰς κρέα ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων τοῦ Ισραηλ κρινῶ ὑμᾶς

text_en: And you shall know that I am the Lord : because you have not walked in my commandments , and have not done my judgments, but you have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you.
text_la: et scietis quia ego Dominus : quia in præceptis meis non ambulastis, et judicia mea non fecistis, sed juxta judicia gentium quæ in circuitu vestro sunt estis operati.
text_pt: E sabereis que eu sou o Senhor, porque não andastes nos meus estatutos, nem cumpristes os meus juízos; antes fizestes conforme os juízos dos gentios que estão ao redor de vós.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass, when I prophesied , that Pheltias the son of Banaias died: and I fell down upon my face, and I cried with a loud voice: and said: Alas, alas, alas, O Lord God : will you make an end of all the remnant of Israel ?
text_la: Et factum est cum prophetarem, Pheltias filius Banaiæ mortuus est : et cecidi in faciem meam clamans voce magna, et dixi : Heu! heu! heu! Domine Deus, consummationem tu facis reliquiarum Israël?
text_pt: E aconteceu que, profetizando eu, morreu Pelatias, filho de Benaia; então caí sobre o meu rosto, e clamei com grande voz, e disse: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Porventura darás tu fim ao remanescente de Israel?
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ προφητεύειν με καὶ Φαλτιας ὁ τοῦ Βαναιου ἀπέθανεν καὶ πίπτω ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου καὶ ἀνεβόησα φωνῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ εἶπα οἴμμοι οἴμμοι κύριε εἰς συντέλειαν σὺ ποιεῖς τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , your brethren, your brethren, your kinsmen , and all the house of Israel , all they to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said: Get far from the Lord , the land is given in possession to us.
text_la: Fili hominis, fratres tui, fratres tui, viri propinqui tui, et omnis domus Israël, universi quibus dixerunt habitatores Jerusalem : Longe recedite a Domino : nobis data est terra in possessionem.
text_pt: Filho do homem, teus irmãos, sim, teus irmãos, os homens de teu parentesco, e toda a casa de Israel, todos eles são aqueles a quem os habitantes de Jerusalém disseram: Apartai-vos para longe do Senhor; esta terra nos foi dada em possessão.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου οἱ ἀδελφοί σου καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας σου καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ συντετέλεσται οἷς εἶπαν αὐτοῖς οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ιερουσαλημ μακρὰν ἀπέχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῖν δέδοται ἡ γῆ εἰς κληρονομίαν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because I have removed them far off among the Gentiles , and because I have scattered them among the countries: I will be to them a little sanctuary in the countries whither they have come.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia longe feci eos in gentibus, et quia dispersi eos in terris : ero eis in sanctificationem modicam in terris ad quas venerunt.
text_pt: Portanto, dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda que os lancei para longe entre os gentios, e ainda que os espalhei pelas terras, todavia lhes serei como um pequeno santuário, nas terras para onde forem.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ὅτι ἀπώσομαι αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰ ἔθνη καὶ διασκορπιῶ αὐτοὺς εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς ἁγίασμα μικρὸν ἐν ταῖς χώραις οὗ ἂν εἰσέλθωσιν ἐκεῖ

text_en: Therefore speak to them: Thus says the Lord God : I will gather you from among the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries wherein you are scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .
text_la: Propterea loquere : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Congregabo vos de populis, et adunabo de terris in quibus dispersi estis, daboque vobis humum Israël.
text_pt: Portanto, dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Hei de ajuntar-vos do meio dos povos, e vos recolherei das terras para onde fostes lançados, e vos darei a terra de Israel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ εἰσδέξομαι αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ συνάξω αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν οὗ διέσπειρα αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And they shall go in thither, and shall take away all the scandals , and all the abominations thereof from thence.
text_la: Et ingredientur illuc, et auferent omnes offensiones, cunctasque abominationes ejus de illa.
text_pt: E virão ali, e tirarão dela todas as suas coisas detestáveis e todas as suas abominações.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελεύσονται ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐξαροῦσιν πάντα τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτῆς καὶ πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῆς ἐξ αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will give them one heart, and will put a new spirit in their bowels: and I will take away the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh:
text_la: Et dabo eis cor unum, et spiritum novum tribuam in visceribus eorum : et auferam cor lapideum de carne eorum, et dabo eis cor carneum,
text_pt: E lhes darei um só coração, e um espírito novo porei dentro deles; e tirarei da sua carne o coração de pedra, e lhes darei um coração de carne;
text_el: καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς καρδίαν ἑτέραν καὶ πνεῦμα καινὸν δώσω ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκσπάσω τὴν καρδίαν τὴν λιθίνην ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτῶν καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς καρδίαν σαρκίνην

text_en: That they may walk in my commandments , and keep my judgments, and do them: and that they may be my people, and I may be their God .
text_la: ut in præceptis meis ambulent, et judicia mea custodiant, faciantque ea, et sint mihi in populum, et ego sim eis in Deum.
text_pt: Para que andem nos meus estatutos, e guardem os meus juízos, e os cumpram; e eles me serão por povo, e eu lhes serei por Deus.
text_el: ὅπως ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου πορεύωνται καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου φυλάσσωνται καὶ ποιῶσιν αὐτά καὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν

text_en: But as for them whose heart walks after their scandals and abominations , I will lay their way upon their head, says the Lord God .
text_la: Quorum cor post offendicula et abominationes suas ambulat, horum viam in capite suo ponam, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Mas, quanto àqueles cujo coração andar conforme o coração das suas coisas detestáveis, e as suas abominações, farei recair nas suas cabeças o seu caminho, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ εἰς τὴν καρδίαν τῶν βδελυγμάτων αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν ὡς ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ἐπορεύετο τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν εἰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν δέδωκα λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and the wheels with them: and the glory of the God of Israel was over them.
text_la: Et elevaverunt cherubim alas suas, et rotæ cum eis, et gloria Dei Israël erat super ea:
text_pt: Então os querubins elevaram as suas asas, e as rodas os acompanhavam; e a glória do Deus de Israel estava em cima sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆραν τὰ χερουβιν τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ τροχοὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ δόξα θεοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπ' αὐτὰ ὑπεράνω αὐτῶν

text_en: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city, and stood over the mount that is on the east side of the city.
text_la: et ascendit gloria Domini de medio civitatis, stetitque super montem qui est ad orientem urbis.
text_pt: E a glória do Senhor se alçou desde o meio da cidade; e se pôs sobre o monte que está ao oriente da cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη ἡ δόξα κυρίου ἐκ μέσης τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους ὃ ἦν ἀπέναντι τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And the spirit lifted me up, and brought me into Chaldea , to them of the captivity , in vision , by the spirit of God : and the vision which I had seen was taken up from me.
text_la: Et spiritus levavit me, adduxitque in Chaldæam ad transmigrationem, in visione, in spiritu Dei : et sublata est a me visio quam videram.
text_pt: Depois o Espírito me levantou, e me levou à Caldéia, para os do cativeiro, em visão, pelo Espírito de Deus; e subiu de sobre mim a visão que eu tinha tido.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με πνεῦμα καὶ ἤγαγέν με εἰς γῆν Χαλδαίων εἰς τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ἐν ὁράσει ἐν πνεύματι θεοῦ καὶ ἀνέβην ἀπὸ τῆς ὁράσεως ἧς εἶδον

text_en: And I spoke to them of the captivity all the words of the Lord , which he had shown me.
text_la: Et locutus sum ad transmigrationem omnia verba Domini quæ ostenderat mihi.
text_pt: E falei aos do cativeiro todas as coisas que o Senhor me havia mostrado.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησα πρὸς τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ κυρίου οὓς ἔδειξέν μοι

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , you dwell in the midst of a provoking house: who have eyes to see, and see not: and ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a provoking house.
text_la: Fili hominis, in medio domus exasperantis tu habitas : qui oculos habent ad videndum, et non vident, et aures ad audiendum, et non audiunt : quia domus exasperans est.
text_pt: Filho do homem, tu habitas no meio da casa rebelde, que tem olhos para ver e não vê, e tem ouvidos para ouvir e não ouve; porque eles são casa rebelde.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδικιῶν αὐτῶν σὺ κατοικεῖς οἳ ἔχουσιν ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ βλέπειν καὶ οὐ βλέπουσιν καὶ ὦτα ἔχουσιν τοῦ ἀκούειν καὶ οὐκ ἀκούουσιν διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν

text_en: You, therefore, O son of man , prepare you all necessaries for removing, and remove by day into their sight: and you shall remove out of your place to another place in their sight, if so be they will regard it: for they are a provoking house.
text_la: Tu ergo, fili hominis, fac tibi vasa transmigrationis, et transmigrabis per diem coram eis. Transmigrabis autem de loco tuo ad locum alterum in conspectu eorum, si forte aspiciant, quia domus exasperans est:
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, prepara mobílias para mudares, e de dia muda aos olhos deles; e do teu lugar mudarás para outro lugar aos olhos deles; bem pode ser que reparem nisso, ainda que eles são casa rebelde.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ποίησον σεαυτῷ σκεύη αἰχμαλωσίας ἡμέρας ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν καὶ αἰχμαλωτευθήσῃ ἐκ τοῦ τόπου σου εἰς ἕτερον τόπον ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ὅπως ἴδωσιν διότι οἶκος παραπικραίνων ἐστίν

text_en: And you shall bring forth your furniture as the furniture of one that is removing by day in their sight: and you shall go forth in the evening in their presence, as one goes forth that removes his dwelling.
text_la: et efferes foras vasa tua quasi vasa transmigrantis per diem in conspectu eorum : tu autem egredieris vespere coram eis, sicut egreditur migrans.
text_pt: Aos olhos deles, pois, tirarás para fora, de dia, as tuas mobílias, como quem vai mudar; então tu sairás de tarde aos olhos deles, como quem sai mudando para o cativeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐξοίσεις τὰ σκεύη σου ὡς σκεύη αἰχμαλωσίας ἡμέρας κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ σὺ ἐξελεύσῃ ἑσπέρας ὡς ἐκπορεύεται αἰχμάλωτος

text_en: Dig you a way through the wall before their eyes: and you shall go forth through it.
text_la: Ante oculos eorum perfode tibi parietem, et egredieris per eum.
text_pt: Faze para ti, à vista deles, uma abertura na parede, e tira-as para fora, por ali.
text_el: ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν διόρυξον σεαυτῷ εἰς τὸν τοῖχον καὶ διεξελεύσῃ δι' αὐτοῦ

text_en: In their sight you shall be carried out upon men's shoulders, you shall be carried out in the dark: you shall cover your face, and shall not see the ground: for I have set you for a sign of things to come to the house of Israel .
text_la: In conspectu eorum in humeris portaberis; in caligine effereris : faciem tuam velabis, et non videbis terram, quia portentum dedi te domui Israël.
text_pt: Aos olhos deles, nos seus ombros, às escuras as tirarás, e cobrirás o teu rosto, para que não vejas a terra; porque te dei por sinal à casa de Israel.
text_el: ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ἐπ' ὤμων ἀναλημφθήσῃ καὶ κεκρυμμένος ἐξελεύσῃ τὸ πρόσωπόν σου συγκαλύψεις καὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδῃς τὴν γῆν διότι τέρας δέδωκά σε τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ

text_en: I did therefore as he had commanded me: I brought forth my goods by day, as the goods of one that removes: and in the evening I digged through the wall with my hand, and I went forth in the dark, and was carried on men's shoulders in their sight.
text_la: Feci ergo sicut præceperat mihi Dominus : vasa mea protuli quasi vasa transmigrantis per diem, et vespere perfodi mihi parietem manu : et in caligine egressus sum, in humeris portatus in conspectu eorum.
text_pt: E fiz assim, como se me deu ordem; as minhas mobílias tirei para fora de dia, como mobílias do cativeiro; então à tarde fiz, com a mão, uma abertura na parede; às escuras as tirei para fora, e nos meus ombros as levei, aos olhos deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησα οὕτως κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατό μοι καὶ σκεύη ἐξήνεγκα ὡς σκεύη αἰχμαλωσίας ἡμέρας καὶ ἑσπέρας διώρυξα ἐμαυτῷ τὸν τοῖχον καὶ κεκρυμμένος ἐξῆλθον ἐπ' ὤμων ἀνελήμφθην ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini mane ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E, pela manhã, veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με τὸ πρωὶ λέγων

text_en: Son of man , has not the house of Israel , the provoking house, said to you: What are you doing?
text_la: Fili hominis, numquid non dixerunt ad te domus Israël, domus exasperans : Quid tu facis?
text_pt: Filho do homem, porventura não te disse a casa de Israel, aquela casa rebelde: Que fazes tu?
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ εἶπαν πρὸς σὲ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ οἶκος ὁ παραπικραίνων τί σὺ ποιεῖς

text_en: Say to them: Thus says the Lord God : This burden concerns my prince that is in Jerusalem , and all the house of Israel , that are among them.
text_la: Dic ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Super ducem onus istud, qui est in Jerusalem, et super omnem domum Israël, quæ est in medio eorum.
text_pt: Dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Esta carga refere-se ao príncipe em Jerusalém, e a toda a casa de Israel, que está no meio dela.
text_el: εἰπὸν πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ὁ ἄρχων καὶ ὁ ἀφηγούμενος ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ παντὶ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ οἵ εἰσιν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: Say: I am a sign of things to come to you: as I have done, so shall it be done to them: they shall be removed from their dwellings, and go into captivity .
text_la: Dic : Ego portentum vestrum : quomodo feci, sic fiet illis : in transmigrationem et in captivitatem ibunt.
text_pt: Dize: Eu sou o vosso sinal. Assim como eu fiz, assim se lhes fará a eles; irão para o exílio em cativeiro.
text_el: εἰπὸν ὅτι ἐγὼ τέρατα ποιῶ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ὃν τρόπον πεποίηκα οὕτως ἔσται αὐτοῖς ἐν μετοικεσίᾳ καὶ ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ πορεύσονται

text_en: And the prince that is in the midst of them, shall be carried on shoulders, he shall go forth in the dark: they shall dig through the wall to bring him out: his face shall be covered, that he may not see the ground with his eyes.
text_la: Et dux qui est in medio eorum, in humeris portabitur; in caligine egredietur : parietem perfodient, ut educant eum; facies ejus operietur, ut non videat oculo terram.
text_pt: E o príncipe que está no meio deles levará aos ombros as mobílias, e às escuras sairá; farão uma abertura na parede para as tirarem por ela; o seu rosto cobrirá, para que com os seus olhos não veja a terra.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄρχων ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν ἐπ' ὤμων ἀρθήσεται καὶ κεκρυμμένος ἐξελεύσεται διὰ τοῦ τοίχου καὶ διορύξει τοῦ ἐξελθεῖν αὐτὸν δι' αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ συγκαλύψει ὅπως μὴ ὁραθῇ ὀφθαλμῷ καὶ αὐτὸς τὴν γῆν οὐκ ὄψεται

text_en: And I will spread my net over him, and he shall be taken in my net: and I will bring him into Babylon , into the land of the Chaldeans, and he shall not see it, and there he shall die.
text_la: Et extendam rete meum super eum, et capietur in sagena mea : et adducam eum in Babylonem, in terram Chaldæorum, et ipsam non videbit : ibique morietur.
text_pt: Também estenderei a minha rede sobre ele, e será apanhado no meu laço; e o levarei à babilônia, à terra dos caldeus, e contudo não a verá, ainda que ali morrerá.
text_el: καὶ ἐκπετάσω τὸ δίκτυόν μου ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ συλλημφθήσεται ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ μου καὶ ἄξω αὐτὸν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα εἰς γῆν Χαλδαίων καὶ αὐτὴν οὐκ ὄψεται καὶ ἐκεῖ τελευτήσει

text_en: And all that are about him, his guards, and his troops I will scatter into every wind: and I will draw out the sword after them.
text_la: Et omnes qui circa eum sunt, præsidium ejus, et agmina ejus, dispergam in omnem ventum, et gladium evaginabo post eos.
text_pt: E a todos os ventos espalharei os que estiverem ao redor dele para seu socorro, e a todas as suas tropas; e desembainharei a espada atrás deles.
text_el: καὶ πάντας τοὺς κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ τοὺς βοηθοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀντιλαμβανομένους αὐτοῦ διασπερῶ εἰς πάντα ἄνεμον καὶ ῥομφαίαν ἐκκενώσω ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall have dispersed them among the nations , and scattered them in the countries.
text_la: Et scient quia ego Dominus, quando dispersero illos in gentibus, et disseminavero eos in terris.
text_pt: Assim saberão que eu sou o Senhor, quando eu os dispersar entre as nações e os espalhar pelas terras.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐν τῷ διασκορπίσαι με αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ διασπερῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν ταῖς χώραις

text_en: And I will leave a few men of them from the sword, and from the famine, and from the pestilence: that they may declare all their wicked deeds among the nations whither they shall go: and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et relinquam ex eis viros paucos a gladio, et fame, et pestilentia, ut enarrent omnia scelera eorum in gentibus ad quas ingredientur, et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Mas deles deixarei ficar alguns poucos, escapos da espada, da fome, e da peste, para que contem todas as suas abominações entre as nações para onde forem; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ὑπολείψομαι ἐξ αὐτῶν ἄνδρας ἀριθμῷ ἐκ ῥομφαίας καὶ ἐκ λιμοῦ καὶ ἐκ θανάτου ὅπως ἐκδιηγῶνται πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὗ εἰσήλθοσαν ἐκεῖ καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , eat your bread in trouble and drink your water in hurry and sorrow.
text_la: Fili hominis, panem tuum in conturbatione comede, sed et aquam tuam in festinatione et mœrore bibe.
text_pt: Filho do homem, o teu pão comerás com tremor, e a tua água beberás com estremecimento e com receio.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τὸν ἄρτον σου μετ' ὀδύνης φάγεσαι καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ σου μετὰ βασάνου καὶ θλίψεως πίεσαι

text_en: And say to the people of the land: Thus says the Lord God to them that dwell in Jerusalem in the land of Israel : They shall eat their bread in care, and drink their water in desolation: that the land may become desolate from the multitude that is therein, for the iniquity of all that dwell therein.
text_la: Et dices ad populum terræ : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus ad eos qui habitant in Jerusalem, in terra Israël : Panem suum in sollicitudine comedent, et aquam suam in desolatione bibent : ut desoletur terra a multitudine sua, propter iniquitatem omnium qui habitant in ea.
text_pt: E dirás ao povo da terra: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS acerca dos habitantes de Jerusalém, na terra de Israel: O seu pão comerão com receio, e a sua água beberão com susto, pois a sua terra será despojada de sua abundância, por causa da violência de todos os que nela habitam.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τῆς γῆς τάδε λέγει κύριος τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ιερουσαλημ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τοῦ Ισραηλ τοὺς ἄρτους αὐτῶν μετ' ἐνδείας φάγονται καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ αὐτῶν μετὰ ἀφανισμοῦ πίονται ὅπως ἀφανισθῇ ἡ γῆ σὺν πληρώματι αὐτῆς ἐν ἀσεβείᾳ γὰρ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And the cities that are now inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et civitates quæ nunc habitantur, desolatæ erunt, terraque deserta, et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E as cidades habitadas serão devastadas, e a terra se tornará em desolação; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν αἱ κατοικούμεναι ἐξερημωθήσονται καὶ ἡ γῆ εἰς ἀφανισμὸν ἔσται καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio ainda a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel ? Saying: The days shall be prolonged, and every vision shall fail.
text_la: Fili hominis, quod est proverbium istud vobis in terra Israël, dicentium : In longum differentur dies, et peribit omnis visio?
text_pt: Filho do homem, que provérbio é este que vós tendes na terra de Israel, dizendo: Prolongar-se-ão os dias, e perecerá toda a visão?
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τίς ὑμῖν ἡ παραβολὴ αὕτη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τοῦ Ισραηλ λέγοντες μακρὰν αἱ ἡμέραι ἀπόλωλεν ὅρασις

text_en: Say to them therefore: Thus says the Lord God : I will make this proverb to cease, neither shall it be any more a common saying in Israel : and tell them that the days are at hand, and the effect of every vision .
text_la: Ideo dic ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quiescere faciam proverbium istud, neque vulgo dicetur ultra in Israël : et loquere ad eos quod appropinquaverint dies, et sermo omnis visionis.
text_pt: Portanto, dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei cessar este provérbio, e já não se servirão mais dele em Israel; mas dize-lhes: Os dias estão próximos e o cumprimento de toda a visão.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπὸν πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀποστρέψω τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην καὶ οὐκέτι μὴ εἴπωσιν τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ ὅτι λαλήσεις πρὸς αὐτούς ἠγγίκασιν αἱ ἡμέραι καὶ λόγος πάσης ὁράσεως

text_en: For there shall be no more any vain visions , nor doubtful divination in the midst of the children of Israel .
text_la: Non enim erit ultra omnis visio cassa, neque divinatio ambigua in medio filiorum Israël :
text_pt: Porque não haverá mais alguma visão vã, nem adivinhação lisonjeira, no meio da casa de Israel.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι πᾶσα ὅρασις ψευδὴς καὶ μαντευόμενος τὰ πρὸς χάριν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: For I the Lord will speak: and what word soever I shall speak, it shall come to pass, and shall not be prolonged any more: but in your days, you provoking house, I will speak the word, and will do it, says the Lord God .
text_la: quia ego Dominus loquar, et quodcumque locutus fuero verbum, fiet, et non prolongabitur amplius : sed in diebus vestris, domus exasperans, loquar verbum, et faciam illud, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Porque eu, o SENHOR, falarei, e a palavra que eu falar se cumprirá; não será mais adiada; porque em vossos dias, ó casa rebelde, falarei uma palavra e a cumprirei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: διότι ἐγὼ κύριος λαλήσω τοὺς λόγους μου λαλήσω καὶ ποιήσω καὶ οὐ μὴ μηκύνω ἔτι ὅτι ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑμῶν οἶκος ὁ παραπικραίνων λαλήσω λόγον καὶ ποιήσω λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Veio mais a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , behold the house of Israel , they that say: The visions that this man sees, is for many days to come: and this man prophesies of times afar off.
text_la: Fili hominis, ecce domus Israël dicentium : Visio quam hic videt, in dies multos et in tempora longa iste prophetat.
text_pt: Filho do homem, eis que os da casa de Israel dizem: A visão que este tem é para muitos dias, e ele profetiza de tempos que estão longe.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἰδοὺ οἶκος Ισραηλ ὁ παραπικραίνων λέγοντες λέγουσιν ἡ ὅρασις ἣν οὗτος ὁρᾷ εἰς ἡμέρας πολλάς καὶ εἰς καιροὺς μακροὺς οὗτος προφητεύει

text_en: Therefore say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Not one word of mine shall be prolonged any more: the word that I shall speak shall be accomplished, says the Lord God .
text_la: Propterea dic ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Non prolongabitur ultra omnis sermo meus : verbum quod locutus fuero, complebitur, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Portanto dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Não será mais adiada nenhuma das minhas palavras; e a palavra que falei se cumprirá, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπὸν πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος οὐ μὴ μηκύνωσιν οὐκέτι πάντες οἱ λόγοι μου οὓς ἂν λαλήσω λαλήσω καὶ ποιήσω λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy : and you shall say to them that prophesy out of their own heart: Hear the word of the Lord :
text_la: Fili hominis, vaticinare ad prophetas Israël qui prophetant, et dices prophetantibus de corde suo : Audite verbum Domini.
text_pt: Filho do homem, profetiza contra os profetas de Israel que profetizam, e dize aos que só profetizam de seu coração: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor;
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον ἐπὶ τοὺς προφήτας τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ προφητεύσεις καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Woe to the foolish prophets that follow their own spirit, and see nothing.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Væ prophetis insipientibus, qui sequuntur spiritum suum, et nihil vident!
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai dos profetas loucos, que seguem o seu próprio espírito e que nada viram!
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος οὐαὶ τοῖς προφητεύουσιν ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ καθόλου μὴ βλέπουσιν

text_en: Your prophets , O Israel , were like foxes in the deserts .
text_la: Quasi vulpes in desertis prophetæ tui, Israël, erant.
text_pt: Os teus profetas, ó Israel, são como raposas nos desertos.
text_el: οἱ προφῆταί σου Ισραηλ ὡς ἀλώπεκες ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις

text_en: You have not gone up to face the enemy, nor have you set up a wall for the house of Israel , to stand in battle in the day of the Lord .
text_la: Non ascendistis ex adverso, neque opposuistis murum pro domo Israël, ut staretis in prælio in die Domini.
text_pt: Não subistes às brechas, nem reparastes o muro para a casa de Israel, para estardes firmes na peleja no dia do Senhor.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστησαν ἐν στερεώματι καὶ συνήγαγον ποίμνια ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ οὐκ ἀνέστησαν οἱ λέγοντες ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κυρίου

text_en: They see vain things, and they foretell lies , saying: The Lord says: whereas the Lord has not sent them: and they have persisted to confirm what they have said.
text_la: Vident vana, et divinant mendacium, dicentes : Ait Dominus, cum Dominus non miserit eos : et perseveraverunt confirmare sermonem.
text_pt: Viram vaidade e adivinhação mentirosa os que dizem: O Senhor disse; quando o Senhor não os enviou; e fazem que se espere o cumprimento da palavra.
text_el: βλέποντες ψευδῆ μαντευόμενοι μάταια οἱ λέγοντες λέγει κύριος καὶ κύριος οὐκ ἀπέσταλκεν αὐτούς καὶ ἤρξαντο τοῦ ἀναστῆσαι λόγον

text_en: Have you not seen a vain vision and spoken a lying divination : and you say: The Lord says: whereas I have not spoken.
text_la: Numquid non visionem cassam vidistis, et divinationem mendacem locuti estis, et dicitis : Ait Dominus, cum ego non sim locutus?
text_pt: Porventura não tivestes visão de vaidade, e não falastes adivinhação mentirosa, quando dissestes: O Senhor diz, sendo que eu tal não falei?
text_el: οὐχ ὅρασιν ψευδῆ ἑωράκατε καὶ μαντείας ματαίας εἰρήκατε

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have spoken vain things, and have seen lies : therefore behold I come against you, says the Lord God .
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia locuti estis vana, et vidistis mendacium, ideo ecce ego ad vos, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Como tendes falado vaidade, e visto a mentira, portanto eis que eu sou contra vós, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν οἱ λόγοι ὑμῶν ψευδεῖς καὶ αἱ μαντεῖαι ὑμῶν μάταιαι διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐφ' ὑμᾶς λέγει κύριος

text_en: And my hand shall be upon the prophets that see vain things, and that divine lies : they shall not be in the council of my people, nor shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel , neither shall they enter into the land of Israel , and you shall know that I am the Lord God .
text_la: Et erit manus mea super prophetas qui vident vana, et divinant mendacium : in consilio populi mei non erunt, et in scriptura domus Israël non scribentur, nec in terram Israël ingredientur, et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus :
text_pt: E a minha mão será contra os profetas que vêem vaidade e que adivinham mentira; não estarão na congregação do meu povo, nem nos registros da casa de Israel se escreverão, nem entrarão na terra de Israel; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς ὁρῶντας ψευδῆ καὶ τοὺς ἀποφθεγγομένους μάταια ἐν παιδείᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ μου οὐκ ἔσονται οὐδὲ ἐν γραφῇ οἴκου Ισραηλ οὐ γραφήσονται καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ οὐκ εἰσελεύσονται καὶ γνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: Because they have deceived my people, saying: Peace, and there is no peace: and the people built up a wall, and they daubed it with dirt without straw.
text_la: eo quod deceperint populum meum, dicentes : Pax, et non est pax : et ipse ædificabat parietem, illi autem liniebant eum luto absque paleis.
text_pt: Porquanto, sim, porquanto andam enganando o meu povo, dizendo: Paz, não havendo paz; e quando um edifica uma parede, eis que outros a cobrem com argamassa não temperada;
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν τὸν λαόν μου ἐπλάνησαν λέγοντες εἰρήνη εἰρήνη καὶ οὐκ ἦν εἰρήνη καὶ οὗτος οἰκοδομεῖ τοῖχον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀλείφουσιν αὐτόν εἰ πεσεῖται

text_en: Say to them that daub without tempering, that it shall fall: for there shall be an overflowing shower, and I will cause great hailstones to fall violently from above, and a stormy wind to throw it down.
text_la: Dic ad eos qui liniunt absque temperatura, quod casurus sit : erit enim imber inundans, et dabo lapides prægrandes desuper irruentes, et ventum procellæ dissipantem.
text_pt: Dize aos que a cobrem com argamassa não temperada que ela cairá. Haverá uma grande pancada de chuva, e vós, ó pedras grandes de saraiva, caireis, e um vento tempestuoso a fenderá.
text_el: εἰπὸν πρὸς τοὺς ἀλείφοντας πεσεῖται καὶ ἔσται ὑετὸς κατακλύζων καὶ δώσω λίθους πετροβόλους εἰς τοὺς ἐνδέσμους αὐτῶν καὶ πεσοῦνται καὶ πνεῦμα ἐξαῖρον καὶ ῥαγήσεται

text_en: Behold, when the wall is fallen: shall it not be said to you: Where is the daubing wherewith you have daubed it?
text_la: Siquidem ecce cecidit paries : numquid non dicetur vobis : Ubi est litura quam linistis?
text_pt: Ora, eis que, caindo a parede, não vos dirão: Onde está a argamassa com que a cobristes?
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ πέπτωκεν ὁ τοῖχος καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσιν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἀλοιφὴ ὑμῶν ἣν ἠλείψατε

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Lo, I will cause a stormy wind to break forth in my indignation, and there shall be an overflowing shower in my anger : and great hailstones in my wrath to consume.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Et erumpere faciam spiritum tempestatum in indignatione mea, et imber inundans in furore meo erit, et lapides grandes in ira in consumptionem.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Fendê-la-ei no meu furor com vento tempestuoso, e chuva de inundar haverá na minha ira, e grandes pedras de saraiva na minha indignação, para a consumir.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ ῥήξω πνοὴν ἐξαίρουσαν μετὰ θυμοῦ καὶ ὑετὸς κατακλύζων ἐν ὀργῇ μου ἔσται καὶ τοὺς λίθους τοὺς πετροβόλους ἐν θυμῷ ἐπάξω εἰς συντέλειαν

text_en: And I will break down the wall that you have daubed with untempered mortar: and I will make it even with the ground, and the foundation thereof shall be laid bare: and it shall fall, and shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et destruam parietem quem linistis absque temperamento, et adæquabo eum terræ, et revelabitur fundamentum ejus : et cadet, et consumetur in medio ejus, et scietis quia ego sum Dominus.
text_pt: E derrubarei a parede que cobristes com argamassa não temperada, e darei com ela por terra, e o seu fundamento se descobrirá; assim cairá, e perecereis no meio dela, e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ κατασκάψω τὸν τοῖχον ὃν ἠλείψατε καὶ πεσεῖται καὶ θήσω αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται τὰ θεμέλια αὐτοῦ καὶ πεσεῖται καὶ συντελεσθήσεσθε μετ' ἐλέγχων καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And I will accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that daub it without tempering the mortar, and I will say to you: The wall is no more, and they that daub it are no more.
text_la: Et complebo indignationem meam in pariete, et in his qui liniunt eum absque temperamento : dicamque vobis : Non est paries, et non sunt qui liniunt eum :
text_pt: Assim cumprirei o meu furor contra a parede, e contra os que a cobriram com argamassa não temperada; e vos direi: Já não há parede, nem existem os que a cobriram;
text_el: καὶ συντελέσω τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπὶ τὸν τοῖχον καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀλείφοντας αὐτόν καὶ πεσεῖται καὶ εἶπα πρὸς ὑμᾶς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ τοῖχος οὐδὲ οἱ ἀλείφοντες αὐτὸν

text_en: Even the prophets of Israel that prophesy to Jerusalem , and that see visions of peace for her: and there is no peace, says the Lord God .
text_la: prophetæ Israël, qui prophetant ad Jerusalem, et vident ei visionem pacis, et non est pax, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Os profetas de Israel, que profetizam acerca de Jerusalém, e vêem para ela visão de paz, não havendo paz, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: προφῆται τοῦ Ισραηλ οἱ προφητεύοντες ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ οἱ ὁρῶντες αὐτῇ εἰρήνην καὶ εἰρήνη οὐκ ἔστιν λέγει κύριος

text_en: And you, son of man , set your face against the daughters of your people that prophesy out of their own heart: and prophesy against them,
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra filias populi tui quæ prophetant de corde suo : et vaticinare super eas,
text_pt: E tu, ó filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra as filhas do teu povo, que profetizam de seu coração, e profetiza contra elas,
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τὰς θυγατέρας τοῦ λαοῦ σου τὰς προφητευούσας ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτῶν καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ' αὐτὰς

text_en: and say: Thus says the Lord God : Woe to them that sew cushions under every elbow: and make pillows for the heads of persons of every age to catch souls : and when they caught the souls of my people, they gave life to their souls .
text_la: et dic : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Væ quæ consuunt pulvillos sub omni cubito manus, et faciunt cervicalia sub capite universæ ætatis ad capiendas animas : et cum caperent animas populi mei, vivificabant animas eorum!
text_pt: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai das que cosem almofadas para todas as axilas, e que fazem véus para as cabeças de pessoas de toda a estatura, para caçarem as almas! Porventura caçareis as almas do meu povo, e as almas guardareis em vida para vós?
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος οὐαὶ ταῖς συρραπτούσαις προσκεφάλαια ἐπὶ πάντα ἀγκῶνα χειρὸς καὶ ποιούσαις ἐπιβόλαια ἐπὶ πᾶσαν κεφαλὴν πάσης ἡλικίας τοῦ διαστρέφειν ψυχάς αἱ ψυχαὶ διεστράφησαν τοῦ λαοῦ μου καὶ ψυχὰς περιεποιοῦντο

text_en: And they violated me among my people, for a handful of barley, and a piece of bread, to kill souls which should not die, and to save souls alive which should not live, telling lies to my people that believe lies .
