text_la: Et violabant me ad populum meum propter pugillum hordei, et fragmen panis, ut interficerent animas quæ non moriuntur, et vivificarent animas quæ non vivunt, mentientes populo meo credenti mendaciis.
text_pt: E vós me profanastes entre o meu povo, por punhados de cevada, e por pedaços de pão, para matardes as almas que não haviam de morrer, e para guardardes em vida as almas que não haviam de viver, mentindo assim ao meu povo que escuta a mentira?
text_el: καὶ ἐβεβήλουν με πρὸς τὸν λαόν μου ἕνεκεν δρακὸς κριθῶν καὶ ἕνεκεν κλασμάτων ἄρτου τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι ψυχάς ἃς οὐκ ἔδει ἀποθανεῖν καὶ τοῦ περιποιήσασθαι ψυχάς ἃς οὐκ ἔδει ζῆσαι ἐν τῷ ἀποφθέγγεσθαι ὑμᾶς λαῷ εἰσακούοντι μάταια ἀποφθέγματα

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold I declare against your cushions, wherewith you catch flying souls : and I will tear them off from your arms: and I will let go the souls that you catch, the souls that should fly.
text_la: Propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad pulvillos vestros, quibus vos capitis animas volantes : et dirumpam eos de brachiis vestris, et dimittam animas quas vos capitis, animas ad volandum.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis aí vou eu contra as vossas almofadas, com que vós ali caçais as almas fazendo-as voar, e as arrancarei de vossos braços, e soltarei as almas, sim, as almas que vós caçais fazendo-as voar.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ τὰ προσκεφάλαια ὑμῶν ἐφ' ἃ ὑμεῖς συστρέφετε ἐκεῖ ψυχάς καὶ διαρρήξω αὐτὰ ἀπὸ τῶν βραχιόνων ὑμῶν καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ τὰς ψυχάς ἃς ὑμεῖς ἐκστρέφετε τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν εἰς διασκορπισμόν

text_en: And I will tear your pillows, and will deliver my people out of your hand, neither shall they be any more in your hands to be a prey: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et dirumpam cervicalia vestra, et liberabo populum meum de manu vestra, neque erunt ultra in manibus vestris ad prædandum : et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E rasgarei os vossos véus, e livrarei o meu povo das vossas mãos, e nunca mais estará em vossas mãos para ser caçado; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ διαρρήξω τὰ ἐπιβόλαια ὑμῶν καὶ ῥύσομαι τὸν λαόν μου ἐκ χειρὸς ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσονται ἐν χερσὶν ὑμῶν εἰς συστροφήν καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: Because with lies you have made the heart of the just to mourn, whom I have not made sorrowful: and have strengthened the hands of the wicked , that he should not return from his evil way, and live.
text_la: Pro eo quod mœrere fecistis cor justi mendaciter, quem ego non contristavi, et confortastis manus impii, ut non reverteretur a via sua mala, et viveret :
text_pt: Visto que entristecestes o coração do justo com falsidade, não o havendo eu entristecido; e fortalecestes as mãos do ímpio, para que não se desviasse do seu mau caminho, para conservá-lo em vida.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν διεστρέφετε καρδίαν δικαίου ἀδίκως καὶ ἐγὼ οὐ διέστρεφον αὐτὸν καὶ τοῦ κατισχῦσαι χεῖρας ἀνόμου τὸ καθόλου μὴ ἀποστρέψαι ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς καὶ ζῆσαι αὐτόν

text_en: Therefore you shall not see vain things, nor divine divinations any more, and I will deliver my people out of your hand: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: propterea vana non videbitis, et divinationes non divinabitis amplius, et eruam populum meum de manu vestra : et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Portanto não vereis mais vaidade, nem mais fareis adivinhações; mas livrarei o meu povo da vossa mão, e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ψευδῆ οὐ μὴ ἴδητε καὶ μαντείας οὐ μὴ μαντεύσησθε ἔτι καὶ ῥύσομαι τὸν λαόν μου ἐκ χειρὸς ὑμῶν καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And some of the ancients of Israel came to me, and sat before me.
text_la: Et venerunt ad me viri seniorum Israël, et sederunt coram me.
text_pt: E vieram a mim alguns homens dos anciãos de Israel, e se assentaram diante de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πρός με ἄνδρες ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐκάθισαν πρὸ προσώπου μου

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , these men have placed their uncleannesses in their hearts, and have set up before their face the stumbling block of their iniquity : and shall I answer when they inquire of me?
text_la: Fili hominis, viri isti posuerunt immunditias suas in cordibus suis, et scandalum iniquitatis suæ statuerunt contra faciem suam : numquid interrogatus respondebo eis?
text_pt: Filho do homem, estes homens levantaram os seus ídolos nos seus corações, e o tropeço da sua maldade puseram diante da sua face; devo eu de alguma maneira ser interrogado por eles?
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου οἱ ἄνδρες οὗτοι ἔθεντο τὰ διανοήματα αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν κόλασιν τῶν ἀδικιῶν αὐτῶν ἔθηκαν πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν εἰ ἀποκρινόμενος ἀποκριθῶ αὐτοῖς

text_en: Therefore speak to them, and say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Man , man of the house of Israel that shall place his uncleannesses in his heart, and set up the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and shall come to the prophet inquiring of me by him: I the Lord will answer him according to the multitude of his uncleannesses :
text_la: Propter hoc loquere eis, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Homo, homo de domo Israël, qui posuerit immunditias suas in corde suo, et scandalum iniquitatis suæ statuerit contra faciem suam, et venerit ad prophetam interrogans per eum me : ego Dominus respondebo ei in multitudine immunditiarum suarum,
text_pt: Portanto fala com eles, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel, que levantar os seus ídolos no seu coração, e puser o tropeço da sua maldade diante da sua face, e vier ao profeta, eu, o SENHOR, vindo ele, lhe responderei conforme a multidão dos seus ídolos;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο λάλησον αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἄνθρωπος ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Ισραηλ ὃς ἂν θῇ τὰ διανοήματα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν κόλασιν τῆς ἀδικίας αὐτοῦ τάξῃ πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλθῃ πρὸς τὸν προφήτην ἐγὼ κύριος ἀποκριθήσομαι αὐτῷ ἐν οἷς ἐνέχεται ἡ διάνοια αὐτοῦ

text_en: That the house of Israel may be caught in their own heart, with which they have departed from me through all their idols .
text_la: ut capiatur domus Israël in corde suo, quo recesserunt a me in cunctis idolis suis.
text_pt: Para que eu possa apanhar a casa de Israel no seu coração, porquanto todos se apartaram de mim para seguirem os seus ídolos.
text_el: ὅπως πλαγιάσῃ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ κατὰ τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν τὰς ἀπηλλοτριωμένας ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐνθυμήμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore say to the house of Israel : Thus says the Lord God : Be converted , and depart from your idols , and turn away your faces from all your abominations .
text_la: Propterea dic ad domum Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Convertimini, et recedite ab idolis vestris, et ab universis contaminationibus vestris avertite facies vestras.
text_pt: Portanto dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Convertei-vos, e tornai-vos dos vossos ídolos; e desviai os vossos rostos de todas as vossas abominações;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπὸν πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἐπιστράφητε καὶ ἀποστρέψατε ἀπὸ τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἀσεβειῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπιστρέψατε τὰ πρόσωπα ὑμῶν

text_en: For every man of the house of Israel , and every stranger among the proselytes in Israel , if he separate himself from me, and place his idols in his heart, and set the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and come to the prophet to inquire of me by him: I the Lord will answer him by myself.
text_la: Quia homo, homo de domo Israël, et de proselytis quicumque advena fuerit in Israël, si alienatus fuerit a me, et posuerit idola sua in corde suo, et scandalum iniquitatis suæ statuerit contra faciem suam, et venerit ad prophetam ut interroget per eum me : ego Dominus respondebo ei per me:
text_pt: Porque qualquer homem da casa de Israel, e dos estrangeiros que peregrinam em Israel, que se alienar de mim, e levantar os seus ídolos no seu coração, e puser o tropeço da sua maldade diante do seu rosto, e vier ao profeta, para me consultar por meio dele, eu, o Senhor, lhe responderei por mim mesmo.
text_el: διότι ἄνθρωπος ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Ισραηλ καὶ ἐκ τῶν προσηλύτων τῶν προσηλυτευόντων ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ ὃς ἂν ἀπαλλοτριωθῇ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ θῆται τὰ ἐνθυμήματα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν κόλασιν τῆς ἀδικίας αὐτοῦ τάξῃ πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλθῃ πρὸς τὸν προφήτην τοῦ ἐπερωτῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐν ἐμοί ἐγὼ κύριος ἀποκριθήσομαι αὐτῷ ἐν ᾧ ἐνέχεται ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: And I will set my face against that man , and will make him an example, and a proverb, and will cut him off from the midst of my people: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: et ponam faciem meam super hominem illum, et faciam eum in exemplum et in proverbium, et disperdam eum de medio populi mei : et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E porei o meu rosto contra o tal homem, e o assolarei para que sirva de sinal e provérbio, e arrancá-lo-ei do meio do meu povo; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ στηριῶ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐπὶ τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐκεῖνον καὶ θήσομαι αὐτὸν εἰς ἔρημον καὶ εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ ἐξαρῶ αὐτὸν ἐκ μέσου τοῦ λαοῦ μου καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And when the prophet shall err , and speak a word: I the Lord have deceived that prophet : and I will stretch forth my hand upon him, and will cut him off from the midst of my people Israel .
text_la: Et propheta cum erraverit, et locutus fuerit verbum, ego Dominus decepi prophetam illum, et extendam manum meam super illum, et delebo eum de medio populi mei Israël.
text_pt: E se o profeta for enganado, e falar alguma coisa, eu, o Senhor, terei enganado esse profeta; e estenderei a minha mão contra ele, e destruí-lo-ei do meio do meu povo Israel.
text_el: καὶ ὁ προφήτης ἐὰν πλανηθῇ καὶ λαλήσῃ ἐγὼ κύριος πεπλάνηκα τὸν προφήτην ἐκεῖνον καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἀφανιῶ αὐτὸν ἐκ μέσου τοῦ λαοῦ μου Ισραηλ

text_en: And they shall bear their iniquity : according to the iniquity of him that inquires, so shall the iniquity of the prophet be.
text_la: Et portabunt iniquitatem suam : juxta iniquitatem interrogantis, sic iniquitas prophetæ erit:
text_pt: E levarão sobre si o castigo da sua iniqüidade; o castigo do profeta será como o castigo de quem o consultar.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται τὴν ἀδικίαν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸ ἀδίκημα τοῦ ἐπερωτῶντος καὶ κατὰ τὸ ἀδίκημα ὁμοίως τῷ προφήτῃ ἔσται

text_en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, nor be polluted with all their transgressions : but may be my people, and I may be their God , says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: ut non erret ultra domus Israël a me, neque polluatur in universis prævaricationibus suis : sed sint mihi in populum, et ego sim eis in Deum, ait Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: Para que a casa de Israel não se desvie mais de mim, nem mais se contamine com todas as suas transgressões; então eles serão o meu povo, e eu lhes serei o seu Deus, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ὅπως μὴ πλανᾶται ἔτι ὁ οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἵνα μὴ μιαίνωνται ἔτι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Veio ainda a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , when a land shall sin against me, so as to transgress grievously, I will stretch forth my hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof: and I will send famine upon it, and will destroy man and beast out of it.
text_la: Fili hominis, terra cum peccaverit mihi, ut prævaricetur prævaricans, extendam manum meam super eam, et conteram virgam panis ejus, et immittam in eam famem, et interficiam de ea hominem et jumentum.
text_pt: Filho do homem, quando uma terra pecar contra mim, se rebelando gravemente, então estenderei a minha mão contra ela, e lhe quebrarei o sustento do pão, e enviarei contra ela fome, e cortarei dela homens e animais.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου γῆ ἐὰν ἁμάρτῃ μοι τοῦ παραπεσεῖν παράπτωμα καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ συντρίψω αὐτῆς στήριγμα ἄρτου καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ ἐπ' αὐτὴν λιμὸν καὶ ἐξαρῶ ἐξ αὐτῆς ἄνθρωπον καὶ κτήνη

text_en: And if these three men , Noe , Daniel , and Job , shall be in it: they shall deliver their own souls by their justice , says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et si fuerint tres viri isti in medio ejus, Noë, Daniel, et Job, ipsi justitia sua liberabunt animas suas, ait Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: Ainda que estivessem no meio dela estes três homens, Noé, Daniel e Jó, eles pela sua justiça livrariam apenas as suas almas, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ὦσιν οἱ τρεῖς ἄνδρες οὗτοι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς Νωε καὶ Δανιηλ καὶ Ιωβ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ αὐτῶν σωθήσονται λέγει κύριος

text_en: And if I shall bring mischievous beasts also upon the land to waste it, and it be desolate, so that there is none that can pass because of the beasts:
text_la: Quod si et bestias pessimas induxero super terram ut vastem eam, et fuerit invia, eo quod non sit pertransiens propter bestias :
text_pt: Se eu fizer passar pela terra as feras selvagens, e elas a desfilharem de modo que fique desolada, e ninguém possa passar por ela por causa das feras;
text_el: ἐὰν καὶ θηρία πονηρὰ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τιμωρήσομαι αὐτὴν καὶ ἔσται εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ διοδεύων ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν θηρίων

text_en: If these three men shall be in it, as I live, says the Lord , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters: but they only shall be delivered, and the land shall be made desolate.
text_la: tres viri isti si fuerint in ea, vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quia nec filios nec filias liberabunt, sed ipsi soli liberabuntur, terra autem desolabitur.
text_pt: E estes três homens estivessem no meio dela, vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que nem a filhos nem a filhas livrariam; eles só ficariam livres, e a terra seria assolada.
text_el: καὶ οἱ τρεῖς ἄνδρες οὗτοι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ὦσι ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος εἰ υἱοὶ ἢ θυγατέρες σωθήσονται ἀλλ' ἢ αὐτοὶ μόνοι σωθήσονται ἡ δὲ γῆ ἔσται εἰς ὄλεθρον

text_en: Or if I bring the sword upon that land, and say to the sword: Pass through the land: and I destroy man and beast out of it:
text_la: Vel si gladium induxero super terram illam, et dixero gladio : Transi per terram : et interfecero de ea hominem et jumentum,
text_pt: Ou, se eu trouxer a espada sobre aquela terra, e disser: Espada, passa pela terra; e eu cortar dela homens e animais;
text_el: ἢ καὶ ῥομφαίαν ἐὰν ἐπάγω ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην καὶ εἴπω ῥομφαία διελθάτω διὰ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐξαρῶ ἐξ αὐτῆς ἄνθρωπον καὶ κτῆνος

text_en: And these three men be in the midst thereof: as I live, says the Lord God , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they themselves alone shall be delivered.
text_la: et tres viri isti fuerint in medio ejus : vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, non liberabunt filios neque filias, sed ipsi soli liberabuntur.
text_pt: Ainda que aqueles três homens estivessem nela, vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que nem filhos nem filhas livrariam, mas somente eles ficariam livres.
text_el: καὶ οἱ τρεῖς ἄνδρες οὗτοι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος οὐ μὴ ῥύσωνται υἱοὺς οὐδὲ θυγατέρας αὐτοὶ μόνοι σωθήσονται

text_en: Or if I also send the pestilence upon that land, and pour out my indignation upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
text_la: Si autem et pestilentiam immisero super terram illam, et effudero indignationem meam super eam in sanguine, ut auferam ex ea hominem et jumentum,
text_pt: Ou, se eu enviar a peste sobre aquela terra, e derramar o meu furor sobre ela com sangue, para cortar dela homens e animais,
text_el: ἢ καὶ θάνατον ἐπαποστείλω ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην καὶ ἐκχεῶ τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἐν αἵματι τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἐξ αὐτῆς ἄνθρωπον καὶ κτῆνος

text_en: And Noe , and Daniel , and Job be in the midst thereof: as I live, says the Lord God , they shall deliver neither son nor daughter: but they shall only deliver their own souls by their justice .
text_la: et Noë, et Daniel, et Job fuerint in medio ejus : vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quia filium et filiam non liberabunt, sed ipsi justitia sua liberabunt animas suas.
text_pt: Ainda que Noé, Daniel e Jó estivessem no meio dela, vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que nem um filho nem uma filha eles livrariam, mas somente eles livrariam as suas próprias almas pela sua justiça.
text_el: καὶ Νωε καὶ Δανιηλ καὶ Ιωβ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος ἐὰν υἱοὶ ἢ θυγατέρες ὑπολειφθῶσιν αὐτοὶ ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ αὐτῶν ῥύσονται τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Although I shall send in upon Jerusalem my four grievous judgments, the sword, and the famine, and the mischievous beasts, and the pestilence, to destroy out of it man and beast,
text_la: Quoniam hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quod etsi quatuor judicia mea pessima, gladium, et famem, ac bestias malas, et pestilentiam, immisero in Jerusalem, ut interficiam de ea hominem et pecus,
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quanto mais, se eu enviar os meus quatro maus juízos, a espada, a fome, as feras, e a peste, contra Jerusalém, para cortar dela homens e feras?
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τὰς τέσσαρας ἐκδικήσεις μου τὰς πονηράς ῥομφαίαν καὶ λιμὸν καὶ θηρία πονηρὰ καὶ θάνατον ἐξαποστείλω ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἐξ αὐτῆς ἄνθρωπον καὶ κτῆνος

text_en: yet there shall be left in it some that shall be saved, who shall bring away their sons and daughters: behold they shall come among you, and you shall see their way, and their doings: and you shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem , in all things that I have brought upon it.
text_la: tamen relinquetur in ea salvatio educentium filios et filias : ecce ipsi ingredientur ad vos, et videbitis viam eorum et adinventiones eorum, et consolabimini super malo quod induxi in Jerusalem, in omnibus quæ importavi super eam.
text_pt: Mas eis que alguns fugitivos restarão nela, que serão levados para fora, assim filhos e filhas; eis que eles virão a vós, e vereis o seu caminho e os seus feitos; e ficareis consolados do mal que eu trouxe sobre Jerusalém, e de tudo o que trouxe sobre ela.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ὑπολελειμμένοι ἐν αὐτῇ οἱ ἀνασεσῳσμένοι αὐτῆς οἳ ἐξάγουσιν ἐξ αὐτῆς υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας ἰδοὺ αὐτοὶ ἐκπορεύονται πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ὄψεσθε τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἐνθυμήματα αὐτῶν καὶ μεταμεληθήσεσθε ἐπὶ τὰ κακά ἃ ἐπήγαγον ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ πάντα τὰ κακὰ ἃ ἐπήγαγον ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: And they shall comfort you, when you shall see their ways, and their doings: and you shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et consolabuntur vos, cum videritis viam eorum et adinventiones eorum : et cognoscetis quod non frustra fecerim omnia quæ feci in ea, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E sereis consolados, quando virdes o seu caminho e os seus feitos; e sabereis que não fiz sem razão tudo quanto nela tenho feito, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ παρακαλέσουσιν ὑμᾶς διότι ὄψεσθε τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἐνθυμήματα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι οὐ μάτην πεποίηκα πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτῇ λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , what shall be made of the wood of the vine, out of all the trees of the woods that are among the trees of the forests?
text_la: Fili hominis, quid fiet de ligno vitis, ex omnibus lignis nemorum quæ sunt inter ligna silvarum?
text_pt: Filho do homem, que mais é a árvore da videira do que qualquer outra árvore, ou do que o sarmento que está entre as árvores do bosque?
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τί ἂν γένοιτο τὸ ξύλον τῆς ἀμπέλου ἐκ πάντων τῶν ξύλων τῶν κλημάτων τῶν ὄντων ἐν τοῖς ξύλοις τοῦ δρυμοῦ

text_en: Shall wood be taken of it, to do any work, or shall a pin be made of it for any vessel to hang thereon?
text_la: numquid tolletur de ea lignum ut fiat opus, aut fabricabitur de ea paxillus ut dependeat in eo quodcumque vas?
text_pt: Toma-se dela madeira para fazer alguma obra? Ou toma-se dela alguma estaca, para que se lhe pendure um vaso?
text_el: εἰ λήμψονται ἐξ αὐτῆς ξύλον τοῦ ποιῆσαι εἰς ἐργασίαν εἰ λήμψονται ἐξ αὐτῆς πάσσαλον τοῦ κρεμάσαι ἐπ' αὐτὸν πᾶν σκεῦος

text_en: Behold it is cast into the fire for fuel: the fire has consumed both ends thereof, and the midst thereof is reduced to ashes: shall it be useful for any work?
text_la: Ecce igni datum est in escam : utramque partem ejus consumpsit ignis, et medietas ejus redacta est in favillam : numquid utile erit ad opus?
text_pt: Eis que é lançado no fogo, para ser consumido; ambas as suas extremidades consome o fogo, e o meio dela fica também queimado; serviria porventura para alguma obra?
text_el: πάρεξ πυρὶ δέδοται εἰς ἀνάλωσιν τὴν κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν κάθαρσιν ἀπ' αὐτῆς ἀναλίσκει τὸ πῦρ καὶ ἐκλείπει εἰς τέλος μὴ χρήσιμον ἔσται εἰς ἐργασίαν

text_en: Even when it was whole it was not fit for work: how much less, when the fire has devoured and consumed it, shall any work be made of it?
text_la: Etiam cum esset integrum, non erat aptum ad opus : quanto magis cum illud ignis devoraverit et combusserit, nihil ex eo fiet operis?
text_pt: Ora, se estando inteiro, não servia para obra alguma, quanto menos sendo consumido pelo fogo, e, sendo queimado, se faria ainda obra dele?
text_el: οὐδὲ ἔτι αὐτοῦ ὄντος ὁλοκλήρου οὐκ ἔσται εἰς ἐργασίαν μὴ ὅτι ἐὰν καὶ πῦρ αὐτὸ ἀναλώσῃ εἰς τέλος εἰ ἔσται ἔτι εἰς ἐργασίαν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : As the vine tree among the trees of the forests which I have given to the fire to be consumed, so will I deliver up the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quomodo lignum vitis inter ligna silvarum, quod dedi igni ad devorandum, sic tradam habitatores Jerusalem.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Como a árvore da videira entre as árvores do bosque, que tenho entregue ao fogo para que seja consumido, assim entregarei os habitantes de Jerusalém.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ὃν τρόπον τὸ ξύλον τῆς ἀμπέλου ἐν τοῖς ξύλοις τοῦ δρυμοῦ ὃ δέδωκα αὐτὸ τῷ πυρὶ εἰς ἀνάλωσιν οὕτως δέδωκα τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And I will set my face against them: they shall go out from fire, and fire shall consume them: and you shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall have set my face against them.
text_la: Et ponam faciem meam in eos : de igne egredientur, et ignis consumet eos : et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum posuero faciem meam in eos,
text_pt: E porei a minha face contra eles; do fogo sairão, mas o fogo os consumirá; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor, quando tiver posto a minha face contra eles.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐπ' αὐτούς ἐκ τοῦ πυρὸς ἐξελεύσονται καὶ πῦρ αὐτοὺς καταφάγεται καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐν τῷ στηρίσαι με τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And I shall have made their land a wilderness , and desolate, because they have been transgressors, says the Lord God .
text_la: et dedero terram inviam et desolatam, eo quod prævaricatores extiterint, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E tornarei a terra em desolação, porquanto grandemente transgrediram, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὴν γῆν εἰς ἀφανισμὸν ἀνθ' ὧν παρέπεσον παραπτώματι λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim outra vez a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , make known to Jerusalem her abominations .
text_la: Fili hominis, notas fac Jerusalem abominationes suas,
text_pt: Filho do homem, faze conhecer a Jerusalém as suas abominações.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου διαμάρτυραι τῇ Ιερουσαλημ τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῆς

text_en: And you shall say: Thus says the Lord God to Jerusalem : Your root, and your nativity is of the land of Chanaan , your father was an Amorrhite , and your mother a Cethite.
text_la: et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Jerusalem : Radix tua et generatio tua de terra Chanaan : pater tuus Amorrhæus, et mater tua Cethæa.
text_pt: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS a Jerusalém: A tua origem e o teu nascimento procedem da terra dos cananeus. Teu pai era amorreu, e tua mãe hetéia.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος τῇ Ιερουσαλημ ἡ ῥίζα σου καὶ ἡ γένεσίς σου ἐκ γῆς Χανααν ὁ πατήρ σου Αμορραῖος καὶ ἡ μήτηρ σου Χετταία

text_en: And when you were born, in the day of your nativity your navel was not cut, neither were you washed with water for your health, nor salted with salt , nor swaddled with clouts.
text_la: Et quando nata es, in die ortus tui non est præcisus umbilicus tuus, et aqua non es lota in salutem, nec sale salita, nec involuta pannis.
text_pt: E, quanto ao teu nascimento, no dia em que nasceste não te foi cortado o umbigo, nem foste lavada com água para te limpar; nem tampouco foste esfregada com sal, nem envolta em faixas.
text_el: καὶ ἡ γένεσίς σου ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐτέχθης οὐκ ἔδησαν τοὺς μαστούς σου καὶ ἐν ὕδατι οὐκ ἐλούσθης οὐδὲ ἁλὶ ἡλίσθης καὶ σπαργάνοις οὐκ ἐσπαργανώθης

text_en: No eye had pity on you to do any of these things for you, out of compassion to you: but you were cast out upon the face of the earth in the abjection of your soul , in the day that you were born.
text_la: Non pepercit super te oculus, ut faceret tibi unum de his, misertus tui : sed projecta es super faciem terræ in abjectione animæ tuæ in die qua nata es.
text_pt: Não se apiedou de ti olho algum, para te fazer alguma coisa disto, compadecendo-se de ti; antes foste lançada em pleno campo, pelo nojo da tua pessoa, no dia em que nasceste.
text_el: οὐδὲ ἐφείσατο ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπὶ σοὶ τοῦ ποιῆσαί σοι ἓν ἐκ πάντων τούτων τοῦ παθεῖν τι ἐπὶ σοί καὶ ἀπερρίφης ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τοῦ πεδίου τῇ σκολιότητι τῆς ψυχῆς σου ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐτέχθης

text_en: And passing by you, I saw that you were trodden under foot in your own blood: and I said to you when you were in your blood: Live: I have said to you: Live in your blood.
text_la: Transiens autem per te, vidi te conculcari in sanguine tuo : et dixi tibi cum esses in sanguine tuo : Vive, dixi, inquam, tibi : in sanguine tuo vive.
text_pt: E, passando eu junto de ti, vi-te a revolver-te no teu sangue, e disse-te: Ainda que estejas no teu sangue, vive; sim, disse-te: Ainda que estejas no teu sangue, vive.
text_el: καὶ διῆλθον ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ εἶδόν σε πεφυρμένην ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου καὶ εἶπά σοι ἐκ τοῦ αἵματός σου ζωή

text_en: I caused you to multiply as the bud of the field: and you increased and grew great, and advanced, and came to woman's ornament: your breasts were fashioned, and your hair grew: and you were naked, and full of confusion.
text_la: Multiplicatam quasi germen agri dedi te : et multiplicata es, et grandis effecta, et ingressa es, et pervenisti ad mundum muliebrem : ubera tua intumuerunt, et pilus tuus germinavit : et eras nuda, et confusione plena.
text_pt: Eu te fiz multiplicar como o renovo do campo, e cresceste, e te engrandeceste, e chegaste à grande formosura; avultaram os seios, e cresceu o teu cabelo; mas estavas nua e descoberta.
text_el: πληθύνου καθὼς ἡ ἀνατολὴ τοῦ ἀγροῦ δέδωκά σε καὶ ἐπληθύνθης καὶ ἐμεγαλύνθης καὶ εἰσῆλθες εἰς πόλεις πόλεων οἱ μαστοί σου ἀνωρθώθησαν καὶ ἡ θρίξ σου ἀνέτειλεν σὺ δὲ ἦσθα γυμνὴ καὶ ἀσχημονοῦσα

text_en: And I passed by you, and saw you: and behold your time was the time of lovers: and I spread my garment over you, and covered your ignominy. And I swore to you, and I entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord God : and you became mine.
text_la: Et transivi per te, et vidi te : et ecce tempus tuum, tempus amantium : et expandi amictum meum super te, et operui ignominiam tuam : et juravi tibi, et ingressus sum pactum tecum, ait Dominus Deus, et facta es mihi.
text_pt: E, passando eu junto de ti, vi-te, e eis que o teu tempo era tempo de amores; e estendi sobre ti a aba do meu manto, e cobri a tua nudez; e dei-te juramento, e entrei em aliança contigo, diz o Senhor DEUS, e tu ficaste sendo minha.
text_el: καὶ διῆλθον διὰ σοῦ καὶ εἶδόν σε καὶ ἰδοὺ καιρός σου καιρὸς καταλυόντων καὶ διεπέτασα τὰς πτέρυγάς μου ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐκάλυψα τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην σου καὶ ὤμοσά σοι καὶ εἰσῆλθον ἐν διαθήκῃ μετὰ σοῦ λέγει κύριος καὶ ἐγένου μοι

text_en: And I washed you with water, and cleansed away your blood from you: and I anointed you with oil.
text_la: Et lavi te aqua, et emundavi sanguinem tuum ex te, et unxi te oleo.
text_pt: Então te lavei com água, e te enxuguei do teu sangue, e te ungi com óleo.
text_el: καὶ ἔλουσά σε ἐν ὕδατι καὶ ἀπέπλυνα τὸ αἷμά σου ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἔχρισά σε ἐν ἐλαίῳ

text_en: And I clothed you with embroidery , and shod you with violet coloured shoes: and I girded you about with fine linen, and clothed you with fine garments.
text_la: Et vestivi te discoloribus, et calceavi te janthino, et cinxi te bysso, et indui te subtilibus:
text_pt: E te vesti com roupas bordadas, e te calcei com pele de texugo, e te cingi com linho fino, e te cobri de seda.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέδυσά σε ποικίλα καὶ ὑπέδησά σε ὑάκινθον καὶ ἔζωσά σε βύσσῳ καὶ περιέβαλόν σε τριχάπτῳ

text_en: I decked you also with ornaments, and put bracelets on your hands, and a chain about your neck.
text_la: et ornavi te ornamento, et dedi armillas in manibus tuis, et torquem circa collum tuum:
text_pt: E te enfeitei com adornos, e te pus braceletes nas mãos e um colar ao redor do teu pescoço.
text_el: καὶ ἐκόσμησά σε κόσμῳ καὶ περιέθηκα ψέλια περὶ τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ κάθεμα περὶ τὸν τράχηλόν σου

text_en: And I put a jewel upon your forehead and earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.
text_la: et dedi inaurem super os tuum, et circulos auribus tuis, et coronam decoris in capite tuo.
text_pt: E te pus um pendente na testa, e brincos nas orelhas, e uma coroa de glória na cabeça.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκα ἐνώτιον περὶ τὸν μυκτῆρά σου καὶ τροχίσκους ἐπὶ τὰ ὦτά σου καὶ στέφανον καυχήσεως ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν σου

text_en: And you were adorned with gold, and silver, and clothed with fine linen, and embroidered work , and many colours: you ate fine flour, and honey, and oil, and were made exceeding beautiful: and were advanced to be a queen.
text_la: Et ornata es auro et argento, et vestita es bysso et polymito et multicoloribus : similam, et mel, et oleum comedisti : et decora facta es vehementer nimis, et profecisti in regnum.
text_pt: E assim foste ornada de ouro e prata, e o teu vestido foi de linho fino, e de seda e de bordados; nutriste-te de flor de farinha, e mel e azeite; e foste formosa em extremo, e foste próspera, até chegares a realeza.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοσμήθης χρυσίῳ καὶ ἀργυρίῳ καὶ τὰ περιβόλαιά σου βύσσινα καὶ τρίχαπτα καὶ ποικίλα σεμίδαλιν καὶ ἔλαιον καὶ μέλι ἔφαγες καὶ ἐγένου καλὴ σφόδρα

text_en: And your renown went forth among the nations for your beauty: for you were perfect through my beauty, which I had put upon you, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et egressum est nomen tuum in gentes propter speciem tuam, quia perfecta eras in decore meo quem posueram super te, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E correu de ti a tua fama entre os gentios, por causa da tua formosura, pois era perfeita, por causa da minha glória que eu pusera em ti, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθέν σου ὄνομα ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐν τῷ κάλλει σου διότι συντετελεσμένον ἦν ἐν εὐπρεπείᾳ ἐν τῇ ὡραιότητι ᾗ ἔταξα ἐπὶ σέ λέγει κύριος

text_en: But trusting in your beauty, you played the harlot because of your renown, and you have prostituted yourself to every passenger, to be his.
text_la: Et habens fiduciam in pulchritudine tua, fornicata es in nomine tuo : et exposuisti fornicationem tuam omni transeunti, ut ejus fieres.
text_pt: Mas confiaste na tua formosura, e te corrompeste por causa da tua fama, e prostituías-te a todo o que passava, para seres dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεποίθεις ἐν τῷ κάλλει σου καὶ ἐπόρνευσας ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου καὶ ἐξέχεας τὴν πορνείαν σου ἐπὶ πάντα πάροδον ὃ οὐκ ἔσται

text_en: And taking of your garments you have made you high places sewed together on each side: and have played the harlot upon them, as has not been done before, nor shall be hereafter.
text_la: Et sumens de vestimentis tuis, fecisti tibi excelsa hinc inde consuta, et fornicata es super eis sicut non est factum, neque futurum est.
text_pt: E tomaste dos teus vestidos, e fizeste lugares altos pintados de diversas cores, e te prostituíste sobre eles, como nunca sucedera, nem sucederá.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβες ἐκ τῶν ἱματίων σου καὶ ἐποίησας σεαυτῇ εἴδωλα ῥαπτὰ καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσας ἐπ' αὐτά καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃς οὐδὲ μὴ γένηται

text_en: And you took your beautiful vessels, of my gold, and my silver, which I gave you, and you made you images of men , and have committed fornication with them.
text_la: Et tulisti vasa decoris tui de auro meo atque argento meo, quæ dedi tibi, et fecisti tibi imagines masculinas, et fornicata es in eis.
text_pt: E tomaste as tuas jóias de enfeite, que eu te dei do meu ouro e da minha prata, e fizeste imagens de homens, e te prostituíste com elas.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβες τὰ σκεύη τῆς καυχήσεώς σου ἐκ τοῦ χρυσίου μου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ἀργυρίου μου ἐξ ὧν ἔδωκά σοι καὶ ἐποίησας σεαυτῇ εἰκόνας ἀρσενικὰς καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσας ἐν αὐταῖς

text_en: And you took your garments of divers colours, and covered them: and set my oil and my sweet incense before them.
text_la: Et sumpsisti vestimenta tua multicoloria, et operuisti illas, et oleum meum et thymiama meum posuisti coram eis.
text_pt: E tomaste os teus vestidos bordados, e as cobriste; e o meu azeite e o meu perfume puseste diante delas.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβες τὸν ἱματισμὸν τὸν ποικίλον σου καὶ περιέβαλες αὐτὰ καὶ τὸ ἔλαιόν μου καὶ τὸ θυμίαμά μου ἔθηκας πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: And my bread which I gave you, the fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed you, you have set before them for a sweet odour; and it was done, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et panem meum quem dedi tibi, similam, et oleum, et mel, quibus enutrivi te, posuisti in conspectu eorum in odorem suavitatis : et factum est, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E o meu pão que te dei, a flor de farinha, e o azeite e o mel com que eu te sustentava, também puseste diante delas em cheiro suave; e assim foi, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους μου οὓς ἔδωκά σοι σεμίδαλιν καὶ ἔλαιον καὶ μέλι ἐψώμισά σε καὶ ἔθηκας αὐτὰ πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας καὶ ἐγένετο λέγει κύριος

text_en: And you have taken your sons, and your daughters, whom you have borne to me: and have sacrificed the same to them to be devoured. Is your fornication small?
text_la: Et tulisti filios tuos et filias tuas quas generasti mihi, et immolasti eis ad devorandum. Numquid parva est fornicatio tua?
text_pt: Além disto, tomaste a teus filhos e tuas filhas, que me tinhas gerado, e os sacrificaste a elas, para serem consumidos; acaso é pequena a tua prostituição?
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβες τοὺς υἱούς σου καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας σου ἃς ἐγέννησας καὶ ἔθυσας αὐτὰ αὐτοῖς εἰς ἀνάλωσιν ὡς μικρὰ ἐξεπόρνευσας

text_en: You have sacrificed and given my children to them, consecrating them by fire.
text_la: Immolasti filios meos, et dedisti, illos consecrans, eis.
text_pt: E mataste a meus filhos, e os entregaste a elas para os fazerem passar pelo fogo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσφαξας τὰ τέκνα σου καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτὰ ἐν τῷ ἀποτροπιάζεσθαί σε ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And after all your abominations, and fornications, you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked, and full of confusion, trodden under foot in your own blood.
text_la: Et post omnes abominationes tuas et fornicationes, non es recordata dierum adolescentiæ tuæ, quando eras nuda et confusione plena, conculcata in sanguine tuo.
text_pt: E em todas as tuas abominações, e nas tuas prostituições, não te lembraste dos dias da tua mocidade, quando tu estavas nua e descoberta, e revolvida no teu sangue.
text_el: τοῦτο παρὰ πᾶσαν τὴν πορνείαν σου καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθης τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς νηπιότητός σου ὅτε ἦσθα γυμνὴ καὶ ἀσχημονοῦσα καὶ πεφυρμένη ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου ἔζησας

text_en: And it came to pass after all your wickedness (woe, woe to you, says the Lord God )
text_la: Et accidit post omnem malitiam tuam (væ, væ tibi! ait Dominus Deus),
text_pt: E sucedeu, depois de toda a tua maldade (ai, ai de ti! diz o Senhor DEUS),
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ πάσας τὰς κακίας σου λέγει κύριος

text_en: that you also built you a common stew, and made you a brothel house in every street.
text_la: et ædificasti tibi lupanar, et fecisti tibi prostibulum in cunctis plateis.
text_pt: Que edificaste uma abóbada, e fizeste lugares altos em cada rua.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησας σεαυτῇ οἴκημα πορνικὸν καὶ ἐποίησας σεαυτῇ ἔκθεμα ἐν πάσῃ πλατείᾳ

text_en: At every head of the way you have set up a sign of your prostitution: and have made your beauty to be abominable: and have prostituted yourself to every one that passed by, and have multiplied your fornications.
text_la: Ad omne caput viæ ædificasti signum prostitutionis tuæ, et abominabilem fecisti decorem tuum : et divisisti pedes tuos omni transeunti, et multiplicasti fornicationes tuas:
text_pt: A cada canto do caminho edificaste o teu lugar alto, e fizeste abominável a tua formosura, e alargaste os teus pés a todo o que passava, e multiplicaste as tuas prostituições.
text_el: καὶ ἐπ' ἀρχῆς πάσης ὁδοῦ ᾠκοδόμησας τὰ πορνεῖά σου καὶ ἐλυμήνω τὸ κάλλος σου καὶ διήγαγες τὰ σκέλη σου παντὶ παρόδῳ καὶ ἐπλήθυνας τὴν πορνείαν σου

text_en: And you have committed fornication with the Egyptians your neighbours, men of large bodies, and have multiplied your fornications to provoke me.
text_la: et fornicata es cum filiis Ægypti, vicinis tuis, magnarum carnium : et multiplicasti fornicationem tuam ad irritandum me.
text_pt: Também te prostituíste com os filhos do Egito, teus vizinhos grandes de carne, e multiplicaste a tua prostituição para me provocares à ira.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσας ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Αἰγύπτου τοὺς ὁμοροῦντάς σοι τοὺς μεγαλοσάρκους καὶ πολλαχῶς ἐξεπόρνευσας τοῦ παροργίσαι με

text_en: Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon you, and will take away your justification: and I will deliver you up to the will of the daughters of the Philistines that hate you, that are ashamed of your wicked way.
text_la: Ecce ego extendam manum meam super te, et auferam justificationem tuam, et dabo te in animas odientium te filiarum Palæstinarum, quæ erubescunt in via tua scelerata.
text_pt: Por isso estendi a minha mão sobre ti, e diminuí a tua porção; e te entreguei à vontade das que te odeiam, das filhas dos filisteus, as quais se envergonhavam do teu caminho depravado.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐκτείνω τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ σέ καὶ ἐξαρῶ τὰ νόμιμά σου καὶ παραδώσω σε εἰς ψυχὰς μισούντων σε θυγατέρας ἀλλοφύλων τὰς ἐκκλινούσας σε ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ σου ἧς ἠσέβησας

text_en: You have also committed fornication with the Assyrians , because you were not yet satisfied: and after you had played the harlot with them, even so you were not contented.
text_la: Et fornicata es in filiis Assyriorum eo quod necdum fueris expleta : et postquam fornicata es, nec sic es satiata:
text_pt: Também te prostituíste com os filhos da Assíria, porquanto eras insaciável; e prostituindo-te com eles, nem ainda assim ficaste farta.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσας ἐπὶ τὰς θυγατέρας Ασσουρ καὶ οὐδ' οὕτως ἐνεπλήσθης καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσας καὶ οὐκ ἐνεπίπλω

text_en: You have also multiplied your fornications in the land of Chanaan with the Chaldeans : and neither so were you satisfied.
text_la: et multiplicasti fornicationem tuam in terra Chanaan cum Chaldæis, et nec sic satiata es.
text_pt: Antes multiplicaste as tuas prostituições na terra de Canaã até Caldéia, e nem ainda com isso te fartaste.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλήθυνας τὰς διαθήκας σου πρὸς γῆν Χαλδαίων καὶ οὐδὲ ἐν τούτοις ἐνεπλήσθης

text_en: Wherein shall I cleanse your heart, says Lord God : seeing you do all these the works of a shameless prostitute?
text_la: In quo mundabo cor tuum, ait Dominus Deus, cum facias omnia hæc opera mulieris meretricis et procacis?
text_pt: Quão fraco é o teu coração, diz o Senhor DEUS, fazendo tu todas estas coisas, obras de uma meretriz imperiosa!
text_el: τί διαθῶ τὴν θυγατέρα σου λέγει κύριος ἐν τῷ ποιῆσαί σε ταῦτα πάντα ἔργα γυναικὸς πόρνης καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσας τρισσῶς

text_en: Because you have built your brothel house at the head of every way, and you have made your high place in every street: and was not as a harlot that by disdain enhances her price,
text_la: Quia fabricasti lupanar tuum in capite omnis viæ, et excelsum tuum fecisti in omni platea : nec facta es quasi meretrix fastidio augens pretium,
text_pt: Edificando tu a tua abóbada ao canto de cada caminho, e fazendo o teu lugar alto em cada rua! Nem foste como a meretriz, pois desprezaste a paga;
text_el: ἐν ταῖς θυγατράσιν σου τὸ πορνεῖόν σου ᾠκοδόμησας ἐπὶ πάσης ἀρχῆς ὁδοῦ καὶ τὴν βάσιν σου ἐποίησας ἐν πάσῃ πλατείᾳ καὶ ἐγένου ὡς πόρνη συνάγουσα μισθώματα

text_en: but is an adulteress, that brings in strangers over her husband.
text_la: sed quasi mulier adultera, quæ super virum suum inducit alienos.
text_pt: Foste como a mulher adúltera que, em lugar de seu marido, recebe os estranhos.
text_el: ἡ γυνὴ ἡ μοιχωμένη ὁμοία σοι παρὰ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς λαμβάνουσα μισθώματα

text_en: Gifts are given to all harlots: but you have given hire to all your lovers, and you have given them gifts to come to you from every side, to commit fornication with you.
text_la: Omnibus meretricibus dantur mercedes : tu autem dedisti mercedes cunctis amatoribus tuis, et dona donabas eis, ut intrarent ad te undique ad fornicandum tecum.
text_pt: A todas as meretrizes dão paga, mas tu dás os teus presentes a todos os teus amantes; e lhes dás presentes, para que venham a ti de todas as partes, pelas tuas prostituições.
text_el: πᾶσι τοῖς ἐκπορνεύσασιν αὐτὴν προσεδίδου μισθώματα καὶ σὺ δέδωκας μισθώματα πᾶσι τοῖς ἐρασταῖς σου καὶ ἐφόρτιζες αὐτοὺς τοῦ ἔρχεσθαι πρὸς σὲ κυκλόθεν ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ σου

text_en: And it has happened in you contrary to the custom of women in your fornications, and after you there shall be no such fornication, for in that you gave rewards, and did not take rewards, the contrary has been done in you.
text_la: Factumque est in te contra consuetudinem mulierum in fornicationibus tuis, et post te non erit fornicatio : in eo enim quod dedisti mercedes, et mercedes non accepisti, factum est in te contrarium.
text_pt: Assim que contigo sucede o contrário das outras mulheres nas tuas prostituições, pois ninguém te procura para prostituição; porque, dando tu a paga, e a ti não sendo dada a paga, fazes o contrário.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν σοὶ διεστραμμένον παρὰ τὰς γυναῖκας ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ σου καὶ μετὰ σοῦ πεπορνεύκασιν ἐν τῷ προσδιδόναι σε μισθώματα καὶ σοὶ μισθώματα οὐκ ἐδόθη καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν σοὶ διεστραμμένα

text_en: Therefore, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord .
text_la: Propterea, meretrix, audi verbum Domini.
text_pt: Portanto, ó meretriz, ouve a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πόρνη ἄκουε λόγον κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because your money has been poured out, and your shame discovered through your fornications with your lovers, and with the idols of your abominations, by the blood of your children whom you gave them:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia effusum est æs tuum et revelata est ignominia tua in fornicationibus tuis super amatores tuos, et super idola abominationum tuarum, in sanguine filiorum tuorum quos dedisti eis,
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto se derramou o teu dinheiro, e se descobriu a tua nudez nas tuas prostituições com os teus amantes, como também com todos os ídolos das tuas abominações, e do sangue de teus filhos que lhes deste;
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐξέχεας τὸν χαλκόν σου καὶ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ἡ αἰσχύνη σου ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ σου πρὸς τοὺς ἐραστάς σου καὶ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἐνθυμήματα τῶν ἀνομιῶν σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς αἵμασιν τῶν τέκνων σου ὧν ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς

text_en: Behold, I will gather together all your lovers with whom you have taken pleasure, and all whom you have loved , with all whom you have hated : and I will gather them together against you on every side, and will discover your shame in their sight, and they shall see all your nakedness.
text_la: ecce ego congregabo omnes amatores tuos quibus commista es, et omnes quos dilexisti, cum universis quos oderas : et congregabo eos super te undique, et nudabo ignominiam tuam coram eis, et videbunt omnem turpitudinem tuam.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que ajuntarei a todos os teus amantes, com os quais te deleitaste, como também a todos os que amaste, com todos os que odiaste, e ajuntá-los-ei contra ti em redor, e descobrirei a tua nudez diante deles, para que vejam toda a tua nudez.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ συνάγω πάντας τοὺς ἐραστάς σου ἐν οἷς ἐπεμίγης ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ πάντας οὓς ἠγάπησας σὺν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐμίσεις καὶ συνάξω αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ σὲ κυκλόθεν καὶ ἀποκαλύψω τὰς κακίας σου πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ ὄψονται πᾶσαν τὴν αἰσχύνην σου

text_en: And I will judge you as adulteresses, and they that shed blood are judged: and I will give you blood in fury and jealousy .
text_la: Et judicabo te judiciis adulterarum, et effundentium sanguinem : et dabo te in sanguinem furoris et zeli.
text_pt: E julgar-te-ei como são julgadas as adúlteras e as que derramam sangue; e entregar-te-ei ao sangue de furor e de ciúme.
text_el: καὶ ἐκδικήσω σε ἐκδικήσει μοιχαλίδος καὶ ἐκχεούσης αἷμα καὶ θήσω σε ἐν αἵματι θυμοῦ καὶ ζήλου

text_en: And I will deliver you into their hands, and they shall destroy your brothel house, and throw down your stews: and they shall strip you of your garments, and shall take away the vessels of your beauty: and leave you naked, and full of disgrace.
text_la: Et dabo te in manus eorum, et destruent lupanar tuum, et demolientur prostibulum tuum : et denudabunt te vestimentis tuis, et auferent vasa decoris tui, et derelinquent te nudam, plenamque ignominia:
text_pt: E entregar-te-ei nas mãos deles; e eles derrubarão a tua abóbada, e transtornarão os teus altos lugares, e te despirão os teus vestidos, e tomarão as tuas jóias de enfeite, e te deixarão nua e descoberta.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσω σε εἰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ κατασκάψουσιν τὸ πορνεῖόν σου καὶ καθελοῦσιν τὴν βάσιν σου καὶ ἐκδύσουσίν σε τὸν ἱματισμόν σου καὶ λήμψονται τὰ σκεύη τῆς καυχήσεώς σου καὶ ἀφήσουσίν σε γυμνὴν καὶ ἀσχημονοῦσαν

text_en: And they shall bring upon you a multitude, and they shall stone you with stones, and shall slay you with their swords.
text_la: et adducent super te multitudinem, et lapidabunt te lapidibus, et trucidabunt te gladiis suis:
text_pt: Então farão subir contra ti uma multidão, e te apedrejarão, e te traspassarão com as suas espadas.
text_el: καὶ ἄξουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ ὄχλους καὶ λιθοβολήσουσίν σε ἐν λίθοις καὶ κατασφάξουσίν σε ἐν τοῖς ξίφεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall burn your houses with fire, and shall execute judgments upon you in the sight of many women : and you shall cease from fornication, and shall give no hire any more.
text_la: et comburent domos tuas igni, et facient in te judicia in oculis mulierum plurimarum. Et desines fornicari, et mercedes ultra non dabis:
text_pt: E queimarão as tuas casas a fogo, e executarão juízos contra ti aos olhos de muitas mulheres; e te farei cessar de ser meretriz, e paga não darás mais.
text_el: καὶ ἐμπρήσουσιν τοὺς οἴκους σου πυρὶ καὶ ποιήσουσιν ἐν σοὶ ἐκδικήσεις ἐνώπιον γυναικῶν πολλῶν καὶ ἀποστρέψω σε ἐκ τῆς πορνείας σου καὶ μισθώματα οὐ μὴ δῷς οὐκέτι

text_en: And my indignation shall rest in you: and my jealousy shall depart from you, and I will cease and be angry no more.
text_la: et requiescet indignatio mea in te, et auferetur zelus meus a te : et quiescam, nec irascar amplius.
text_pt: Assim satisfarei em ti o meu furor, e os meus ciúmes se desviarão de ti, e me aquietarei, e nunca mais me indignarei.
text_el: καὶ ἐπαφήσω τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπὶ σέ καὶ ἐξαρθήσεται ὁ ζῆλός μου ἐκ σοῦ καὶ ἀναπαύσομαι καὶ οὐ μὴ μεριμνήσω οὐκέτι

text_en: Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have provoked me in all these things: wherefore I also have turned all your ways upon your head, says the Lord God , and I have not done according to your wicked deeds in all your abominations.
text_la: Eo quod non fueris recordata dierum adolescentiæ tuæ, et provocasti me in omnibus his, quapropter et ego vias tuas in capite tuo dedi, ait Dominus Deus, et non feci juxta scelera tua in omnibus abominationibus tuis.
text_pt: Porquanto não te lembraste dos dias da tua mocidade, e me provocaste à ira com tudo isto, eis que também eu farei recair o teu caminho sobre a tua cabeça, diz o Senhor DEUS, e não mais farás tal perversidade sobre todas as tuas abominações.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθης τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς νηπιότητός σου καὶ ἐλύπεις με ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις καὶ ἐγὼ ἰδοὺ τὰς ὁδούς σου εἰς κεφαλήν σου δέδωκα λέγει κύριος καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησας τὴν ἀσέβειαν ἐπὶ πάσαις ταῖς ἀνομίαις σου

text_en: Behold every one that uses a common proverb, shall use this against you, saying: As the mother was, so also is her daughter.
text_la: Ecce omnis qui dicit vulgo proverbium, in te assumet illud, dicens : Sicut mater, ita et filia ejus.
text_pt: Eis que todo o que usa de provérbios usará contra ti este provérbio, dizendo: Tal mãe, tal filha.
text_el: ταῦτά ἐστιν πάντα ὅσα εἶπαν κατὰ σοῦ ἐν παραβολῇ λέγοντες καθὼς ἡ μήτηρ καὶ ἡ θυγάτηρ

text_en: You are your mother's daughter, that cast off her husband, and her children: and you are the sister of your sisters, who cast off their husbands, and their children: your mother was a Cethite, and your father an Amorrhite .
text_la: Filia matris tuæ es tu, quæ projecit virum suum et filios suos : et soror sororum tuarum es tu, quæ projecerunt viros suos et filios suos : mater vestra Cethæa, et pater vester Amorrhæus.
text_pt: Tu és filha de tua mãe, que tinha nojo de seu marido e de seus filhos; e tu és irmã de tuas irmãs, que tinham nojo de seus maridos e de seus filhos; vossa mãe foi hetéia, e vosso pai amorreu.
text_el: θυγάτηρ τῆς μητρός σου σὺ εἶ ἡ ἀπωσαμένη τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς καὶ ἀδελφὴ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν ἀπωσαμένων τοὺς ἄνδρας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἡ μήτηρ ὑμῶν Χετταία καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν Αμορραῖος

text_en: And your elder sister is Samaria , she and her daughters that dwell at your left hand: and your younger sister that dwells at your right hand is Sodom , and her daughters.
text_la: Et soror tua major, Samaria, ipsa et filiæ ejus, quæ habitant ad sinistram tuam : soror autem tua minor te, quæ habitat a dextris tuis, Sodoma, et filiæ ejus.
text_pt: E tua irmã, a maior, é Samaria, ela e suas filhas, a qual habita à tua esquerda; e a tua irmã menor, que habita à tua mão direita, é Sodoma e suas filhas.
text_el: ἡ ἀδελφὴ ὑμῶν ἡ πρεσβυτέρα Σαμάρεια αὐτὴ καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς ἡ κατοικοῦσα ἐξ εὐωνύμων σου καὶ ἡ ἀδελφή σου ἡ νεωτέρα σου ἡ κατοικοῦσα ἐκ δεξιῶν σου Σοδομα καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς

text_en: But neither have you walked in their ways, nor have you done a little less than they according to their wickednesses : you have done almost more wicked things than they in all your ways.
text_la: Sed nec in viis earum ambulasti, neque secundum scelera earum fecisti pauxillum minus : pene sceleratiora fecisti illis in omnibus viis tuis.
text_pt: Todavia não andaste nos seus caminhos, nem fizeste conforme as suas abominações; mas como se isto fora mui pouco, ainda te corrompeste mais do que elas, em todos os teus caminhos.
text_el: καὶ οὐδ' ὧς ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν ἐπορεύθης οὐδὲ κατὰ τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῶν ἐποίησας παρὰ μικρὸν καὶ ὑπέρκεισαι αὐτὰς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς σου

text_en: As I live, says the Lord God , your sister Sodom herself, and her daughters, have not done as you have done, and your daughters.
text_la: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quia non fecit Sodoma soror tua, ipsa et filiæ ejus, sicut fecisti tu et filiæ tuæ.
text_pt: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que não fez Sodoma, tua irmã, nem ela, nem suas filhas, como fizeste tu e tuas filhas.
text_el: ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος εἰ πεποίηκεν Σοδομα ἡ ἀδελφή σου αὐτὴ καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησας σὺ καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες σου

text_en: Behold this was the iniquity of Sodom your sister, pride , fullness of bread, and abundance, and the idleness of her, and of her daughters: and they did not put forth their hand to the needy , and the poor.
text_la: Ecce hæc fuit iniquitas Sodomæ sororis tuæ : superbia, saturitas panis et abundantia, et otium ipsius et filiarum ejus : et manum egeno et pauperi non porrigebant:
text_pt: Eis que esta foi a iniqüidade de Sodoma, tua irmã: Soberba, fartura de pão, e abundância de ociosidade teve ela e suas filhas; mas nunca fortaleceu a mão do pobre e do necessitado.
text_el: πλὴν τοῦτο τὸ ἀνόμημα Σοδομων τῆς ἀδελφῆς σου ὑπερηφανία ἐν πλησμονῇ ἄρτων καὶ ἐν εὐθηνίᾳ οἴνου ἐσπατάλων αὐτὴ καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς τοῦτο ὑπῆρχεν αὐτῇ καὶ ταῖς θυγατράσιν αὐτῆς καὶ χεῖρα πτωχοῦ καὶ πένητος οὐκ ἀντελαμβάνοντο

text_en: And they were lifted up, and committed abominations before me: and I took them away as you have seen.
text_la: et elevatæ sunt, et fecerunt abominationes coram me : et abstuli eas sicut vidisti.
text_pt: E se ensoberbeceram, e fizeram abominações diante de mim; portanto, vendo eu isto as tirei dali.
text_el: καὶ ἐμεγαλαύχουν καὶ ἐποίησαν ἀνομήματα ἐνώπιόν μου καὶ ἐξῆρα αὐτάς καθὼς εἶδον

text_en: And Samaria committed not half your sins : but you have surpassed them with your crimes, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
text_la: Et Samaria dimidium peccatorum tuorum non peccavit : sed vicisti eas sceleribus tuis, et justificasti sorores tuas in omnibus abominationibus tuis quas operata es.
text_pt: Também Samaria não cometeu a metade de teus pecados; e multiplicaste as tuas abominações mais do que elas, e justificaste a tuas irmãs, com todas as tuas abominações que fizeste.
text_el: καὶ Σαμάρεια κατὰ τὰς ἡμίσεις τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν σου οὐχ ἥμαρτεν καὶ ἐπλήθυνας τὰς ἀνομίας σου ὑπὲρ αὐτὰς καὶ ἐδικαίωσας τὰς ἀδελφάς σου ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἀνομίαις σου αἷς ἐποίησας

text_en: Therefore also bear your confusion, you that have surpassed your sisters with your sins , doing more wickedly than they: for they are justified above you, therefore be also confounded, and bear your shame, you that have justified your sisters.
text_la: Ergo et tu porta confusionem tuam, quæ vicisti sorores tuas peccatis tuis, sceleratius agens ab eis : justificatæ sunt enim a te : ergo et tu confundere, et porta ignominiam tuam, quæ justificasti sorores tuas.
text_pt: Tu, também, que julgaste a tuas irmãs, leva a tua vergonha pelos pecados, que cometeste, mais abomináveis do que elas; mais justas são do que tu; envergonha-te logo também, e leva a tua vergonha, pois justificaste a tuas irmãs.
text_el: καὶ σὺ κόμισαι βάσανόν σου ἐν ᾗ ἔφθειρας τὰς ἀδελφάς σου ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις σου αἷς ἠνόμησας ὑπὲρ αὐτὰς καὶ ἐδικαίωσας αὐτὰς ὑπὲρ σεαυτήν καὶ σὺ αἰσχύνθητι καὶ λαβὲ τὴν ἀτιμίαν σου ἐν τῷ δικαιῶσαί σε τὰς ἀδελφάς σου

text_en: And I will bring back and restore them by bringing back Sodom , with her daughters, and by bringing back Samaria , and her daughters: and I will bring those that return of you in the midst of them.
text_la: Et convertam restituens eas conversione Sodomorum cum filiabus suis, et conversione Samariæ et filiarum ejus, et convertam reversionem tuam in medio earum,
text_pt: Eu, pois, farei voltar os cativos delas; os cativos de Sodoma e suas filhas, e os cativos de Samaria e suas filhas, e os cativos do teu cativeiro dentre elas;
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὰς ἀποστροφὰς αὐτῶν τὴν ἀποστροφὴν Σοδομων καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων αὐτῆς καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὴν ἀποστροφὴν Σαμαρείας καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων αὐτῆς καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὴν ἀποστροφήν σου ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: That you may bear your shame, and may be confounded in all that you have done, comforting them.
text_la: ut portes ignominiam tuam, et confundaris in omnibus quæ fecisti consolans eas.
text_pt: Para que leves a tua vergonha, e sejas envergonhada por tudo o que fizeste, dando-lhes tu consolação.
text_el: ὅπως κομίσῃ τὴν βάσανόν σου καὶ ἀτιμωθήσῃ ἐκ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησας ἐν τῷ σε παροργίσαι με

text_en: And your sister Sodom and her daughters shall return to their ancient state: and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their ancient state: and you and your daughters shall return to your ancient state.
text_la: Et soror tua Sodoma et filiæ ejus revertentur ad antiquitatem suam, et Samaria et filiæ ejus revertentur ad antiquitatem suam, et tu et filiæ tuæ revertemini ad antiquitatem vestram.
text_pt: Quando tuas irmãs, Sodoma e suas filhas, tornarem ao seu primeiro estado, e também Samaria e suas filhas tornarem ao seu primeiro estado, também tu e tuas filhas tornareis ao vosso primeiro estado.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἀδελφή σου Σοδομα καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς ἀποκατασταθήσονται καθὼς ἦσαν ἀπ' ἀρχῆς καὶ Σαμάρεια καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς ἀποκατασταθήσονται καθὼς ἦσαν ἀπ' ἀρχῆς καὶ σὺ καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες σου ἀποκατασταθήσεσθε καθὼς ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἦτε

text_en: And Sodom your sister was not heard of in your mouth, in the day of your pride ,
text_la: Non fuit autem Sodoma soror tua audita in ore tuo in die superbiæ tuæ,
text_pt: Nem mesmo Sodoma, tua irmã, foi mencionada pela tua boca, no dia da tua soberba,
text_el: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἦν Σοδομα ἡ ἀδελφή σου εἰς ἀκοὴν ἐν τῷ στόματί σου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑπερηφανίας σου

text_en: before your malice was laid open: as it is at this time, making you a reproach of the daughters of Syria , and of all the daughters of Palestine round about you, that encompass you on all sides.
text_la: antequam revelaretur malitia tua, sicut hoc tempore in opprobrium filiarum Syriæ, et cunctarum in circuitu tuo filiarum Palæstinarum quæ ambiunt te per gyrum.
text_pt: Antes que se descobrisse a tua maldade, como no tempo do desprezo das filhas da Síria, e de todos os que estavam ao redor dela, as filhas dos filisteus, que te desprezavam em redor.
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι τὰς κακίας σου ὃν τρόπον νῦν ὄνειδος εἶ θυγατέρων Συρίας καὶ πάντων τῶν κύκλῳ αὐτῆς θυγατέρων ἀλλοφύλων τῶν περιεχουσῶν σε κύκλῳ

text_en: You have borne your wickedness , and your disgrace, says the Lord God .
text_la: Scelus tuum et ignominiam tuam tu portasti, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: A tua perversidade e as tuas abominações tu levarás, diz o Senhor.
text_el: τὰς ἀσεβείας σου καὶ τὰς ἀνομίας σου σὺ κεκόμισαι αὐτάς λέγει κύριος

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : I will deal with you, as you have despised the oath , in breaking the covenant:
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Et faciam tibi sicut despexisti juramentum, ut irritum faceres pactum:
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu te farei como fizeste, que desprezaste o juramento, quebrando a aliança.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ ποιήσω ἐν σοὶ καθὼς ἐποίησας ὡς ἠτίμωσας ταῦτα τοῦ παραβῆναι τὴν διαθήκην μου

text_en: And I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth: and I will establish with you an everlasting covenant.
text_la: et recordabor ego pacti mei tecum in diebus adolescentiæ tuæ, et suscitabo tibi pactum sempiternum.
text_pt: Contudo eu me lembrarei da minha aliança, que fiz contigo nos dias da tua mocidade; e estabelecerei contigo uma aliança eterna.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσομαι ἐγὼ τῆς διαθήκης μου τῆς μετὰ σοῦ ἐν ἡμέραις νηπιότητός σου καὶ ἀναστήσω σοι διαθήκην αἰώνιον

text_en: And you shall remember your ways, and be ashamed: when you shall receive your sisters, your elder and your younger: and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
text_la: Et recordaberis viarum tuarum, et confunderis, cum receperis sorores tuas te majores cum minoribus tuis : et dabo eas tibi in filias, sed non ex pacto tuo.
text_pt: Então te lembrarás dos teus caminhos, e te confundirás, quando receberes tuas irmãs maiores do que tu, com as menores do que tu, porque tas darei por filhas, mas não pela tua aliança.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσῃ τὴν ὁδόν σου καὶ ἐξατιμωθήσῃ ἐν τῷ ἀναλαβεῖν σε τὰς ἀδελφάς σου τὰς πρεσβυτέρας σου σὺν ταῖς νεωτέραις σου καὶ δώσω αὐτάς σοι εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ ἐκ διαθήκης σου

text_en: And I will establish my covenant with you: and you shall know that I am the Lord ,
text_la: Et suscitabo ego pactum meum tecum, et scies quia ego Dominus:
text_pt: Porque eu estabelecerei a minha aliança contigo, e saberás que eu sou o Senhor;
text_el: καὶ ἀναστήσω ἐγὼ τὴν διαθήκην μου μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: that you may remember, and be confounded, and may no more open your mouth because of your confusion, when I shall be pacified toward you for all that you have done, says the Lord God .
text_la: ut recorderis, et confundaris, et non sit tibi ultra aperire os præ confusione tua, cum placatus tibi fuero in omnibus quæ fecisti, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Para que te lembres disso, e te envergonhes, e nunca mais abras a tua boca, por causa da tua vergonha, quando eu te expiar de tudo quanto fizeste, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ὅπως μνησθῇς καὶ αἰσχυνθῇς καὶ μὴ ᾖ σοι ἔτι ἀνοῖξαι τὸ στόμα σου ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ἀτιμίας σου ἐν τῷ ἐξιλάσκεσθαί μέ σοι κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησας λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , put forth a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel ,
text_la: Fili hominis, propone ænigma, et narra parabolam ad domum Israël,
text_pt: Filho do homem, propõe um enigma, e profere uma parábola para com a casa de Israel.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου διήγησαι διήγημα καὶ εἰπὸν παραβολὴν πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: and say: Thus says the Lord God ; A large eagle with great wings, long-limbed, full of feathers, and of variety, came to Libanus , and took away the marrow of the cedar .
text_la: et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Aquila grandis magnarum alarum, longo membrorum ductu, plena plumis et varietate, venit ad Libanum, et tulit medullam cedri.
text_pt: E disse: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Uma grande águia, de grandes asas, de plumagem comprida, e cheia de penas de várias cores, veio ao Líbano e levou o mais alto ramo de um cedro.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ ἀετὸς ὁ μέγας ὁ μεγαλοπτέρυγος ὁ μακρὸς τῇ ἐκτάσει πλήρης ὀνύχων ὃς ἔχει τὸ ἥγημα εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν Λίβανον καὶ ἔλαβε τὰ ἐπίλεκτα τῆς κέδρου

text_en: He cropped off the top of the twigs thereof: and carried it away into the land of Chanaan , and he set it in a city of merchants.
text_la: Summitatem frondium ejus avulsit, et transportavit eam in terram Chanaan : in urbe negotiatorum posuit illam.
text_pt: E arrancou a ponta mais alta dos seus renovos, e a levou a uma terra de mercancia; numa cidade de mercadores a pôs.
text_el: τὰ ἄκρα τῆς ἁπαλότητος ἀπέκνισεν καὶ ἤνεγκεν αὐτὰ εἰς γῆν Χανααν εἰς πόλιν τετειχισμένην ἔθετο αὐτά

text_en: And he took of the seed of the land, and put it in the ground for seed, that it might take a firm root over many waters: he planted it on the surface of the earth.
text_la: Et tulit de semine terræ, et posuit illud in terra pro semine, ut firmaret radicem super aquas multas : in superficie posuit illud.
text_pt: Tomou da semente da terra, e a lançou num solo frutífero; tomando-a, colocou-a junto às muitas águas, plantando-a como salgueiro.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τοῦ σπέρματος τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸ εἰς τὸ πεδίον φυτὸν ἐφ' ὕδατι πολλῷ ἐπιβλεπόμενον ἔταξεν αὐτό

text_en: And it sprung up and grew into a spreading vine of low stature, and the branches thereof looked towards him: and the roots thereof were under him. So it became a vine, and grew into branches, and shot forth sprigs.
text_la: Cumque germinasset, crevit in vineam latiorem, humili statura, respicientibus ramis ejus ad eam, et radices ejus sub illa erant : facta est ergo vinea, et fructificavit in palmites, et emisit propagines.
text_pt: E brotou, e tornou-se numa videira muito larga, de pouca altura, virando-se para ela os seus ramos, porque as suas raízes estavam debaixo dela; e tornou-se numa videira, e produzia sarmentos, e brotava renovos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέτειλεν καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς ἄμπελον ἀσθενοῦσαν καὶ μικρὰν τῷ μεγέθει τοῦ ἐπιφαίνεσθαι αὐτήν τὰ κλήματα αὐτῆς ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ αἱ ῥίζαι αὐτῆς ὑποκάτω αὐτῆς ἦσαν καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς ἄμπελον καὶ ἐποίησεν ἀπώρυγας καὶ ἐξέτεινεν τὴν ἀναδενδράδα αὐτῆς

text_en: And there was another large eagle, with great wings, and many feathers: and behold this vine, bending as it were her roots towards him, stretched forth her branches to him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
text_la: Et facta est aquila altera grandis, magnis alis, multisque plumis : et ecce vinea ista quasi mittens radices suas ad eam, palmites suos extendit ad illam, ut irrigaret eam de areolis germinis sui.
text_pt: E houve mais uma grande águia, de grandes asas, e cheia de penas; e eis que esta videira lançou para ela as suas raízes, e estendeu para ela os seus ramos, desde as covas do seu plantio, para que a regasse.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἀετὸς ἕτερος μέγας μεγαλοπτέρυγος πολὺς ὄνυξιν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ ἄμπελος αὕτη περιπεπλεγμένη πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ αἱ ῥίζαι αὐτῆς πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ τὰ κλήματα αὐτῆς ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτῷ τοῦ ποτίσαι αὐτὴν σὺν τῷ βώλῳ τῆς φυτείας αὐτῆς

text_en: It was planted in a good ground upon many waters, that it might bring forth branches, and bear fruit, that it might become a large vine.
text_la: In terra bona super aquas multas plantata est, ut faciat frondes, et portet fructum, ut sit in vineam grandem.
text_pt: Num bom campo, junto a muitas águas, estava ela plantada, para produzir ramos, e para dar fruto, a fim de que fosse videira excelente.
text_el: εἰς πεδίον καλὸν ἐφ' ὕδατι πολλῷ αὕτη πιαίνεται τοῦ ποιεῖν βλαστοὺς καὶ φέρειν καρπὸν τοῦ εἶναι εἰς ἄμπελον μεγάλην

text_en: Say you: Thus says the Lord God : Shall it prosper then? Shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and strip off its fruit, and dry up all the branches it has shot forth, and make it wither: and this without a strong arm, or many people to pluck it up by the root?
text_la: Dic : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ergone prosperabitur? nonne radices ejus evellet, et fructus ejus distringet, et siccabit omnes palmites germinis ejus, et arescet, et non in brachio grandi, neque in populo multo, ut evelleret eam radicitus?
text_pt: Dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porventura há de prosperar? Não lhe arrancará as suas raízes, e não cortará o seu fruto, para que se seque? Para que sequem todas as folhas de seus renovos, e isto não com grande força, nem muita gente, para arrancá-la pelas suas raízes.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος εἰ κατευθυνεῖ οὐχὶ αἱ ῥίζαι τῆς ἁπαλότητος αὐτῆς καὶ ὁ καρπὸς σαπήσεται καὶ ξηρανθήσεται πάντα τὰ προανατέλλοντα αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ἐν βραχίονι μεγάλῳ οὐδ' ἐν λαῷ πολλῷ τοῦ ἐκσπάσαι αὐτὴν ἐκ ῥιζῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: Behold, it is planted: shall it prosper then? Shall it not be dried up when the burning wind shall touch it, and shall it not wither in the furrows where it grew?
text_la: Ecce plantata est : ergone prosperabitur? nonne, cum tetigerit eam ventus urens, siccabitur, et in areis germinis sui arescet?
text_pt: Mas, estando plantada, prosperará? Porventura, tocando-lhe vento oriental, de todo não se secará? Nas covas do seu plantio se secará.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ πιαίνεται μὴ κατευθυνεῖ οὐχ ἅμα τῷ ἅψασθαι αὐτῆς ἄνεμον τὸν καύσωνα ξηρανθήσεται ξηρασίᾳ σὺν τῷ βώλῳ ἀνατολῆς αὐτῆς ξηρανθήσεται

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Say to the provoking house: Know you not what these things mean? Tell them: Behold the king of Babylon comes to Jerusalem : and he shall take away the king and the princes thereof and carry them with him to Babylon .
text_la: Dic ad domum exasperantem : Nescitis quid ista significent? Dic : Ecce venit rex Babylonis in Jerusalem, et assumet regem et principes ejus, et adducet eos ad semetipsum in Babylonem.
text_pt: Dize agora à casa rebelde: Não sabeis o que significam estas coisas? Dize: Eis que veio o rei de babilônia a Jerusalém, e tomou o seu rei e os seus príncipes, e os levou consigo para babilônia.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰπὸν δὴ πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τὸν παραπικραίνοντα οὐκ ἐπίστασθε τί ἦν ταῦτα εἰπόν ὅταν ἔλθῃ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ λήμψεται τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτῆς καὶ ἄξει αὐτοὺς πρὸς ἑαυτὸν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: And he shall take one of the king's seed, and make a covenant with him, and take an oath of him. Yea, and he shall take away the mighty men of the land,
text_la: Et tollet de semine regni, ferietque cum eo fœdus, et ab eo accipiet jusjurandum. Sed et fortes terræ tollet,
text_pt: E tomou um da descendência real, e fez aliança com ele, e o fez prestar juramento; e tomou consigo os poderosos da terra,
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος τῆς βασιλείας καὶ διαθήσεται πρὸς αὐτὸν διαθήκην καὶ εἰσάξει αὐτὸν ἐν ἀρᾷ καὶ τοὺς ἡγουμένους τῆς γῆς λήμψεται

text_en: that it may be a low kingdom and not lift itself up, but keep his covenant and observe it.
text_la: ut sit regnum humile, et non elevetur, sed custodiat pactum ejus, et servet illud.
text_pt: Para que o reino ficasse humilhado, e não se levantasse, embora, guardando a sua aliança, pudesse subsistir.
text_el: τοῦ γενέσθαι εἰς βασιλείαν ἀσθενῆ τὸ καθόλου μὴ ἐπαίρεσθαι τοῦ φυλάσσειν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ καὶ ἱστάνειν αὐτήν

text_en: But he has revolted from him and sent ambassadors to Egypt , that it might give him horses, and much people. And shall he that has done thus prosper, or be saved? And shall he escape that has broken the covenant?
text_la: Qui recedens ab eo misit nuntios ad Ægyptum, ut daret sibi equos et populum multum : numquid prosperabitur, vel consequetur salutem, qui fecit hæc? et qui dissolvit pactum, numquid effugiet?
text_pt: Mas rebelou-se contra ele, enviando os seus mensageiros ao Egito, para que se lhe mandassem cavalos e muita gente. Porventura prosperará ou escapará aquele que faz tais coisas, ou quebrará a aliança, e ainda escapará?
text_el: καὶ ἀποστήσεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἐξαποστέλλειν ἀγγέλους ἑαυτοῦ εἰς Αἴγυπτον τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτῷ ἵππους καὶ λαὸν πολύν εἰ κατευθυνεῖ εἰ διασωθήσεται ὁ ποιῶν ἐναντία καὶ παραβαίνων διαθήκην εἰ σωθήσεται

text_en: As I live, says the Lord God : In the place where the king dwells that made him king, whose oath he has made void, and whose covenant he broke, even in the midst of Babylon shall he die.
text_la: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quoniam in loco regis qui constituit eum regem, cujus fecit irritum juramentum, et solvit pactum quod habebat cum eo, in medio Babylonis morietur.
text_pt: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que no lugar em que habita o rei que o fez reinar, cujo juramento desprezou, e cuja aliança quebrou, sim, com ele no meio de babilônia certamente morrerá.
text_el: ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος ἐὰν μὴ ἐν ᾧ τόπῳ ὁ βασιλεὺς ὁ βασιλεύσας αὐτόν ὃς ἠτίμωσεν τὴν ἀράν μου καὶ ὃς παρέβη τὴν διαθήκην μου μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ Βαβυλῶνος τελευτήσει

text_en: And not with a great army, nor with much people shall Pharao fight against him: when he shall cast up mounts, and build forts, to cut off many souls .
text_la: Et non in exercitu grandi, neque in populo multo, faciet contra eum Pharao prælium : in jactu aggeris, et in exstructione vallorum, ut interficiat animas multas.
text_pt: E Faraó, nem com grande exército, nem com uma companhia numerosa, fará coisa alguma com ele em guerra, levantando trincheiras e edificando baluartes, para destruir muitas vidas.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐν δυνάμει μεγάλῃ οὐδ' ἐν ὄχλῳ πολλῷ ποιήσει πρὸς αὐτὸν Φαραω πόλεμον ἐν χαρακοβολίᾳ καὶ ἐν οἰκοδομῇ βελοστάσεων τοῦ ἐξᾶραι ψυχάς

text_en: For he had despised the oath , breaking his covenant, and behold he has given his hand: and having done all these things, he shall not escape.
text_la: Spreverat enim juramentum, ut solveret fœdus, et ecce dedit manum suam : et cum omnia hæc fecerit, non effugiet.
text_pt: Porque desprezou o juramento, quebrando a aliança; eis que ele tinha dado a sua mão; contudo fez todas estas coisas; não escapará.
text_el: καὶ ἠτίμωσεν ὁρκωμοσίαν τοῦ παραβῆναι διαθήκην καὶ ἰδοὺ δέδωκεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα ταῦτα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ μὴ σωθήσεται

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : As I live, I will lay upon his head the oath he has despised , and the covenant he has broken.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Vivo ego, quoniam juramentum quod sprevit, et fœdus quod prævaricatus est, ponam in caput ejus.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Vivo eu, que o meu juramento, que desprezou, e a minha aliança, que quebrou, isto farei recair sobre a sua cabeça.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ζῶ ἐγὼ ἐὰν μὴ τὴν διαθήκην μου ἣν παρέβη καὶ τὴν ὁρκωμοσίαν μου ἣν ἠτίμωσεν καὶ δώσω αὐτὰ εἰς κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I will spread my net over him, and he shall be taken in my net: and I will bring him into Babylon , and will judge him there for the transgression by which he has despised me.
text_la: Et expandam super eum rete meum, et comprehendetur in sagena mea : et adducam eum in Babylonem, et judicabo eum ibi in prævaricatione qua despexit me.
text_pt: E estenderei sobre ele a minha rede, e ficará preso no meu laço; e o levarei a babilônia, e ali entrarei em juízo com ele por causa da rebeldia que praticou contra mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐκπετάσω ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὸ δίκτυόν μου καὶ ἁλώσεται ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword: and the residue shall be scattered into every wind: and you shall know that I the Lord have spoken.
text_la: Et omnes profugi ejus, cum universo agmine suo, gladio cadent : residui autem in omnem ventum dispergentur : et scietis quia ego Dominus locutus sum.
text_pt: E todos os seus fugitivos, com todas as suas tropas, cairão à espada, e os que restarem serão espalhados a todo o vento; e sabereis que eu, o Senhor, o disse.
text_el: ἐν πάσῃ παρατάξει αὐτοῦ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσοῦνται καὶ τοὺς καταλοίπους εἰς πάντα ἄνεμον διασπερῶ καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : I myself will take of the marrow of the high cedar , and will set it: I will crop off a tender twig from the top of the branches thereof, and I will plant it on a mountain high and eminent.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Et sumam ego de medulla cedri sublimis, et ponam : de vertice ramorum ejus tenerum distringam, et plantabo super montem excelsum et eminentem.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Também eu tomarei um broto do topo do cedro, e o plantarei; do principal dos seus renovos cortarei o mais tenro, e o plantarei sobre um monte alto e sublime.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ λήμψομαι ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἐπιλέκτων τῆς κέδρου ἐκ κορυφῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν ἀποκνιῶ καὶ καταφυτεύσω ἐγὼ ἐπ' ὄρος ὑψηλόν καὶ κρεμάσω αὐτὸν

text_en: On the high mountains of Israel will I plant it, and it shall shoot forth into branches and shall bear fruit, and it shall become a great cedar : and all birds shall dwell under it, and every fowl shall make its nest under the shadow of the branches thereof.
text_la: In monte sublimi Israël plantabo illud, et erumpet in germen, et faciet fructum, et erit in cedrum magnam : et habitabunt sub ea omnes volucres, et universum volatile sub umbra frondium ejus nidificabit:
text_pt: No monte alto de Israel o plantarei, e produzirá ramos, e dará fruto, e se fará um cedro excelente; e habitarão debaixo dele aves de toda plumagem, à sombra dos seus ramos habitarão.
text_el: ἐν ὄρει μετεώρῳ τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ καταφυτεύσω καὶ ἐξοίσει βλαστὸν καὶ ποιήσει καρπὸν καὶ ἔσται εἰς κέδρον μεγάλην καὶ ἀναπαύσεται ὑποκάτω αὐτοῦ πᾶν θηρίον καὶ πᾶν πετεινὸν ὑπὸ τὴν σκιὰν αὐτοῦ ἀναπαύσεται τὰ κλήματα αὐτοῦ ἀποκατασταθήσεται

text_en: And all the trees of the country shall know that I the Lord have brought down the high tree, and exalted the low tree: and have dried up the green tree, and have caused the dry tree to flourish. I the Lord have spoken and have done it.
text_la: et scient omnia ligna regionis quia ego Dominus humiliavi lignum sublime, et exaltavi lignum humile; et siccavi lignum viride, et frondere feci lignum aridum. Ego Dominus locutus sum, et feci.
text_pt: Assim saberão todas as árvores do campo que eu, o Senhor, abati a árvore alta, elevei a árvore baixa, sequei a árvore verde, e fiz reverdecer a árvore seca; eu, o Senhor, o disse, e o fiz.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται πάντα τὰ ξύλα τοῦ πεδίου διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ ταπεινῶν ξύλον ὑψηλὸν καὶ ὑψῶν ξύλον ταπεινὸν καὶ ξηραίνων ξύλον χλωρὸν καὶ ἀναθάλλων ξύλον ξηρόν ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα καὶ ποιήσω

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying: What is the meaning?
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: That you use among you this parable as a proverb in the land of Israel , saying: The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge.
text_la: Quid est quod inter vos parabolam vertitis in proverbium istud in terra Israël, dicentes : Patres comederunt uvam acerbam, et dentes filiorum obstupescunt?
text_pt: Que pensais, vós, os que usais esta parábola sobre a terra de Israel, dizendo: Os pais comeram uvas verdes, e os dentes dos filhos se embotaram?
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τί ὑμῖν ἡ παραβολὴ αὕτη ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγοντες οἱ πατέρες ἔφαγον ὄμφακα καὶ οἱ ὀδόντες τῶν τέκνων ἐγομφίασαν

text_en: As I live, says the Lord God , this parable shall be no more to you a proverb in Israel .
text_la: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, si erit ultra vobis parabola hæc in proverbium in Israël.
text_pt: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que nunca mais direis esta parábola em Israel.
text_el: ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος ἐὰν γένηται ἔτι λεγομένη ἡ παραβολὴ αὕτη ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: Behold all souls are mine: as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sins , the same shall die.
text_la: Ecce omnes animæ meæ sunt : ut anima patris, ita et anima filii mea est : anima quæ peccaverit, ipsa morietur.
text_pt: Eis que todas as almas são minhas; como o é a alma do pai, assim também a alma do filho é minha: a alma que pecar, essa morrerá.
text_el: ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ψυχαὶ ἐμαί εἰσιν ὃν τρόπον ἡ ψυχὴ τοῦ πατρός οὕτως καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ τοῦ υἱοῦ ἐμαί εἰσιν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡ ἁμαρτάνουσα αὕτη ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: And if a man be just , and do judgment and justice ,
text_la: Et vir si fuerit justus, et fecerit judicium et justitiam,
text_pt: Sendo, pois, o homem justo, e praticando juízo e justiça,
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἔσται δίκαιος ὁ ποιῶν κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην

text_en: and has not eaten upon the mountains, nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel : and has not defiled his neighbour's wife, nor come near to a menstruous woman :
text_la: in montibus non comederit, et oculos suos non levaverit ad idola domus Israël : et uxorem proximi sui non violaverit, et ad mulierem menstruatam non accesserit:
text_pt: Não comendo sobre os montes, nem levantando os seus olhos para os ídolos da casa de Israel, nem contaminando a mulher do seu próximo, nem se chegando à mulher na sua separação,
text_el: ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων οὐ φάγεται καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ ἐπάρῃ πρὸς τὰ ἐνθυμήματα οἴκου Ισραηλ καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ μιάνῃ καὶ πρὸς γυναῖκα ἐν ἀφέδρῳ οὖσαν οὐ προσεγγιεῖ

text_en: And has not wronged any man : but has restored the pledge to the debtor, has taken nothing away by violence : has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment:
text_la: et hominem non contristaverit, pignus debitori reddiderit, per vim nihil rapuerit : panem suum esurienti dederit, et nudum operuerit vestimento:
