text_pt: Não oprimindo a ninguém, tornando ao devedor o seu penhor, não roubando, dando o seu pão ao faminto, e cobrindo ao nu com roupa,
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπον οὐ μὴ καταδυναστεύσῃ ἐνεχυρασμὸν ὀφείλοντος ἀποδώσει καὶ ἅρπαγμα οὐχ ἁρπᾶται τὸν ἄρτον αὐτοῦ τῷ πεινῶντι δώσει καὶ γυμνὸν περιβαλεῖ

text_en: Hath not lent upon usury , nor taken any increase: has withdrawn his hand from iniquity , and has executed true judgment between man and man :
text_la: ad usuram non commodaverit, et amplius non acceperit : ab iniquitate averterit manum suam, et judicium verum fecerit inter virum et virum:
text_pt: Não dando o seu dinheiro à usura, e não recebendo demais, desviando a sua mão da injustiça, e fazendo verdadeiro juízo entre homem e homem;
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τόκῳ οὐ δώσει καὶ πλεονασμὸν οὐ λήμψεται καὶ ἐξ ἀδικίας ἀποστρέψει τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ κρίμα δίκαιον ποιήσει ἀνὰ μέσον ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Hath walked in my commandments , and kept my judgments, to do truth : he is just , he shall surely live, says the Lord God .
text_la: in præceptis meis ambulaverit, et judicia mea custodierit, ut faciat veritatem : hic justus est; vita vivet, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Andando nos meus estatutos, e guardando os meus juízos, e procedendo segundo a verdade, o tal justo certamente viverá, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου πεπόρευται καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου πεφύλακται τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτά δίκαιος οὗτός ἐστιν ζωῇ ζήσεται λέγει κύριος

text_en: And if he beget a son that is a robber , a shedder of blood , and that has done some one of these things:
text_la: Quod si genuerit filium latronem, effundentem sanguinem, et fecerit unum de istis:
text_pt: E se ele gerar um filho ladrão, derramador de sangue, que fizer a seu irmão qualquer destas coisas;
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν γεννήσῃ υἱὸν λοιμὸν ἐκχέοντα αἷμα καὶ ποιοῦντα ἁμαρτήματα

text_en: Though he does not all these things, but that eats upon the mountains, and that defiles his neighbour's wife:
text_la: et hæc quidem omnia non facientem, sed in montibus comedentem, et uxorem proximi sui polluentem:
text_pt: E não cumprir todos aqueles deveres, mas antes comer sobre os montes, e contaminar a mulher de seu próximo,
text_el: ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ τοῦ δικαίου οὐκ ἐπορεύθη ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ἔφαγεν καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἐμίανεν

text_en: That grieves the needy and the poor, that takes away by violence , that restores not the pledge, and that lifts up his eyes to idols , that commits abomination :
text_la: egenum et pauperem contristantem, rapientem rapinas, pignus non reddentem, et ad idola levantem oculos suos, abominationem facientem:
text_pt: Oprimir ao pobre e necessitado, praticar roubos, não tornar o penhor, e levantar os seus olhos para os ídolos, e cometer abominação,
text_el: καὶ πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα κατεδυνάστευσεν καὶ ἅρπαγμα ἥρπασεν καὶ ἐνεχυρασμὸν οὐκ ἀπέδωκεν καὶ εἰς τὰ εἴδωλα ἔθετο τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ ἀνομίαν πεποίηκεν

text_en: That gives upon usury , and that takes an increase: shall such a one live? He shall not live. Seeing he has done all these detestable things, he shall surely die, his blood shall be upon him.
text_la: ad usuram dantem, et amplius accipientem : numquid vivet? Non vivet : cum universa hæc detestanda fecerit, morte morietur; sanguis ejus in ipso erit.
text_pt: E emprestar com usura, e receber demais, porventura viverá? Não viverá. Todas estas abominações ele fez, certamente morrerá; o seu sangue será sobre ele.
text_el: μετὰ τόκου ἔδωκε καὶ πλεονασμὸν ἔλαβεν οὗτος ζωῇ οὐ ζήσεται πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας ταύτας ἐποίησεν θανάτῳ θανατωθήσεται τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἔσται

text_en: But if he beget a son, who, seeing all his father's sins , which he has done, is afraid, and shall not do the like to them:
text_la: Quod si genuerit filium, qui videns omnia peccata patris sui quæ fecit, timuerit, et non fecerit simile eis:
text_pt: E eis que também, se ele gerar um filho que veja todos os pecados que seu pai fez e, vendo-os, não cometer coisas semelhantes,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γεννήσῃ υἱόν καὶ ἴδῃ πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἃς ἐποίησεν καὶ φοβηθῇ καὶ μὴ ποιήσῃ κατὰ ταύτας

text_en: That has not eaten upon the mountains, nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , and has not defiled his neighbour's wife:
text_la: super montes non comederit, et oculos suos non levaverit ad idola domus Israël, et uxorem proximi sui non violaverit:
text_pt: Não comer sobre os montes, e não levantar os seus olhos para os ídolos da casa de Israel, e não contaminar a mulher de seu próximo,
text_el: ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων οὐ βέβρωκεν καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔθετο εἰς τὰ ἐνθυμήματα οἴκου Ισραηλ καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐμίανεν

text_en: And has not grieved any man , nor withholden the pledge, nor taken away with violence , but has given his bread to the hungry, and covered the naked with a garment:
text_la: et virum non contristaverit, pignus non retinuerit, et rapinam non rapuerit : panem suum esurienti dederit, et nudum operuerit vestimento:
text_pt: E não oprimir a ninguém, e não retiver o penhor, e não roubar, der o seu pão ao faminto, e cobrir ao nu com roupa,
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπον οὐ κατεδυνάστευσεν καὶ ἐνεχυρασμὸν οὐκ ἐνεχύρασεν καὶ ἅρπαγμα οὐχ ἥρπασεν τὸν ἄρτον αὐτοῦ τῷ πεινῶντι ἔδωκεν καὶ γυμνὸν περιέβαλεν

text_en: That has turned away his hand from injuring the poor , has not taken usury and increase, but has executed my judgments, and has walked in my commandments : this man shall not die for the iniquity of his father, but living he shall live.
text_la: a pauperis injuria averterit manum suam, usuram et superabundantiam non acceperit, judicia mea fecerit, in præceptis meis ambulaverit : hic non morietur in iniquitate patris sui, sed vita vivet.
text_pt: Desviar do pobre a sua mão, não receber usura e juros, cumprir os meus juízos, e andar nos meus estatutos, o tal não morrerá pela iniqüidade de seu pai; certamente viverá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπ' ἀδικίας ἀπέστρεψε τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ τόκον οὐδὲ πλεονασμὸν οὐκ ἔλαβεν δικαιοσύνην ἐποίησεν καὶ ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου ἐπορεύθη οὐ τελευτήσει ἐν ἀδικίαις πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ζωῇ ζήσεται

text_en: As for his father, because he oppressed and offered violence to his brother, and wrought evil in the midst of his people, behold he is dead in his own iniquity .
text_la: Pater ejus, quia calumniatus est, et vim fecit fratri, et malum operatus est in medio populi sui, ecce mortuus est in iniquitate sua.
text_pt: Seu pai, porque praticou a extorsão, roubou os bens do irmão, e fez o que não era bom no meio de seu povo, eis que ele morrerá pela sua iniqüidade.
text_el: ὁ δὲ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐὰν θλίψει θλίψῃ καὶ ἁρπάσῃ ἅρπαγμα ἐναντία ἐποίησεν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ μου καὶ ἀποθανεῖται ἐν τῇ ἀδικίᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And you say: Why has not the son borne the iniquity of his father? Verily, because the son has wrought judgment and justice , has kept all my commandments , and done them, living, he shall live.
text_la: Et dicitis : Quare non portavit filius iniquitatem patris? Videlicet quia filius judicium et justitiam operatus est, omnia præcepta mea custodivit, et fecit illa, vivet vita.
text_pt: Mas dizeis: Por que não levará o filho a iniqüidade do pai? Porque o filho procedeu com retidão e justiça, e guardou todos os meus estatutos, e os praticou, por isso certamente viverá.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖτε τί ὅτι οὐκ ἔλαβεν τὴν ἀδικίαν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ὁ υἱὸς δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἔλεος ἐποίησεν πάντα τὰ νόμιμά μου συνετήρησεν καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτά ζωῇ ζήσεται

text_en: The soul that sins , the same shall die: the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, and the father shall not bear the iniquity of the son: the justice of the just shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
text_la: Anima quæ peccaverit, ipsa morietur : filius non portabit iniquitatem patris, et pater non portabit iniquitatem filii : justitia justi super eum erit, et impietas impii erit super eum.
text_pt: A alma que pecar, essa morrerá; o filho não levará a iniqüidade do pai, nem o pai levará a iniqüidade do filho. A justiça do justo ficará sobre ele e a impiedade do ímpio cairá sobre ele.
text_el: ἡ δὲ ψυχὴ ἡ ἁμαρτάνουσα ἀποθανεῖται ὁ δὲ υἱὸς οὐ λήμψεται τὴν ἀδικίαν τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ὁ πατὴρ λήμψεται τὴν ἀδικίαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ δικαιοσύνη δικαίου ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἔσται καὶ ἀνομία ἀνόμου ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἔσται

text_en: But if the wicked do penance for all his sins which he has committed, and keep all my commandments , and do judgment, and justice , living he shall live, and shall not die.
text_la: Si autem impius egerit pœnitentiam ab omnibus peccatis suis quæ operatus est, et custodierit omnia præcepta mea, et fecerit judicium et justitiam, vita vivet, et non morietur.
text_pt: Mas se o ímpio se converter de todos os pecados que cometeu, e guardar todos os meus estatutos, e proceder com retidão e justiça, certamente viverá; não morrerá.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄνομος ἐὰν ἀποστρέψῃ ἐκ πασῶν τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτοῦ ὧν ἐποίησεν καὶ φυλάξηται πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ ποιήσῃ δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἔλεος ζωῇ ζήσεται οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ

text_en: I will not remember all his iniquities that he has done: in his justice which he has wrought, he shall live.
text_la: Omnium iniquitatum ejus quas operatus est, non recordabor : in justitia sua quam operatus est, vivet.
text_pt: De todas as transgressões que cometeu não haverá lembrança contra ele; pela justiça que praticou viverá.
text_el: πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐποίησεν οὐ μνησθήσεται ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ αὐτοῦ ᾗ ἐποίησεν ζήσεται

text_en: Is it my will that a sinner should die, says the Lord God , and not that he should be converted from his ways, and live?
text_la: Numquid voluntatis meæ est mors impii, dicit Dominus Deus, et non ut convertatur a viis suis, et vivat?
text_pt: Desejaria eu, de qualquer maneira, a morte do ímpio? diz o Senhor DEUS; Não desejo antes que se converta dos seus caminhos, e viva?
text_el: μὴ θελήσει θελήσω τὸν θάνατον τοῦ ἀνόμου λέγει κύριος ὡς τὸ ἀποστρέψαι αὐτὸν ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς καὶ ζῆν αὐτόν

text_en: But if the just man turn himself away from his justice , and do iniquity according to all the abominations which the wicked man uses to work, shall he live? All his justices which he has done, shall not be remembered: in the prevarication, by which he has prevaricated, and in his sin , which he has committed, in them he shall die.
text_la: Si autem averterit se justus a justitia sua, et fecerit iniquitatem secundum omnes abominationes quas operari solet impius, numquid vivet? Omnes justitiæ ejus quas fecerat, non recordabuntur : in prævaricatione qua prævaricatus est, et in peccato suo quod peccavit, in ipsis morietur.
text_pt: Mas, desviando-se o justo da sua justiça, e cometendo a iniqüidade, fazendo conforme todas as abominações que faz o ímpio, porventura viverá? De todas as justiças que tiver feito não se fará memória; na sua transgressão com que transgrediu, e no seu pecado com que pecou, neles morrerá.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ ἀποστρέψαι δίκαιον ἐκ τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιήσῃ ἀδικίαν κατὰ πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας ἃς ἐποίησεν ὁ ἄνομος πᾶσαι αἱ δικαιοσύναι αὐτοῦ ἃς ἐποίησεν οὐ μὴ μνησθῶσιν ἐν τῷ παραπτώματι αὐτοῦ ᾧ παρέπεσεν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτοῦ αἷς ἥμαρτεν ἐν αὐταῖς ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: And you have said: The way of the Lord is not right. Hear, therefore, O house of Israel : Is it my way that is not right, and are not rather your ways perverse?
text_la: Et dixistis : Non est æqua via Domini! Audite ergo, domus Israël : numquid via mea non est æqua, et non magis viæ vestræ pravæ sunt?
text_pt: Dizeis, porém: O caminho do Senhor não é direito. Ouvi agora, ó casa de Israel: Porventura não é o meu caminho direito? Não são os vossos caminhos tortuosos?
text_el: καὶ εἴπατε οὐ κατευθύνει ἡ ὁδὸς κυρίου ἀκούσατε δή πᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ μὴ ἡ ὁδός μου οὐ κατευθύνει οὐχὶ ἡ ὁδὸς ὑμῶν οὐ κατευθύνει

text_en: For when the just turns himself away from his justice , and commits iniquity , he shall die therein: in the injustice that he has wrought he shall die.
text_la: Cum enim averterit se justus a justitia sua, et fecerit iniquitatem, morietur in eis : in injustitia quam operatus est morietur.
text_pt: Desviando-se o justo da sua justiça, e cometendo iniqüidade, morrerá por ela; na iniqüidade, que cometeu, morrerá.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέψαι τὸν δίκαιον ἐκ τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιήσῃ παράπτωμα καὶ ἀποθάνῃ ἐν τῷ παραπτώματι ᾧ ἐποίησεν ἐν αὐτῷ ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: And when the wicked turns himself away from his wickedness , which he has wrought, and does judgment, and justice : he shall save his soul alive.
text_la: Et cum averterit se impius ab impietate sua quam operatus est, et fecerit judicium et justitiam, ipse animam suam vivificabit:
text_pt: Mas, convertendo-se o ímpio da impiedade que cometeu, e procedendo com retidão e justiça, conservará este a sua alma em vida.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέψαι ἄνομον ἀπὸ τῆς ἀνομίας αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐποίησεν καὶ ποιήσῃ κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην οὗτος τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐφύλαξεν

text_en: Because he considers and turns away himself from all his iniquities which he has wrought, he shall surely live, and not die.
text_la: considerans enim, et avertens se ab omnibus iniquitatibus suis quas operatus est, vita vivet, et non morietur.
text_pt: Pois que reconsidera, e se converte de todas as suas transgressões que cometeu; certamente viverá, não morrerá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν ἐκ πασῶν τῶν ἀσεβειῶν αὐτοῦ ὧν ἐποίησεν ζωῇ ζήσεται οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ

text_en: And the children of Israel say: The way of the Lord is not right. Are not my ways right, O house of Israel , and are not rather your ways perverse?
text_la: Et dicunt filii Israël : Non est æqua via Domini! Numquid viæ meæ non sunt æquæ, domus Israël, et non magis viæ vestræ pravæ?
text_pt: Contudo, diz a casa de Israel: O caminho do Senhor não é direito. Porventura não são direitos os meus caminhos, ó casa de Israel? E não são tortuosos os vossos caminhos?
text_el: καὶ λέγουσιν ὁ οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ οὐ κατορθοῖ ἡ ὁδὸς κυρίου μὴ ἡ ὁδός μου οὐ κατορθοῖ οἶκος Ισραηλ οὐχὶ ἡ ὁδὸς ὑμῶν οὐ κατορθοῖ

text_en: Therefore will I judge every man according to his ways , O house of Israel , says the Lord God . Be converted , and do penance for all your iniquities : and iniquity shall not be your ruin.
text_la: Idcirco unumquemque juxta vias suas judicabo, domus Israël, ait Dominus Deus. Convertimini, et agite pœnitentiam ab omnibus iniquitatibus vestris, et non erit vobis in ruinam iniquitas.
text_pt: Portanto, eu vos julgarei, cada um conforme os seus caminhos, ó casa de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS. Tornai-vos, e convertei-vos de todas as vossas transgressões, e a iniqüidade não vos servirá de tropeço.
text_el: ἕκαστον κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ κρινῶ ὑμᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος ἐπιστράφητε καὶ ἀποστρέψατε ἐκ πασῶν τῶν ἀσεβειῶν ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται ὑμῖν εἰς κόλασιν ἀδικίας

text_en: Cast away from you all your transgressions , by which you have transgressed, and make to yourselves a new heart, and a new spirit : and why will you die, O house of Israel ?
text_la: Projicite a vobis omnes prævaricationes vestras in quibus prævaricati estis, et facite vobis cor novum, et spiritum novum : et quare moriemini, domus Israël?
text_pt: Lançai de vós todas as vossas transgressões com que transgredistes, e fazei-vos um coração novo e um espírito novo; pois, por que razão morreríeis, ó casa de Israel?
text_el: ἀπορρίψατε ἀπὸ ἑαυτῶν πάσας τὰς ἀσεβείας ὑμῶν ἃς ἠσεβήσατε εἰς ἐμέ καὶ ποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς καρδίαν καινὴν καὶ πνεῦμα καινόν καὶ ἵνα τί ἀποθνῄσκετε οἶκος Ισραηλ

text_en: For I desire not the death of him that dies, says the Lord God , return and live.
text_la: Quia nolo mortem morientis, dicit Dominus Deus : revertimini, et vivite.
text_pt: Porque não tenho prazer na morte do que morre, diz o Senhor DEUS; convertei-vos, pois, e vivei.
text_el: διότι οὐ θέλω τὸν θάνατον τοῦ ἀποθνῄσκοντος λέγει κύριος

text_en: Moreover take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel ,
text_la: Et tu assume planctum super principes Israël,
text_pt: E tu levanta uma lamentação sobre os príncipes de Israel,
text_el: καὶ σὺ λαβὲ θρῆνον ἐπὶ τὸν ἄρχοντα τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: and say: Why did your mother the lioness lie down among the lions, and bring up her whelps in the midst of young lions?
text_la: et dices : Quare mater tua leæna inter leones cubavit? in medio leunculorum enutrivit catulos suos?
text_pt: E dize: Quem foi tua mãe? Uma leoa entre os leões a qual, deitada no meio dos leõezinhos, criou os seus filhotes.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τί ἡ μήτηρ σου σκύμνος ἐν μέσῳ λεόντων ἐγενήθη ἐν μέσῳ λεόντων ἐπλήθυνεν σκύμνους αὐτῆς

text_en: And she brought out one of her whelps, and he became a lion: and he learned to catch the prey, and to devour men .
text_la: Et eduxit unum de leunculis suis, et leo factus est : et didicit capere prædam, hominemque comedere.
text_pt: E educou um dos seus filhotes, o qual veio a ser leãozinho e aprendeu a apanhar a presa, e devorou homens,
text_el: καὶ ἀπεπήδησεν εἷς τῶν σκύμνων αὐτῆς λέων ἐγένετο καὶ ἔμαθεν τοῦ ἁρπάζειν ἁρπάγματα ἀνθρώπους ἔφαγεν

text_en: And the nations heard of him, and took him, but not without receiving wounds: and they brought him in chains into the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et audierunt de eo gentes : et non absque vulneribus suis ceperunt eum, et adduxerunt eum in catenis in terram Ægypti.
text_pt: E, ouvindo falar dele as nações, foi apanhado na cova delas, e o trouxeram com cadeias à terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν κατ' αὐτοῦ ἔθνη ἐν τῇ διαφθορᾷ αὐτῶν συνελήμφθη καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἐν κημῷ εἰς γῆν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: But she seeing herself weakened, and that her hope was lost, took one of her young lions, and set him up for a lion.
text_la: Quæ cum vidisset quoniam infirmata est, et periit exspectatio ejus, tulit unum de leunculis suis; leonem constituit eum.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, ela que havia esperado muito, e que a sua expectação era perdida, tomou outro dos seus filhotes, e fez dele um leãozinho.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὅτι ἀπῶσται ἀπ' αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπώλετο ἡ ὑπόστασις αὐτῆς καὶ ἔλαβεν ἄλλον ἐκ τῶν σκύμνων αὐτῆς λέοντα ἔταξεν αὐτόν

text_en: And he went up and down among the lions, and became a lion: and he learned to catch the prey, and to devour men .
text_la: Qui incedebat inter leones, et factus est leo : et didicit prædam capere, et homines devorare :
text_pt: Este, pois, andando continuamente no meio dos leões, veio a ser leãozinho, e aprendeu a apanhar a presa, e devorou homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεστρέφετο ἐν μέσῳ λεόντων λέων ἐγένετο καὶ ἔμαθεν ἁρπάζειν ἁρπάγματα ἀνθρώπους ἔφαγεν

text_en: He learned to make widows , and to lay waste their cities: and the land became desolate, and the fullness thereof by the noise of his roaring.
text_la: didicit viduas facere, et civitates earum in desertum adducere : et desolata est terra et plenitudo ejus a voce rugitus illius.
text_pt: E conheceu os seus palácios, e destruiu as suas cidades; e assolou-se a terra, e a sua plenitude, ao som do seu rugido.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέμετο τῷ θράσει αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν ἐξηρήμωσεν καὶ ἠφάνισεν γῆν καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς ἀπὸ φωνῆς ὠρύματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the nations came together against him on every side out of the provinces, and they spread their net over him, in their wounds he was taken.
text_la: Et convenerunt adversus eum gentes undique de provinciis, et expanderunt super eum rete suum : in vulneribus earum captus est,
text_pt: Então se ajuntaram contra ele os povos das províncias ao redor, e estenderam sobre ele a rede, e foi apanhado na cova deles.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἔθνη ἐκ χωρῶν κυκλόθεν καὶ ἐξεπέτασαν ἐπ' αὐτὸν δίκτυα αὐτῶν ἐν διαφθορᾷ αὐτῶν συνελήμφθη

text_en: And they put him into a cage, they brought him in chains to the king of Babylon : and they cast him into prison , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .
text_la: et miserunt eum in caveam : in catenis adduxerunt eum ad regem Babylonis, miseruntque eum in carcerem, ne audiretur vox ejus ultra super montes Israël.
text_pt: E com cadeias colocaram-no em uma jaula, e o levaram ao rei de babilônia; fizeram-no entrar nos lugares fortes, para que não se ouvisse mais a sua voz nos montes de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔθεντο αὐτὸν ἐν κημῷ καὶ ἐν γαλεάγρᾳ ἦλθεν πρὸς βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακήν ὅπως μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Your mother is like a vine in your blood planted by the water: her fruit and her branches have grown out of many waters.
text_la: Mater tua quasi vinea in sanguine tuo super aquam plantata est : fructus ejus et frondes ejus creverunt ex aquis multis.
text_pt: Tua mãe era como uma videira no teu sangue, plantada junto às águas; ela frutificou, e encheu-se de ramos, por causa das muitas águas.
text_el: ἡ μήτηρ σου ὡς ἄμπελος ὡς ἄνθος ἐν ῥόᾳ ἐν ὕδατι πεφυτευμένη ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῆς καὶ ὁ βλαστὸς αὐτῆς ἐγένετο ἐξ ὕδατος πολλοῦ

text_en: And she has strong rods to make sceptres for them that bear rule, and her stature was exalted among the branches: and she saw her height in the multitude of her branches.
text_la: Et factæ sunt ei virgæ solidæ in sceptra dominantium, et exaltata est statura ejus inter frondes, et vidit altitudinem suam in multitudine palmitum suorum.
text_pt: E tinha varas fortes para cetros de dominadores, e elevou-se a sua estatura entre os espessos ramos, e foi vista na sua altura com a multidão dos seus ramos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῇ ῥάβδος ἰσχύος ἐπὶ φυλὴν ἡγουμένων καὶ ὑψώθη τῷ μεγέθει αὐτῆς ἐν μέσῳ στελεχῶν καὶ εἶδεν τὸ μέγεθος αὐτῆς ἐν πλήθει κλημάτων αὐτῆς

text_en: But she was plucked up in wrath , and cast on the ground, and the burning wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods are withered, and dried up: the fire has devoured her.
text_la: Et evulsa est in ira, in terramque projecta, et ventus urens siccavit fructum ejus : marcuerunt et arefactæ sunt virgæ roboris ejus : ignis comedit eam.
text_pt: Mas foi arrancada com furor, foi lançada por terra, e o vento oriental secou o seu fruto; quebraram-se e secaram-se as suas fortes varas, o fogo as consumiu,
text_el: καὶ κατεκλάσθη ἐν θυμῷ ἐπὶ γῆν ἐρρίφη καὶ ἄνεμος ὁ καύσων ἐξήρανεν τὰ ἐκλεκτὰ αὐτῆς ἐξεδικήθη καὶ ἐξηράνθη ἡ ῥάβδος ἰσχύος αὐτῆς πῦρ ἀνήλωσεν αὐτήν

text_en: And now she is transplanted into the desert , in a land not passable, and dry.
text_la: Et nunc transplantata est in desertum, in terra invia et sitienti.
text_pt: E agora está plantada no deserto, numa terra seca e sedenta.
text_el: καὶ νῦν πεφύτευκαν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν γῇ ἀνύδρῳ

text_en: And a fire has gone out from a rod of her branches, which has devoured her fruit: so that she now has no strong rod, to be a sceptre of rulers. This is a lamentation, and it shall be for a lamentation.
text_la: Et egressus est ignis de virga ramorum ejus, qui fructum ejus comedit : et non fuit in ea virga fortis, sceptrum dominantium. Planctus est, et erit in planctum.
text_pt: E de uma vara dos seus ramos saiu fogo que consumiu o seu fruto de maneira que nela não há mais vara forte, cetro para dominar. Esta é a lamentação, e servirá de lamentação.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πῦρ ἐκ ῥάβδου ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτῆς καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτήν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἐν αὐτῇ ῥάβδος ἰσχύος φυλὴ εἰς παραβολὴν θρήνου ἐστὶν καὶ ἔσται εἰς θρῆνον

text_en: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month: there came men of the ancients of Israel to inquire of the Lord , and they sat before me.
text_la: Et factum est in anno septimo, in quinto, in decima mensis, venerunt viri de senioribus Israël ut interrogarent Dominum, et sederunt coram me.
text_pt: E aconteceu, no sétimo ano, no quinto mês, aos dez do mês, que vieram alguns dos anciãos de Israel, para consultarem o SENHOR; e assentaram-se diante de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ἑβδόμῳ ἐν τῷ πέμπτῳ μηνὶ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἦλθον ἄνδρες ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων οἴκου Ισραηλ ἐπερωτῆσαι τὸν κύριον καὶ ἐκάθισαν πρὸ προσώπου μου

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , speak to the ancients of Israel and say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Are you come to inquire of me? As I live, I will not answer you, says the Lord God .
text_la: Fili hominis, loquere senioribus Israël, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Numquid ad interrogandum me vos venistis? vivo ego quia non respondebo vobis, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Filho do homem, fala aos anciãos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Viestes consultar-me? Vivo eu, que não me deixarei ser consultado por vós, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου λάλησον πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος εἰ ἐπερωτῆσαί με ὑμεῖς ἔρχεσθε ζῶ ἐγὼ εἰ ἀποκριθήσομαι ὑμῖν λέγει κύριος

text_en: If you judge them, if you judge, O son of man , declare to them the abominations of their fathers.
text_la: Si judicas eos, si judicas, fili hominis, abominationes patrum eorum ostende eis.
text_pt: Porventura tu os julgarias, julgarias tu, ó filho do homem? Notifica-lhes as abominações de seus pais;
text_el: εἰ ἐκδικήσω αὐτοὺς ἐκδικήσει υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τὰς ἀνομίας τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν διαμάρτυραι αὐτοῖς

text_en: And say to them: Thus says the Lord God : In the day when I chose Israel , and lifted up my hand for the race of the house of Jacob : and appeared to them in the land of Egypt , and lifted up my hand for them, saying: I am the Lord your God :
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : In die qua elegi Israël, et levavi manum meam pro stirpe domus Jacob, et apparui eis in terra Ægypti, et levavi manum meam pro eis, dicens : Ego Dominus Deus vester:
text_pt: E dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia em que escolhi a Israel, levantei a minha mão para a descendência da casa de Jacó, e me dei a conhecer a eles na terra do Egito, e levantei a minha mão para eles, dizendo: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus;
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ᾑρέτισα τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ καὶ ἐγνωρίσθην τῷ σπέρματι οἴκου Ιακωβ καὶ ἐγνώσθην αὐτοῖς ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἀντελαβόμην τῇ χειρί μου αὐτῶν λέγων ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: In that day I lifted up my hand for them to bring them out of the land of Egypt , into a land which I had provided for them, flowing with milk and honey, which excels amongst all lands.
text_la: in die illa levavi manum meam pro eis ut educerem eos de terra Ægypti, in terram quam provideram eis, fluentem lacte et melle, quæ est egregia inter omnes terras.
text_pt: Naquele dia levantei a minha mão para eles, para os tirar da terra do Egito, para uma terra que já tinha previsto para eles, a qual mana leite e mel, e é a glória de todas as terras.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἀντελαβόμην τῇ χειρί μου αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἡτοίμασα αὐτοῖς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι κηρίον ἐστὶν παρὰ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: And I said to them: Let every man cast away the scandals of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt : I am the Lord your God .
text_la: Et dixi ad eos : Unusquisque offensiones oculorum suorum abjiciat, et in idolis Ægypti nolite pollui : ego Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: Então lhes disse: Cada um lance de si as abominações dos seus olhos, e não vos contamineis com os ídolos do Egito; eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτούς ἕκαστος τὰ βδελύγματα τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ ἀπορριψάτω καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν Αἰγύπτου μὴ μιαίνεσθε ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: But they provoked me, and would not hearken to me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of his eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt : and I said I would pour out my indignation upon them, and accomplish my wrath against them in the midst of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et irritaverunt me, nolueruntque me audire : unusquisque abominationes oculorum suorum non projecit, nec idola Ægypti reliquerunt. Et dixi ut effunderem indignationem meam super eos, et implerem iram meam in eis, in medio terræ Ægypti.
text_pt: Mas rebelaram-se contra mim, e não me quiseram ouvir; ninguém lançava de si as abominações dos seus olhos, nem deixava os ídolos do Egito; então eu disse que derramaria sobre eles o meu furor, para cumprir a minha ira contra eles no meio da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστησαν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν εἰσακοῦσαί μου τὰ βδελύγματα τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἀπέρριψαν καὶ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα Αἰγύπτου οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπον καὶ εἶπα τοῦ ἐκχέαι τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τοῦ συντελέσαι τὴν ὀργήν μου ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν μέσῳ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: But I did otherwise for my name's sake, that it might not be violated before the nations , in the midst of whom they were, and among whom I made myself known to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et feci propter nomen meum, ut non violaretur coram gentibus in quarum medio erant, et inter quas apparui eis ut educerem eos de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: O que fiz, porém, foi por amor do meu nome, para que não fosse profanado diante dos olhos dos gentios, no meio dos quais estavam, a cujos olhos eu me dei a conhecer a eles, para os tirar da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησα ὅπως τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ παράπαν μὴ βεβηλωθῇ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν αὐτοί εἰσιν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν ἐν οἷς ἐγνώσθην πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: Therefore I brought them out from the land of Egypt , and brought them into the desert .
text_la: Ejeci ergo eos de terra Ægypti, et eduxi eos in desertum.
text_pt: E os tirei da terra do Egito, e os levei ao deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγον αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν ἔρημον

text_en: And I gave them my statutes , and I showed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall live in them.
text_la: Et dedi eis præcepta mea, et judicia mea ostendi eis, quæ faciens homo vivet in eis.
text_pt: E dei-lhes os meus estatutos e lhes mostrei os meus juízos, os quais, cumprindo-os o homem, viverá por eles.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς τὰ προστάγματά μου καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς ὅσα ποιήσει αὐτὰ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Moreover I gave them also my sabbaths , to be a sign between me and them: and that they might know that I am the Lord that sanctify them.
text_la: Insuper et sabbata mea dedi eis, ut essent signum inter me et eos, et scirent quia ego Dominus sanctificans eos.
text_pt: E também lhes dei os meus sábados, para que servissem de sinal entre mim e eles; para que soubessem que eu sou o Senhor que os santifica.
text_el: καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς τοῦ εἶναι εἰς σημεῖον ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτοὺς διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων αὐτούς

text_en: But the house of Israel provoked me in the desert : they walked not in my statutes, and they cast away my judgments, which if a man do he shall live in them: and they grievously violated my sabbaths . I said therefore that I would pour out my indignation upon them in the desert , and would consume them.
text_la: Et irritaverunt me domus Israël in deserto : in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt, et judicia mea projecerunt, quæ faciens homo vivet in eis, et sabbata mea violaverunt vehementer. Dixi ergo ut effunderem furorem meum super eos in deserto, et consumerem eos:
text_pt: Mas a casa de Israel se rebelou contra mim no deserto, não andando nos meus estatutos, e rejeitando os meus juízos, os quais, cumprindo-os, o homem viverá por eles; e profanaram grandemente os meus sábados; e eu disse que derramaria sobre eles o meu furor no deserto, para os consumir.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου πορεύεσθε καὶ οὐκ ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου ἀπώσαντο ἃ ποιήσει αὐτὰ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἐβεβήλωσαν σφόδρα καὶ εἶπα τοῦ ἐκχέαι τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ ἐξαναλῶσαι αὐτούς

text_en: But I spared them for the sake of my name , lest it should be profaned before the nations , from which I brought them out, in their sight.
text_la: et feci propter nomen meum, ne violaretur coram gentibus de quibus ejeci eos in conspectu earum.
text_pt: O que fiz, porém, foi por amor do meu nome, para que não fosse profanado diante dos olhos dos gentios perante a vista dos quais os fiz sair.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησα ὅπως τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ παράπαν μὴ βεβηλωθῇ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ἐξήγαγον αὐτοὺς κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: So I lifted up my hand over them in the desert , not to bring them into the land which I had given them flowing with milk and honey, the best of all lands.
text_la: Ego igitur levavi manum meam super eos in deserto, ne inducerem eos in terram quam dedi eis, fluentem lacte et melle, præcipuam terrarum omnium:
text_pt: E, contudo, eu levantei a minha mão para eles no deserto, para não os deixar entrar na terra que lhes tinha dado, a qual mana leite e mel, e é a glória de todas as terras;
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἐξῆρα τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸ παράπαν τοῦ μὴ εἰσαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι κηρίον ἐστὶν παρὰ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: Because they cast off my judgments, and walked not in my statutes , and violated my sabbaths : for their heart went after idols .
text_la: quia judicia mea projecerunt, et in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt, et sabbata mea violaverunt : post idola enim cor eorum gradiebatur.
text_pt: Porque rejeitaram os meus juízos, e não andaram nos meus estatutos, e profanaram os meus sábados; porque o seu coração andava após os seus ídolos.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν τὰ δικαιώματά μου ἀπώσαντο καὶ ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου οὐκ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἐβεβήλουν καὶ ὀπίσω τῶν ἐνθυμημάτων τῶν καρδιῶν αὐτῶν ἐπορεύοντο

text_en: Yet my eye spared them, so that I destroyed them not: neither did I consume them in the desert .
text_la: Et pepercit oculus meus super eos, ut non interficerem eos : nec consumpsi eos in deserto.
text_pt: Não obstante o meu olho lhes perdoou, e eu não os destruí nem os consumi no deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἐφείσατο ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τοῦ ἐξαλεῖψαι αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησα αὐτοὺς εἰς συντέλειαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And I said to their children in the wilderness : Walk not in the statutes of your fathers, and observe not their judgments, nor be defiled with their idols :
text_la: Dixi autem ad filios eorum in solitudine : In præceptis patrum vestrorum nolite incedere, nec judicia eorum custodiatis, nec in idolis eorum polluamini.
text_pt: Mas disse eu a seus filhos no deserto: Não andeis nos estatutos de vossos pais, nem guardeis os seus juízos, nem vos contamineis com os seus ídolos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν τοῖς νομίμοις τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν μὴ πορεύεσθε καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτῶν μὴ φυλάσσεσθε καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν μὴ συναναμίσγεσθε καὶ μὴ μιαίνεσθε

text_en: I am the Lord your God : walk in my statutes , and observe my judgments, and do them.
text_la: Ego Dominus Deus vester : in præceptis meis ambulate : judicia mea custodite, et facite ea,
text_pt: Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus; andai nos meus estatutos, e guardai os meus juízos, e executai-os.
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου πορεύεσθε καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου φυλάσσεσθε καὶ ποιεῖτε αὐτὰ

text_en: And sanctify my sabbaths , that they may be a sign between me and you: and that you may know that I am the Lord your God .
text_la: et sabbata mea sanctificate, ut sint signum inter me et vos, et sciatis quia ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: E santificai os meus sábados, e servirão de sinal entre mim e vós, para que saibais que eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἁγιάζετε καὶ ἔστω εἰς σημεῖον ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ὑμῶν τοῦ γινώσκειν διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: But their children provoked me, they walked not in my commandments , nor observed my judgments to do them: which if a man do, he shall live in them: and they violated my sabbaths : and I threatened to pour out my indignation upon them, and to accomplish my wrath in them in the desert .
text_la: Et exacerbaverunt me filii : in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt, et judicia mea non custodierunt ut facerent ea, quæ cum fecerit homo, vivet in eis, et sabbata mea violaverunt. Et comminatus sum ut effunderem furorem meum super eos, et implerem iram meam in eis in deserto.
text_pt: Mas também os filhos se rebelaram contra mim, e não andaram nos meus estatutos, nem guardaram os meus juízos para os fazer, os quais, cumprindo-os, o homem viverá por eles; eles profanaram os meus sábados; por isso eu disse que derramaria sobre eles o meu furor, para cumprir contra eles a minha ira no deserto.
text_el: καὶ παρεπίκρανάν με καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου οὐκ ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο τοῦ ποιεῖν αὐτά ἃ ποιήσει ἄνθρωπος καὶ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἐβεβήλουν καὶ εἶπα τοῦ ἐκχέαι τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ συντελέσαι τὴν ὀργήν μου ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: But I turned away my hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it might not be violated before the nations , out of which I brought them forth in their sight.
text_la: Averti autem manum meam, et feci propter nomen meum, ut non violaretur coram gentibus de quibus ejeci eos in oculis earum.
text_pt: Mas contive a minha mão, e o fiz por amor do meu nome, para que não fosse profanado perante os olhos dos gentios, à vista dos quais os fiz sair.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησα ὅπως τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ παράπαν μὴ βεβηλωθῇ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ἐξήγαγον αὐτοὺς κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: Again I lifted up my hand upon them in the wilderness , to disperse them among the nations , and scatter them through the countries:
text_la: Iterum levavi manum meam in eos in solitudine, ut dispergerem illos in nationes, et ventilarem in terras,
text_pt: Também levantei a minha mão para eles no deserto, para os espalhar entre os gentios, e os derramar pelas terras,
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆρα τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ διασκορπίσαι αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ διασπεῖραι αὐτοὺς ἐν ταῖς χώραις

text_en: Because they had not done my judgments, and had cast off my statutes , and had violated my sabbaths , and their eyes had been after the idols of their fathers.
text_la: eo quod judicia mea non fecissent, et præcepta mea reprobassent, et sabbata mea violassent, et post idola patrum suorum fuissent oculi eorum.
text_pt: Porque não executaram os meus juízos, e rejeitaram os meus estatutos, e profanaram os meus sábados, e os seus olhos iam após os ídolos de seus pais.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν τὰ δικαιώματά μου οὐκ ἐποίησαν καὶ τὰ προστάγματά μου ἀπώσαντο καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἐβεβήλουν καὶ ὀπίσω τῶν ἐνθυμημάτων τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν ἦσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore I also gave them statutes that were not good , and judgments, in which they shall not live.
text_la: Ergo et ego dedi eis præcepta non bona, et judicia in quibus non vivent.
text_pt: Por isso também lhes dei estatutos que não eram bons, juízos pelos quais não haviam de viver;
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς προστάγματα οὐ καλὰ καὶ δικαιώματα ἐν οἷς οὐ ζήσονται ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And I polluted them in their own gifts , when they offered all that opened the womb , for their offences : and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et pollui eos in muneribus suis, cum offerrent omne quod aperit vulvam, propter delicta sua : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E os contaminei em seus próprios dons, nos quais faziam passar pelo fogo tudo o que abre a madre; para assolá-los para que soubessem que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ μιανῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς δόμασιν αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ διαπορεύεσθαί με πᾶν διανοῖγον μήτραν ὅπως ἀφανίσω αὐτούς

text_en: Wherefore speak to the house of Israel , O son of man , and say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Moreover in this also your fathers blasphemed me, when they had despised and contemned me;
text_la: Quam ob rem loquere ad domum Israël, fili hominis, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Adhuc et in hoc blasphemaverunt me patres vestri, cum sprevissent me contemnentes,
text_pt: Portanto fala à casa de Israel, ó filho do homem, e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda até nisto me blasfemaram vossos pais, e que procederam traiçoeiramente contra mim.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο λάλησον πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἕως τούτου παρώργισάν με οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν αὐτῶν ἐν οἷς παρέπεσον εἰς ἐμέ

text_en: and I had brought them into the land, for which I lifted up my hand to give it them: they saw every high hill, and every shady tree, and there they sacrificed their victims: and there they presented the provocation of their offerings , and there they set their sweet odours, and poured forth their libations.
text_la: et induxissem eos in terram super quam levavi manum meam ut darem eis : viderunt omnem collem excelsum, et omne lignum nemorosum, et immolaverunt ibi victimas suas, et dederunt ibi irritationem oblationis suæ, et posuerunt ibi odorem suavitatis suæ, et libaverunt libationes suas.
text_pt: Porque, havendo-os eu introduzido na terra sobre a qual eu levantara a minha mão, para lha dar, então olharam para todo o outeiro alto, e para toda a árvore frondosa, e ofereceram ali os seus sacrifícios e apresentaram ali a provocação das suas ofertas; puseram ali os seus cheiros suaves, e ali derramaram as suas libações.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγον αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἦρα τὴν χεῖρά μου τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶδον πᾶν βουνὸν ὑψηλὸν καὶ πᾶν ξύλον κατάσκιον καὶ ἔθυσαν ἐκεῖ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἔταξαν ἐκεῖ ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας καὶ ἔσπεισαν ἐκεῖ σπονδὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And I said to them: What means the high place to which you go? And the name thereof was called High-place even to this day.
text_la: Et dixi ad eos : Quid est excelsum, ad quod vos ingredimini? et vocatum est nomen ejus Excelsum usque ad hanc diem.
text_pt: E eu lhes disse: Que alto é este, aonde vós ides? E seu nome tem sido Bamá até o dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτούς τί ἐστιν Αβαμα ὅτι ὑμεῖς εἰσπορεύεσθε ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐπεκάλεσαν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Αβαμα ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: Wherefore say to the house of Israel : Thus says the Lord God : Verily, you are defiled in the way of your fathers, and you commit fornication with their abominations.
text_la: Propterea dic ad domum Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Certe in via patrum vestrorum vos polluimini, et post offendicula eorum vos fornicamini:
text_pt: Portanto dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Contaminai-vos a vós mesmos a maneira de vossos pais? E vos prostituístes com as suas abominações?
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπὸν πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ τάδε λέγει κύριος εἰ ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν ὑμεῖς μιαίνεσθε καὶ ὀπίσω τῶν βδελυγμάτων αὐτῶν ὑμεῖς ἐκπορνεύετε

text_en: And you defile yourselves with all your idols unto this day, in the offering of your gifts, when you make your children pass through the fire: and shall I answer you, O house of Israel ? As I live, says the Lord God , I will not answer you.
text_la: et in oblatione donorum vestrorum, cum traducitis filios vestros per ignem, vos polluimini in omnibus idolis vestris usque hodie : et ego respondebo vobis, domus Israël? Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quia non respondebo vobis.
text_pt: E, quando ofereceis os vossos dons, e fazeis passar os vossos filhos pelo fogo, não é certo que estais contaminados com todos os vossos ídolos, até este dia? E vós me consultaríeis, ó casa de Israel? Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que vós não me consultareis.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀπαρχαῖς τῶν δομάτων ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ἀφορισμοῖς ὑμεῖς μιαίνεσθε ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐνθυμήμασιν ὑμῶν ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας καὶ ἐγὼ ἀποκριθῶ ὑμῖν οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος εἰ ἀποκριθήσομαι ὑμῖν καὶ εἰ ἀναβήσεται ἐπὶ τὸ πνεῦμα ὑμῶν τοῦτο

text_en: Neither shall the thought of your mind come to pass, by which you say: We will be as the Gentiles , and as the families of the earth, to worship stocks and stones .
text_la: Neque cogitatio mentis vestræ fiet, dicentium : Erimus sicut gentes et sicut cognationes terræ, ut colamus ligna et lapides.
text_pt: E o que veio à vossa mente de modo algum sucederá, quando dizeis: Seremos como os gentios, como as outras famílias da terra, servindo ao madeiro e à pedra.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον ὑμεῖς λέγετε ἐσόμεθα ὡς τὰ ἔθνη καὶ ὡς αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς τοῦ λατρεύειν ξύλοις καὶ λίθοις

text_en: As I live, says the Lord God , I will reign over you with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
text_la: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quoniam in manu forti, et in brachio extento, et in furore effuso, regnabo super vos.
text_pt: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com indignação derramada, hei de reinar sobre vós.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ καὶ ἐν θυμῷ κεχυμένῳ βασιλεύσω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς

text_en: And I will bring you out from the people, and I will gather you out of the countries, in which you are scattered , I will reign over you with a strong hand and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
text_la: Et educam vos de populis, et congregabo vos de terris in quibus dispersi estis : in manu valida, et in brachio extento, et in furore effuso, regnabo super vos.
text_pt: E vos tirarei dentre os povos, e vos congregarei das terras nas quais andais espalhados, com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com indignação derramada.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάξω ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῶν λαῶν καὶ εἰσδέξομαι ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν οὗ διεσκορπίσθητε ἐν αὐταῖς ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ καὶ ἐν θυμῷ κεχυμένῳ

text_en: And I will bring you into the wilderness of people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
text_la: Et adducam vos in desertum populorum, et judicabor vobiscum ibi facie ad faciem.
text_pt: E vos levarei ao deserto dos povos; e ali face a face entrarei em juízo convosco;
text_el: καὶ ἄξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τῶν λαῶν καὶ διακριθήσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐκεῖ πρόσωπον κατὰ πρόσωπον

text_en: As I pleaded against your fathers in the desert of the land of Egypt ; even so will I judge you, says the Lord God .
text_la: Sicut judicio contendi adversum patres vestros in deserto terræ Ægypti, sic judicabo vos, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Como entrei em juízo com vossos pais, no deserto da terra do Egito, assim entrarei em juízo convosco, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον διεκρίθην πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ γῆς Αἰγύπτου οὕτως κρινῶ ὑμᾶς λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will make you subject to my sceptre, and will bring you into the bands of the covenant.
text_la: Et subjiciam vos sceptro meo, et inducam vos in vinculis fœderis.
text_pt: Também vos farei passar debaixo da vara, e vos farei entrar no vínculo da aliança.
text_el: καὶ διάξω ὑμᾶς ὑπὸ τὴν ῥάβδον μου καὶ εἰσάξω ὑμᾶς ἐν ἀριθμῷ

text_en: And I will pick out from among you the transgressors, and the wicked , and will bring them out of the land where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et eligam de vobis transgressores et impios, et de terra incolatus eorum educam eos, et in terram Israël non ingredientur : et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E separarei dentre vós os rebeldes, e os que transgrediram contra mim; da terra das suas peregrinações os tirarei, mas à terra de Israel não voltarão; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκλέξω ἐξ ὑμῶν τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς καὶ τοὺς ἀφεστηκότας διότι ἐκ τῆς παροικεσίας αὐτῶν ἐξάξω αὐτούς καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ οὐκ εἰσελεύσονται καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And as for you, O house of Israel : thus says the Lord God : Walk every one after your idols , and serve them. But if in this also you hear me not, but defile my holy name any more with your gifts , and with your idols ;
text_la: Et vos, domus Israël, hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Singuli post idola vestra ambulate, et servite eis. Quod si et in hoc non audieritis me, et nomen meum sanctum pollueritis ultra in muneribus vestris et in idolis vestris:
text_pt: Quanto a vós, ó casa de Israel, assim diz o Senhor DEUS; Ide, sirva cada um os seus ídolos, pois que a mim não me quereis ouvir; mas não profaneis mais o meu santo nome com as vossas dádivas e com os vossos ídolos.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς οἶκος Ισραηλ τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἕκαστος τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτοῦ ἐξάρατε καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰ μὴ ὑμεῖς εἰσακούετέ μου καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ ἅγιον οὐ βεβηλώσετε οὐκέτι ἐν τοῖς δώροις ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν ὑμῶν

text_en: in my holy mountain, in the high mountain of Israel , says the Lord God , there shall all the house of Israel serve me; all of them I say, in the land in which they shall please me, and there will I require your firstfruits , and the chief of your tithes with all your sanctifications.
text_la: in monte sancto meo, in monte excelso Israël, ait Dominus Deus, ibi serviet mihi omnis domus Israël : omnes, inquam, in terra in qua placebunt mihi : et ibi quæram primitias vestras, et initium decimarum vestrarum, in omnibus sanctificationibus vestris.
text_pt: Porque no meu santo monte, no monte alto de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS, ali me servirá toda a casa de Israel, toda ela naquela terra; ali me deleitarei neles, e ali requererei as vossas ofertas alçadas, e as primícias das vossas oblações, com todas as vossas coisas santas;
text_el: διότι ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ ἁγίου μου ἐπ' ὄρους ὑψηλοῦ λέγει κύριος κύριος ἐκεῖ δουλεύσουσίν μοι πᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ εἰς τέλος καὶ ἐκεῖ προσδέξομαι καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐπισκέψομαι τὰς ἀπαρχὰς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τῶν ἀφορισμῶν ὑμῶν ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγιάσμασιν ὑμῶν

text_en: I will accept of you for an odour of sweetness, when I shall have brought you out from the people, and shall have gathered you out of the lands into which you are scattered , and I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations .
text_la: In odorem suavitatis suscipiam vos, cum eduxero vos de populis, et congregavero vos de terris in quas dispersi estis : et sanctificabor in vobis in oculis nationum.
text_pt: Com cheiro suave me deleitarei em vós, quando eu vos tirar dentre os povos e vos congregar das terras em que andais espalhados; e serei santificado em vós perante os olhos dos gentios.
text_el: ἐν ὀσμῇ εὐωδίας προσδέξομαι ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἐξαγαγεῖν με ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῶν λαῶν καὶ εἰσδέχεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν ἐν αἷς διεσκορπίσθητε ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν ὑμῖν κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν λαῶν

text_en: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall have brought you into the land of Israel , into the land for which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers.
text_la: Et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum induxero vos ad terram Israël, in terram pro qua levavi manum meam ut darem eam patribus vestris.
text_pt: E sabereis que eu sou o Senhor, quando eu vos introduzir na terra de Israel, terra pela qual levantei a minha mão para dá-la a vossos pais.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐν τῷ εἰσαγαγεῖν με ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ἦρα τὴν χεῖρά μου τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτὴν τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν

text_en: And there you shall remember your ways, and all your wicked doings with which you have been defiled; and you shall be displeased with yourselves in your own sight, for all your wicked deeds which you committed.
text_la: Et recordabimini ibi viarum vestrarum, et omnium scelerum vestrorum, quibus polluti estis in eis : et displicebitis vobis in conspectu vestro, in omnibus malitiis vestris quas fecistis.
text_pt: E ali vos lembrareis de vossos caminhos, e de todos os vossos atos com que vos contaminastes, e tereis nojo de vós mesmos, por causa de todas as vossas maldades que tendes cometido.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσεσθε ἐκεῖ τὰς ὁδοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν ἐν οἷς ἐμιαίνεσθε ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ κόψεσθε τὰ πρόσωπα ὑμῶν ἐν πᾶσαις ταῖς κακίαις ὑμῶν

text_en: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall have done well by you for my own name's sake, and not according to your evil ways, nor according to your wicked deeds , O house of Israel , says the Lord God .
text_la: Et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum benefecero vobis propter nomen meum, et non secundum vias vestras malas, neque secundum scelera vestra pessima, domus Israël, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu proceder para convosco por amor do meu nome; não conforme os vossos maus caminhos, nem conforme os vossos atos corruptos, ó casa de Israel, disse o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐν τῷ ποιῆσαί με οὕτως ὑμῖν ὅπως τὸ ὄνομά μου μὴ βεβηλωθῇ κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς ὑμῶν τὰς κακὰς καὶ κατὰ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν τὰ διεφθαρμένα λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , set your face against the way of the south, and drop towards the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field.
text_la: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra viam austri, et stilla ad africum, et propheta ad saltum agri meridiani.
text_pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto para o caminho do sul, e derrama as tuas palavras contra o sul, e profetiza contra o bosque do campo do sul.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Θαιμαν καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ Δαρωμ καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπὶ δρυμὸν ἡγούμενον Ναγεβ

text_en: And say to the south forest: Hear the word of the Lord : Thus says the Lord God : Behold I will kindle a fire in you, and will burn in you every green tree, and every dry tree: the flame of the fire shall not be quenched: and every face shall be burned in it, from the south even to the north.
text_la: Et dices saltui meridiano : Audi verbum Domini : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego succendam in te ignem, et comburam in te omne lignum viride, et omne lignum aridum : non extinguetur flamma succensionis : et comburetur in ea omnis facies ab austro usque ad aquilonem,
text_pt: E dize ao bosque do sul: Ouve a palavra do SENHOR: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que acenderei em ti um fogo que em ti consumirá toda a árvore verde e toda a árvore seca; não se apagará a chama flamejante, antes com ela se queimarão todos os rostos, desde o sul até ao norte.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τῷ δρυμῷ Ναγεβ ἄκουε λόγον κυρίου τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀνάπτω ἐν σοὶ πῦρ καὶ καταφάγεται ἐν σοὶ πᾶν ξύλον χλωρὸν καὶ πᾶν ξύλον ξηρόν οὐ σβεσθήσεται ἡ φλὸξ ἡ ἐξαφθεῖσα καὶ κατακαυθήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ πᾶν πρόσωπον ἀπὸ ἀπηλιώτου ἕως βορρᾶ

text_en: And all flesh shall see, that I the Lord have kindled it, and it shall not be quenched.
text_la: et videbit universa caro quia ego Dominus succendi eam, nec extinguetur.
text_pt: E verá toda a carne que eu, o Senhor, o acendi; não se apagará.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται πᾶσα σὰρξ ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐξέκαυσα αὐτό καὶ οὐ σβεσθήσεται

text_en: And I said: Ah, ah, ah, O Lord God : they say of me: Does not this man speak by parables ?
text_la: Et dixi : A, a, a, Domine Deus : ipsi dicunt de me : Numquid non per parabolas loquitur iste?
text_pt: Então disse eu: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Eles dizem de mim: Não é este um proferidor de parábolas?
text_el: καὶ εἶπα μηδαμῶς κύριε κύριε αὐτοὶ λέγουσιν πρός με οὐχὶ παραβολή ἐστιν λεγομένη αὕτη

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , set your face toward Jerusalem , and let your speech flow towards the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel :
text_la: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam ad Jerusalem, et stilla ad sanctuaria, et propheta contra humum Israël.
text_pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra Jerusalém, e derrama as tuas palavras sobre os santuários, e profetiza sobre a terra de Israel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο προφήτευσον υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου καὶ στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγια αὐτῶν καὶ προφητεύσεις ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And say to the land of Israel , Thus says the Lord God : Behold I come against you, and I will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off in you the just , and the wicked .
text_la: Et dices terræ Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad te, et ejiciam gladium meum de vagina sua, et occidam in te justum et impium.
text_pt: E dize à terra de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que sou contra ti, e tirarei a minha espada da bainha, e exterminarei do meio de ti o justo e o ímpio.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς σὲ καὶ ἐκσπάσω τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω ἐκ σοῦ ἄδικον καὶ ἄνομον

text_en: And forasmuch as I have cut off in you the just and the wicked , therefore shall my sword go forth out of its sheath against all flesh, from the south even to the north.
text_la: Pro eo autem quod occidi in te justum et impium, idcirco egredietur gladius meus de vagina sua ad omnem carnem, ab austro usque ad aquilonem :
text_pt: E, por isso que hei de exterminar do meio de ti o justo e o ímpio, a minha espada sairá da sua bainha contra toda a carne, desde o sul até o norte.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν ἐξολεθρεύσω ἐκ σοῦ ἄδικον καὶ ἄνομον οὕτως ἐξελεύσεται τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα ἀπὸ ἀπηλιώτου ἕως βορρᾶ

text_en: That all flesh may know that I the Lord have drawn my sword out of its sheath not to be turned back.
text_la: ut sciat omnis caro quia ego Dominus, eduxi gladium meum de vagina sua irrevocabilem.
text_pt: E saberá toda a carne que eu, o Senhor, tirei a minha espada da bainha; nunca mais voltará a ela.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεται πᾶσα σὰρξ διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐξέσπασα τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀποστρέψει οὐκέτι

text_en: And you, son of man , mourn with the breaking of your loins, and with bitterness sigh before them.
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, ingemisce in contritione lumborum, et in amaritudinibus ingemisce coram eis.
text_pt: Tu, porém, ó filho do homem, suspira; suspira aos olhos deles, com quebrantamento dos teus lombos e com amargura.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου καταστέναξον ἐν συντριβῇ ὀσφύος σου καὶ ἐν ὀδύναις στενάξεις κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: And when they shall say to you: Why do you mourn? You shall say: For that which I hear: because it comes, and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be made feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and water shall run down every knee: behold it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord God .
text_la: Cumque dixerint ad te : Quare tu gemis? dices : Pro auditu : quia venit, et tabescet omne cor, et dissolventur universæ manus, et infirmabitur omnis spiritus, et per cuncta genua fluent aquæ : ecce venit, et fiet, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E será que, quando eles te disserem: Por que suspiras tu? Dirás: Por causa das novas, porque vêm; e todo o coração desmaiará, e todas as mãos se enfraquecerão, e todo o espírito se angustiará, e todos os joelhos se desfarão em águas; eis que vêm, e se cumprirão, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν εἴπωσιν πρὸς σέ ἕνεκα τίνος σὺ στενάζεις καὶ ἐρεῖς ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγγελίᾳ διότι ἔρχεται καὶ θραυσθήσεται πᾶσα καρδία καὶ πᾶσαι χεῖρες παραλυθήσονται καὶ ἐκψύξει πᾶσα σὰρξ καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα καὶ πάντες μηροὶ μολυνθήσονται ὑγρασίᾳ ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται καὶ ἔσται λέγει κύριος κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , prophesy , and say: Thus says the Lord God : Say: The sword, the sword is sharpened, and furbished.
text_la: Fili hominis, propheta, et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : loquere : Gladius, gladius exacutus est, et limatus :
text_pt: Filho do homem, profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor: dize: A espada, a espada está afiada e polida.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον καὶ ἐρεῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος εἰπόν ῥομφαία ῥομφαία ὀξύνου καὶ θυμώθητι

text_en: It is sharpened to kill victims: it is furbished that it may glitter: you remove the sceptre of my son, you have cut down every tree.
text_la: ut cædat victimas, exacutus est : ut splendeat, limatus est : qui moves sceptrum filii mei, succidisti omne lignum.
text_pt: Para grande matança está afiada, para reluzir está polida. Alegrar-nos-emos pois? A vara de meu filho é que despreza todo o madeiro.
text_el: ὅπως σφάξῃς σφάγια ὀξύνου ὅπως γένῃ εἰς στίλβωσιν ἑτοίμη εἰς παράλυσιν σφάζε ἐξουδένει ἀπωθοῦ πᾶν ξύλον

text_en: And I have given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, that it may be in the hand of the slayer.
text_la: Et dedi eum ad levigandum, ut teneatur manu : iste exacutus est gladius, et iste limatus est, ut sit in manu interficientis.
text_pt: E foi dada a polir, para ser manejada; esta espada está afiada, e está polida, para ser posta na mão do matador.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν ἑτοίμην τοῦ κρατεῖν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐξηκονήθη ῥομφαία ἔστιν ἑτοίμη τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτὴν εἰς χεῖρα ἀποκεντοῦντος

text_en: Cry, and howl, O son of man , for this sword is upon my people, it is upon all the princes of Israel , that are fled: they are delivered up to the sword with my people, strike therefore upon your thigh,
text_la: Clama et ulula, fili hominis, quia hic factus est in populo meo, hic in cunctis ducibus Israël qui fugerant : gladio traditi sunt cum populo meo : idcirco plaude super femur,
text_pt: Grita e geme, ó filho do homem, porque ela será contra o meu povo, contra todos os príncipes de Israel. Estes, juntamente com o meu povo, estão espantados com a espada; bate, pois, na tua coxa.
text_el: ἀνάκραγε καὶ ὀλόλυξον υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ὅτι αὐτὴ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου αὐτὴ ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀφηγουμένοις τοῦ Ισραηλ παροικήσουσιν ἐπὶ ῥομφαίᾳ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου διὰ τοῦτο κρότησον ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρά σου

text_en: because it is tried: and that when it shall overthrow the sceptre, and it shall not be, says the Lord God .
text_la: quia probatus est : et hoc, cum sceptrum subverterit, et non erit, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Pois se faz uma prova; e que seria se a espada desprezasse mesmo a vara? Ela não seria mais, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ὅτι δεδικαίωται καὶ τί εἰ καὶ φυλὴ ἀπώσθη οὐκ ἔσται λέγει κύριος κύριος

text_en: You therefore, O son of man , prophesy , and strike your hands together, and let the sword be doubled, and let the sword of the slain be tripled: this is the sword of a great slaughter, that makes them stand amazed,
text_la: Tu ergo, fili hominis, propheta, et percute manu ad manum : et duplicetur gladius, ac triplicetur gladius interfectorum : hic est gladius occisionis magnæ, qui obstupescere eos facit
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, profetiza e bate com as mãos uma na outra; e dobre-se a espada até a terceira vez, a espada dos mortos; ela é a espada para a grande matança, que os traspassará até o seu interior.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον καὶ κρότησον χεῖρα ἐπὶ χεῖρα καὶ διπλασίασον ῥομφαίαν ἡ τρίτη ῥομφαία τραυματιῶν ἐστιν ῥομφαία τραυματιῶν ἡ μεγάλη καὶ ἐκστήσει αὐτούς

text_en: and languish in heart, and that multiplies ruins. In all their gates I have set the dread of the sharp sword, the sword that is furbished to glitter, that is made ready for slaughter.
text_la: et corde tabescere, et multiplicat ruinas. In omnibus portis eorum dedi conturbationem gladii acuti, et limati ad fulgendum, amicti ad cædem.
text_pt: Para que desmaie o coração, e se multipliquem as destruições, contra todas as suas portas, pus a ponta da espada, a que foi feita para reluzir, e está preparada para a matança!
text_el: ὅπως θραυσθῇ ἡ καρδία καὶ πληθυνθῶσιν οἱ ἀσθενοῦντες ἐπὶ πᾶσαν πύλην αὐτῶν παραδέδονται εἰς σφάγια ῥομφαίας εὖ γέγονεν εἰς σφαγήν εὖ γέγονεν εἰς στίλβωσιν

text_en: Be sharpened, go to the right hand, or to the left, which way soever you have a mind to set your face.
text_la: Exacuere, vade ad dexteram sive ad sinistram, quocumque faciei tuæ est appetitus.
text_pt: Ó espada, une-te, vira-te para a direita; prepara-te, vira-te para a esquerda, para onde quer que o teu rosto se dirigir.
text_el: διαπορεύου ὀξύνου ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων οὗ ἂν τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐξεγείρηται

text_en: And I will clap my hands together, and will satisfy my indignation: I the Lord have spoken.
text_la: Quin et ego plaudam manu ad manum, et implebo indignationem meam : ego Dominus locutus sum.
text_pt: E também eu baterei com as minhas mãos uma na outra, e farei descansar a minha indignação; eu, o Senhor, o disse.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ δὲ κροτήσω χεῖρά μου πρὸς χεῖρά μου καὶ ἐναφήσω τὸν θυμόν μου ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: And you son of man , set you two ways, for the sword of the king of Babylon to come: both shall come forth out of one land: and with his hand he shall draw lots, he shall consult at the head of the way of the city.
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, pone tibi duas vias, ut veniat gladius regis Babylonis : de terra una egredientur ambæ : et manu capiet conjecturam; in capite viæ civitatis conjiciet.
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, propõe dois caminhos, por onde venha a espada do rei de babilônia. Ambos procederão de uma mesma terra, e escolhe um lugar; escolhe-o no cimo do caminho da cidade.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου διάταξον σεαυτῷ δύο ὁδοὺς τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν ῥομφαίαν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ἐκ χώρας μιᾶς ἐξελεύσονται αἱ δύο καὶ χεὶρ ἐν ἀρχῇ ὁδοῦ πόλεως ἐπ' ἀρχῆς

text_en: You shall make a way that the sword may come to Rabbath of the children of Ammon , and to Juda unto Jerusalem the strong city.
text_la: Viam pones ut veniat gladius ad Rabbath filiorum Ammon, et ad Judam in Jerusalem munitissimam.
text_pt: Um caminho proporás, por onde virá a espada contra Rabá dos filhos de Amom, e contra Judá, em Jerusalém, a fortificada.
text_el: ὁδοῦ διατάξεις τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν ῥομφαίαν ἐπὶ Ραββαθ υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν Ιουδαίαν καὶ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: For the king of Babylon stood in the highway, at the head of two ways, seeking divination , shuffling arrows: he inquired of the idols , and consulted entrails.
text_la: Stetit enim rex Babylonis in bivio, in capite duarum viarum, divinationem quærens, commiscens sagittas : interrogavit idola, exta consuluit.
text_pt: Porque o rei de babilônia parará na encruzilhada, no cimo dos dois caminhos, para fazer adivinhações; aguçará as suas flechas, consultará as imagens, atentará para o fígado.
text_el: διότι στήσεται βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐπὶ τὴν ἀρχαίαν ὁδὸν ἐπ' ἀρχῆς τῶν δύο ὁδῶν τοῦ μαντεύσασθαι μαντείαν τοῦ ἀναβράσαι ῥάβδον καὶ ἐπερωτῆσαι ἐν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς καὶ ἡπατοσκοπήσασθαι ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: On his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem , to set battering rams, to open the mouth in slaughter, to lift up the voice in howling, to set engines against the gates, to cast up a mount, to build forts.
text_la: Ad dexteram ejus facta est divinatio super Jerusalem, ut ponat arietes, ut aperiat os in cæde, ut elevet vocem in ululatu, ut ponat arietes contra portas, ut comportet aggerem, ut ædificet munitiones.
text_pt: « sua direita estará a adivinhação sobre Jerusalém, para ordenar aos capitàes, para abrirem a boca, ordenando a matança, para levantarem a voz com júbilo, para pôrem os aríetes contra as portas, para levantarem trincheiras, para edificarem baluartes.
text_el: ἐγένετο τὸ μαντεῖον ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ βαλεῖν χάρακα τοῦ διανοῖξαι στόμα ἐν βοῇ ὑψῶσαι φωνὴν μετὰ κραυγῆς τοῦ βαλεῖν χάρακα ἐπὶ τὰς πύλας αὐτῆς καὶ βαλεῖν χῶμα καὶ οἰκοδομῆσαι βελοστάσεις

text_en: And he shall be in their eyes as one consulting the oracle in vain, and imitating the leisure of sabbaths : but he will call to remembrance the iniquity that they may be taken.
text_la: Eritque quasi consulens frustra oraculum in oculis eorum, et sabbatorum otium imitans : ipse autem recordabitur iniquitatis ad capiendum.
text_pt: Isto será como adivinhação vã, aos olhos daqueles que lhes fizeram juramentos; mas ele se lembrará da iniqüidade, para que sejam apanhados.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς αὐτοῖς ὡς μαντευόμενος μαντείαν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν καὶ αὐτὸς ἀναμιμνῄσκων ἀδικίας αὐτοῦ μνησθῆναι

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have remembered your iniquity , and have discovered your prevarications, and your sins have appeared in all your devices: because, I say, you have remembered, you shall be taken with the hand.
text_la: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod recordati estis iniquitatis vestræ, et revelastis prævaricationes vestras, et apparuerunt peccata vestra in omnibus cogitationibus vestris, pro eo, inquam, quod recordati estis, manu capiemini.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Visto que me fazeis lembrar da vossa iniqüidade, descobrindo-se as vossas transgressões, aparecendo os vossos pecados em todos os vossos atos; visto que viestes em memória, sereis apanhados com a mão.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἀνεμνήσατε τὰς ἀδικίας ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι τὰς ἀσεβείας ὑμῶν τοῦ ὁραθῆναι ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἀσεβείαις ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν ὑμῶν ἀνθ' ὧν ἀνεμνήσατε ἐν τούτοις ἁλώσεσθε

text_en: But you profane wicked prince of Israel , whose day has come that has been appointed in the time of iniquity :
text_la: Tu autem, profane, impie dux Israël, cujus venit dies in tempore iniquitatis præfinita:
text_pt: E tu, ó profano e ímpio príncipe de Israel, cujo dia virá no tempo da extrema iniqüidade,
text_el: καὶ σύ βέβηλε ἄνομε ἀφηγούμενε τοῦ Ισραηλ οὗ ἥκει ἡ ἡμέρα ἐν καιρῷ ἀδικίας πέρας

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Remove the diadem, take off the crown: is it not this that has exalted the low one, and brought down him that was high?
text_la: hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Aufer cidarim, tolle coronam : nonne hæc est quæ humilem sublevavit, et sublimem humiliavit?
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Tira o diadema, e remove a coroa; esta não será a mesma; exalta ao humilde, e humilha ao soberbo.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀφείλου τὴν κίδαριν καὶ ἐπέθου τὸν στέφανον αὕτη οὐ τοιαύτη ἔσται ἐταπείνωσας τὸ ὑψηλὸν καὶ τὸ ταπεινὸν ὕψωσας

text_en: I will show it to be iniquity , iniquity , iniquity : but this was not done till he came to whom judgment belongs, and I will give it him.
text_la: Iniquitatem, iniquitatem, iniquitatem ponam eam : et hoc non factum est, donec veniret cujus est judicium, et tradam ei.
text_pt: Ao revés, ao revés, ao revés porei aquela coroa, e ela não mais será, até que venha aquele a quem pertence de direito; a ele a darei.
text_el: ἀδικίαν ἀδικίαν θήσομαι αὐτήν οὐδ' αὕτη τοιαύτη ἔσται ἕως οὗ ἔλθῃ ᾧ καθήκει καὶ παραδώσω αὐτῷ

text_en: And you son of man , prophesy , and say: Thus says the Lord God concerning the children of Ammon , and concerning their reproach, and you shall say: O sword, O sword, come out of the scabbard to kill , be furbished to destroy, and to glitter,
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, propheta, et dic : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus ad filios Ammon, et ad opprobrium eorum : et dices : Mucro, mucro, evaginate ad occidendum : limate ut interficias et fulgeas :
text_pt: E tu, ó filho do homem, profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS acerca dos filhos de Amom, e acerca do seu opróbrio; dize pois: A espada, a espada está desembainhada, polida para a matança, para consumir, por estar reluzente;
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον καὶ ἐρεῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων καὶ πρὸς τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐρεῖς ῥομφαία ῥομφαία ἐσπασμένη εἰς σφάγια καὶ ἐσπασμένη εἰς συντέλειαν ἐγείρου ὅπως στίλβῃς

text_en: whilst they see vain things in your regard, and they divine lies : to bring you upon the necks of the wicked that are wounded, whose appointed day has come in the time of iniquity .
text_la: cum tibi viderentur vana, et divinarentur mendacia, ut dareris super colla vulneratorum impiorum, quorum venit dies in tempore iniquitatis præfinita.
text_pt: Entretanto te profetizam vaidade, te adivinham mentira, para te porem no pescoço dos ímpios, daqueles que estão mortos, cujo dia veio no tempo da iniqüidade final.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ὁράσει σου τῇ ματαίᾳ καὶ ἐν τῷ μαντεύεσθαί σε ψευδῆ τοῦ παραδοῦναί σε ἐπὶ τραχήλους τραυματιῶν ἀνόμων ὧν ἥκει ἡ ἡμέρα ἐν καιρῷ ἀδικίας πέρας

text_en: Return into your sheath. I will judge you in the place wherein you were created , in the land of your nativity.
text_la: Revertere ad vaginam tuam, in loco in quo creatus es : in terra nativitatis tuæ judicabo te.
text_pt: Torne a tua espada à sua bainha. No lugar em que foste criado, na terra do teu nascimento, eu te julgarei.
text_el: ἀπόστρεφε μὴ καταλύσῃς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ ᾧ γεγέννησαι ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ ἰδίᾳ σου κρινῶ σε

text_en: And I will pour out upon you my indignation: in the fire of my rage will I blow upon you, and will give you into the hands of men that are brutish and contrive your destruction.
text_la: Et effundam super te indignationem meam; in igne furoris mei sufflabo in te : daboque te in manus hominum insipientium, et fabricantium interitum.
text_pt: E derramarei sobre ti a minha indignação, assoprarei contra ti o fogo do meu furor, entregar-te-ei nas mãos dos homens brutais, inventores de destruição.
text_el: καὶ ἐκχεῶ ἐπὶ σὲ ὀργήν μου ἐν πυρὶ ὀργῆς μου ἐμφυσήσω ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ παραδώσω σε εἰς χεῖρας ἀνδρῶν βαρβάρων τεκταινόντων διαφθοράν

text_en: You shall be fuel for the fire, your blood shall be in the midst of the land, you shall be forgotten: for I the Lord have spoken it.
text_la: Igni eris cibus; sanguis tuus erit in medio terræ; oblivioni traderis : quia ego Dominus locutus sum.
text_pt: Ao fogo servirás para ser consumido; o teu sangue estará no meio da terra; já não serás mais lembrado, porque eu, o Senhor, o disse.
text_el: ἐν πυρὶ ἔσῃ κατάβρωμα τὸ αἷμά σου ἔσται ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς σου οὐ μὴ γένηταί σου μνεία διότι ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: And you son of man , do you not judge, do you not judge the city of blood?
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, nonne judicas, nonne judicas civitatem sanguinum?
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, porventura julgarás, julgarás a cidade sanguinária? Faze-lhe conhecer, pois, todas as suas abominações.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰ κρινεῖς τὴν πόλιν τῶν αἱμάτων καὶ παράδειξον αὐτῇ πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῆς

text_en: And you shall show her all her abominations , and shall say: Thus says the Lord God : This is the city that sheds blood in the midst of her, that her time may come: and that has made idols against herself, to defile herself.
text_la: Et ostendes ei omnes abominationes suas, et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Civitas effundens sanguinem in medio sui, ut veniat tempus ejus : et quæ fecit idola contra semetipsam, ut pollueretur.
text_pt: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai da cidade que derrama o sangue no meio de si para que venha o seu tempo! Que faz ídolos contra si mesma, para se contaminar!
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ὦ πόλις ἐκχέουσα αἵματα ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς τοῦ ἐλθεῖν καιρὸν αὐτῆς καὶ ποιοῦσα ἐνθυμήματα καθ' αὑτῆς τοῦ μιαίνειν αὐτήν

text_en: You have become guilty in your blood which you have shed: and you are defiled in your idols which you have made: and you have made your days to draw near, and have brought on the time of your years: therefore have I made you a reproach to the Gentiles , and a mockery to all countries.
text_la: In sanguine tuo, qui a te effusus est, deliquisti, et in idolis tuis, quæ fecisti, polluta es : et appropinquare fecisti dies tuos, et adduxisti tempus annorum tuorum : propterea dedi te opprobrium gentibus, et irrisionem universis terris.
text_pt: Pelo teu sangue que derramaste te fizeste culpada, e pelos teus ídolos que fabricaste te contaminaste, e fizeste aproximarem-se os teus dias, e tem chegado o fim dos teus anos; por isso eu te fiz o opróbrio das nações e o escárnio de todas as terras.
text_el: ἐν τοῖς αἵμασιν αὐτῶν οἷς ἐξέχεας παραπέπτωκας καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐνθυμήμασίν σου οἷς ἐποίεις ἐμιαίνου καὶ ἤγγισας τὰς ἡμέρας σου καὶ ἤγαγες καιρὸν ἐτῶν σου διὰ τοῦτο δέδωκά σε εἰς ὄνειδος τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ εἰς ἐμπαιγμὸν πάσαις ταῖς χώραις

text_en: Those that are near, and those that are far from you, shall triumph over you: you filthy one, infamous , great in destruction.
text_la: Quæ juxta sunt, et quæ procul a te, triumphabunt de te, sordida, nobilis, grandis interitu.
text_pt: As que estão perto de ti e as que estão longe escarnecerão de ti, infamada, cheia de inquietação.
text_el: ταῖς ἐγγιζούσαις πρὸς σὲ καὶ ταῖς μακρὰν ἀπεχούσαις ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἐμπαίξονται ἐν σοί ἀκάθαρτος ἡ ὀνομαστὴ καὶ πολλὴ ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις

text_en: Behold the princes of Israel , every one has employed his arm in you to shed blood.
text_la: Ecce principes Israël singuli in brachio suo fuerunt in te, ad effundendum sanguinem.
text_pt: Eis que os príncipes de Israel, cada um conforme o seu poder, estavam em ti para derramarem sangue.
text_el: ἰδοὺ οἱ ἀφηγούμενοι οἴκου Ισραηλ ἕκαστος πρὸς τοὺς συγγενεῖς αὐτοῦ συνανεφύροντο ἐν σοί ὅπως ἐκχέωσιν αἷμα

text_en: They have abused father and mother in you, they have oppressed the stranger in the midst of you, they have grieved the fatherless and widow in you.
text_la: Patrem et matrem contumeliis affecerunt : in te advenam calumniati sunt in medio tui : pupillum et viduam contristaverunt apud te.
text_pt: Ao pai e à mãe desprezaram em ti; para com o estrangeiro usaram de opressão no meio de ti; ao órfão e à viúva oprimiram em ti.
text_el: πατέρα καὶ μητέρα ἐκακολόγουν ἐν σοὶ καὶ πρὸς τὸν προσήλυτον ἀνεστρέφοντο ἐν ἀδικίαις ἐν σοί ὀρφανὸν καὶ χήραν κατεδυνάστευον ἐν σοί

text_en: You have despised my sanctuaries, and profaned my sabbaths .
text_la: Sanctuaria mea sprevisti, et sabbata mea polluisti.
text_pt: As minhas coisas santas desprezaste, e os meus sábados profanaste.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἅγιά μου ἐξουδένουν καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἐβεβήλουν ἐν σοί

text_en: Slanderers have been in you to shed blood, and they have eaten upon the mountains in you, they have committed wickedness in the midst of you.
text_la: Viri detractores fuerunt in te ad effundendum sanguinem, et super montes comederunt in te : scelus operati sunt in medio tui.
text_pt: Homens caluniadores se acharam em ti, para derramarem sangue; e em ti sobre os montes comeram; perversidade cometeram no meio de ti.
text_el: ἄνδρες λῃσταὶ ἐν σοί ὅπως ἐκχέωσιν ἐν σοὶ αἷμα καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ἤσθοσαν ἐν σοί ἀνόσια ἐποίουν ἐν μέσῳ σου

text_en: They have discovered the nakedness of their father in you, they have humbled the uncleanness of the menstruous woman in you.
text_la: Verecundiora patris discooperuerunt in te; immunditiam menstruatæ humiliaverunt in te:
text_pt: A vergonha do pai descobriram em ti; a que estava imunda, na sua separação, humilharam no meio de ti.
text_el: αἰσχύνην πατρὸς ἀπεκάλυψαν ἐν σοὶ καὶ ἐν ἀκαθαρσίαις ἀποκαθημένην ἐταπείνουν ἐν σοί

text_en: And every one has committed abomination with his neighbour's wife , and the father in law has wickedly defiled his daughter in law, the brother has oppressed his sister the daughter of his father in you.
text_la: et unusquisque in uxorem proximi sui operatus est abominationem, et socer nurum suam polluit nefarie : frater sororem suam, filiam patris sui, oppressit in te.
text_pt: Um cometeu abominação com a mulher do seu próximo, outro contaminou abominavelmente a sua nora, e outro humilhou no meio de ti a sua irmã, filha de seu pai.
text_el: ἕκαστος τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἠνομοῦσαν καὶ ἕκαστος τὴν νύμφην αὐτοῦ ἐμίαινεν ἐν ἀσεβείᾳ καὶ ἕκαστος τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ θυγατέρα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐταπείνουν ἐν σοί
