text_en: They have taken gifts in you to shed blood: you have taken usury and increase, and have covetously oppressed your neighbours: and you have forgotten me, says the Lord God .
text_la: Munera acceperunt apud te ad effundendum sanguinem : usuram et superabundantiam accepisti, et avare proximos tuos calumniabaris : meique oblita es, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Presentes receberam no meio de ti para derramarem sangue; usura e juros ilícitos tomaste, e usaste de avareza com o teu próximo, oprimindo-o; mas de mim te esqueceste, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: δῶρα ἐλαμβάνοσαν ἐν σοί ὅπως ἐκχέωσιν αἷμα τόκον καὶ πλεονασμὸν ἐλαμβάνοσαν ἐν σοί καὶ συνετελέσω συντέλειαν κακίας σου τὴν ἐν καταδυναστείᾳ ἐμοῦ δὲ ἐπελάθου λέγει κύριος

text_en: Behold, I have clapped my hands at your covetousness , which you have exercised: and at the blood that has been shed in the midst of you.
text_la: Ecce complosi manus meas super avaritiam tuam quam fecisti, et super sanguinem qui effusus est in medio tui.
text_pt: E eis que bati as mãos contra a avareza que cometeste, e por causa do sangue que houve no meio de ti.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ πατάξω χεῖρά μου πρὸς χεῖρά μου ἐφ' οἷς συντετέλεσαι οἷς ἐποίησας καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς αἵμασίν σου τοῖς γεγενημένοις ἐν μέσῳ σου

text_en: Shall your heart endure, or shall your hands prevail in the days which I will bring upon you: I the Lord have spoken, and will do it.
text_la: Numquid sustinebit cor tuum, aut prævalebunt manus tuæ, in diebus quos ego faciam tibi? Ego Dominus locutus sum, et faciam.
text_pt: Porventura estará firme o teu coração? Porventura estarão fortes as tuas mãos, nos dias em que eu tratarei contigo? Eu, o Senhor, o disse, e o farei.
text_el: εἰ ὑποστήσεται ἡ καρδία σου εἰ κρατήσουσιν αἱ χεῖρές σου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αἷς ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν σοί ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα καὶ ποιήσω

text_en: And I will disperse you in the nations , and will scatter you among the countries, and I will put an end to your uncleanness in you.
text_la: Et dispergam te in nationes, et ventilabo te in terras, et deficere faciam immunditiam tuam a te.
text_pt: E espalhar-te-ei entre as nações, e dispersar-te-ei pelas terras, e porei termo à tua imundícia.
text_el: καὶ διασκορπιῶ σε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ διασπερῶ σε ἐν ταῖς χώραις καὶ ἐκλείψει ἡ ἀκαθαρσία σου ἐκ σοῦ

text_en: And I will possess you in the sight of the Gentiles , and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et possidebo te in conspectu gentium : et scies quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E tu serás profanada em ti mesma aos olhos dos gentios, e saberás que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ κατακληρονομήσω ἐν σοὶ κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ γνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , the house of Israel has become dross to me: all these are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace: they have become the dross of silver.
text_la: Fili hominis, versa est mihi domus Israël in scoriam : omnes isti æs, et stannum, et ferrum, et plumbum in medio fornacis : scoria argenti facti sunt.
text_pt: Filho do homem, a casa de Israel se tornou para mim em escórias; todos eles são bronze, e estanho, e ferro, e chumbo no meio do forno; em escórias de prata se tornaram.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἰδοὺ γεγόνασί μοι ὁ οἶκος Ισραηλ ἀναμεμειγμένοι πάντες χαλκῷ καὶ σιδήρῳ καὶ κασσιτέρῳ καὶ μολίβῳ ἐν μέσῳ ἀργυρίου ἀναμεμειγμένος ἐστίν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you are all turned into dross, therefore behold I will gather you together in the midst of Jerusalem .
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Eo quod versi estis omnes in scoriam, propterea ecce ego congregabo vos in medio Jerusalem,
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Pois que todos vós vos tornastes em escórias, por isso eis que eu vos ajuntarei no meio de Jerusalém.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐγένεσθε πάντες εἰς σύγκρασιν μίαν διὰ τοῦτο ἐγὼ εἰσδέχομαι ὑμᾶς εἰς μέσον Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: As they gather silver, and brass, and tin, and iron, and lead in the midst of the furnace: that I may kindle a fire in it to melt it: so will I gather you together in my fury and in my wrath , and will take my rest, and I will melt you down.
text_la: congregatione argenti, et æris, et stanni, et ferri, et plumbi, in medio fornacis, ut succendam in ea ignem ad conflandum. Sic congregabo in furore meo, et in ira mea : et requiescam, et conflabo vos.
text_pt: Como se ajuntam a prata, e o bronze, e o ferro, e o chumbo, e o estanho, no meio do forno, para assoprar o fogo sobre eles, a fim de se fundirem, assim vos ajuntarei na minha ira e no meu furor, e ali vos deixarei e fundirei.
text_el: καθὼς εἰσδέχεται ἄργυρος καὶ χαλκὸς καὶ σίδηρος καὶ κασσίτερος καὶ μόλιβος εἰς μέσον καμίνου τοῦ ἐκφυσῆσαι εἰς αὐτὸ πῦρ τοῦ χωνευθῆναι οὕτως εἰσδέξομαι ὑμᾶς ἐν ὀργῇ μου καὶ συνάξω καὶ χωνεύσω ὑμᾶς

text_en: And will gather you together, and will burn you in the fire of my wrath , and you shall be melted in the midst thereof.
text_la: Et congregabo vos, et succendam vos in igne furoris mei, et conflabimini in medio ejus.
text_pt: E congregar-vos-ei, e assoprarei sobre vós o fogo do meu furor; e sereis fundidos no meio dela.
text_el: καὶ ἐκφυσήσω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἐν πυρὶ ὀργῆς μου καὶ χωνευθήσεσθε ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall you be in the midst thereof: and you shall know that I am the Lord , when I have poured out my indignation upon you.
text_la: Ut conflatur argentum in medio fornacis, sic eritis in medio ejus : et scietis quia ego Dominus cum effuderim indignationem meam super vos.
text_pt: Como se funde a prata no meio do forno, assim sereis fundidos no meio dela; e sabereis que eu, o Senhor, derramei o meu furor sobre vós.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον χωνεύεται ἀργύριον ἐν μέσῳ καμίνου οὕτως χωνευθήσεσθε ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐξέχεα τὸν θυμόν μου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , say to her: You are a land that is unclean , and not rained upon in the day of wrath .
text_la: Fili hominis, dic ei : Tu es terra immunda, et non compluta in die furoris.
text_pt: Filho do homem, dize-lhe: Tu és uma terra que não está purificada; e que não tem chuva no dia da indignação.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰπὸν αὐτῇ σὺ εἶ γῆ ἡ οὐ βρεχομένη οὐδὲ ὑετὸς ἐγένετο ἐπὶ σὲ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς

text_en: There is a conspiracy of prophets in the midst thereof: like a lion that roars and catches the prey, they have devoured souls , they have taken riches and hire, they have made many widows in the midst thereof.
text_la: Conjuratio prophetarum in medio ejus : sicut leo rugiens, rapiensque prædam, animas devoraverunt : opes et pretium acceperunt : viduas ejus multiplicaverunt in medio illius.
text_pt: Conspiração dos seus profetas há no meio dela, como um leão que ruge, que arrebata a presa; eles devoram as almas; tomam tesouros e coisas preciosas, multiplicam as suas viúvas no meio dela.
text_el: ἧς οἱ ἀφηγούμενοι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ὡς λέοντες ὠρυόμενοι ἁρπάζοντες ἁρπάγματα ψυχὰς κατεσθίοντες ἐν δυναστείᾳ τιμὰς λαμβάνοντες ἐν ἀδικίᾳ καὶ αἱ χῆραί σου ἐπληθύνθησαν ἐν μέσῳ σου

text_en: Her priests have despised my law , and have defiled my sanctuaries: they have put no difference between holy and profane : nor have distinguished between the polluted and the clean: and they have turned away their eyes from my sabbaths , and I was profaned in the midst of them.
text_la: Sacerdotes ejus contempserunt legem meam, et polluerunt sanctuaria mea : inter sanctum et profanum non habuerunt distantiam, et inter pollutum et mundum non intellexerunt : et a sabbatis meis averterunt oculos suos, et coinquinabar in medio eorum.
text_pt: Os seus sacerdotes violentam a minha lei, e profanam as minhas coisas santas; não fazem diferença entre o santo e o profano, nem discernem o impuro do puro; e de meus sábados escondem os seus olhos, e assim sou profanado no meio deles.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς ἠθέτησαν νόμον μου καὶ ἐβεβήλουν τὰ ἅγιά μου ἀνὰ μέσον ἁγίου καὶ βεβήλου οὐ διέστελλον καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον ἀκαθάρτου καὶ τοῦ καθαροῦ οὐ διέστελλον καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν σαββάτων μου παρεκάλυπτον τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβεβηλούμην ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: Her princes in the midst of her, are like wolves ravening the prey to shed blood, and to destroy souls , and to run after gains through covetousness .
text_la: Principes ejus in medio illius quasi lupi rapientes prædam ad effundendum sanguinem, et ad perdendas animas, et avare ad sectanda lucra.
text_pt: Os seus príncipes no meio dela são como lobos que arrebatam a presa, para derramarem sangue, para destruírem as almas, para seguirem a avareza.
text_el: οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῆς ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ὡς λύκοι ἁρπάζοντες ἁρπάγματα τοῦ ἐκχέαι αἷμα ὅπως πλεονεξίᾳ πλεονεκτῶσιν

text_en: And her prophets have daubed them without tempering the mortar, seeing vain things, and divining lies unto them, saying: Thus says the Lord God : when the Lord has not spoken.
text_la: Prophetæ autem ejus liniebant eos absque temperamento, videntes vana, et divinantes eis mendacium, dicentes : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : cum Dominus non sit locutus.
text_pt: E os seus profetas têm feito para eles cobertura com argamassa não temperada, profetizando vaidade, adivinhando-lhes mentira, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS; sem que o SENHOR tivesse falado.
text_el: καὶ οἱ προφῆται αὐτῆς ἀλείφοντες αὐτοὺς πεσοῦνται ὁρῶντες μάταια μαντευόμενοι ψευδῆ λέγοντες τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ κύριος οὐ λελάληκεν

text_en: The people of the land have used oppression, and committed robbery : they afflicted the needy and poor , and they oppressed the stranger by calumny without judgment.
text_la: Populi terræ calumniabantur calumniam, et rapiebant violenter : egenum et pauperem affligebant, et advenam opprimebant calumnia absque judicio.
text_pt: Ao povo da terra oprimem gravemente, e andam roubando, e fazendo violência ao pobre e necessitado, e ao estrangeiro oprimem sem razão.
text_el: λαὸν τῆς γῆς ἐκπιεζοῦντες ἀδικίᾳ καὶ διαρπάζοντες ἁρπάγματα πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα καταδυναστεύοντες καὶ πρὸς τὸν προσήλυτον οὐκ ἀναστρεφόμενοι μετὰ κρίματος

text_en: And I sought among them for a man that might set up a hedge, and stand in the gap before me in favour of the land, that I might not destroy it: and I found none.
text_la: Et quæsivi de eis virum qui interponeret sepem, et staret oppositus contra me pro terra, ne dissiparem eam : et non inveni.
text_pt: E busquei dentre eles um homem que estivesse tapando o muro, e estivesse na brecha perante mim por esta terra, para que eu não a destruísse; porém a ninguém achei.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτουν ἐξ αὐτῶν ἄνδρα ἀναστρεφόμενον ὀρθῶς καὶ ἑστῶτα πρὸ προσώπου μου ὁλοσχερῶς ἐν καιρῷ τῆς γῆς τοῦ μὴ εἰς τέλος ἐξαλεῖψαι αὐτήν καὶ οὐχ εὗρον

text_en: And I poured out my indignation upon them, in the fire of my wrath I consumed them: I have rendered their way upon their own head, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et effudi super eos indignationem meam; in igne iræ meæ consumpsi eos : viam eorum in caput eorum reddidi, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Por isso eu derramei sobre eles a minha indignação; com o fogo do meu furor os consumi; fiz que o seu caminho recaísse sobre a sua cabeça, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέχεα ἐπ' αὐτὴν θυμόν μου ἐν πυρὶ ὀργῆς μου τοῦ συντελέσαι τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν εἰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν δέδωκα λέγει κύριος κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Veio mais a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , there were two women , daughters of one mother.
text_la: Fili hominis, duæ mulieres filiæ matris unius fuerunt :
text_pt: Filho do homem, houve duas mulheres, filhas de uma mesma mãe.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου δύο γυναῖκες ἦσαν θυγατέρες μητρὸς μιᾶς

text_en: And they committed fornication in Egypt , in their youth they committed fornication: there were their breasts pressed down, and the teats of their virginity were bruised.
text_la: et fornicatæ sunt in Ægypto, in adolescentia sua fornicatæ sunt : ibi subacta sunt ubera earum, et fractæ sunt mammæ pubertatis earum.
text_pt: Estas se prostituíram no Egito; prostituíram-se na sua mocidade; ali foram apertados os seus seios, e ali foram apalpados os seios da sua virgindade.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσαν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἐν τῇ νεότητι αὐτῶν ἐκεῖ ἔπεσον οἱ μαστοὶ αὐτῶν ἐκεῖ διεπαρθενεύθησαν

text_en: And their names were Oolla the elder, and Ooliba her younger sister: and I took them, and they bore sons and daughters. Now for their names , Samaria is Oolla, and Jerusalem is Ooliba.
text_la: Nomina autem earum, Oolla major, et Ooliba soror ejus minor : et habui eas, et pepererunt filios et filias. Porro earum nomina, Samaria Oolla, et Jerusalem Ooliba.
text_pt: E os seus nomes eram: Aolá, a mais velha, e Aolibá, sua irmã; e foram minhas, e tiveram filhos e filhas; e, quanto aos seus nomes, Samaria é Aolá, e Jerusalém é Aolibá.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν ἦν Οολα ἡ πρεσβυτέρα καὶ Οολιβα ἡ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐγένοντό μοι καὶ ἔτεκον υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν Σαμάρεια ἡ Οολα καὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἡ Οολιβα

text_en: And Oolla committed fornication against me, and doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians that came to her,
text_la: Fornicata est igitur super me Oolla, et insanivit in amatores suos, in Assyrios propinquantes,
text_pt: E prostituiu-se Aolá, sendo minha; e enamorou-se dos seus amantes, dos assírios, seus vizinhos,
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπόρνευσεν ἡ Οολα ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐπέθετο ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐραστὰς αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τοὺς Ἀσσυρίους τοὺς ἐγγίζοντας αὐτῇ

text_en: who were clothed with blue, princes, and rulers, beautiful youths, all horsemen, mounted upon horses.
text_la: vestitos hyacintho, principes et magistratus, juvenes cupidinis, universos equites, ascensores equorum.
text_pt: Vestidos de azul, capitàes e magistrados, todos jovens cobiçáveis, cavaleiros montados a cavalo.
text_el: ἐνδεδυκότας ὑακίνθινα ἡγουμένους καὶ στρατηγούς νεανίσκοι ἐπίλεκτοι πάντες ἱππεῖς ἱππαζόμενοι ἐφ' ἵππων

text_en: And she committed her fornications with those chosen men , all sons of the Assyrians : and she defiled herself with the uncleanness of all them on whom she doted.
text_la: Et dedit fornicationes suas super eos electos, filios Assyriorum universos : et in omnibus in quos insanivit, in immunditiis eorum polluta est.
text_pt: Assim cometeu ela as suas devassidões com eles, que eram todos a flor dos filhos da Assíria, e com todos os de quem se enamorava; com todos os seus ídolos se contaminou.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν τὴν πορνείαν αὐτῆς ἐπ' αὐτούς ἐπίλεκτοι υἱοὶ Ἀσσυρίων πάντες καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας οὓς ἐπέθετο ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἐνθυμήμασιν αὐτῆς ἐμιαίνετο

text_en: Moreover also she did not forsake her fornications which she had committed in Egypt : for they also lay with her in her youth, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity , and poured out their fornication upon her.
text_la: Insuper et fornicationes suas, quas habuerat in Ægypto, non reliquit : nam et illi dormierunt cum ea in adolescentia ejus, et illi confregerunt ubera pubertatis ejus, et effuderunt fornicationem suam super eam.
text_pt: E as suas prostituições, que trouxe do Egito, não as deixou; porque com ela se deitaram na sua mocidade, e eles apalparam os seios da sua virgindade, e derramaram sobre ela a sua impudicícia.
text_el: καὶ τὴν πορνείαν αὐτῆς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπεν ὅτι μετ' αὐτῆς ἐκοιμῶντο ἐν νεότητι αὐτῆς καὶ αὐτοὶ διεπαρθένευσαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐξέχεαν τὴν πορνείαν αὐτῶν ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: Therefore have I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the sons of the Assyrians , upon whose lust she doted.
text_la: Propterea tradidi eam in manus amatorum suorum, in manus filiorum Assur, super quorum insanivit libidine.
text_pt: Portanto a entreguei na mão dos seus amantes, na mão dos filhos da Assíria, de quem se enamorara.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο παρέδωκα αὐτὴν εἰς χεῖρας τῶν ἐραστῶν αὐτῆς εἰς χεῖρας υἱῶν Ἀσσυρίων ἐφ' οὓς ἐπετίθετο

text_en: They discovered her disgrace, took away her sons and daughters, and slew her with the sword: and they became infamous women , and they executed judgments in her.
text_la: Ipsi discooperuerunt ignominiam ejus, filios et filias ejus tulerunt, et ipsam occiderunt gladio : et factæ sunt famosæ mulieres, et judicia perpetraverunt in ea.
text_pt: Estes descobriram a sua vergonha, levaram seus filhos e suas filhas, mas a ela mataram à espada; e tornou-se falada entre as mulheres, e sobre ela executaram os juízos.
text_el: αὐτοὶ ἀπεκάλυψαν τὴν αἰσχύνην αὐτῆς υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας αὐτῆς ἔλαβον καὶ αὐτὴν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ ἀπέκτειναν καὶ ἐγένετο λάλημα εἰς γυναῖκας καὶ ἐποίησαν ἐκδικήσεις ἐν αὐτῇ εἰς τὰς θυγατέρας

text_en: And when her sister Ooliba saw this, she was mad with lust more than she: and she carried her fornication beyond the fornication of her sister.
text_la: Quod cum vidisset soror ejus Ooliba, plus quam illa insanivit libidine, et fornicationem suam super fornicationem sororis suæ :
text_pt: Vendo isto sua irmã Aolibá, corrompeu o seu imoderado amor mais do que ela, e as suas devassidões foram mais do que as de sua irmã.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ἡ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῆς Οολιβα καὶ διέφθειρε τὴν ἐπίθεσιν αὐτῆς ὑπὲρ αὐτὴν καὶ τὴν πορνείαν αὐτῆς ὑπὲρ τὴν πορνείαν τῆς ἀδελφῆς αὐτῆς

text_en: Impudently prostituting herself to the children of the Assyrians , the princes, and rulers that came to her, clothed with divers colours, to the horsemen that rode upon horses, and to young men all of great beauty.
text_la: ad filios Assyriorum præbuit impudenter, ducibus et magistratibus ad se venientibus, indutis veste varia, equitibus qui vectabantur equis, et adolescentibus forma cunctis egregia.
text_pt: Enamorou-se dos filhos da Assíria, dos capitàes e dos magistrados seus vizinhos, vestidos com primor, cavaleiros que andam montados em cavalos, todos jovens cobiçáveis.
text_el: ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν Ἀσσυρίων ἐπέθετο ἡγουμένους καὶ στρατηγοὺς τοὺς ἐγγὺς αὐτῆς ἐνδεδυκότας εὐπάρυφα ἱππεῖς ἱππαζομένους ἐφ' ἵππων νεανίσκοι ἐπίλεκτοι πάντες

text_en: And I saw that she was defiled, and that they both took one way.
text_la: Et vidi quod polluta esset via una ambarum.
text_pt: E vi que se tinha contaminado; o caminho de ambas era o mesmo.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ὅτι μεμίανται ὁδὸς μία τῶν δύο

text_en: And she increased her fornications: and when she had seen men painted on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans set forth in colours,
text_la: Et auxit fornicationes suas : cumque vidisset viros depictos in pariete, imagines Chaldæorum expressas coloribus,
text_pt: E aumentou as suas impudicícias, porque viu homens pintados na parede, imagens dos caldeus, pintadas de vermelho;
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο πρὸς τὴν πορνείαν αὐτῆς καὶ εἶδεν ἄνδρας ἐζωγραφημένους ἐπὶ τοῦ τοίχου εἰκόνας Χαλδαίων ἐζωγραφημένους ἐν γραφίδι

text_en: and girded with girdles about their reins, and with dyed turbans on their heads, the resemblance of all the captains , the likeness of the sons of Babylon , and of the land of the Chaldeans wherein they were born,
text_la: et accinctos balteis renes, et tiaras tinctas in capitibus eorum, formam ducum omnium, similitudinem filiorum Babylonis, terræque Chaldæorum, in qua orti sunt,
text_pt: Cingidos de cinto nos seus lombos, e tiaras largas e tingidas nas suas cabeças, todos com parecer de príncipes, semelhantes aos filhos de babilônia em Caldéia, terra do seu nascimento.
text_el: ἐζωσμένους ποικίλματα ἐπὶ τὰς ὀσφύας αὐτῶν καὶ τιάραι βαπταὶ ἐπὶ τῶν κεφαλῶν αὐτῶν ὄψις τρισσὴ πάντων ὁμοίωμα υἱῶν Χαλδαίων γῆς πατρίδος αὐτῶν

text_en: she doted upon them with the lust of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them into Chaldea .
text_la: insanivit super eos concupiscentia oculorum suorum, et misit nuntios ad eos in Chaldæam.
text_pt: E enamorou-se deles, ao lançar sobre eles os seus olhos; e lhes mandou mensageiros à Caldéia.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθετο ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τῇ ὁράσει ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἰς γῆν Χαλδαίων

text_en: And when the sons of Babylon had come to her to the bed of love , they defiled her with their fornications, and she was polluted by them, and her soul was glutted with them.
text_la: Cumque venissent ad eam filii Babylonis ad cubile mammarum, polluerunt eam stupris suis : et polluta est ab eis, et saturata est anima ejus ab illis.
text_pt: Então vieram a ela os filhos de babilônia para o leito dos amores, e a contaminaram com as suas impudicícias; e ela se contaminou com eles; então a sua alma apartou-se deles.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν πρὸς αὐτὴν υἱοὶ Βαβυλῶνος εἰς κοίτην καταλυόντων καὶ ἐμίαινον αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐμιάνθη ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀπέστη ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῆς ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And she discovered her fornications, and discovered her disgrace: and my soul was alienated from her, as my soul was alienated from her sister.
text_la: Denudavit quoque fornicationes suas, et discooperuit ignominiam suam : et recessit anima mea ab ea, sicut recesserat anima mea a sorore ejus :
text_pt: Assim pôs a descoberto as suas devassidões, e descobriu a sua vergonha; então a minha alma se apartou dela, como já tinha se apartado a minha alma de sua irmã.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκάλυψεν τὴν πορνείαν αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπεκάλυψεν τὴν αἰσχύνην αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπέστη ἡ ψυχή μου ἀπ' αὐτῆς ὃν τρόπον ἀπέστη ἡ ψυχή μου ἀπὸ τῆς ἀδελφῆς αὐτῆς

text_en: For she multiplied her fornications, remembering the days of her youth, in which she played the harlot in the land of Egypt .
text_la: multiplicavit enim fornicationes suas, recordans dies adolescentiæ suæ, quibus fornicata est in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Todavia ela multiplicou as suas prostituições, lembrando-se dos dias da sua mocidade, em que se prostituíra na terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλήθυνας τὴν πορνείαν σου τοῦ ἀναμνῆσαι ἡμέρας νεότητός σου ἐν αἷς ἐπόρνευσας ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And she was mad with lust after lying with them whose flesh is as the flesh of asses: and whose issue as the issue of horses.
text_la: Et insanivit libidine super concubitum eorum, quorum carnes sunt ut carnes asinorum, et sicut fluxus equorum fluxus eorum.
text_pt: E enamorou-se dos seus amantes, cuja carne é como a de jumentos, e cujo fluxo é como o de cavalos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθου ἐπὶ τοὺς Χαλδαίους ὧν ἦσαν ὡς ὄνων αἱ σάρκες αὐτῶν καὶ αἰδοῖα ἵππων τὰ αἰδοῖα αὐτῶν

text_en: And you have renewed the wickedness of your youth, when your breasts were pressed in Egypt , and the paps of your virginity broken.
text_la: Et visitasti scelus adolescentiæ tuæ, quando subacta sunt in Ægypto ubera tua, et confractæ sunt mammæ pubertatis tuæ.
text_pt: Assim trouxeste à memória a perversidade da tua mocidade, quando os do Egito apalpavam os teus seios, por causa dos peitos da tua mocidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεσκέψω τὴν ἀνομίαν νεότητός σου ἃ ἐποίεις ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἐν τῷ καταλύματί σου οὗ οἱ μαστοὶ νεότητός σου

text_en: Therefore, Ooliba, thus says the Lord God : Behold I will raise up against you all your lovers with whom your soul has been glutted: and I will gather them together against you round about.
text_la: Propterea, Ooliba, hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego suscitabo omnes amatores tuos contra te, de quibus satiata est anima tua, et congregabo eos adversum te in circuitu :
text_pt: Por isso, ó Aolibá, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu suscitarei contra ti os teus amantes, dos quais se tinha apartado a tua alma, e os trarei contra ti de toda a parte em derredor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο Οολιβα τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξεγείρω τοὺς ἐραστάς σου ἐπὶ σέ ἀφ' ὧν ἀπέστη ἡ ψυχή σου ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπάξω αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ σὲ κυκλόθεν

text_en: The children of Babylon , and all the Chaldeans , the nobles, and the kings, and princes, all the sons of the Assyrians , beautiful young men, all the captains , and rulers, the princes of princes, and the renowned horsemen.
text_la: filios Babylonis, et universos Chaldæos, nobiles, tyrannosque, et principes, omnes filios Assyriorum, juvenes forma egregia, duces et magistratus universos, principes principum, et nominatos ascensores equorum :
text_pt: Os filhos de Babilônia, e todos os caldeus de Pecode, e de Soa, e de Coa, e todos os filhos da Assíria com eles, jovens cobiçáveis, capitàes e magistrados todos eles, grandes e afamados senhores, todos eles montados a cavalo.
text_el: υἱοὺς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ πάντας τοὺς Χαλδαίους Φακουδ καὶ Σουε καὶ Κουε καὶ πάντας υἱοὺς Ἀσσυρίων μετ' αὐτῶν νεανίσκους ἐπιλέκτους ἡγεμόνας καὶ στρατηγοὺς πάντας τρισσοὺς καὶ ὀνομαστοὺς ἱππεύοντας ἐφ' ἵππων

text_en: And they shall come upon you well appointed with chariot and wheel, a multitude of people: they shall be armed against you on every side with breastplate, and buckler, and helmet: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge you by their judgments.
text_la: et venient super te instructi curru et rota, multitudo populorum : lorica, et clypeo, et galea armabuntur contra te undique : et dabo coram eis judicium, et judicabunt te judiciis suis.
text_pt: E virão contra ti com carros, carretas e rodas, e com multidão de povos; e se colocarão contra ti em redor com paveses, e escudos e capacetes; e porei diante deles o juízo, e julgar-te-ão segundo os seus juízos.
text_el: καὶ πάντες ἥξουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἅρματα καὶ τροχοὶ μετ' ὄχλου λαῶν θυρεοὶ καὶ πέλται καὶ βαλοῦσιν φυλακὴν ἐπὶ σὲ κύκλῳ καὶ δώσω πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν κρίμα καὶ ἐκδικήσουσίν σε ἐν τοῖς κρίμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will set my jealousy against you, which they shall execute upon you with fury : they shall cut off your nose and your ears: and what remains shall fall by the sword: they shall take your sons, and your daughters, and your residue shall be devoured by fire.
text_la: Et ponam zelum meum in te, quem exercent tecum in furore : nasum tuum et aures tuas præcident, et quæ remanserint, gladio concident. Ipsi filios tuos et filias tuas capient, et novissimum tuum devorabitur igni :
text_pt: E porei contra ti o meu zelo, e usarão de indignação contigo. Tirar-te-ão o nariz e as orelhas, e o que restar cairá à espada. Eles tomarão teus filhos e tuas filhas, e o que ficar por último em ti será consumido pelo fogo.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὸν ζῆλόν μου ἐν σοί καὶ ποιήσουσιν μετὰ σοῦ ἐν ὀργῇ θυμοῦ μυκτῆρά σου καὶ ὦτά σου ἀφελοῦσιν καὶ τοὺς καταλοίπους σου ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καταβαλοῦσιν αὐτοὶ υἱούς σου καὶ θυγατέρας σου λήμψονται καὶ τοὺς καταλοίπους σου πῦρ καταφάγεται

text_en: And they shall strip you of your garments, and take away the instruments of your glory .
text_la: et denudabunt te vestimentis tuis, et tollent vasa gloriæ tuæ.
text_pt: Também te despirão as tuas vestes, e te tomarão as tuas belas jóias.
text_el: καὶ ἐκδύσουσίν σε τὸν ἱματισμόν σου καὶ λήμψονται τὰ σκεύη τῆς καυχήσεώς σου

text_en: And I will put an end to your wickedness in you, and your fornication brought out of the land of Egypt : neither shall you lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.
text_la: Et requiescere faciam scelus tuum de te, et fornicationem tuam de terra Ægypti : nec levabis oculos tuos ad eos, et Ægypti non recordaberis amplius.
text_pt: Assim farei cessar em ti a tua perversidade e a tua prostituição trazida da terra do Egito; e não levantarás os teus olhos para eles, nem te lembrarás nunca mais do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὰς ἀσεβείας σου ἐκ σοῦ καὶ τὴν πορνείαν σου ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ οὐ μὴ ἄρῃς τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ Αἰγύπτου οὐ μὴ μνησθῇς οὐκέτι

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will deliver you into the hands of them whom you hate , into their hands with whom your soul has been glutted.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego tradam te in manus eorum quos odisti, in manus de quibus satiata est anima tua.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu te entregarei na mão dos que odeias, na mão daqueles de quem tem se apartado a tua alma.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραδίδωμί σε εἰς χεῖρας ὧν μισεῖς ἀφ' ὧν ἀπέστη ἡ ψυχή σου ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall deal with you in hatred , and they shall take away all your labours, and shall let you go naked, and full of disgrace, and the disgrace of your fornication shall be discovered, your wickedness , and your fornications.
text_la: Et agent tecum in odio, et tollent omnes labores tuos, et dimittent te nudam et ignominia plenam : et revelabitur ignominia fornicationum tuarum, scelus tuum, et fornicationes tuæ.
text_pt: E eles te tratarão com ódio, e levarão todo o fruto do teu trabalho, e te deixarão nua e despida; e descobrir-se-á a vergonha da tua prostituição, e a tua perversidade, e as tuas devassidões.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσουσιν ἐν σοὶ ἐν μίσει καὶ λήμψονται πάντας τοὺς πόνους σου καὶ τοὺς μόχθους σου καὶ ἔσῃ γυμνὴ καὶ ἀσχημονοῦσα καὶ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται αἰσχύνη πορνείας σου καὶ ἀσέβειά σου καὶ ἡ πορνεία σου

text_en: They have done these things to you, because you have played the harlot with the nations among which you were defiled with their idols .
text_la: Fecerunt hæc tibi, quia fornicata es post gentes inter quas polluta es in idolis earum.
text_pt: Estas coisas se te farão, porque te prostituíste após os gentios, e te contaminaste com os seus ídolos.
text_el: ἐποίησεν ταῦτά σοι ἐν τῷ ἐκπορνεῦσαί σε ὀπίσω ἐθνῶν καὶ ἐμιαίνου ἐν τοῖς ἐνθυμήμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: You have walked in the way of your sister and I will give her cup into your hand.
text_la: In via sororis tuæ ambulasti, et dabo calicem ejus in manu tua.
text_pt: No caminho de tua irmã andaste; por isso entregarei o seu cálice na tua mão.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τῆς ἀδελφῆς σου ἐπορεύθης καὶ δώσω τὸ ποτήριον αὐτῆς εἰς χεῖράς σου

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : You shall drink your sister's cup, deep and wide: you shall be had in derision and scorn, which contains very much.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Calicem sororis tuæ bibes profundum et latum : eris in derisum et in subsannationem quæ est capacissima.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Beberás o cálice de tua irmã, fundo e largo; servirás de riso e escárnio; pois nele cabe muito.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος τὸ ποτήριον τῆς ἀδελφῆς σου πίεσαι τὸ βαθὺ καὶ τὸ πλατὺ τὸ πλεονάζον τοῦ συντελέσαι

text_en: You shall be filled with drunkenness , and sorrow: with the cup of grief and sadness, with the cup of your sister Samaria .
text_la: Ebrietate et dolore repleberis : calice mœroris et tristitiæ, calice sororis tuæ Samariæ.
text_pt: De embriaguez e de dor te encherás; o cálice de tua irmã Samaria é cálice de espanto e de assolação.
text_el: μέθην καὶ ἐκλύσεως πλησθήσῃ καὶ τὸ ποτήριον ἀφανισμοῦ ποτήριον ἀδελφῆς σου Σαμαρείας

text_en: And you shall drink it, and shall drink it up even to the dregs, and you shall devour the fragments thereof, you shall rend your breasts: because I have spoken it, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et bibes illum, et epotabis usque ad fæces : et fragmenta ejus devorabis, et ubera tua lacerabis, quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Bebê-lo-ás, pois, e esgotá-lo-ás, e os seus cacos roerás, e os teus seios arrancarás; porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ πίεσαι αὐτό καὶ τὰς ἑορτὰς καὶ τὰς νεομηνίας αὐτῆς ἀποστρέψω διότι ἐγὼ λελάληκα λέγει κύριος

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have forgotten me, and have cast me off behind your back, bear also your wickedness , and your fornications.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia oblita es mei, et projecisti me post corpus tuum, tu quoque porta scelus tuum et fornicationes tuas.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Como te esqueceste de mim, e me lançaste para trás das tuas costas, também carregarás com a tua perversidade e as tuas devassidões.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐπελάθου μου καὶ ἀπέρριψάς με ὀπίσω τοῦ σώματός σου καὶ σὺ λαβὲ τὴν ἀσέβειάν σου καὶ τὴν πορνείαν σου

text_en: And the Lord spoke to me, saying: Son of man , do you judge Oolla, and Ooliba, and do you declare to them their wicked deeds ?
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad me, dicens : Fili hominis, numquid judicas Oollam et Oolibam, et annuntias eis scelera earum?
text_pt: Disse-me ainda o Senhor: Filho do homem, porventura julgarás tu a Aolá e a Aolibá? Mostra-lhes, pois, as suas abominações.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου οὐ κρινεῖς τὴν Οολαν καὶ τὴν Οολιβαν καὶ ἀπαγγελεῖς αὐταῖς τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῶν

text_en: Because they have committed adultery , and blood is in their hands, and they have committed fornication with their idols : moreover also their children, whom they bore to me, they have offered to them to be devoured.
text_la: Quia adulteratæ sunt, et sanguis in manibus earum, et cum idolis suis fornicatæ sunt : insuper et filios suos quos genuerunt mihi, obtulerunt eis ad devorandum.
text_pt: Porque adulteraram, e sangue se acha nas suas mãos, e com os seus ídolos adulteraram, e até os seus filhos, que de mim geraram, fizeram passar pelo fogo, para os consumir.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμοιχῶντο καὶ αἷμα ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν τὰ ἐνθυμήματα αὐτῶν ἐμοιχῶντο καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἃ ἐγέννησάν μοι διήγαγον αὐτοῖς δι' ἐμπύρων

text_en: Yea, and they have done this to me. They polluted my sanctuary on the same day, and profaned my sabbaths .
text_la: Sed et hoc fecerunt mihi : polluerunt sanctuarium meum in die illa, et sabbata mea profanaverunt.
text_pt: E ainda isto me fizeram: contaminaram o meu santuário no mesmo dia, e profanaram os meus sábados.
text_el: ἕως καὶ ταῦτα ἐποίησάν μοι τὰ ἅγιά μου ἐμίαινον καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἐβεβήλουν

text_en: And when they sacrificed their children to their idols , and went into my sanctuary the same day to profane it: they did these things even in the midst of my house.
text_la: Cumque immolarent filios suos idolis suis, et ingrederentur sanctuarium meum in die illa ut polluerent illud, etiam hæc fecerunt in medio domus meæ.
text_pt: Porquanto, havendo sacrificado seus filhos aos seus ídolos, vinham ao meu santuário no mesmo dia para o profanarem; e eis que assim fizeram no meio da minha casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ σφάζειν αὐτοὺς τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν καὶ εἰσεπορεύοντο εἰς τὰ ἅγιά μου τοῦ βεβηλοῦν αὐτά καὶ ὅτι οὕτως ἐποίουν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου μου

text_en: They sent for men coming from afar, to whom they had sent a messenger: and behold they came: for whom you washed yourself, and painted your eyes, and were adorned with women's ornaments.
text_la: Miserunt ad viros venientes de longe, ad quos nuntium miserant : itaque ecce venerunt quibus te lavisti, et circumlinisti stibio oculos tuos, et ornata es mundo muliebri.
text_pt: E, mais ainda, mandaram vir alguns homens, de longe, aos quais fora enviado um mensageiro, e eis que vieram. Por amor deles te lavaste, coloriste os teus olhos, e te ornaste de enfeites.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τοῖς ἐρχομένοις μακρόθεν οἷς ἀγγέλους ἐξαπεστέλλοσαν πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ ἅμα τῷ ἔρχεσθαι αὐτοὺς εὐθὺς ἐλούου καὶ ἐστιβίζου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου καὶ ἐκόσμου κόσμῳ

text_en: You sat on a very fine bed, and a table was decked before you: whereupon you set my incense , and my ointment .
text_la: Sedisti in lecto pulcherrimo, et mensa ornata est ante te : thymiama meum et unguentum meum posuisti super eam.
text_pt: E te assentaste sobre um leito de honra, diante do qual estava uma mesa preparada; e puseste sobre ela o meu incenso e o meu azeite.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθου ἐπὶ κλίνης ἐστρωμένης καὶ τράπεζα κεκοσμημένη πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ θυμίαμά μου καὶ τὸ ἔλαιόν μου εὐφραίνοντο ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And there was in her the voice of a multitude rejoicing: and to some that were brought of the multitude of men , and that came from the desert , they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.
text_la: Et vox multitudinis exsultantis erat in ea : et in viris, qui de multitudine hominum adducebantur, et veniebant de deserto, posuerunt armillas in manibus eorum, et coronas speciosas in capitibus eorum.
text_pt: Com ela se ouvia a voz de uma multidão satisfeita; com homens de classe baixa foram trazidos beberrões do deserto; e puseram braceletes nas mãos das mulheres e coroas de esplendor nas suas cabeças.
text_el: καὶ φωνὴν ἁρμονίας ἀνεκρούοντο καὶ πρὸς ἄνδρας ἐκ πλήθους ἀνθρώπων ἥκοντας ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ ἐδίδοσαν ψέλια ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ στέφανον καυχήσεως ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And I said to her that was worn out in her adulteries : Now will this woman still continue in her fornication.
text_la: Et dixi ei, quæ attrita est in adulteriis : Nunc fornicabitur in fornicatione sua etiam hæc.
text_pt: Então disse à envelhecida em adultérios: Agora deveras se prostituirão com ela, e ela com eles?
text_el: καὶ εἶπα οὐκ ἐν τούτοις μοιχεύουσιν καὶ ἔργα πόρνης καὶ αὐτὴ ἐξεπόρνευσεν

text_en: And they went in to her, as to a harlot: so went they in unto Oolla, and Ooliba, wicked women .
text_la: Et ingressi sunt ad eam quasi ad mulierem meretricem : sic ingrediebantur ad Oollam et Oolibam, mulieres nefarias.
text_pt: E entraram a ela, como quem entra a uma prostituta; assim entraram a Aolá e a Aolibá, mulheres infames.
text_el: καὶ εἰσεπορεύοντο πρὸς αὐτήν ὃν τρόπον εἰσπορεύονται πρὸς γυναῖκα πόρνην οὕτως εἰσεπορεύοντο πρὸς Οολαν καὶ πρὸς Οολιβαν τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἀνομίαν

text_en: They therefore are just men : these shall judge them as adulteresses are judged, and as shedders of blood are judged: because they are adulteresses , and blood is in their hands.
text_la: Viri ergo justi sunt : hi judicabunt eas judicio adulterarum, et judicio effundentium sanguinem : quia adulteræ sunt, et sanguis in manibus earum.
text_pt: De maneira que homens justos as julgarão como se julgam as adúlteras, e como se julgam as que derramam sangue; porque são adúlteras, e sangue há nas suas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἄνδρες δίκαιοι αὐτοὶ ἐκδικήσουσιν αὐτὰς ἐκδικήσει μοιχαλίδος καὶ ἐκδικήσει αἵματος ὅτι μοιχαλίδες εἰσίν καὶ αἷμα ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : Bring a multitude upon them, and deliver them over to tumult and rapine:
text_la: Hæc enim dicit Dominus Deus : Adduc ad eas multitudinem, et trade eas in tumultum et in rapinam.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei subir contra elas uma multidão, e as entregarei ao desterro e ao saque.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἀνάγαγε ἐπ' αὐτὰς ὄχλον καὶ δὸς ἐν αὐταῖς ταραχὴν καὶ διαρπαγὴν

text_en: And let the people stone them with stones, and let them be stabbed with their swords: they shall kill their sons and daughters, and their houses they shall burn with fire.
text_la: Et lapidentur lapidibus populorum, et confodiantur gladiis eorum : filios et filias earum interficient, et domos earum igne succendent.
text_pt: E a multidão as apedrejará, e as golpeará com as suas espadas; eles a seus filhos e a suas filhas matarão, e as suas casas queimarão a fogo.
text_el: καὶ λιθοβόλησον ἐπ' αὐτὰς λίθοις ὄχλων καὶ κατακέντει αὐτὰς ἐν τοῖς ξίφεσιν αὐτῶν υἱοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ θυγατέρας αὐτῶν ἀποκτενοῦσι καὶ τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν ἐμπρήσουσιν

text_en: And I will take away wickedness out of the land: and all women shall learn, not to do according to the wickedness of them.
text_la: Et auferam scelus de terra, et discent omnes mulieres ne faciant secundum scelus earum.
text_pt: Assim farei cessar a perversidade da terra, para que se escarmentem todas as mulheres, e não façam conforme a vossa perversidade;
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω ἀσέβειαν ἐκ τῆς γῆς καὶ παιδευθήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ γυναῖκες καὶ οὐ μὴ ποιήσουσιν κατὰ τὰς ἀσεβείας αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall render your wickedness upon you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols : and you shall know that I am the Lord God .
text_la: Et dabunt scelus vestrum super vos, et peccata idolorum vestrorum portabitis : et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus.
text_pt: O castigo da vossa perversidade eles farão recair sobre vós, e levareis os pecados dos vossos ídolos; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ δοθήσεται ἡ ἀσέβεια ὑμῶν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ τὰς ἁμαρτίας τῶν ἐνθυμημάτων ὑμῶν λήμψεσθε καὶ γνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, the tenth day of the month, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me in anno nono, in mense decimo, decima die mensis, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, no nono ano, no décimo mês, aos dez do mês, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ἐνάτῳ ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δεκάτῳ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς λέγων

text_en: Son of man , write you the name of this day, on which the king of Babylon has set himself against Jerusalem to day.
text_la: Fili hominis, scribe tibi nomen diei hujus, in qua confirmatus est rex Babylonis adversum Jerusalem hodie.
text_pt: Filho do homem, escreve o nome deste dia, deste mesmo dia; porque o rei de babilônia se pôs contra Jerusalém neste mesmo dia.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου γράψον σεαυτῷ εἰς ἡμέραν ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ἀφ' ἧς ἀπηρείσατο βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς σήμερον

text_en: And you shall speak by a figure a parable to the provoking house, and say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Set on a pot, set it on, I say, and put water in it.
text_la: Et dices per proverbium ad domum irritatricem parabolam, et loqueris ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pone ollam; pone, inquam, et mitte in eam aquam.
text_pt: E fala por parábola à casa rebelde, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Põe a panela ao lume, põe-na, e deita-lhe também água dentro.
text_el: καὶ εἰπὸν ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τὸν παραπικραίνοντα παραβολὴν καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπίστησον τὸν λέβητα καὶ ἔκχεον εἰς αὐτὸν ὕδωρ

text_en: Heap together into it the pieces thereof, every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder, choice pieces and full of bones.
text_la: Congere frusta ejus in eam, omnem partem bonam, femur et armum, electa et ossibus plena.
text_pt: Ajunta nela pedaços, todos os bons pedaços, as coxas e as espáduas; enche-a de ossos escolhidos.
text_el: καὶ ἔμβαλε εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ διχοτομήματα πᾶν διχοτόμημα καλόν σκέλος καὶ ὦμον ἐκσεσαρκισμένα ἀπὸ τῶν ὀστῶν

text_en: Take the fattest of the flock, and lay together piles of bones under it: the seething thereof is boiling hot, and the bones thereof are thoroughly sodden in the midst of it.
text_la: Pinguissimum pecus assume, compone quoque strues ossium sub ea : efferbuit coctio ejus, et discocta sunt ossa illius in medio ejus.
text_pt: Escolhe o melhor do rebanho, e queima também os ossos debaixo dela; faze-a ferver bem, e cozam-se dentro dela os seus ossos.
text_el: ἐξ ἐπιλέκτων κτηνῶν εἰλημμένων καὶ ὑπόκαιε τὰ ὀστᾶ ὑποκάτω αὐτῶν ἔζεσεν ἔζεσεν καὶ ἥψηται τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτῆς ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose rust is in it, and its rust is not gone out of it: cast it out piece by piece, there has no lot fallen upon it.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Væ civitati sanguinum, ollæ cujus rubigo in ea est, et rubigo ejus non exivit de ea! per partes et per partes suas ejice eam : non cecidit super eam sors.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai da cidade sanguinária, da panela que escuma por dentro, e cuja escuma não saiu dela! Tira dela pedaço por pedaço; não caia sorte sobre ela;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ὦ πόλις αἱμάτων λέβης ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἰὸς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ὁ ἰὸς οὐκ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτῆς κατὰ μέλος αὐτῆς ἐξήνεγκεν οὐκ ἔπεσεν ἐπ' αὐτὴν κλῆρος

text_en: For her blood is in the midst of her, she has shed it upon the smooth rock: she has not shed it upon the ground, that it might be covered with dust.
text_la: Sanguis enim ejus in medio ejus est; super limpidissimam petram effudit illum : non effudit illum super terram, ut possit operiri pulvere.
text_pt: Porque o seu sangue está no meio dela, sobre uma penha descalvada o pôs; não o derramou sobre a terra, para o cobrir com pó.
text_el: ὅτι αἷμα αὐτῆς ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐστιν ἐπὶ λεωπετρίαν τέταχα αὐτό οὐκ ἐκκέχυκα αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ καλύψαι ἐπ' αὐτὸ γῆν

text_en: And that I might bring my indignation upon her, and take my vengeance: I have shed her blood upon the smooth rock, that it should not be covered.
text_la: Ut superinducerem indignationem meam, et vindicta ulciscerer, dedi sanguinem ejus super petram limpidissimam, ne operiretur.
text_pt: Para fazer subir a indignação, para tomar vingança, eu pus o seu sangue numa penha descalvada, para que não fosse coberto.
text_el: τοῦ ἀναβῆναι θυμὸν εἰς ἐκδίκησιν ἐκδικηθῆναι δέδωκα τὸ αἷμα αὐτῆς ἐπὶ λεωπετρίαν τοῦ μὴ καλύψαι αὐτό

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Woe to the bloody city, of which I will make a great bonfire.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Væ civitati sanguinum, cujus ego grandem faciam pyram!
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ai da cidade sanguinária! Também eu farei uma grande fogueira.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος κἀγὼ μεγαλυνῶ τὸν δαλὸν

text_en: Heap together the bones, which I will burn with fire: the flesh shall be consumed, and the whole composition shall be sodden, and the bones shall be consumed.
text_la: Congere ossa, quæ igne succendam : consumentur carnes, et coquetur universa compositio, et ossa tabescent.
text_pt: Amontoa muita lenha, acende o fogo, ferve bem a carne, e tempera o caldo, e ardam os ossos.
text_el: καὶ πληθυνῶ τὰ ξύλα καὶ ἀνακαύσω τὸ πῦρ ὅπως τακῇ τὰ κρέα καὶ ἐλαττωθῇ ὁ ζωμὸς

text_en: Then set it empty upon burning coals, that it may be hot, and the brass thereof may be melted: and let the filth of it be melted in the midst thereof, and let the rust of it be consumed.
text_la: Pone quoque eam super prunas vacuam, ut incalescat, et liquefiat æs ejus, et confletur in medio ejus inquinamentum ejus, et consumatur rubigo ejus.
text_pt: Então a porás vazia sobre as suas brasas, para que ela aqueça, e se queime o seu cobre, e se funda a sua imundícia no meio dela, e se consuma a sua escuma.
text_el: καὶ στῇ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄνθρακας ὅπως προσκαυθῇ καὶ θερμανθῇ ὁ χαλκὸς αὐτῆς καὶ τακῇ ἐν μέσῳ ἀκαθαρσίας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐκλίπῃ ὁ ἰὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: Great pains have been taken, and the great rust thereof is not gone out, not even by fire.
text_la: Multo labore sudatum est, et non exivit de ea nimia rubigo ejus, neque per ignem.
text_pt: Ela com mentiras se cansou; e não saiu dela a sua muita escuma; ao fogo irá a sua escuma.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃ ἐξ αὐτῆς πολὺς ὁ ἰὸς αὐτῆς καταισχυνθήσεται ὁ ἰὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: Your uncleanness is execrable: because I desired to cleanse you, and you are not cleansed from your filthiness: neither shall you be cleansed, before I cause my indignation to rest in you.
text_la: Immunditia tua execrabilis, quia mundare te volui, et non es mundata a sordibus tuis : sed nec mundaberis prius, donec quiescere faciam indignationem meam in te.
text_pt: Na imundícia está a infâmia, porquanto te purifiquei, e não permaneceste pura; nunca mais serás purificada da tua imundícia, enquanto eu não fizer descansar sobre ti a minha indignação.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν ἐμιαίνου σύ καὶ τί ἐὰν μὴ καθαρισθῇς ἔτι ἕως οὗ ἐμπλήσω τὸν θυμόν μου

text_en: I the Lord have spoken: it shall come to pass, and I will do it: I will not pass by, nor spare, nor be pacified: I will judge you according to your ways, and according to your doings, says the Lord .
text_la: Ego Dominus locutus sum : veniet, et faciam : non transeam, nec parcam, nec placabor : juxta vias tuas, et juxta adinventiones tuas judicabo te, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Eu, o SENHOR, o disse: viva isso, e o farei, não me tornarei atrás, e não pouparei, nem me arrependerei; conforme os teus caminhos, e conforme os teus feitos, te julgarão, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα καὶ ἥξει καὶ ποιήσω οὐ διαστελῶ οὐδὲ μὴ ἐλεήσω κατὰ τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ κατὰ τὰ ἐνθυμήματά σου κρινῶ σε λέγει κύριος διὰ τοῦτο ἐγὼ κρινῶ σε κατὰ τὰ αἵματά σου καὶ κατὰ τὰ ἐνθυμήματά σου κρινῶ σε ἡ ἀκάθαρτος ἡ ὀνομαστὴ καὶ πολλὴ τοῦ παραπικραίνειν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , behold I take from you the desire of your eyes with a stroke, and you shall not lament, nor weep; neither shall your tears run down.
text_la: Fili hominis, ecce ego tollo a te desiderabile oculorum tuorum in plaga : et non planges, neque plorabis, neque fluent lacrimæ tuæ.
text_pt: Filho do homem, eis que, de um golpe tirarei de ti o desejo dos teus olhos, mas não lamentarás, nem chorarás, nem te correrão as lágrimas.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ λαμβάνω ἐκ σοῦ τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου ἐν παρατάξει οὐ μὴ κοπῇς οὐδὲ μὴ κλαυσθῇς

text_en: Sigh in silence, make no mourning for the dead: let the tire of your head be upon you, and your shoes on your feet, and cover not your face, nor eat the meat of mourners.
text_la: Ingemisce tacens : mortuorum luctum non facies : corona tua circumligata sit tibi, et calceamenta tua erunt in pedibus tuis : nec amictu ora velabis, nec cibos lugentium comedes.
text_pt: Geme em silêncio, não faças luto por mortos; ata o teu turbante, e põe nos pés os teus sapatos, e não cubras os teus lábios, e não comas o pão dos homens.
text_el: στεναγμὸς αἵματος ὀσφύος πένθους ἐστίν οὐκ ἔσται τὸ τρίχωμά σου συμπεπλεγμένον ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ τὰ ὑποδήματά σου ἐν τοῖς ποσίν σου οὐ μὴ παρακληθῇς ἐν χείλεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἄρτον ἀνδρῶν οὐ μὴ φάγῃς

text_en: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening: and I did in the morning as he had commanded me.
text_la: Locutus sum ergo ad populum mane, et mortua est uxor mea vespere : fecique mane sicut præceperat mihi.
text_pt: E falei ao povo pela manhã, e à tarde morreu minha mulher; e fiz pela manhã como me foi mandado.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησα πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τὸ πρωὶ ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατό μοι καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἡ γυνή μου ἑσπέρας καὶ ἐποίησα τὸ πρωὶ ὃν τρόπον ἐπετάγη μοι

text_en: And the people said to me: Why do you not tell us what these things mean that you do?
text_la: Et dixit ad me populus : Quare non indicas nobis quid ista significent quæ tu facis?
text_pt: E o povo me disse: Porventura não nos farás saber o que significam para nós estas coisas que estás fazendo?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ὁ λαός οὐκ ἀναγγελεῖς ἡμῖν τί ἐστιν ταῦτα ἃ σὺ ποιεῖς

text_en: And I said to them: The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et dixi ad eos : Sermo Domini factus est ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E eu lhes disse: Veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτούς λόγος κυρίου πρός με ἐγένετο λέγων

text_en: Speak to the house of Israel : Thus says the Lord God : Behold I will profane my sanctuary , the glory of your realm, and the thing that your eyes desire, and for which your soul fears : your sons, and your daughters, whom you have left, shall fall by the sword.
text_la: Loquere domui Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego polluam sanctuarium meum, superbiam imperii vestri, et desiderabile oculorum vestrorum, et super quo pavet anima vestra : filii vestri et filiæ vestræ quas reliquistis, gladio cadent.
text_pt: Dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu profanarei o meu santuário, a glória da vossa força, o desejo dos vossos olhos, e o anelo das vossas almas; e vossos filhos e vossas filhas, que deixastes, cairão à espada.
text_el: εἰπὸν πρὸς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ βεβηλῶ τὰ ἅγιά μου φρύαγμα ἰσχύος ὑμῶν ἐπιθυμήματα ὀφθαλμῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ὑπὲρ ὧν φείδονται αἱ ψυχαὶ ὑμῶν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν οὓς ἐγκατελίπετε ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσοῦνται

text_en: And you shall do as I have done: you shall not cover your faces, nor shall you eat the meat of mourners.
text_la: Et facietis sicut feci : ora amictu non velabitis, et cibos lugentium non comedetis:
text_pt: E fareis como eu fiz; não vos cobrireis os lábios, e não comereis o pão dos homens.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσετε ὃν τρόπον πεποίηκα ἀπὸ στόματος αὐτῶν οὐ παρακληθήσεσθε καὶ ἄρτον ἀνδρῶν οὐ φάγεσθε

text_en: You shall have crowns on your heads, and shoes on your feet: you shall not lament nor weep, but you shall pine away for your iniquities , and every one shall sigh with his brother.
text_la: coronas habebitis in capitibus vestris, et calceamenta in pedibus : non plangetis, neque flebitis, sed tabescetis in iniquitatibus vestris, et unusquisque gemet ad fratrem suum.
text_pt: E tereis nas cabeças os vossos turbantes, e os vossos sapatos nos pés; não lamentareis, nem chorareis, mas definhar-vos-eis nas vossas maldades, e gemereis uns com os outros.
text_el: καὶ αἱ κόμαι ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ὑποδήματα ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν ὑμῶν οὔτε μὴ κόψησθε οὔτε μὴ κλαύσητε καὶ ἐντακήσεσθε ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις ὑμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσετε ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Ezechiel shall be unto you for a sign of things to come: according to all that he has done, so shall you do, when this shall come to pass: and you shall know that I am the Lord God .
text_la: Eritque Ezechiel vobis in portentum : juxta omnia quæ fecit, facietis cum venerit istud : et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Assim vos servirá Ezequiel de sinal; conforme tudo quanto ele fez, fareis; quando isso suceder, sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Ιεζεκιηλ ὑμῖν εἰς τέρας κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ποιήσετε ὅταν ἔλθῃ ταῦτα καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And you, O son of man , behold in the day wherein I will take away from them their strength, and the joy of their glory , and the desire of their eyes, upon which their souls rest, their sons and their daughters.
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, ecce in die qua tollam ab eis fortitudinem eorum, et gaudium dignitatis, et desiderium oculorum eorum, super quo requiescunt animæ eorum, filios et filias eorum:
text_pt: E quanto a ti, filho do homem, não sucederá que no dia que eu lhes tirar a sua força, a alegria da sua glória, o desejo dos seus olhos, e o anelo de suas almas, com seus filhos e suas filhas,
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου οὐχὶ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὅταν λαμβάνω τὴν ἰσχὺν παρ' αὐτῶν τὴν ἔπαρσιν τῆς καυχήσεως αὐτῶν τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν ἔπαρσιν ψυχῆς αὐτῶν υἱοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ θυγατέρας αὐτῶν

text_en: In that day when he that escapes shall come to you, to tell you:
text_la: in die illa, cum venerit fugiens ad te ut annuntiet tibi:
text_pt: Nesse dia virá ter contigo aquele que escapar, para te dar notícias pessoalmente?
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἥξει ὁ ἀνασῳζόμενος πρὸς σὲ τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαί σοι εἰς τὰ ὦτα

text_en: In that day, I say, shall your mouth be opened to him that has escaped, and you shall speak, and shall be silent no more: and you shall be unto them for a sign of things to come, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: in die, inquam illa, aperietur os tuum cum eo qui fugit, et loqueris, et non silebis ultra : erisque eis in portentum, et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Naquele dia abrir-se-á a tua boca para com aquele que escapar, e falarás, e não mais ficarás mudo; assim virás a ser para eles um sinal, e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ διανοιχθήσεται τὸ στόμα σου πρὸς τὸν ἀνασῳζόμενον καὶ λαλήσεις καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποκωφωθῇς οὐκέτι καὶ ἔσῃ αὐτοῖς εἰς τέρας καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , set your face against the children of Ammon , and you shall prophesy of them.
text_la: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra filios Ammon, et prophetabis de eis.
text_pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra os filhos de Amom, e profetiza contra eles.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ' αὐτοὺς

text_en: And you shall say to the children of Ammon : Hear the word of the Lord God : Thus says the Lord God : Because you have said: Ha, ha, upon my sanctuary , because it was profaned : and upon the land of Israel , because it was laid waste: and upon the house of Juda , because they are led into captivity :
text_la: Et dices filiis Ammon : Audite verbum Domini Dei. Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod dixisti : Euge, euge, super sanctuarium meum, quia pollutum est; et super terram Israël, quoniam desolata est; et super domum Juda, quoniam ducti sunt in captivitatem :
text_pt: E dize aos filhos de Amom: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor DEUS: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto tu disseste: Ah! contra o meu santuário, quando foi profanado; e contra a terra de Israel, quando foi assolada; e contra a casa de Judá, quando foi ao cativeiro;
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐπεχάρητε ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγιά μου ὅτι ἐβεβηλώθη καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ ὅτι ἠφανίσθη καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ιουδα ὅτι ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ

text_en: Therefore will I deliver you to the men of the east for an inheritance, and they shall place their sheepcotes in you, and shall set up their tents in you: they shall eat your fruits: and they shall drink your milk.
text_la: idcirco ego tradam te filiis orientalibus in hæreditatem : et collocabunt caulas suas in te, et ponent in te tentoria sua : ipsi comedent fruges tuas, et ipsi bibent lac tuum.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que te entregarei em possessão aos do oriente, e em ti estabelecerão os seus acampamentos, e porão em ti as suas moradas; eles comerão os teus frutos, e eles beberão o teu leite.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραδίδωμι ὑμᾶς τοῖς υἱοῖς Κεδεμ εἰς κληρονομίαν καὶ κατασκηνώσουσιν ἐν τῇ ἀπαρτίᾳ αὐτῶν ἐν σοὶ καὶ δώσουσιν ἐν σοὶ τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτῶν αὐτοὶ φάγονται τοὺς καρπούς σου καὶ αὐτοὶ πίονται τὴν πιότητά σου

text_en: And I will make Rabbath a stable for camels, and the children of Ammon a couching place for flocks: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Daboque Rabbath in habitaculum camelorum, et filios Ammon in cubile pecorum : et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E farei de Rabá uma estrebaria de camelos, e dos filhos de Amom um curral de ovelhas; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὴν πόλιν τοῦ Αμμων εἰς νομὰς καμήλων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων εἰς νομὴν προβάτων καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : Because you have clapped your hands and stamped with your foot, and have rejoiced with all your heart against the land of Israel :
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod plausisti manu et percussisti pede, et gavisa es ex toto affectu super terram Israël,
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto bateste com as mãos, e pateaste com os pés, e com todo o desprezo do teu coração te alegraste contra a terra de Israel,
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐκρότησας τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ ἐπεψόφησας τῷ ποδί σου καὶ ἐπέχαρας ἐκ ψυχῆς σου ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Therefore behold I will stretch forth my hand upon you, and will deliver you to be the spoil of nations , and will cut you off from among the people, and destroy you out of the lands, and break you in pieces: and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: idcirco ecce ego extendam manum meam super te, et tradam te in direptionem gentium, et interficiam te de populis, et perdam de terris, et conteram : et scies quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que eu tenho estendido a minha mão sobre ti, e te darei por despojo aos gentios, e te arrancarei dentre os povos, e te destruirei dentre as terras, e acabarei de todo contigo; e saberás que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ δώσω σε εἰς διαρπαγὴν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω σε ἐκ τῶν λαῶν καὶ ἀπολῶ σε ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν ἀπωλείᾳ καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because Moab and Seir have said: Behold the house of Juda is like all other nations :
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod dixerunt Moab et Seir : Ecce sicut omnes gentes, domus Juda :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto dizem Moabe e Seir: Eis que a casa de Judá é como todos os gentios;
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν εἶπεν Μωαβ ἰδοὺ ὃν τρόπον πάντα τὰ ἔθνη οἶκος Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα

text_en: Therefore behold I will open the shoulder of Moab from the cities, from his cities, I say, and his borders, the noble cities of the land of Bethiesimoth, and Beelmeon, and Cariathaim,
text_la: idcirco ecce ego aperiam humerum Moab de civitatibus, de civitatibus, inquam, ejus, et de finibus ejus, inclytas terræ Bethiesimoth, et Beelmeon, et Cariathaim,
text_pt: Portanto, eis que eu abrirei o lado de Moabe desde as cidades, desde as suas cidades da fronteira, a glória da terra, Bete-Jesimote, Baal-Meom, e Quiriataim.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραλύω τὸν ὦμον Μωαβ ἀπὸ πόλεων ἀκρωτηρίων αὐτοῦ ἐκλεκτὴν γῆν οἶκον Ασιμουθ ἐπάνω πηγῆς πόλεως παραθαλασσίας

text_en: to the people of the east with the children of Ammon , and I will give it them for an inheritance: that there may be no more any remembrance of the children of Ammon among the nations .
text_la: filiis orientis cum filiis Ammon, et dabo eam in hæreditatem, ut non sit ultra memoria filiorum Ammon in gentibus.
text_pt: E aos do oriente, contra os filhos de Amom, o entregarei em possessão, para que não haja memória dos filhos de Amom entre as nações.
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Κεδεμ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων δέδωκα αὐτοὺς εἰς κληρονομίαν ὅπως μὴ μνεία γένηται τῶν υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And I will execute judgments in Moab : and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et in Moab faciam judicia, et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Também executarei juízos sobre Moabe, e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἰς Μωαβ ποιήσω ἐκδίκησιν καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because Edom has taken vengeance to revenge herself of the children of Juda , and has greatly offended , and has sought revenge of them:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod fecit Idumæa ultionem ut se vindicaret de filiis Juda, peccavitque delinquens, et vindictam expetivit de eis :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto Edom se houve vingativamente para com a casa de Judá, e se fez culpadíssimo, quando se vingou deles;
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐποίησεν ἡ Ιδουμαία ἐν τῷ ἐκδικῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἐκδίκησιν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ιουδα καὶ ἐμνησικάκησαν καὶ ἐξεδίκησαν δίκην

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : I will stretch forth my hand upon Edom , and will take away out of it man and beast, and will make it desolate from the south: and they that are in Dedan shall fall by the sword.
text_la: idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Extendam manum meam super Idumæam, et auferam de ea hominem et jumentum, et faciam eam desertam ab austro : et qui sunt in Dedan, gladio cadent.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Também estenderei a minha mão sobre Edom, e arrancarei dela homens e animais; e a tornarei em deserto, e desde Temã até Dedã cairão à espada.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τὴν Ιδουμαίαν καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω ἐξ αὐτῆς ἄνθρωπον καὶ κτῆνος καὶ θήσομαι αὐτὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἐκ Θαιμαν διωκόμενοι ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσοῦνται

text_en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel : and they shall do in Edom according to my wrath , and my fury : and they shall know my vengeance, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et dabo ultionem meam super Idumæam per manum populi mei Israël : et facient in Edom juxta iram meam et furorem meum, et scient vindictam meam, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E exercerei a minha vingança sobre Edom, pela mão do meu povo de Israel; e farão em Edom segundo a minha ira e segundo o meu furor; e conhecerão a minha vingança, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ δώσω ἐκδίκησίν μου ἐπὶ τὴν Ιδουμαίαν ἐν χειρὶ λαοῦ μου Ισραηλ καὶ ποιήσουσιν ἐν τῇ Ιδουμαίᾳ κατὰ τὴν ὀργήν μου καὶ κατὰ τὸν θυμόν μου καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται τὴν ἐκδίκησίν μου λέγει κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because the Philistines have taken vengeance, and have revenged themselves with all their mind , destroying and satisfying old enmities :
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod fecerunt Palæstini vindictam, et ulti se sunt toto animo, interficientes, et implentes inimicitias veteres,
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto os filisteus se houveram vingativamente, e executaram vingança com desprezo de coração, para destruírem com perpétua inimizade,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐποίησαν οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ἐν ἐκδικήσει καὶ ἐξανέστησαν ἐκδίκησιν ἐπιχαίροντες ἐκ ψυχῆς τοῦ ἐξαλεῖψαι ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold I will stretch forth my hand upon the Philistines , and will kill the killers, and will destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
text_la: propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego extendam manum meam super Palæstinos, et interficiam interfectores, et perdam reliquias maritimæ regionis,
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu estendo a minha mão sobre os filisteus, e arrancarei os quereteus, e destruirei o restante da costa do mar.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω Κρῆτας καὶ ἀπολῶ τοὺς καταλοίπους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν παραλίαν

text_en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them, rebuking them in fury : and they shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
text_la: faciamque in eis ultiones magnas, arguens in furore : et scient quia ego Dominus, cum dedero vindictam meam super eos.
text_pt: E executarei sobre eles grandes vinganças, com furiosos castigos, e saberão que eu sou o Senhor, quando eu tiver exercido a minha vingança sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐκδικήσεις μεγάλας καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ἐν τῷ δοῦναι τὴν ἐκδίκησίν μου ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est in undecimo anno, prima mensis : factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E sucedeu no undécimo ano, ao primeiro do mês, que veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ ἔτει μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , because Tyre has said of Jerusalem : Aha, the gates of the people are broken, she is turned to me: I shall be filled, now she is laid waste.
text_la: Fili hominis, pro eo quod dixit Tyrus de Jerusalem : Euge, confractæ sunt portæ populorum, conversa est ad me : implebor; deserta est :
text_pt: Filho do homem, visto que Tiro disse contra Jerusalém: Ah! está quebrada a porta dos povos; virou-se para mim; eu me encherei, agora que ela está assolada;
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἀνθ' ὧν εἶπεν Σορ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ εὖγε συνετρίβη ἀπόλωλεν τὰ ἔθνη ἐπεστράφη πρός με ἡ πλήρης ἠρήμωται

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold I come against you, O Tyre , and I will cause many nations to come up to you, as the waves of the sea rise up.
text_la: propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego super te, Tyre, et ascendere faciam ad te gentes multas, sicut ascendit mare fluctuans.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu estou contra ti, ó Tiro, e farei subir contra ti muitas nações, como o mar faz subir as suas ondas,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σέ Σορ καὶ ἀνάξω ἐπὶ σὲ ἔθνη πολλά ὡς ἀναβαίνει ἡ θάλασσα τοῖς κύμασιν αὐτῆς

text_en: And they shall break down the walls of Tyre , and destroy the towers thereof: and I will scrape her dust from her, and make her like a smooth rock.
text_la: Et dissipabunt muros Tyri, et destruent turres ejus : et radam pulverem ejus de ea, et dabo eam in limpidissimam petram.
text_pt: Elas destruirão os muros de Tiro, e derrubarão as suas torres; e eu lhe varrerei o seu pó, e dela farei uma penha descalvada.
text_el: καὶ καταβαλοῦσιν τὰ τείχη Σορ καὶ καταβαλοῦσι τοὺς πύργους σου καὶ λικμήσω τὸν χοῦν αὐτῆς ἀπ' αὐτῆς καὶ δώσω αὐτὴν εἰς λεωπετρίαν

text_en: She shall be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, because I have spoken it, says the Lord God : and she shall be a spoil to the nations .
text_la: Siccatio sagenarum erit in medio maris, quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus : et erit in direptionem gentibus.
text_pt: No meio do mar virá a ser um enxugadouro das redes; porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor DEUS; e servirá de despojo para as nações.
text_el: ψυγμὸς σαγηνῶν ἔσται ἐν μέσῳ θαλάσσης ὅτι ἐγὼ λελάληκα λέγει κύριος καὶ ἔσται εἰς προνομὴν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: Her daughters also that are in the field, shall be slain by the sword: and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Filiæ quoque ejus quæ sunt in agro, gladio interficientur : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E suas filhas, que estão no campo, serão mortas à espada; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς αἱ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ μαχαίρᾳ ἀναιρεθήσονται καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : Behold I will bring against Tyre Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon , the king of kings, from the north, with horses, and chariots, and horsemen, and companies, and much people.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego adducam ad Tyrum Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis ab aquilone, regem regum, cum equis, et curribus, et equitibus, et cœtu, populoque magno.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu, desde o norte, trarei contra Tiro a Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, o rei dos reis, com cavalos, e com carros, e com cavaleiros, e companhias, e muito povo.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ σέ Σορ τὸν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος ἀπὸ τοῦ βορρᾶ βασιλεὺς βασιλέων ἐστίν μεθ' ἵππων καὶ ἁρμάτων καὶ ἱππέων καὶ συναγωγῆς ἐθνῶν πολλῶν σφόδρα

text_en: Your daughters that are in the field, he shall kill with the sword: and he shall compass you with forts, and shall cast up a mount round about: and he shall lift up the buckler against you.
text_la: Filias tuas quæ sunt in agro, gladio interficiet, et circumdabit te munitionibus, et comportabit aggerem in gyro, et elevabit contra te clypeum :
text_pt: As tuas filhas que estão no campo, ele as matará à espada, e levantará um baluarte contra ti, e fundará uma trincheira contra ti, e levantará paveses contra ti.
text_el: οὗτος τὰς θυγατέρας σου τὰς ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ μαχαίρᾳ ἀνελεῖ καὶ δώσει ἐπὶ σὲ προφυλακὴν καὶ περιοικοδομήσει καὶ ποιήσει ἐπὶ σὲ κύκλῳ χάρακα καὶ περίστασιν ὅπλων καὶ τὰς λόγχας αὐτοῦ ἀπέναντί σου δώσει

text_en: And he shall set engines of war and battering rams against your walls, and shall destroy your towers with his arms.
text_la: et vineas et arietes temperabit in muros tuos, et turres tuas destruet in armatura sua.
text_pt: E disporá os seus aríetes contra os teus muros, e derrubará as tuas torres com os seus machados.
text_el: τὰ τείχη σου καὶ τοὺς πύργους σου καταβαλεῖ ἐν ταῖς μαχαίραις αὐτοῦ

text_en: By reason of the multitude of his horses, their dust shall cover you: your walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and wheels, and chariots, when they shall go in at your gates, as by the entrance of a city that is destroyed.
text_la: Inundatione equorum ejus operiet te pulvis eorum : a sonitu equitum, et rotarum, et curruum, movebuntur muri tui, cum ingressus fuerit portas tuas quasi per introitum urbis dissipatæ.
text_pt: Por causa da multidão de seus cavalos te cobrirá o seu pó; os teus muros tremerão com o estrondo dos cavaleiros, e das rodas, e dos carros, quando ele entrar pelas tuas portas, como os homens entram numa cidade em que se fez brecha.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ἵππων αὐτοῦ κατακαλύψει σε ὁ κονιορτὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς τῶν ἱππέων αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν τροχῶν τῶν ἁρμάτων αὐτοῦ σεισθήσεται τὰ τείχη σου εἰσπορευομένου αὐτοῦ τὰς πύλας σου ὡς εἰσπορευόμενος εἰς πόλιν ἐκ πεδίου

text_en: With the hoofs of his horses he shall tread down all your streets, your people he shall kill with the sword, and your famous statues shall fall to the ground.
text_la: Ungulis equorum suorum conculcabit omnes plateas tuas : populum tuum gladio cædet, et statuæ tuæ nobiles in terram corruent.
text_pt: Com os cascos dos seus cavalos pisará todas as tuas ruas; ao teu povo matará à espada, e as tuas fortes colunas cairão por terra.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ὁπλαῖς τῶν ἵππων αὐτοῦ καταπατήσουσίν σου πάσας τὰς πλατείας τὸν λαόν σου μαχαίρᾳ ἀνελεῖ καὶ τὴν ὑπόστασίν σου τῆς ἰσχύος ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν κατάξει

text_en: They shall waste your riches , they shall make a spoil of your merchandise: and they shall destroy your walls, and pull down your fine houses: and they shall lay your stones and your timber, and your dust in the midst of the waters.
text_la: Vastabunt opes tuas, diripient negotiationes tuas, et destruent muros tuos, et domos tuas præclaras subvertent : et lapides tuos, et ligna tua, et pulverem tuum in medio aquarum ponent.
text_pt: E roubarão as tuas riquezas, e saquearão as tuas mercadorias, e derrubarão os teus muros, e arrazarão as tuas casas agradáveis; e lançarão no meio das águas as tuas pedras, e as tuas madeiras, e o teu pó.
text_el: καὶ προνομεύσει τὴν δύναμίν σου καὶ σκυλεύσει τὰ ὑπάρχοντά σου καὶ καταβαλεῖ σου τὰ τείχη καὶ τοὺς οἴκους σου τοὺς ἐπιθυμητοὺς καθελεῖ καὶ τοὺς λίθους σου καὶ τὰ ξύλα σου καὶ τὸν χοῦν σου εἰς μέσον τῆς θαλάσσης ἐμβαλεῖ

text_en: And I will make the multitude of your songs to cease, and the sound of your harps shall be heard no more.
text_la: Et quiescere faciam multitudinem canticorum tuorum : et sonitus cithararum tuarum non audietur amplius.
text_pt: E farei cessar o ruído das tuas cantigas, e o som dos tuas harpas não se ouvirá mais.
text_el: καὶ καταλύσει τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μουσικῶν σου καὶ ἡ φωνὴ τῶν ψαλτηρίων σου οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἔτι

text_en: And I will make you like a naked rock, you shall be a drying place for nets, neither shall you be built any more: for I have spoken it, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et dabo te in limpidissimam petram, siccatio sagenarum eris, nec ædificaberis ultra, quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E farei de ti uma penha descalvada; virás a ser um enxugadouro das redes, nunca mais serás edificada; porque eu o SENHOR o falei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ δώσω σε εἰς λεωπετρίαν ψυγμὸς σαγηνῶν ἔσῃ οὐ μὴ οἰκοδομηθῇς ἔτι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐλάλησα λέγει κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord God to Tyre : Shall not the islands shake at the sound of your fall, and the groans of your slain when they shall be killed in the midst of you?
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Tyro : Numquid non a sonitu ruinæ tuæ, et gemitu interfectorum tuorum, cum occisi fuerint in medio tui, commovebuntur insulæ?
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS a Tiro: Porventura não tremerão as ilhas com o estrondo da tua queda, quando gemerem os feridos, quando se fizer uma espantosa matança no meio de ti?
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος τῇ Σορ οὐκ ἀπὸ φωνῆς τῆς πτώσεώς σου ἐν τῷ στενάξαι τραυματίας ἐν τῷ σπάσαι μάχαιραν ἐν μέσῳ σου σεισθήσονται αἱ νῆσοι

text_en: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones: and take off their robes, and cast away their broidered garments, and be clothed with astonishment: they shall sit on the ground, and with amazement shall wonder at your sudden fall.
text_la: Et descendent de sedibus suis omnes principes maris, et auferent exuvias suas, et vestimenta sua varia abjicient, et induentur stupore : in terra sedebunt, et attoniti super repentino casu tuo admirabuntur :
text_pt: E todos os príncipes do mar descerão dos seus tronos, e tirarão de si os seus mantos, e despirão as suas vestes bordadas; se vestirão de tremores, sobre a terra se assentarão, e estremecerão a cada momento; e por tua causa pasmarão.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσονται ἀπὸ τῶν θρόνων αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἀφελοῦνται τὰς μίτρας ἀπὸ τῶν κεφαλῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὸν ἱματισμὸν τὸν ποικίλον αὐτῶν ἐκδύσονται ἐκστάσει ἐκστήσονται ἐπὶ γῆν καθεδοῦνται καὶ φοβηθήσονται τὴν ἀπώλειαν αὐτῶν καὶ στενάξουσιν ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: And taking up a lamentation over you, they shall say to you: How are you fallen, that dwell in the sea, renowned city that was strong in the sea, with your inhabitants whom all did dread?
text_la: et assumentes super te lamentum, dicent tibi : Quomodo peristi, quæ habitas in mari, urbs inclyta, quæ fuisti fortis in mari cum habitatoribus tuis, quos formidabant universi?
text_pt: E levantarão uma lamentação sobre ti, e te dirão: Como pereceste, ó bem povoada e afamada cidade, que foste forte no mar; ela e os seus moradores, que atemorizaram a todos os seus habitantes!
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται ἐπὶ σὲ θρῆνον καὶ ἐροῦσίν σοι πῶς κατελύθης ἐκ θαλάσσης ἡ πόλις ἡ ἐπαινεστὴ ἡ δοῦσα τὸν φόβον αὐτῆς πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν αὐτήν

text_en: Now shall the ships be astonished in the day of your terror: and the islands in the sea shall be troubled because no one comes out of you.
text_la: Nunc stupebunt naves in die pavoris tui, et turbabuntur insulæ in mari, eo quod nullus egrediatur ex te.
text_pt: Agora, estremecerão as ilhas no dia da tua queda; sim, as ilhas, que estão no mar, turbar-se-ão com tua saída.
text_el: καὶ φοβηθήσονται αἱ νῆσοι ἀφ' ἡμέρας πτώσεώς σου

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : When I shall make you a desolate city like the cities that are not inhabited: and shall bring the deep upon you, and many waters shall cover you:
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Cum dedero te urbem desolatam, sicut civitates quæ non habitantur; et adduxero super te abyssum, et operuerint te aquæ multæ;
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quando eu te fizer uma cidade assolada, como as cidades que não se habitam, quando eu fizer subir sobre ti o abismo, e as muitas águas te cobrirem,
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ὅταν δῶ σε πόλιν ἠρημωμένην ὡς τὰς πόλεις τὰς μὴ κατοικηθησομένας ἐν τῷ ἀναγαγεῖν με ἐπὶ σὲ τὴν ἄβυσσον καὶ κατακαλύψῃ σε ὕδωρ πολύ

text_en: And when I shall bring you down with those that descend into the pit to the everlasting people, and shall set you in the lowest parts of the earth, as places desolate of old, with them that are brought down into the pit, that you be not inhabited: and when I shall give glory in the land of the living,
text_la: et detraxero te cum his qui descendunt in lacum ad populum sempiternum; et collocavero te in terra novissima sicut solitudines veteres, cum his qui deducuntur in lacum, ut non habiteris; porro cum dedero gloriam in terra viventium :
text_pt: Então te farei descer com os que descem à cova, ao povo antigo, e te farei habitar nas mais baixas partes da terra, em lugares desertos antigos, com os que descem à cova, para que não sejas habitada; e estabelecerei a glória na terra dos viventes.
text_el: καὶ καταβιβάσω σε πρὸς τοὺς καταβαίνοντας εἰς βόθρον πρὸς λαὸν αἰῶνος καὶ κατοικιῶ σε εἰς βάθη τῆς γῆς ὡς ἔρημον αἰώνιον μετὰ καταβαινόντων εἰς βόθρον ὅπως μὴ κατοικηθῇς μηδὲ ἀνασταθῇς ἐπὶ γῆς ζωῆς

text_en: I will bring you to nothing, and you shall not be, and if you be sought for, you shall not be found any more for ever, says the Lord God .
text_la: in nihilum redigam te, et non eris : et requisita non invenieris ultra in sempiternum, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Farei de ti um grande espanto, e não mais existirás; e quando te buscarem então nunca mais serás achada para sempre, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ἀπώλειάν σε δώσω καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρξεις ἔτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα λέγει κύριος κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: You therefore, O son of man , take up a lamentation for Tyre :
text_la: Tu ergo, fili hominis, assume super Tyrum lamentum:
text_pt: Tu pois, ó filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre Tiro.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου λαβὲ ἐπὶ Σορ θρῆνον

text_en: And say to Tyre that dwells at the entry of the sea, being the mart of the people for many islands: Thus says the Lord God : O Tyre , you have said: I am of perfect beauty,
