text_la: et dices Tyro, quæ habitat in introitu maris, negotiationi populorum ad insulas multas : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : O Tyre, tu dixisti : Perfecti decoris ego sum,
text_pt: E dize a Tiro, que habita nas entradas do mar, e negocia com os povos em muitas ilhas: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Ó Tiro, tu dizes: Eu sou perfeita em formosura.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τῇ Σορ τῇ κατοικούσῃ ἐπὶ τῆς εἰσόδου τῆς θαλάσσης τῷ ἐμπορίῳ τῶν λαῶν ἀπὸ νήσων πολλῶν τάδε λέγει κύριος τῇ Σορ σὺ εἶπας ἐγὼ περιέθηκα ἐμαυτῇ κάλλος μου

text_en: and situate in the heart of the sea. Your neighbours, that built you, have perfected your beauty:
text_la: et in corde maris sita. Finitimi tui qui te ædificaverunt, impleverunt decorem tuum :
text_pt: No coração dos mares estão os teus termos; os que te edificaram aperfeiçoaram a tua formosura.
text_el: ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης τῷ Βεελιμ υἱοί σου περιέθηκάν σοι κάλλος

text_en: With fir trees of Sanir they have built you with all sea planks: they have taken cedars from Libanus to make you masts.
text_la: abietibus de Sanir exstruxerunt te cum omnibus tabulatis maris : cedrum de Libano tulerunt ut facerent tibi malum.
text_pt: Fabricaram todos os teus conveses de faias de Senir; trouxeram cedros do Líbano para te fazerem mastros.
text_el: κέδρος ἐκ Σανιρ ᾠκοδομήθη σοι ταινίαι σανίδων κυπαρίσσου ἐκ τοῦ Λιβάνου ἐλήμφθησαν τοῦ ποιῆσαί σοι ἱστοὺς ἐλατίνους

text_en: They have cut your oars out of the oaks of Basan: and they have made you benches of Indian ivory and cabins with things brought from the islands of Italy .
text_la: Quercus de Basan dolaverunt in remos tuos, et transtra tua fecerunt tibi ex ebore indico, et prætoriola de insulis Italiæ.
text_pt: Fizeram os teus remos de carvalhos de Basã; os teus bancos fizeram-nos de marfim engastado em buxo das ilhas dos quiteus.
text_el: ἐκ τῆς Βασανίτιδος ἐποίησαν τὰς κώπας σου τὰ ἱερά σου ἐποίησαν ἐξ ἐλέφαντος οἴκους ἀλσώδεις ἀπὸ νήσων τῶν Χεττιιν

text_en: Fine broidered linen from Egypt was woven for your sail, to be spread on your mast: blue and purple from the islands of Elisa , were made your covering.
text_la: Byssus varia de Ægypto texta est tibi in velum ut poneretur in malo : hyacinthus et purpura de insulis Elisa facta sunt operimentum tuum.
text_pt: Linho fino bordado do Egito era a tua cortina, para te servir de vela; azul e púrpura das ilhas de Elisá era a tua cobertura.
text_el: βύσσος μετὰ ποικιλίας ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐγένετό σοι στρωμνὴ τοῦ περιθεῖναί σοι δόξαν καὶ περιβαλεῖν σε ὑάκινθον καὶ πορφύραν ἐκ τῶν νήσων Ελισαι καὶ ἐγένετο περιβόλαιά σου

text_en: The inhabitants of Sidon , and the Arabians were your rowers: your wise men , O Tyre , were your pilots.
text_la: Habitatores Sidonis et Aradii fuerunt remiges tui : sapientes tui, Tyre, facti sunt gubernatores tui.
text_pt: Os moradores de Sidom e de Arvade foram os teus remadores; os teus sábios, ó Tiro, que se achavam em ti, esses foram os teus pilotos.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντές σου οἱ κατοικοῦντες Σιδῶνα καὶ Αράδιοι ἐγένοντο κωπηλάται σου οἱ σοφοί σου Σορ οἳ ἦσαν ἐν σοί οὗτοι κυβερνῆταί σου

text_en: The ancients of Gebal, and the wise men thereof furnished mariners for the service of your various furniture: all the ships of the sea, and their mariners were your factors.
text_la: Senes Giblii et prudentes ejus habuerunt nautas ad ministerium variæ supellectilis tuæ : omnes naves maris, et nautæ earum, fuerunt in populo negotiationis tuæ.
text_pt: Os anciãos de Gebal e seus sábios foram em ti os que consertavam as tuas fendas; todos os navios do mar e os marinheiros se acharam em ti, para tratarem dos teus negócios.
text_el: οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Βυβλίων καὶ οἱ σοφοὶ αὐτῶν ἦσαν ἐν σοί οὗτοι ἐνίσχυον τὴν βουλήν σου καὶ πάντα τὰ πλοῖα τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ οἱ κωπηλάται αὐτῶν ἐγένοντό σοι ἐπὶ δυσμὰς δυσμῶν

text_en: The Persians , and Lydians, and the Libyans were your soldiers in your army: they hung up the buckler and the helmet in you for your ornament.
text_la: Persæ, et Lydii, et Libyes erant in exercitu tuo viri bellatores tui : clypeum et galeam suspenderunt in te pro ornatu tuo.
text_pt: Os persas, e os lídios, e os de Pute eram no teu exército os teus soldados; escudos e capacetes penduraram em ti; eles manifestaram a tua beleza.
text_el: Πέρσαι καὶ Λυδοὶ καὶ Λίβυες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου ἄνδρες πολεμισταί σου πέλτας καὶ περικεφαλαίας ἐκρέμασαν ἐν σοί οὗτοι ἔδωκαν τὴν δόξαν σου

text_en: The men of Arad were with your army upon your walls round about: the Pygmeans also that were in your towers, hung up their quivers on your walls round about: they perfected your beauty.
text_la: Filii Aradii cum exercitu tuo erant super muros tuos in circuitu : sed et Pigmæi qui erant in turribus tuis, pharetras suas suspenderunt in muris tuis per gyrum : ipsi compleverunt pulchritudinem tuam.
text_pt: Os filhos de Arvade e o teu exército estavam sobre os teus muros em redor, e os gamaditas nas tuas torres; penduravam os seus escudos nos teus muros em redor; eles aperfeiçoavam a tua formosura.
text_el: υἱοὶ Αραδίων καὶ ἡ δύναμίς σου ἐπὶ τῶν τειχέων σου φύλακες ἐν τοῖς πύργοις σου ἦσαν τὰς φαρέτρας αὐτῶν ἐκρέμασαν ἐπὶ τῶν ὅρμων σου κύκλῳ οὗτοι ἐτελείωσάν σου τὸ κάλλος

text_en: The Carthaginians your merchants supplied your fairs with a multitude of all kinds of riches , with silver, iron, tin, and lead,
text_la: Carthaginenses negotiatores tui, a multitudine cunctarum divitiarum, argento, ferro, stanno, plumboque repleverunt nundinas tuas.
text_pt: Társis negociava contigo, por causa da abundância de toda a casta de riquezas; com prata, ferro, estanho e chumbo, negociavam em tuas feiras.
text_el: Καρχηδόνιοι ἔμποροί σου ἀπὸ πλήθους πάσης ἰσχύος σου ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον καὶ σίδηρον καὶ κασσίτερον καὶ μόλυβον ἔδωκαν τὴν ἀγοράν σου

text_en: Greece , Thubal, and Mosoch, they were your merchants, they brought to your people slaves and vessels of brass.
text_la: Græcia, Thubal, et Mosoch, ipsi institores tui : mancipia, et vasa ærea advexerunt populo tuo.
text_pt: Javã, Tubal e Meseque eram teus mercadores; em troca das tuas mercadorias davam pessoas de homens e objetos de bronze.
text_el: ἡ Ἑλλὰς καὶ ἡ σύμπασα καὶ τὰ παρατείνοντα οὗτοι ἐνεπορεύοντό σοι ἐν ψυχαῖς ἀνθρώπων καὶ σκεύη χαλκᾶ ἔδωκαν τὴν ἐμπορίαν σου

text_en: From the house of Thogorma they brought horses, and horsemen, and mules to your market.
text_la: De domo Thogorma, equos, et equites, et mulos adduxerunt ad forum tuum.
text_pt: Os da casa de Togarma trocavam pelas tuas mercadorias, cavalos, e cavaleiros e mulos.
text_el: ἐξ οἴκου Θεργαμα ἵππους καὶ ἱππεῖς ἔδωκαν ἀγοράν σου

text_en: The men of Dedan were your merchants: many islands were the traffic of your hand, they exchanged for your price teeth of ivory and ebony.
text_la: Filii Dedan negotiatores tui; insulæ multæ, negotiatio manus tuæ : dentes eburneos et hebeninos commutaverunt in pretio tuo.
text_pt: Os filhos de Dedã eram os teus mercadores; muitas ilhas eram o comércio da tua mão; dentes de marfim e pau de ébano tornavam a dar-te em presente.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ῥοδίων ἔμποροί σου ἀπὸ νήσων ἐπλήθυναν τὴν ἐμπορίαν σου ὀδόντας ἐλεφαντίνους καὶ τοῖς εἰσαγομένοις ἀντεδίδους τοὺς μισθούς σου

text_en: The Syrian was your merchant: by reason of the multitude of your works, they set forth precious stones , and purple, and broidered works, and fine linen, and silk, and chodchod in your market.
text_la: Syrus negotiator tuus propter multitudinem operum tuorum : gemmam, et purpuram, et scutulata, et byssum, et sericum, et chodchod proposuerunt in mercatu tuo.
text_pt: A Síria negociava contigo por causa da multidão das tuas manufaturas; pelas tuas mercadorias davam esmeralda, púrpura, obra bordada, linho fino, corais e ágata.
text_el: ἀνθρώπους ἐμπορίαν σου ἀπὸ πλήθους τοῦ συμμίκτου σου στακτὴν καὶ ποικίλματα ἐκ Θαρσις καὶ Ραμωθ καὶ Χορχορ ἔδωκαν τὴν ἀγοράν σου

text_en: Juda and the land of Israel , they were your merchants with the best corn: they set forth balm, and honey, and oil and rosin in your fairs.
text_la: Juda et terra Israël, ipsi institores tui in frumento primo : balsamum, et mel, et oleum, et resinam proposuerunt in nundinis tuis.
text_pt: Judá e a terra de Israel, eram os teus mercadores; pelas tuas mercadorias trocavam trigo de Minite, e Panague, e mel, azeite e bálsamo.
text_el: Ιουδας καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ Ισραηλ οὗτοι ἔμποροί σου ἐν σίτου πράσει καὶ μύρων καὶ κασίας καὶ πρῶτον μέλι καὶ ἔλαιον καὶ ῥητίνην ἔδωκαν εἰς τὸν σύμμικτόν σου

text_en: The men of Damascus were your merchants in the multitude of your works, in the multitude of divers riches , in rich wine, in wool of the best colour.
text_la: Damascenus negotiator tuus in multitudine operum tuorum, in multitudine diversarum opum, in vino pingui, in lanis coloris optimi.
text_pt: Damasco negociava contigo, por causa da multidão das tuas obras, por causa da abundância de toda a sorte de riqueza, dando em troca vinho de Helbom e lã branca.
text_el: Δαμασκὸς ἔμπορός σου ἐκ πλήθους πάσης δυνάμεώς σου οἶνος ἐκ Χελβων καὶ ἔρια ἐκ Μιλήτου

text_en: Dan , and Greece , and Mosel have set forth in your marts wrought iron: stacte, and calamus were in your market.
text_la: Dan, et Græcia, et Mosel, in nundinis tuis proposuerunt ferrum fabrefactum : stacte et calamus in negotiatione tua.
text_pt: Também Dã e Javã, de Uzal, pelas tuas mercadorias, davam em troca ferro trabalhado, cássia e cálamo aromático, que assim entravam no teu comércio.
text_el: καὶ οἶνον εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν σου ἔδωκαν ἐξ Ασηλ σίδηρος εἰργασμένος καὶ τροχὸς ἐν τῷ συμμίκτῳ σού ἐστιν

text_en: The men of Dedan were your merchants in tapestry for seats.
text_la: Dedan institores tui in tapetibus ad sedendum.
text_pt: Dedã negociava contigo com panos preciosos para carros.
text_el: Δαιδαν ἔμποροί σου μετὰ κτηνῶν ἐκλεκτῶν εἰς ἅρματα

text_en: Arabia , and all the princes of Cedar , they were the merchants of your hand: your merchants came to you with lambs, and rams, and kids.
text_la: Arabia et universi principes Cedar, ipsi negotiatores manus tuæ : cum agnis, et arietibus, et hædis, venerunt ad te negotiatores tui.
text_pt: A Arábia, e todos os príncipes de Quedar, eram mercadores ao teu serviço, com cordeiros, carneiros e bodes; nestas coisas negociavam contigo.
text_el: ἡ Ἀραβία καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες Κηδαρ οὗτοι ἔμποροί σου διὰ χειρός σου καμήλους καὶ κριοὺς καὶ ἀμνοὺς ἐν οἷς ἐμπορεύονταί σε

text_en: The sellers of Saba , and Reema, they were your merchants: with all the best spices, and precious stones , and gold, which they set forth in your market.
text_la: Venditores Saba et Reema, ipsi negotiatores tui : cum universis primis aromatibus, et lapide pretioso, et auro, quod proposuerunt in mercatu tuo.
text_pt: Os mercadores de Sabá e Raamá eram os teus mercadores; em todos os seus mais finos aromas, em toda a pedra preciosa e ouro, negociaram nas tuas feiras.
text_el: ἔμποροι Σαβα καὶ Ραγμα οὗτοι ἔμποροί σου μετὰ πρώτων ἡδυσμάτων καὶ λίθων χρηστῶν καὶ χρυσίον ἔδωκαν τὴν ἀγοράν σου

text_en: Haran , and Chene, and Eden were your merchants; Saba , Assur , and Chelmad sold to you.
text_la: Haran, et Chene, et Eden, negotiatores tui; Saba, Assur, et Chelmad venditores tui.
text_pt: Harã, e Cane e Éden, os mercadores de Sabá, Assur e Quilmade negociavam contigo.
text_el: Χαρραν καὶ Χαννα οὗτοι ἔμποροί σου Ασσουρ καὶ Χαρμαν ἔμποροί σου

text_en: They were your merchants in divers manners, with bales of blue cloth, and of embroidered work , and of precious riches, which were wrapped up and bound with cords: they had cedars also in your merchandise.
text_la: Ipsi negotiatores tui multifariam, involucris hyacinthi, et polymitorum, gazarumque pretiosarum, quæ obvolutæ et astrictæ erant funibus : cedros quoque habebant in negotiationibus tuis.
text_pt: Estes eram teus mercadores em roupas escolhidas, em pano de azul, e bordados, e em cofres de roupas preciosas, amarrados com cordas e feitos de cedros, entre tua mercadoria.
text_el: φέροντες ἐμπορίαν ὑάκινθον καὶ θησαυροὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς δεδεμένους σχοινίοις καὶ κυπαρίσσινα

text_en: The ships of the sea, were your chief in your merchandise: and you were replenished, and glorified exceedingly in the heart of the sea.
text_la: Naves maris, principes tui in negotiatione tua : et repleta es, et glorificata nimis in corde maris.
text_pt: Os navios de Társis eram as tuas caravanas que traziam tuas mercadorias; e te encheste, e te glorificaste muito no meio dos mares.
text_el: πλοῖα ἐν αὐτοῖς Καρχηδόνιοι ἔμποροί σου ἐν τῷ πλήθει ἐν τῷ συμμίκτῳ σου καὶ ἐνεπλήσθης καὶ ἐβαρύνθης σφόδρα ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης

text_en: Your rowers have brought you into great waters: the south wind has broken you in the heart of the sea.
text_la: In aquis multis adduxerunt te remiges tui : ventus auster contrivit te in corde maris.
text_pt: Os teus remadores te conduziram sobre grandes águas; o vento oriental te quebrou no meio dos mares.
text_el: ἐν ὕδατι πολλῷ ἦγόν σε οἱ κωπηλάται σου τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ νότου συνέτριψέν σε ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης

text_en: Your riches , and your treasures, and your manifold furniture, your mariners, and your pilots, who kept your goods , and were chief over your people: your men of war also, that were in you, with all your multitude that is in the midst of you: shall fall in the heart of the sea in the day of your ruin.
text_la: Divitiæ tuæ, et thesauri tui, et multiplex instrumentum tuum : nautæ tui et gubernatores tui, qui tenebant supellectilem tuam, et populo tuo præerant : viri quoque bellatores tui, qui erant in te, cum universa multitudine tua quæ est in medio tui, cadent in corde maris in die ruinæ tuæ :
text_pt: As tuas riquezas, as tuas feiras, e tuas mercadorias, os teus marinheiros, os teus pilotos, os que consertavam as tuas fendas, os que faziam os teus negócios, e todos os teus soldados, que estão em ti, juntamente com toda a tua companhia, que está no meio de ti, cairão no meio dos mares no dia da tua queda,
text_el: ἦσαν δυνάμεις σου καὶ ὁ μισθός σου καὶ τῶν συμμίκτων σου καὶ οἱ κωπηλάται σου καὶ οἱ κυβερνῆταί σου καὶ οἱ σύμβουλοί σου καὶ οἱ σύμμικτοί σου ἐκ τῶν συμμίκτων σου καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ πολεμισταί σου οἱ ἐν σοὶ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή σου ἐν μέσῳ σου πεσοῦνται ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς πτώσεώς σου

text_en: Your fleets shall be troubled at the sound of the cry of your pilots.
text_la: a sonitu clamoris gubernatorum tuorum conturbabuntur classes.
text_pt: Ao estrondo da gritaria dos teus pilotos tremerão os arrabaldes.
text_el: πρὸς τὴν φωνὴν τῆς κραυγῆς σου οἱ κυβερνῆταί σου φόβῳ φοβηθήσονται

text_en: And all that handled the oar shall come down from their ships: the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea shall stand upon the land:
text_la: Et descendent de navibus suis omnes qui tenebant remum : nautæ et universi gubernatores maris in terra stabunt.
text_pt: E todos os que pegam no remo, os marinheiros, e todos os pilotos do mar descerão de seus navios, e pararão em terra.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσονται ἀπὸ τῶν πλοίων πάντες οἱ κωπηλάται σου καὶ οἱ ἐπιβάται καὶ οἱ πρωρεῖς τῆς θαλάσσης ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν στήσονται

text_en: And they shall mourn over you with a loud voice and shall cry bitterly: and they shall cast up dust upon their heads and shall be sprinkled with ashes.
text_la: Et ejulabunt super te voce magna : et clamabunt amare, et superjacient pulverem capitibus suis, et cinere conspergentur.
text_pt: E farão ouvir a sua voz sobre ti, e gritarão amargamente; e lançarão pó sobre as cabeças, e na cinza se revolverão.
text_el: καὶ ἀλαλάξουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ τῇ φωνῇ αὐτῶν καὶ κεκράξονται πικρὸν καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν γῆν καὶ σποδὸν ὑποστρώσονται

text_en: And they shall shave themselves bald for you, and shall be girded with haircloth : and they shall weep for you with bitterness of soul , with most bitter weeping.
text_la: Et radent super te calvitium, et accingentur ciliciis : et plorabunt te in amaritudine animæ, ploratu amarissimo.
text_pt: E far-se-ão calvos por tua causa, e cingir-se-ão de sacos, e chorarão sobre ti com amargura de alma, e com amarga lamentação.

text_en: And they shall take up a mournful song for you, and shall lament you: What city is like Tyre , which has become silent in the midst of the sea?
text_la: Et assument super te carmen lugubre, et plangent te : Quæ est ut Tyrus, quæ obmutuit in medio maris?
text_pt: E no seu pranto levantarão uma lamentação sobre ti, e te lamentarão sobre ti, dizendo: Quem foi como Tiro, como a que foi destruída no meio do mar?
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἐπὶ σὲ θρῆνον καὶ θρήνημά σοι

text_en: Which by your merchandise that went from you by sea filled many people: which by the multitude of your riches , and of your people enriched the kings of the earth.
text_la: Quæ in exitu negotiationum tuarum de mari implesti populos multos : in multitudine divitiarum tuarum, et populorum tuorum, ditasti reges terræ.
text_pt: Quando as tuas mercadorias saiam pelos mares, fartaste a muitos povos; com a multidão das tuas riquezas e do teu negócio, enriqueceste os reis da terra.
text_el: πόσον τινὰ εὗρες μισθὸν ἀπὸ τῆς θαλάσσης ἐνέπλησας ἔθνη ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους σου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ συμμίκτου σου ἐπλούτισας πάντας βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς

text_en: Now you are destroyed by the sea, your riches are in the bottom of the waters, and all the multitude that was in the midst of you is fallen.
text_la: Nunc contrita es a mari : in profundis aquarum opes tuæ, et omnis multitudo tua quæ erat in medio tui, ceciderunt.
text_pt: No tempo em que foste quebrantada pelos mares, nas profundezas das águas, caíram, no meio de ti, os teus negócios e toda a tua companhia.
text_el: νῦν συνετρίβης ἐν θαλάσσῃ ἐν βάθει ὕδατος ὁ σύμμικτός σου καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή σου ἐν μέσῳ σου ἔπεσον πάντες οἱ κωπηλάται σου

text_en: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you: and all their kings being struck with the storm have changed their countenance.
text_la: Universi habitatores insularum obstupuerunt super te, et reges earum omnes tempestate perculsi mutaverunt vultus.
text_pt: Todos os moradores das ilhas estão a teu respeito cheios de espanto; e os seus reis tremeram sobremaneira, e ficaram perturbados nos seus rostos;
text_el: πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὰς νήσους ἐστύγνασαν ἐπὶ σέ καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἐκστάσει ἐξέστησαν καὶ ἐδάκρυσεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν

text_en: The merchants of people have hissed at you: you are brought to nothing, and you shall never be any more.
text_la: Negotiatores populorum sibilaverunt super te : ad nihilum deducta es, et non eris usque in perpetuum.
text_pt: Os mercadores dentre os povos assobiaram contra ti; tu te tornaste em grande espanto, e jamais subsistirá.
text_el: ἔμποροι ἀπὸ ἐθνῶν ἐσύρισάν σε ἀπώλεια ἐγένου καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , say to the prince of Tyre : Thus says the Lord God : Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said: I am God , and I sit in the chair of God in the heart of the sea: whereas you are a man , and not God : and have set your heart as if it were the heart of God .
text_la: Fili hominis, dic principi Tyri : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Eo quod elevatum est cor tuum, et dixisti : Deus ego sum, et in cathedra Dei sedi in corde maris, cum sis homo, et non deus : et dedisti cor tuum quasi cor Dei :
text_pt: Filho do homem, dize ao príncipe de Tiro: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto o teu coração se elevou e disseste: Eu sou Deus, sobre a cadeira de Deus me assento no meio dos mares; e não passas de homem, e não és Deus, ainda que estimas o teu coração como se fora o coração de Deus;
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰπὸν τῷ ἄρχοντι Τύρου τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ὑψώθη σου ἡ καρδία καὶ εἶπας θεός εἰμι ἐγώ κατοικίαν θεοῦ κατῴκηκα ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης σὺ δὲ εἶ ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐ θεὸς καὶ ἔδωκας τὴν καρδίαν σου ὡς καρδίαν θεοῦ

text_en: Behold you are wiser than Daniel : no secret is hid from you.
text_la: ecce sapientior es tu Daniele : omne secretum non est absconditum a te :
text_pt: Eis que tu és mais sábio que Daniel; e não há segredo algum que se possa esconder de ti.
text_el: μὴ σοφώτερος εἶ σὺ τοῦ Δανιηλ σοφοὶ οὐκ ἐπαίδευσάν σε τῇ ἐπιστήμῃ αὐτῶν

text_en: In your wisdom and your understanding you have made yourself strong: and have gotten gold and silver into your treasures.
text_la: in sapientia et prudentia tua fecisti tibi fortitudinem, et acquisisti aurum et argentum in thesauris tuis :
text_pt: Pela tua sabedoria e pelo teu entendimento alcançaste para ti riquezas, e adquiriste ouro e prata nos teus tesouros.
text_el: μὴ ἐν τῇ ἐπιστήμῃ σου ἢ ἐν τῇ φρονήσει σου ἐποίησας σεαυτῷ δύναμιν καὶ χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς σου

text_en: By the greatness of your wisdom, and by your traffic you have increased your strength: and your heart is lifted up with your strength.
text_la: in multitudine sapientiæ tuæ, et in negotiatione tua multiplicasti tibi fortitudinem, et elevatum est cor tuum in robore tuo :
text_pt: Pela extensão da tua sabedoria no teu comércio aumentaste as tuas riquezas; e eleva-se o teu coração por causa das tuas riquezas;
text_el: ἐν τῇ πολλῇ ἐπιστήμῃ σου καὶ ἐμπορίᾳ σου ἐπλήθυνας δύναμίν σου ὑψώθη ἡ καρδία σου ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord God : Because your heart is lifted up as the heart of God :
text_la: propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Eo quod elevatum est cor tuum quasi cor dei,
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto estimas o teu coração, como se fora o coração de Deus,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπειδὴ δέδωκας τὴν καρδίαν σου ὡς καρδίαν θεοῦ

text_en: Therefore behold, I will bring upon you strangers: the strongest of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they shall defile your beauty.
text_la: idcirco ecce ego adducam super te alienos, robustissimos gentium : et nudabunt gladios suos super pulchritudinem sapientiæ tuæ, et polluent decorem tuum.
text_pt: Por isso eis que eu trarei sobre ti estrangeiros, os mais terríveis dentre as nações, os quais desembainharão as suas espadas contra a formosura da tua sabedoria, e mancharão o teu resplendor.
text_el: ἀντὶ τούτου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ σὲ ἀλλοτρίους λοιμοὺς ἀπὸ ἐθνῶν καὶ ἐκκενώσουσιν τὰς μαχαίρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ κάλλος τῆς ἐπιστήμης σου καὶ στρώσουσιν τὸ κάλλος σου εἰς ἀπώλειαν

text_en: They shall kill you, and bring you down: and you shall die the death of them that are slain in the heart of the sea.
text_la: Interficient, et detrahent te : et morieris in interitu occisorum in corde maris.
text_pt: Eles te farão descer à cova e morrerás da morte dos traspassados no meio dos mares.
text_el: καὶ καταβιβάσουσίν σε καὶ ἀποθανῇ θανάτῳ τραυματιῶν ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης

text_en: Will you yet say before them that slay you: I am God ; whereas you are a man , and not God , in the hand of them that slay you?
text_la: Numquid dicens loqueris : Deus ego sum, coram interficientibus te, cum sis homo, et non deus, in manu occidentium te?
text_pt: Acaso dirás ainda diante daquele que te matar: Eu sou Deus? mas tu és homem, e não Deus, na mão do que te traspassa.
text_el: μὴ λέγων ἐρεῖς θεός εἰμι ἐγώ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀναιρούντων σε σὺ δὲ εἶ ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐ θεός ἐν πλήθει

text_en: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, says the Lord God .
text_la: Morte incircumcisorum morieris in manu alienorum, quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Da morte dos incircuncisos morrerás, por mão de estrangeiros, porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ἀπεριτμήτων ἀπολῇ ἐν χερσὶν ἀλλοτρίων ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐλάλησα λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying: Son of man , take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre :
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens : Fili hominis, leva planctum super regem Tyri,
text_pt: Veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: And say to him: Thus says the Lord God : You were the seal of resemblance, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
text_la: et dices ei : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Tu signaculum similitudinis, plenus sapientia, et perfectus decore.
text_pt: Filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre o rei de Tiro, e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Tu eras o selo da medida, cheio de sabedoria e perfeito em formosura.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου λαβὲ θρῆνον ἐπὶ τὸν ἄρχοντα Τύρου καὶ εἰπὸν αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος σὺ ἀποσφράγισμα ὁμοιώσεως καὶ στέφανος κάλλους

text_en: You were in the pleasures of the paradise of God : every precious stone was your covering: the sardius, the topaz, and the jasper, the chrysolite, and the onyx, and the beryl, the sapphire, and the carbuncle, and the emerald: gold the work of your beauty: and your pipes were prepared in the day that you were created .
text_la: In deliciis paradisi Dei fuisti : omnis lapis pretiosus operimentum tuum, sardius, topazius, et jaspis, chrysolithus, et onyx, et beryllus, sapphirus, et carbunculus, et smaragdus : aurum, opus decoris tui : et foramina tua, in die qua conditus es, præparata sunt.
text_pt: Estiveste no Éden, jardim de Deus; de toda a pedra preciosa era a tua cobertura: sardônia, topázio, diamante, turquesa, ônix, jaspe, safira, carbúnculo, esmeralda e ouro; em ti se faziam os teus tambores e os teus pífaros; no dia em que foste criado foram preparados.
text_el: ἐν τῇ τρυφῇ τοῦ παραδείσου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγενήθης πᾶν λίθον χρηστὸν ἐνδέδεσαι σάρδιον καὶ τοπάζιον καὶ σμάραγδον καὶ ἄνθρακα καὶ σάπφειρον καὶ ἴασπιν καὶ ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον καὶ λιγύριον καὶ ἀχάτην καὶ ἀμέθυστον καὶ χρυσόλιθον καὶ βηρύλλιον καὶ ὀνύχιον καὶ χρυσίου ἐνέπλησας τοὺς θησαυρούς σου καὶ τὰς ἀποθήκας σου ἐν σοὶ ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἐκτίσθης σύ

text_en: You a cherub stretched out, and protecting, and I set you in the holy mountain of God , you have walked in the midst of the stones of fire.
text_la: Tu cherub extentus, et protegens, et posui te in monte sancto Dei : in medio lapidum ignitorum ambulasti,
text_pt: Tu eras o querubim, ungido para cobrir, e te estabeleci; no monte santo de Deus estavas, no meio das pedras afogueadas andavas.
text_el: μετὰ τοῦ χερουβ ἔθηκά σε ἐν ὄρει ἁγίῳ θεοῦ ἐγενήθης ἐν μέσῳ λίθων πυρίνων

text_en: You were perfect in your ways from the day of your creation , until iniquity was found in you.
text_la: perfectus in viis tuis a die conditionis tuæ, donec inventa est iniquitas in te.
text_pt: Perfeito eras nos teus caminhos, desde o dia em que foste criado, até que se achou iniqüidade em ti.
text_el: ἐγενήθης ἄμωμος σὺ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις σου ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας σὺ ἐκτίσθης ἕως εὑρέθη τὰ ἀδικήματα ἐν σοί

text_en: By the multitude of your merchandise, your inner parts were filled with iniquity , and you have sinned : and I cast you out from the mountain of God , and destroyed you, O covering cherub , out of the midst of the stones of fire.
text_la: In multitudine negotiationis tuæ repleta sunt interiora tua iniquitate, et peccasti : et ejeci te de monte Dei, et perdidi te, o cherub protegens, de medio lapidum ignitorum.
text_pt: Na multiplicação do teu comércio encheram o teu interior de violência, e pecaste; por isso te lancei, profanado, do monte de Deus, e te fiz perecer, ó querubim cobridor, do meio das pedras afogueadas.
text_el: ἀπὸ πλήθους τῆς ἐμπορίας σου ἔπλησας τὰ ταμίειά σου ἀνομίας καὶ ἥμαρτες καὶ ἐτραυματίσθης ἀπὸ ὄρους τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἤγαγέν σε τὸ χερουβ ἐκ μέσου λίθων πυρίνων

text_en: And your heart was lifted up with your beauty: you have lost your wisdom in your beauty, I have cast you to the ground: I have set you before the face of kings, that they might behold you.
text_la: Et elevatum est cor tuum in decore tuo; perdidisti sapientiam tuam in decore tuo : in terram projeci te; ante faciem regum dedi te ut cernerent te.
text_pt: Elevou-se o teu coração por causa da tua formosura, corrompeste a tua sabedoria por causa do teu resplendor; por terra te lancei, diante dos reis te pus, para que olhem para ti.
text_el: ὑψώθη ἡ καρδία σου ἐπὶ τῷ κάλλει σου διεφθάρη ἡ ἐπιστήμη σου μετὰ τοῦ κάλλους σου διὰ πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν σου ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἔρριψά σε ἐναντίον βασιλέων ἔδωκά σε παραδειγματισθῆναι

text_en: You have defiled your sanctuaries by the multitude of your iniquities , and by the iniquity of your traffic: therefore I will bring forth a fire from the midst of you, to devour you, and I will make you as ashes upon the earth in the sight of all that see you.
text_la: In multitudine iniquitatum tuarum, et iniquitate negotiationis tuæ, polluisti sanctificationem tuam : producam ergo ignem de medio tui, qui comedat te, et dabo te in cinerem super terram, in conspectu omnium videntium te.
text_pt: Pela multidão das tuas iniqüidades, pela injustiça do teu comércio profanaste os teus santuários; eu, pois, fiz sair do meio de ti um fogo, que te consumiu e te tornei em cinza sobre a terra, aos olhos de todos os que te vêem.
text_el: διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν σου καὶ τῶν ἀδικιῶν τῆς ἐμπορίας σου ἐβεβήλωσας τὰ ἱερά σου καὶ ἐξάξω πῦρ ἐκ μέσου σου τοῦτο καταφάγεταί σε καὶ δώσω σε εἰς σποδὸν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς σου ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν ὁρώντων σε

text_en: All that shall see you among the nations , shall be astonished at you: you are brought to nothing, and you shall never be any more.
text_la: Omnes qui viderint te in gentibus, obstupescent super te : nihili factus es, et non eris in perpetuum.
text_pt: Todos os que te conhecem entre os povos estão espantados de ti; em grande espanto te tornaste, e nunca mais subsistirá.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐπιστάμενοί σε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν στυγνάσουσιν ἐπὶ σέ ἀπώλεια ἐγένου καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρξεις ἔτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , set your face against Sidon : and you shall prophesy of it,
text_la: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra Sidonem, et prophetabis de ea:
text_pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra Sidom, e profetiza contra ela,
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Σιδῶνα καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ' αὐτὴν

text_en: and shall say: Thus says the Lord God : Behold I come against you, Sidon , and I will be glorified in the midst of you: and they shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall execute judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
text_la: et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad te, Sidon, et glorificabor in medio tui : et scient quia ego Dominus, cum fecero in ea judicia, et sanctificatus fuero in ea.
text_pt: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis-me contra ti, ó Sidom, e serei glorificado no meio de ti; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando nela executar juízos e nela me santificar.
text_el: καὶ εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σέ Σιδών καὶ ἐνδοξασθήσομαι ἐν σοί καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἐν τῷ ποιῆσαί με ἐν σοὶ κρίματα καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν σοί

text_en: And I will send into her pestilence, and blood in her streets: and they shall fall being slain by the sword on all sides in the midst thereof: and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et immittam ei pestilentiam, et sanguinem in plateis ejus : et corruent interfecti in medio ejus gladio per circuitum, et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Porque enviarei contra ela a peste, e o sangue nas suas ruas, e os traspassados cairão no meio dela, estando a espada contra ela por todos os lados; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: αἷμα καὶ θάνατος ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις σου καὶ πεσοῦνται τετραυματισμένοι ἐν μαχαίραις ἐν σοὶ περικύκλῳ σου καὶ γνώσονται διότι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And the house of Israel shall have no more a stumbling block of bitterness, nor a thorn causing pain on every side round about them, of them that are against them: and they shall know that I am the Lord God .
text_la: Et non erit ultra domui Israël offendiculum amaritudinis, et spina dolorem inferens undique per circuitum eorum qui adversantur eis : et scient quia ego Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E a casa de Israel nunca mais terá espinho que a fira, nem espinho que cause dor, entre os que se acham ao redor deles e que os desprezam; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται οὐκέτι τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ Ισραηλ σκόλοψ πικρίας καὶ ἄκανθα ὀδύνης ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν περικύκλῳ αὐτῶν τῶν ἀτιμασάντων αὐτούς καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : When I shall have gathered together the house of Israel out of the people among whom they are scattered : I will be sanctified in them before the Gentiles : and they shall dwell in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quando congregavero domum Israël de populis in quibus dispersi sunt, sanctificabor in eis coram gentibus : et habitabunt in terra sua, quam dedi servo meo Jacob :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quando eu congregar a casa de Israel dentre os povos entre os quais estão espalhados, e eu me santificar entre eles, perante os olhos dos gentios, então habitarão na sua terra que dei a meu servo, a Jacó.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος καὶ συνάξω τὸν Ισραηλ ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὗ διεσκορπίσθησαν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐνώπιον τῶν λαῶν καὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν ἣν δέδωκα τῷ δούλῳ μου Ιακωβ

text_en: And they shall dwell therein secure, and they shall build houses, and shall plant vineyards, and shall dwell with confidence, when I shall have executed judgments upon all that are their enemies round about: and they shall know that I am the Lord their God .
text_la: et habitabunt in ea securi, et ædificabunt domos, et plantabunt vineas, et habitabunt confidenter, cum fecero judicia in omnibus qui adversantur eis per circuitum : et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum.
text_pt: E habitarão nela seguros, e edificarão casas, e plantarão vinhas, e habitarão seguros, quando eu executar juízos contra todos os que estão ao seu redor e que os desprezam; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἐν ἐλπίδι καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν οἰκίας καὶ φυτεύσουσιν ἀμπελῶνας καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐν ἐλπίδι ὅταν ποιήσω κρίμα ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀτιμάσασιν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς κύκλῳ αὐτῶν καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν

text_en: In the tenth year, the tenth month, the eleventh day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: In anno decimo, decimo mense, undecima die mensis, factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: No décimo ano, no décimo mês, no dia doze do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δεκάτῳ ἐν τῷ δεκάτῳ μηνὶ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , set your face against Pharao king of Egypt : and you shall prophesy of him, and of all Egypt :
text_la: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra Pharaonem regem Ægypti, et prophetabis de eo, et de Ægypto universa.
text_pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra Faraó, rei do Egito, e profetiza contra ele e contra todo o Egito.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον ὅλην

text_en: Speak, and say: Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I come against you, Pharao king of Egypt , you great dragon that lies in the midst of your rivers, and say: The river is mine, and I made myself.
text_la: Loquere, et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad te, Pharao rex Ægypti, draco magne, qui cubas in medio fluminum tuorum, et dicis : Meus est fluvius, et ego feci memetipsum.
text_pt: Fala, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis-me contra ti, ó Faraó, rei do Egito, grande dragão, que pousas no meio dos teus rios, e que dizes: O meu rio é meu, e eu o fiz para mim.
text_el: καὶ εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ Φαραω τὸν δράκοντα τὸν μέγαν τὸν ἐγκαθήμενον ἐν μέσῳ ποταμῶν αὐτοῦ τὸν λέγοντα ἐμοί εἰσιν οἱ ποταμοί καὶ ἐγὼ ἐποίησα αὐτούς

text_en: But I will put a bridle in your jaws: and I will cause the fish of your rivers to stick to your scales: and I will draw you out of the midst of your rivers, and all your fish shall stick to your scales.
text_la: Et ponam frenum in maxillis tuis, et agglutinabo pisces fluminum tuorum squamis tuis, et extraham te de medio fluminum tuorum, et universi pisces tui squamis tuis adhærebunt.
text_pt: Mas eu porei anzóis em teus queixos, e farei que os peixes dos teus rios se apeguem às tuas escamas; e tirar-te-ei do meio dos teus rios, e todos os peixes dos teus rios se apegarem às tuas escamas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ δώσω παγίδας εἰς τὰς σιαγόνας σου καὶ προσκολλήσω τοὺς ἰχθῦς τοῦ ποταμοῦ σου πρὸς τὰς πτέρυγάς σου καὶ ἀνάξω σε ἐκ μέσου τοῦ ποταμοῦ σου καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἰχθύας τοῦ ποταμοῦ σου

text_en: And I will cast you forth into the desert , and all the fish of your river: you shall fall upon the face of the earth, you shall not be taken up, nor gathered together: I have given you for meat to the beasts of the earth, and to the fowls of the air.
text_la: Et projiciam te in desertum, et omnes pisces fluminis tui : super faciem terræ cades; non colligeris, neque congregaberis : bestiis terræ et volatilibus cæli dedi te ad devorandum.
text_pt: E te deixarei no deserto, a ti e a todo o peixe dos teus rios; sobre a face do campo cairás; não serás recolhido nem ajuntado; aos animais da terra e às aves do céu te dei por mantimento.
text_el: καὶ καταβαλῶ σε ἐν τάχει καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἰχθύας τοῦ ποταμοῦ σου ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τοῦ πεδίου πεσῇ καὶ οὐ μὴ συναχθῇς καὶ οὐ μὴ περισταλῇς τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ δέδωκά σε εἰς κατάβρωμα

text_en: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the Lord : because you have been a staff of a reed to the house of Israel .
text_la: Et scient omnes habitatores Ægypti quia ego Dominus, pro eo quod fuisti baculus arundineus domui Israël :
text_pt: E saberão todos os moradores do Egito que eu sou o Senhor, porquanto se tornaram um bordão de cana para a casa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες Αἴγυπτον ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐγενήθης ῥάβδος καλαμίνη τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ

text_en: When they took hold of you with the hand you broke, and rent all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon you, you broke, and weakened all their loins.
text_la: quando apprehenderunt te manu, et confractus es, et lacerasti omnem humerum eorum : et innitentibus eis super te comminutus es, et dissolvisti omnes renes eorum.
text_pt: Tomando-te eles pela mão, te quebraste, e lhes rasgaste todo o ombro; e quando se apoiaram em ti, te quebraste, e lhes fazias tremer todos os seus lombos.
text_el: ὅτε ἐπελάβοντό σου τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῶν ἐθλάσθης καὶ ὅτε ἐπεκράτησεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς πᾶσα χεὶρ καὶ ὅτε ἐπανεπαύσαντο ἐπὶ σέ συνετρίβης καὶ συνέκλασας αὐτῶν πᾶσαν ὀσφύν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will bring the sword upon you: and cut off man and beast out of you.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego adducam super te gladium, et interficiam de te hominem et jumentum.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu trarei sobre ti a espada, e de ti destruirei homem e animal,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ σὲ ῥομφαίαν καὶ ἀπολῶ ἀνθρώπους ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ κτήνη

text_en: And the land of Egypt shall become a desert , and a wilderness : and they shall know that I am the Lord , because you have said: The river is mine, and I made it.
text_la: Et erit terra Ægypti in desertum et in solitudinem : et scient quia ego Dominus, pro eo quod dixeris : Fluvius meus est, et ego feci eum.
text_pt: E a terra do Egito se tornará em desolação e deserto; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor, porquanto disse: O rio é meu, e eu o fiz.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου ἀπώλεια καὶ ἔρημος καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἀντὶ τοῦ λέγειν σε οἱ ποταμοὶ ἐμοί εἰσιν καὶ ἐγὼ ἐποίησα αὐτούς

text_en: Therefore, behold I come against you, and your rivers: and I will make the land of Egypt utterly desolate, and wasted by the sword, from the tower of Syene , even to the borders of Ethiopia .
text_la: Idcirco ecce ego ad te, et ad flumina tua : daboque terram Ægypti in solitudines, gladio dissipatam, a turre Syenes usque ad terminos Æthiopiæ.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que eu estou contra ti, e contra os teus rios; e tornarei a terra do Egito deserta, em completa desolação, desde a torre de Syene até aos confins da Etiópia.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ποταμούς σου καὶ δώσω γῆν Αἰγύπτου εἰς ἔρημον καὶ ῥομφαίαν καὶ ἀπώλειαν ἀπὸ Μαγδώλου καὶ Συήνης καὶ ἕως ὁρίων Αἰθιόπων

text_en: The foot of man shall not pass through it, neither shall the foot of beasts go through it: nor shall it be inhabited during forty years.
text_la: Non pertransibit eam pes hominis, neque pes jumenti gradietur in ea, et non habitabitur quadraginta annis.
text_pt: Não passará por ela pé de homem, nem pé de animal passará por ela, nem será habitada quarenta anos.
text_el: οὐ μὴ διέλθῃ ἐν αὐτῇ ποὺς ἀνθρώπου καὶ ποὺς κτήνους οὐ μὴ διέλθῃ αὐτήν καὶ οὐ κατοικηθήσεται τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη

text_en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the lands that are desolate, and the cities thereof in the midst of the cities that are destroyed, and they shall be desolate for forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries.
text_la: Daboque terram Ægypti desertam in medio terrarum desertarum, et civitates ejus in medio urbium subversarum, et erunt desolatæ quadraginta annis : et dispergam Ægyptios in nationes, et ventilabo eos in terras.
text_pt: Porque tornarei a terra do Egito em desolação no meio das terras desoladas; e as suas cidades entre as cidades desertas se tornarão em desolação por quarenta anos; e espalharei os egípcios entre as nações, e os dispersarei pelas terras.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὴν γῆν αὐτῆς ἀπώλειαν ἐν μέσῳ γῆς ἠρημωμένης καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτῆς ἐν μέσῳ πόλεων ἠρημωμένων ἔσονται τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη καὶ διασπερῶ Αἴγυπτον ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ λικμήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χώρας

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the people among whom they had been scattered.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Post finem quadraginta annorum congregabo Ægyptum de populis in quibus dispersi fuerant.
text_pt: Porém, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ao fim de quarenta anos ajuntarei os egípcios dentre os povos entre os quais foram espalhados.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος μετὰ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη συνάξω τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὗ διεσκορπίσθησαν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And I will bring back the captivity of Egypt , and will place them in the land of Phatures, in the land of their nativity, and they shall be there a low kingdom:
text_la: Et reducam captivitatem Ægypti, et collocabo eos in terra Phathures, in terra nativitatis suæ, et erunt ibi in regnum humile.
text_pt: E removerei o cativeiro dos egípcios, e os farei voltar à terra de Patros, à terra de sua origem; e serão ali um reino humilde;
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων καὶ κατοικίσω αὐτοὺς ἐν γῇ Παθουρης ἐν τῇ γῇ ὅθεν ἐλήμφθησαν καὶ ἔσται ἀρχὴ ταπεινὴ

text_en: It shall be the lowest among other kingdoms, and it shall no more be exalted over the nations , and I will diminish them that they shall rule no more over the nations .
text_la: Inter cetera regna erit humillima, et non elevabitur ultra super nationes, et imminuam eos ne imperent gentibus.
text_pt: Mais humilde se fará do que os outros reinos, e nunca mais se exalçará sobre as nações; porque os diminuirei, para que não dominem sobre as nações.
text_el: παρὰ πάσας τὰς ἀρχάς οὐ μὴ ὑψωθῇ ἔτι ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη καὶ ὀλιγοστοὺς αὐτοὺς ποιήσω τοῦ μὴ εἶναι αὐτοὺς πλείονας ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: And they shall be no more a confidence to the house of Israel , teaching iniquity , that they may flee, and follow them: and they shall know that I am the Lord God .
text_la: Neque erunt ultra domui Israël in confidentia, docentes iniquitatem ut fugiant, et sequantur eos : et scient quia ego Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E não será mais a confiança da casa de Israel, para lhes trazer à lembrança a sua iniqüidade, quando olharem para trás deles; antes saberão que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσονται τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ εἰς ἐλπίδα ἀναμιμνῄσκουσαν ἀνομίαν ἐν τῷ αὐτοὺς ἀκολουθῆσαι ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year in the first month, in the first of the month: that the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est in vigesimo et septimo anno, in primo, in una mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, no ano vinte e sete, no primeiro mês, no primeiro dia do mês, veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑβδόμῳ καὶ εἰκοστῷ ἔτει μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon has made his army to undergo hard service against Tyre : every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled and there has been no reward given him, nor his army for Tyre , for the service that he rendered me against it.
text_la: Fili hominis, Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis servire fecit exercitum suum servitute magna adversum Tyrum : omne caput decalvatum, et omnis humerus depilatus est : et merces non est reddita ei, neque exercitui ejus, de Tyro, pro servitute qua servivit mihi adversus eam.
text_pt: Filho do homem, Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, fez com que o seu exército prestasse um grande serviço contra Tiro; toda a cabeça se tornou calva, e todo o ombro se pelou; e não houve paga de Tiro para ele, nem para o seu exército, pelo serviço que prestou contra ela.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος κατεδουλώσατο αὐτοῦ τὴν δύναμιν δουλείᾳ μεγάλῃ ἐπὶ Τύρου πᾶσα κεφαλὴ φαλακρὰ καὶ πᾶς ὦμος μαδῶν καὶ μισθὸς οὐκ ἐγενήθη αὐτῷ καὶ τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Τύρου καὶ τῆς δουλείας ἧς ἐδούλευσαν ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will set Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon in the land of Egypt : and he shall take her multitude, and take the booty thereof for a prey, and rifle the spoils thereof: and it shall be wages for his army.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego dabo Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis in terra Ægypti : et accipiet multitudinem ejus, et deprædabitur manubias ejus, et diripiet spolia ejus : et erit merces exercitui illius,
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu darei a Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, a terra do Egito; e levará a sua multidão, e tomará o seu despojo, e roubará a sua presa, e isto será a recompensa para o seu exército.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἰδοὺ δίδωμι τῷ Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος γῆν Αἰγύπτου καὶ προνομεύσει τὴν προνομὴν αὐτῆς καὶ σκυλεύσει τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς καὶ ἔσται μισθὸς τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ

text_en: And for the service that he has done me against it: I have given him the land of Egypt , because he has laboured for me, says the Lord God .
text_la: et operi quo servivit adversus eam : dedi ei terram Ægypti pro eo quod laboraverit mihi, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Como recompensa do seu trabalho, com que serviu contra ela, lhe dei a terra do Egito; porquanto trabalharam por mim, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ἀντὶ τῆς λειτουργίας αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐδούλευσεν ἐπὶ Τύρον δέδωκα αὐτῷ γῆν Αἰγύπτου τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος

text_en: In that day a horn shall bud forth to the house of Israel , and I will give you an open mouth in the midst of them: and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: In die illo pullulabit cornu domui Israël, et tibi dabo apertum os in medio eorum, et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Naquele dia farei brotar o poder na casa de Israel, e abrirei a tua boca no meio deles; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀνατελεῖ κέρας παντὶ τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ καὶ σοὶ δώσω στόμα ἀνεῳγμένον ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man prophesy , and say: Thus says the Lord God : Howl, Woe, woe to the day:
text_la: Fili hominis, propheta, et dic : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ululate : Væ, væ diei!
text_pt: Filho do homem, profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Gemei: Ah! Aquele dia!
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον καὶ εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ὦ ὦ ἡ ἡμέρα

text_en: For the day is near, yea the day of the Lord is near: a cloudy day, it shall be the time of the nations .
text_la: quia juxta est dies, et appropinquat dies Domini, dies nubis : tempus gentium erit.
text_pt: Porque está perto o dia, sim, está perto o dia do Senhor; dia nublado; será o tempo dos gentios.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμέρα πέρας ἐθνῶν ἔσται

text_en: And the sword shall come upon Egypt : and there shall be dread in Ethiopia , when the wounded shall fall in Egypt , and the multitude thereof shall be taken away, and the foundations thereof shall be destroyed.
text_la: Et veniet gladius in Ægyptum, et erit pavor in Æthiopia, cum ceciderint vulnerati in Ægypto, et ablata fuerit multitudo illius, et destructa fundamenta ejus.
text_pt: A espada virá ao Egito, e haverá grande dor na Etiópia, quando caírem os traspassados no Egito; e tomarão a sua multidão, e serão destruídos os seus fundamentos.
text_el: καὶ ἥξει μάχαιρα ἐπ' Αἰγυπτίους καὶ ἔσται ταραχὴ ἐν τῇ Αἰθιοπίᾳ καὶ πεσοῦνται τετραυματισμένοι ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ συμπεσεῖται αὐτῆς τὰ θεμέλια

text_en: Ethiopia , and Libya, and Lydia, and all the rest of the crowd, and Chub, and the children of the land of the covenant, shall fall with them by the sword.
text_la: Æthiopia, et Libya, et Lydi, et omne reliquum vulgus, et Chub, et filii terræ fœderis, cum eis gladio cadent.
text_pt: Etiópia, Pute e Lude, e toda a mistura de gente, e Cube, e os homens da terra da liga, juntamente com eles cairão à espada.
text_el: Πέρσαι καὶ Κρῆτες καὶ Λυδοὶ καὶ Λίβυες καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐπίμικτοι καὶ τῶν υἱῶν τῆς διαθήκης μου μαχαίρᾳ πεσοῦνται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : They also that uphold Egypt shall fall, and the pride of her empire shall be brought down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, says the Lord the God of hosts .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Et corruent fulcientes Ægyptum, et destruetur superbia imperii ejus : a turre Syenes gladio cadent in ea, ait Dominus Deus exercituum.
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Também cairão os que sustém o Egito, e descerá a soberba de seu poder; desde a torre de Syene ali cairão à espada, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ πεσοῦνται τὰ ἀντιστηρίγματα Αἰγύπτου καὶ καταβήσεται ἡ ὕβρις τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτῆς ἀπὸ Μαγδώλου ἕως Συήνης μαχαίρᾳ πεσοῦνται ἐν αὐτῇ λέγει κύριος

text_en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the lands that are desolate, and the cities thereof shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
text_la: Et dissipabuntur in medio terrarum desolatarum, et urbes ejus in medio civitatum desertarum erunt :
text_pt: E serão desolados no meio das terras assoladas; e as suas cidades estarão no meio das cidades desertas.
text_el: καὶ ἐρημωθήσεται ἐν μέσῳ χωρῶν ἠρημωμένων καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν ἐν μέσῳ πόλεων ἠρημωμένων ἔσονται

text_en: And they shall know that I am the Lord : when I shall have set a fire in Egypt , and all the helpers thereof shall be destroyed.
text_la: et scient quia ego Dominus, cum dedero ignem in Ægypto, et attriti fuerint omnes auxiliatores ejus.
text_pt: E saberão que eu sou o Senhor, quando eu puser fogo no Egito, e forem destruídos todos os que lhe davam auxílio.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὅταν δῶ πῦρ ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ συντριβῶσι πάντες οἱ βοηθοῦντες αὐτῇ

text_en: In that day shall messengers go forth from my face in ships to destroy the confidence of Ethiopia , and there shall be dread among them in the day of Egypt : because it shall certainly come.
text_la: In die illa egredientur nuntii a facie mea in trieribus ad conterendam Æthiopiæ confidentiam : et erit pavor in eis in die Ægypti, quia absque dubio veniet.
text_pt: Naquele dia sairão mensageiros de diante de mim em navios, para espantarem a Etiópia descuidada; e haverá neles grandes dores, como no dia do Egito; pois, eis que já vem.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐξελεύσονται ἄγγελοι σπεύδοντες ἀφανίσαι τὴν Αἰθιοπίαν καὶ ἔσται ταραχὴ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ Αἰγύπτου ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἥκει

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : I will make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Cessare faciam multitudinem Ægypti in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu, pois, farei cessar a multidão do Egito, por mão de Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος καὶ ἀπολῶ πλῆθος Αἰγυπτίων διὰ χειρὸς Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: He and his people with him, the strongest of nations , shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords upon Egypt : and shall fill the land with the slain .
text_la: Ipse et populus ejus cum eo, fortissimi gentium, adducentur ad disperdendam terram : et evaginabunt gladios suos super Ægyptum, et implebunt terram interfectis.
text_pt: Ele e o seu povo com ele, os mais terríveis das nações, serão levados para destruírem a terra; e desembainharão as suas espadas contra o Egito, e encherão a terra de mortos.
text_el: αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ λοιμοὶ ἀπὸ ἐθνῶν ἀπεσταλμένοι ἀπολέσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐκκενώσουσιν πάντες τὰς μαχαίρας αὐτῶν ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ πλησθήσεται ἡ γῆ τραυματιῶν

text_en: And I will make the channels of the rivers dry, and will deliver the land into the hand of the wicked : and will lay waste the land and all that is therein by the hands of strangers, I the Lord have spoken it.
text_la: Et faciam alveos fluminum aridos, et tradam terram in manus pessimorum : et dissipabo terram et plenitudinem ejus manu alienorum : ego Dominus locutus sum.
text_pt: E secarei os rios, e venderei a terra entregando-a na mão dos maus, e assolarei a terra e a sua plenitude pela mão dos estrangeiros; eu, o Senhor, o disse.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τοὺς ποταμοὺς αὐτῶν ἐρήμους καὶ ἀπολῶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς ἐν χερσὶν ἀλλοτρίων ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : I will also destroy the idols , and I will make an end of the idols of Memphis : and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt and I will cause a terror in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Et disperdam simulacra, et cessare faciam idola de Memphis : et dux de terra Ægypti non erit amplius, et dabo terrorem in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Também destruirei os ídolos, e farei cessar as imagens de Nofe; e não haverá mais um príncipe da terra do Egito; e porei o temor na terra do Egito.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος καὶ ἀπολῶ μεγιστᾶνας ἀπὸ Μέμφεως καὶ ἄρχοντας ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται ἔτι

text_en: And I will destroy the land of Phatures, and will make a fire in Taphnis, and will execute judgments in Alexandria .
text_la: Et disperdam terram Phathures, et dabo ignem in Taphnis, et faciam judicia in Alexandria.
text_pt: E assolarei a Patros, e porei fogo a Zoã, e executarei juízos em Nô.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολῶ γῆν Παθουρης καὶ δώσω πῦρ ἐπὶ Τάνιν καὶ ποιήσω ἐκδίκησιν ἐν Διοσπόλει

text_en: And I will pour out my indignation upon Pelusium the strength of Egypt , and will cut off the multitude of Alexandria .
text_la: Et effundam indignationem meam super Pelusium, robur Ægypti, et interficiam multitudinem Alexandriæ.
text_pt: E derramarei o meu furor sobre Sim, a fortaleza do Egito, e exterminarei a multidão de Nô.
text_el: καὶ ἐκχεῶ τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπὶ Σάιν τὴν ἰσχὺν Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἀπολῶ τὸ πλῆθος Μέμφεως

text_en: And I will make a fire in Egypt : Pelusium shall be in pain like a woman in labour, and Alexandria shall be laid waste, and in Memphis there shall be daily distresses.
text_la: Et dabo ignem in Ægypto : quasi parturiens dolebit Pelusium, et Alexandria erit dissipata, et in Memphis angustiæ quotidianæ.
text_pt: E porei fogo no Egito; Sim terá grande dor, e Nô será fendida, e Nofe terá angústias cotidianas.
text_el: καὶ δώσω πῦρ ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ ταραχὴν ταραχθήσεται Συήνη καὶ ἐν Διοσπόλει ἔσται ἔκρηγμα καὶ διαχυθήσεται ὕδατα

text_en: The young men of Heliopolis, and of Bubastus shall fall by the sword, and they themselves shall go into captivity.
text_la: Juvenes Heliopoleos et Bubasti gladio cadent, et ipsæ captivæ ducentur.
text_pt: Os jovens de Áven e Pi-Besete cairão à espada, e as cidades irão em cativeiro.
text_el: νεανίσκοι ἡλίου πόλεως καὶ Βουβάστου ἐν μαχαίρᾳ πεσοῦνται καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ πορεύσονται

text_en: And in Taphnis the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the sceptres of Egypt , and the pride of her power shall cease in her: a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall be led into captivity.
text_la: Et in Taphnis nigrescet dies, cum contrivero ibi sceptra Ægypti, et defecerit in ea superbia potentiæ ejus : ipsam nubes operiet, filiæ autem ejus in captivitatem ducentur.
text_pt: E em Tafnes se escurecerá o dia, quando eu quebrar ali os jugos do Egito, e nela cessar a soberba do seu poder; uma nuvem a cobrirá, e suas filhas irão em cativeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐν Ταφνας συσκοτάσει ἡ ἡμέρα ἐν τῷ συντρῖψαι με ἐκεῖ τὰ σκῆπτρα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἀπολεῖται ἐκεῖ ἡ ὕβρις τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτῆς καὶ αὐτὴν νεφέλη καλύψει καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῆς αἰχμάλωτοι ἀχθήσονται

text_en: And I will execute judgments in Egypt : and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et judicia faciam in Ægypto : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Assim executarei juízos no Egito, e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσω κρίμα ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est in undecimo anno, in primo mense, in septima mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, no ano undécimo, no primeiro mês, aos sete do mês, veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ ἔτει ἐν τῷ πρώτῳ μηνὶ ἑβδόμῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , I have broken the arm of Pharao king of Egypt : and behold it is not bound up, to be healed, to be tied up with clothes, and swathed with linen, that it might recover strength, and hold the sword.
text_la: Fili hominis, brachium Pharaonis regis Ægypti confregi, et ecce non est obvolutum ut restitueretur ei sanitas, ut ligaretur pannis, et fasciaretur linteolis, ut recepto robore posset tenere gladium.
text_pt: Filho do homem, eu quebrei o braço de Faraó, rei do Egito, e eis que não foi atado para se lhe aplicar remédios, nem lhe colocarão ligaduras para o atar, a fim de torná-lo forte, para pegar na espada.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τοὺς βραχίονας Φαραω βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου συνέτριψα καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐ κατεδέθη τοῦ δοθῆναι ἴασιν τοῦ δοθῆναι ἐπ' αὐτὸν μάλαγμα τοῦ δοθῆναι ἰσχὺν ἐπιλαβέσθαι μαχαίρας

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord God : Behold, I come against Pharao king of Egypt , and I will break into pieces his strong arm, which is already broken: and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand:
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti, et comminuam brachium ejus forte, sed confractum : et dejiciam gladium de manu ejus,
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu estou contra Faraó, rei do Egito, e quebrarei os seus braços, assim o forte como o que está quebrado, e farei cair da sua mão a espada.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ συντρίψω τοὺς βραχίονας αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἰσχυροὺς καὶ τοὺς τεταμένους καὶ καταβαλῶ τὴν μάχαιραν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I will disperse Egypt among the nations , and scatter them through the countries.
text_la: et dispergam Ægyptum in gentibus, et ventilabo eos in terris.
text_pt: E espalharei os egípcios entre as nações, e os dispersarei pelas terras.
text_el: καὶ διασπερῶ Αἴγυπτον εἰς τὰ ἔθνη καὶ λικμήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χώρας

text_en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and will put my sword in his hand: and I will break the arms of Pharao , and they shall groan bitterly being slain before his face.
text_la: Et confortabo brachia regis Babylonis, daboque gladium meum in manu ejus, et confringam brachia Pharaonis, et gement gemitibus interfecti coram facie ejus.
text_pt: E fortalecerei os braços do rei de babilônia, e porei a minha espada na sua mão; mas quebrarei os braços de Faraó, e diante dele gemerá como geme o traspassado.
text_el: καὶ κατισχύσω τοὺς βραχίονας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ δώσω τὴν ῥομφαίαν μου εἰς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάξει αὐτὴν ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ προνομεύσει τὴν προνομὴν αὐτῆς καὶ σκυλεύσει τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and the arms of Pharao shall fall: and they shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall have given my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall have stretched it forth upon the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et confortabo brachia regis Babylonis, et brachia Pharaonis concident : et scient quia ego Dominus, cum dedero gladium meum in manu regis Babylonis, et extenderit eum super terram Ægypti.
text_pt: Eu fortalecerei os braços do rei de babilônia, mas os braços de Faraó cairão; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu puser a minha espada na mão do rei de babilônia, e ele a estender sobre a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐνισχύσω τοὺς βραχίονας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος οἱ δὲ βραχίονες Φαραω πεσοῦνται καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἐν τῷ δοῦναι τὴν ῥομφαίαν μου εἰς χεῖρας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἐκτενεῖ αὐτὴν ἐπὶ γῆν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And I will disperse Egypt among the nations , and will scatter them through the countries, and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et dispergam Ægyptum in nationes, et ventilabo eos in terras : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E espalharei os egípcios entre as nações, e os dispersarei entre as terras; assim saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ διασπερῶ Αἴγυπτον εἰς τὰ ἔθνη καὶ λικμήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χώρας καὶ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, the third month the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est in anno undecimo, tertio mense, una mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E sucedeu, no ano undécimo, no terceiro mês, ao primeiro do mês, que veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ ἔτει ἐν τῷ τρίτῳ μηνὶ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , speak to Pharao king of Egypt , and to his people: To whom are you like in your greatness?
text_la: Fili hominis, dic Pharaoni regi Ægypti et populo ejus : Cui similis factus es in magnitudine tua?
text_pt: Filho do homem, dize a Faraó, rei do Egito, e à sua multidão: A quem és semelhante na tua grandeza?
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰπὸν πρὸς Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ τῷ πλήθει αὐτοῦ τίνι ὡμοίωσας σεαυτὸν ἐν τῷ ὕψει σου

text_en: Behold, the Assyrian was like a cedar in Libanus , with fair branches, and full of leaves, of a high stature, and his top was elevated among the thick boughs.
text_la: ecce Assur quasi cedrus in Libano, pulcher ramis, et frondibus nemorosus, excelsusque altitudine, et inter condensas frondes elevatum est cacumen ejus.
text_pt: Eis que a Assíria era um cedro no Líbano, de ramos formosos, de sombrosa ramagem e de alta estatura, e a sua copa estava entre os ramos espessos.
text_el: ἰδοὺ Ασσουρ κυπάρισσος ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ καὶ καλὸς ταῖς παραφυάσιν καὶ ὑψηλὸς τῷ μεγέθει εἰς μέσον νεφελῶν ἐγένετο ἡ ἀρχὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The waters nourished him, the deep set him up on high, the streams thereof ran round about his roots, and it sent forth its rivulets to all the trees of the country.
text_la: Aquæ nutrierunt illum; abyssus exaltavit illum : flumina ejus manabant in circuitu radicum ejus, et rivos suos emisit ad universa ligna regionis.
text_pt: As águas o fizeram crescer, o abismo o exalçou; as suas correntes corriam em torno da sua plantação, e ele enviava os regatos a todas as árvores do campo.
text_el: ὕδωρ ἐξέθρεψεν αὐτόν ἡ ἄβυσσος ὕψωσεν αὐτόν τοὺς ποταμοὺς αὐτῆς ἤγαγεν κύκλῳ τῶν φυτῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ συστέματα αὐτῆς ἐξαπέστειλεν εἰς πάντα τὰ ξύλα τοῦ πεδίου

text_en: Therefore was his height exalted above all the trees of the country and his branches were multiplied, and his boughs were elevated because of many waters.
text_la: Propterea elevata est altitudo ejus super omnia ligna regionis, et multiplicata sunt arbusta ejus, et elevati sunt rami ejus præ aquis multis.
text_pt: Por isso se elevou a sua estatura sobre todas as árvores do campo, e se multiplicaram os seus ramos, e se alongaram as suas varas, por causa das muitas águas quando brotava.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τούτου ὑψώθη τὸ μέγεθος αὐτοῦ παρὰ πάντα τὰ ξύλα τοῦ πεδίου καὶ ἐπλατύνθησαν οἱ κλάδοι αὐτοῦ ἀφ' ὕδατος πολλοῦ

text_en: And when he had spread forth his shadow, all the fowls of the air made their nests in his boughs, and all the beasts of the forest brought forth their young under his branches, and the assembly of many nations dwelt under his shadow.
text_la: Cumque extendisset umbram suam, in ramis ejus fecerunt nidos omnia volatilia cæli : et sub frondibus ejus genuerunt omnes bestiæ saltuum, et sub umbraculo illius habitabat cœtus gentium plurimarum.
text_pt: Todas as aves do céu se aninhavam nos seus ramos, e todos os animais do campo geravam debaixo dos seus ramos, e todas as grandes nações habitavam à sua sombra.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς παραφυάσιν αὐτοῦ ἐνόσσευσαν πάντα τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὑποκάτω τῶν κλάδων αὐτοῦ ἐγεννῶσαν πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ πεδίου ἐν τῇ σκιᾷ αὐτοῦ κατῴκησεν πᾶν πλῆθος ἐθνῶν

text_en: And he was most beautiful for his greatness, and for the spreading of his branches: for his root was near great waters.
text_la: Eratque pulcherrimus in magnitudine sua, et in dilatatione arbustorum suorum : erat enim radix illius juxta aquas multas.
text_pt: Assim era ele formoso na sua grandeza, na extensão dos seus ramos, porque a sua raiz estava junto às muitas águas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο καλὸς ἐν τῷ ὕψει αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν κλάδων αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐγενήθησαν αἱ ῥίζαι αὐτοῦ εἰς ὕδωρ πολύ

text_en: The cedars in the paradise of God were not higher than he, the fir trees did not equal his top, neither were the plane trees to be compared with him for branches: no tree in the paradise of God was like him in his beauty.
text_la: Cedri non fuerunt altiores illo in paradiso Dei; abietes non adæquaverunt summitatem ejus, et platani non fuerunt æquæ frondibus illius : omne lignum paradisi Dei non est assimilatum illi, et pulchritudini ejus.
text_pt: Os cedros, no jardim de Deus, não o podiam obscurecer; as faias não igualavam os seus ramos, e os castanheiros não eram como os seus renovos; nenhuma árvore no jardim de Deus se assemelhou a ele na sua formosura.
text_el: κυπάρισσοι τοιαῦται οὐκ ἐγενήθησαν ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πίτυες οὐχ ὅμοιαι ταῖς παραφυάσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάται οὐκ ἐγένοντο ὅμοιαι τοῖς κλάδοις αὐτοῦ πᾶν ξύλον ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐχ ὡμοιώθη αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ κάλλει αὐτοῦ

text_en: For I made him beautiful and thick set with many branches: and all the trees of pleasure, that were in the paradise of God , envied him.
text_la: Quoniam speciosum feci eum, et multis condensisque frondibus, et æmulata sunt eum omnia ligna voluptatis quæ erant in paradiso Dei.
text_pt: Formoso o fiz com a multidão dos seus ramos; e todas as árvores do Éden, que estavam no jardim de Deus, tiveram inveja dele.
text_el: διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν κλάδων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐζήλωσεν αὐτὸν τὰ ξύλα τοῦ παραδείσου τῆς τρυφῆς τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because he was exalted in height, and shot up his top green and thick, and his heart was lifted up in his height:
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod sublimatus est in altitudine, et dedit summitatem suam virentem atque condensam, et elevatum est cor ejus in altitudine sua :
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto te elevaste na tua estatura, e se levantou a sua copa no meio dos espessos ramos, e o seu coração se exalçou na sua altura,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ἐγένου μέγας τῷ μεγέθει καὶ ἔδωκας τὴν ἀρχήν σου εἰς μέσον νεφελῶν καὶ εἶδον ἐν τῷ ὑψωθῆναι αὐτόν

text_en: I have delivered him into the hands of the mighty one of the nations , he shall deal with him: I have cast him out according to his wickedness .
text_la: tradidi eum in manu fortissimi gentium : faciens faciet ei : juxta impietatem ejus ejeci eum.
text_pt: Eu o entregarei na mão do mais poderoso dos gentios, que lhe dará o tratamento merecido; pela sua impiedade o lançarei fora.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκα αὐτὸν εἰς χεῖρας ἄρχοντος ἐθνῶν καὶ ἐποίησεν τὴν ἀπώλειαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And strangers, and the most cruel of the nations shall cut him down, and cast him away upon the mountains, and his boughs shall fall in every valley, and his branches shall be broken on every rock of the country: and all the people of the earth shall depart from his shadow, and leave him.
text_la: Et succident eum alieni, et crudelissimi nationum, et projicient eum super montes : et in cunctis convallibus corruent rami ejus, et confringentur arbusta ejus in universis rupibus terræ : et recedent de umbraculo ejus omnes populi terræ, et relinquent eum.
text_pt: E estrangeiros, das mais terríveis nações o cortarão, e deixá-lo-ão; cairão os seus ramos sobre os montes e por todos os vales, e os seus renovos serão quebrados por todos os rios da terra; e todos os povos da terra se retirarão da sua sombra, e o deixarão.
text_el: καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσαν αὐτὸν ἀλλότριοι λοιμοὶ ἀπὸ ἐθνῶν καὶ κατέβαλον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ἐν πάσαις ταῖς φάραγξιν ἔπεσαν οἱ κλάδοι αὐτοῦ καὶ συνετρίβη τὰ στελέχη αὐτοῦ ἐν παντὶ πεδίῳ τῆς γῆς καὶ κατέβησαν ἀπὸ τῆς σκέπης αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ λαοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ ἠδάφισαν αὐτόν

text_en: All the fowls of the air dwelt upon his ruins, and all the beasts of the field were among his branches.
text_la: In ruina ejus habitaverunt omnia volatilia cæli, et in ramis ejus fuerunt universæ bestiæ regionis.
text_pt: Todas as aves do céu habitarão sobre a sua ruína, e todos os animais do campo se acolherão sob os seus renovos;
text_el: ἐπὶ τὴν πτῶσιν αὐτοῦ ἀνεπαύσαντο πάντα τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ στελέχη αὐτοῦ ἐγένοντο πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ

text_en: For which cause none of the trees by the waters shall exalt themselves for their height: nor shoot up their tops among the thick branches and leaves, neither shall any of them that are watered stand up in their height: for they are all delivered unto death to the lowest parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men , with them that go down into the pit.
text_la: Quam ob rem non elevabuntur in altitudine sua omnia ligna aquarum, nec ponent sublimitatem suam inter nemorosa atque frondosa, nec stabunt in sublimitate sua omnia quæ irrigantur aquis : quia omnes traditi sunt in mortem ad terram ultimam, in medio filiorum hominum, ad eos qui descendunt in lacum.
text_pt: Para que todas as árvores junto às águas não se exaltem na sua estatura, nem levantem a sua copa no meio dos ramos espessos, nem as que bebem as águas venham a confiar em si, por causa da sua altura; porque todos estão entregues à morte, até à terra mais baixa, no meio dos filhos dos homens, com os que descem à cova.
text_el: ὅπως μὴ ὑψωθῶσιν ἐν τῷ μεγέθει αὐτῶν πάντα τὰ ξύλα τὰ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκαν τὴν ἀρχὴν αὐτῶν εἰς μέσον νεφελῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔστησαν ἐν τῷ ὕψει αὐτῶν πρὸς αὐτὰ πάντες οἱ πίνοντες ὕδωρ πάντες ἐδόθησαν εἰς θάνατον εἰς γῆς βάθος ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν ἀνθρώπων πρὸς καταβαίνοντας εἰς βόθρον

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : In the day when he went down to hell, I brought in mourning, I covered him with the deep : and I withheld its rivers, and restrained the many waters: Libanus grieved for him, and all the trees of the field trembled.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : In die quando descendit ad inferos, induxi luctum : operui eum abysso, et prohibui flumina ejus, et coërcui aquas multas : contristatus est super eum Libanus, et omnia ligna agri concussa sunt.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia em que ele desceu ao inferno, fiz eu que houvesse luto; fiz cobrir o abismo, por sua causa, e retive as suas correntes, e detiveram-se as muitas águas; e cobri o Líbano de preto por causa dele, e todas as árvores do campo por causa dele desfaleceram.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ κατέβη εἰς ᾅδου ἐπένθησεν αὐτὸν ἡ ἄβυσσος καὶ ἐπέστησα τοὺς ποταμοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ ἐκώλυσα πλῆθος ὕδατος καὶ ἐσκότασεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν ὁ Λίβανος πάντα τὰ ξύλα τοῦ πεδίου ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐξελύθησαν

text_en: I shook the nations with the sound of his fall, when I brought him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of pleasure, the choice and best in Libanus , all that were moistened with waters, were comforted in the lowest parts of the earth.
text_la: A sonitu ruinæ ejus commovi gentes cum deducerem eum ad infernum cum his qui descendebant in lacum : et consolata sunt in terra infima omnia ligna voluptatis egregia atque præclara in Libano, universa quæ irrigabantur aquis.
text_pt: Ao som da sua queda fiz tremer as nações, quando o fiz descer ao inferno, com os que descem à cova; e todas as árvores do Éden, a flor e o melhor do Líbano, todas as árvores que bebem águas, se consolavam nas partes mais baixas da terra.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς τῆς πτώσεως αὐτοῦ ἐσείσθησαν τὰ ἔθνη ὅτε κατεβίβαζον αὐτὸν εἰς ᾅδου μετὰ τῶν καταβαινόντων εἰς λάκκον καὶ παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν ἐν γῇ πάντα τὰ ξύλα τῆς τρυφῆς καὶ τὰ ἐκλεκτὰ τοῦ Λιβάνου πάντα τὰ πίνοντα ὕδωρ

text_en: For they also shall go down with him to hell to them that are slain by the sword; and the arm of every one shall sit down under his shadow in the midst of the nations .
text_la: Nam et ipsi cum eo descendent in infernum ad interfectos gladio : et brachium uniuscujusque sedebit sub umbraculo ejus in medio nationum.
text_pt: Também estes com ele descerão ao inferno a juntar-se aos que foram traspassados à espada, sim, aos que foram seu braço, e que habitavam à sombra no meio dos gentios.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ κατέβησαν μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς ᾅδου ἐν τοῖς τραυματίαις ἀπὸ μαχαίρας καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ὑπὸ τὴν σκέπην αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ τῆς ζωῆς αὐτῶν ἀπώλοντο

text_en: To whom are you like, O you that are famous and lofty among the trees of pleasure? Behold, you are brought down with the trees of pleasure to the lowest parts of the earth: you shall sleep in the midst of the uncircumcised , with them that are slain by the sword: this is Pharao , and all his multitude, says the Lord God .
text_la: Cui assimilatus es, o inclyte atque sublimis inter ligna voluptatis? ecce deductus es cum lignis voluptatis ad terram ultimam : in medio incircumcisorum dormies, cum eis qui interfecti sunt gladio : ipse est Pharao, et omnis multitudo ejus, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: A quem, pois, és semelhante em glória e em grandeza entre as árvores do Éden? Todavia serás precipitado com as árvores do Éden às partes mais baixas da terra; no meio dos incircuncisos jazerás com os que foram traspassados à espada; este é Faraó e toda a sua multidão, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: τίνι ὡμοιώθης κατάβηθι καὶ καταβιβάσθητι μετὰ τῶν ξύλων τῆς τρυφῆς εἰς γῆς βάθος ἐν μέσῳ ἀπεριτμήτων κοιμηθήσῃ μετὰ τραυματιῶν μαχαίρας οὕτως Φαραω καὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ λέγει κύριος κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est, duodecimo anno, in mense duodecimo, in una mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, no ano duodécimo, no duodécimo mês, ao primeiro do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ ἔτει ἐν τῷ δωδεκάτῳ μηνὶ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , take up a lamentation for Pharao the king of Egypt , and say to him: You are like the lion of the nations , and the dragon that is in the sea: and you pushed with the horn in your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and trampled upon their streams.
text_la: Fili hominis, assume lamentum super Pharaonem regem Ægypti, et dices ad eum : Leoni gentium assimilatus es, et draconi qui est in mari : et ventilabas cornu in fluminibus tuis, et conturbabas aquas pedibus tuis, et conculcabas flumina earum.
text_pt: Filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre Faraó, rei do Egito, e dize-lhe: Eras semelhante a um filho do leão entre as nações, mas tu és como uma baleia nos mares, e rompias os teus rios, e turbavas as águas com os teus pés, e pisavas os teus rios.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου λαβὲ θρῆνον ἐπὶ Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτῷ λέοντι ἐθνῶν ὡμοιώθης καὶ σὺ ὡς δράκων ὁ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐκεράτιζες τοῖς ποταμοῖς σου καὶ ἐτάρασσες ὕδωρ τοῖς ποσίν σου καὶ κατεπάτεις τοὺς ποταμούς σου

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord God : I will spread out my net over you with the multitude of many people, and I will draw you up in my net.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Expandam super te rete meum in multitudine populorum multorum, et extraham te in sagena mea.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Portanto, estenderei sobre ti a minha rede com reunião de muitos povos, e te farão subir na minha rede.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ περιβαλῶ ἐπὶ σὲ δίκτυα λαῶν πολλῶν καὶ ἀνάξω σε ἐν τῷ ἀγκίστρῳ μου

text_en: And I will throw you out on the land, I will cast you away into the open field and I will cause all the fowls of the air to dwell upon you, and I will fill the beasts of all the earth with you.
text_la: Et projiciam te in terram; super faciem agri abjiciam te : et habitare faciam super te omnia volatilia cæli, et saturabo de te bestias universæ terræ.
text_pt: Então te deixarei em terra; sobre a face do campo te lançarei, e farei posar sobre ti todas as aves do céu, e fartarei de ti os animais de toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτενῶ σε ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν πεδία πλησθήσεταί σου καὶ ἐπικαθιῶ ἐπὶ σὲ πάντα τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἐμπλήσω ἐκ σοῦ πάντα τὰ θηρία πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: And I will lay your flesh upon the mountains, and will fill your hills with your corruption,
text_la: Et dabo carnes tuas super montes, et implebo colles tuos sanie tua.
text_pt: E porei as tuas carnes sobre os montes, e encherei os vales da tua altura.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὰς σάρκας σου ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη καὶ ἐμπλήσω ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματός σου

text_en: and I will water the earth with your stinking blood upon the mountains, and the valleys shall be filled with you.
text_la: Et irrigabo terram fœtore sanguinis tui super montes, et valles implebuntur ex te.
text_pt: E regarei com o teu sangue a terra onde nadas, até aos montes; e os rios se encherão de ti.
text_el: καὶ ποτισθήσεται ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ τῶν προχωρημάτων σου ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους σου ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων φάραγγας ἐμπλήσω ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: And I will cover the heavens , when you shall be put out, and I will make the stars thereof dark: I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
text_la: Et operiam, cum extinctus fueris, cælum, et nigrescere faciam stellas ejus : solem nube tegam, et luna non dabit lumen suum.
text_pt: E, apagando-te eu, cobrirei os céus, e enegrecerei as suas estrelas; ao sol encobrirei com uma nuvem, e a lua não fará resplandecer a sua luz.
text_el: καὶ κατακαλύψω ἐν τῷ σβεσθῆναί σε οὐρανὸν καὶ συσκοτάσω τὰ ἄστρα αὐτοῦ ἥλιον ἐν νεφέλῃ καλύψω καὶ σελήνη οὐ μὴ φάνῃ τὸ φῶς αὐτῆς
