text_en: And I will pour upon you clean water, and you shall be cleansed from all your filthiness, and I will cleanse you from all your idols .
text_la: Et effundam super vos aquam mundam, et mundabimini ab omnibus inquinamentis vestris, et ab universis idolis vestris mundabo vos.
text_pt: Então aspergirei água pura sobre vós, e ficareis purificados; de todas as vossas imundícias e de todos os vossos ídolos vos purificarei.
text_el: καὶ ῥανῶ ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ὕδωρ καθαρόν καὶ καθαρισθήσεσθε ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἀκαθαρσιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν εἰδώλων ὑμῶν καὶ καθαριῶ ὑμᾶς

text_en: And I will give you a new heart, and put a new spirit within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and will give you a heart of flesh.
text_la: Et dabo vobis cor novum, et spiritum novum ponam in medio vestri : et auferam cor lapideum de carne vestra, et dabo vobis cor carneum.
text_pt: E dar-vos-ei um coração novo, e porei dentro de vós um espírito novo; e tirarei da vossa carne o coração de pedra, e vos darei um coração de carne.
text_el: καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν καρδίαν καινὴν καὶ πνεῦμα καινὸν δώσω ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ἀφελῶ τὴν καρδίαν τὴν λιθίνην ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν καρδίαν σαρκίνην

text_en: And I will put my spirit in the midst of you: and I will cause you to walk in my commandments , and to keep my judgments, and do them.
text_la: Et spiritum meum ponam in medio vestri : et faciam ut in præceptis meis ambuletis, et judicia mea custodiatis et operemini.
text_pt: E porei dentro de vós o meu Espírito, e farei que andeis nos meus estatutos, e guardeis os meus juízos, e os observeis.
text_el: καὶ τὸ πνεῦμά μου δώσω ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ποιήσω ἵνα ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν μου πορεύησθε καὶ τὰ κρίματά μου φυλάξησθε καὶ ποιήσητε

text_en: And you shall dwell in the land which I gave to your fathers, and you shall be my people, and I will be your God .
text_la: Et habitabitis in terra quam dedi patribus vestris : et eritis mihi in populum, et ego ero vobis in Deum.
text_pt: E habitareis na terra que eu dei a vossos pais e vós sereis o meu povo, e eu serei o vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ κατοικήσετε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς ἔδωκα τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσεσθέ μοι εἰς λαόν κἀγὼ ἔσομαι ὑμῖν εἰς θεόν

text_en: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses : and I will call for corn, and will multiply it, and will lay no famine upon you.
text_la: Et salvabo vos ex universis inquinamentis vestris : et vocabo frumentum et multiplicabo illud, et non imponam vobis famem.
text_pt: E livrar-vos-ei de todas as vossas imundícias; e chamarei o trigo, e o multiplicarei, e não trarei fome sobre vós.
text_el: καὶ σώσω ὑμᾶς ἐκ πασῶν τῶν ἀκαθαρσιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ καλέσω τὸν σῖτον καὶ πληθυνῶ αὐτὸν καὶ οὐ δώσω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς λιμόν

text_en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that you bear no more the reproach of famine among the nations .
text_la: Et multiplicabo fructum ligni, et genimina agri, ut non portetis ultra opprobrium famis in gentibus.
text_pt: E multiplicarei o fruto das árvores, e a novidade do campo, para que nunca mais recebais o opróbrio da fome entre os gentios.
text_el: καὶ πληθυνῶ τὸν καρπὸν τοῦ ξύλου καὶ τὰ γενήματα τοῦ ἀγροῦ ὅπως μὴ λάβητε ὀνειδισμὸν λιμοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: And you shall remember your wicked ways, and your doings that were not good : and your iniquities , and your wicked deeds shall displease you.
text_la: Et recordabimini viarum vestrarum pessimarum, studiorumque non bonorum : et displicebunt vobis iniquitates vestræ et scelera vestra.
text_pt: Então vos lembrareis dos vossos maus caminhos, e dos vossos feitos, que não foram bons; e tereis nojo em vós mesmos das vossas iniqüidades e das vossas abominações.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσεσθε τὰς ὁδοὺς ὑμῶν τὰς πονηρὰς καὶ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν τὰ μὴ ἀγαθὰ καὶ προσοχθιεῖτε κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς βδελύγμασιν ὑμῶν

text_en: It is not for your sakes that I will do this, says the Lord God , be it known to you: be confounded, and ashamed at your own ways, O house of Israel .
text_la: Non propter vos ego faciam, ait Dominus Deus, notum sit vobis : confundimini, et erubescite super viis vestris, domus Israël.
text_pt: Não é por amor de vós que eu faço isto, diz o Senhor DEUS; notório vos seja; envergonhai-vos, e confundi-vos por causa dos vossos caminhos, ó casa de Israel.
text_el: οὐ δι' ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ ποιῶ λέγει κύριος κύριος γνωστὸν ἔσται ὑμῖν αἰσχύνθητε καὶ ἐντράπητε ἐκ τῶν ὁδῶν ὑμῶν οἶκος Ισραηλ

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : In the day that I shall cleanse you from all your iniquities , and shall cause the cities to be inhabited, and shall repair the ruinous places,
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : In die qua mundavero vos ex omnibus iniquitatibus vestris, et inhabitari fecero urbes, et instauravero ruinosa,
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia em que eu vos purificar de todas as vossas iniqüidades, então farei com que sejam habitadas as cidades e sejam edificados os lugares devastados.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ καθαριῶ ὑμᾶς ἐκ πασῶν τῶν ἀνομιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ κατοικιῶ τὰς πόλεις καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσονται αἱ ἔρημοι

text_en: and the desolate land shall be tilled, which before was waste in the sight of all that passed by,
text_la: et terra deserta fuerit exculta, quæ quondam erat desolata in oculis omnis viatoris,
text_pt: E a terra assolada será lavrada, em lugar de estar assolada aos olhos de todos os que passavam.
text_el: καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡ ἠφανισμένη ἐργασθήσεται ἀνθ' ὧν ὅτι ἠφανισμένη ἐγενήθη κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς παντὸς παροδεύοντος

text_en: they shall say: This land that was untilled has become as a garden of pleasure: and the cities that were abandoned, and desolate, and destroyed, are peopled and fenced.
text_la: dicent : Terra illa inculta facta est ut hortus voluptatis : et civitates desertæ, et destitutæ atque suffossæ, munitæ sederunt.
text_pt: E dirão: Esta terra assolada ficou como jardim do Éden: e as cidades solitárias, e assoladas, e destruídas, estão fortalecidas e habitadas.
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν ἡ γῆ ἐκείνη ἡ ἠφανισμένη ἐγενήθη ὡς κῆπος τρυφῆς καὶ αἱ πόλεις αἱ ἔρημοι καὶ ἠφανισμέναι καὶ κατεσκαμμέναι ὀχυραὶ ἐκάθισαν

text_en: And the nations , that shall be left round about you, shall know that I the Lord have built up what was destroyed, and planted what was desolate, that I the Lord have spoken and done it.
text_la: Et scient gentes quæcumque derelictæ fuerint in circuitu vestro, quia ego Dominus ædificavi dissipata, plantavique inculta : ego Dominus locutus sim, et fecerim.
text_pt: Então saberão os gentios, que tiverem ficado ao redor de vós, que eu, o Senhor, tenho reedificado as cidades destruídas, e plantado o que estava devastado. Eu, o Senhor, o disse e o farei.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται τὰ ἔθνη ὅσα ἂν καταλειφθῶσιν κύκλῳ ὑμῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ᾠκοδόμησα τὰς καθῃρημένας καὶ κατεφύτευσα τὰς ἠφανισμένας ἐγὼ κύριος ἐλάλησα καὶ ποιήσω

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Moreover in this shall the house of Israel find me, that I will do it for them: I will multiply them as a flock of men ,
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Adhuc in hoc invenient me domus Israël, ut faciam eis : multiplicabo eos sicut gregem hominum,
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda por isso serei solicitado pela casa de Israel, que lho faça; multiplicar-lhes-ei os homens, como a um rebanho.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἔτι τοῦτο ζητηθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτοῖς πληθυνῶ αὐτοὺς ὡς πρόβατα ἀνθρώπους

text_en: as a holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts: so shall the waste cities be full of flocks of men : and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: ut gregem sanctum, ut gregem Jerusalem in solemnitatibus ejus : sic erunt civitates desertæ, plenæ gregibus hominum : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Como o rebanho santificado, como o rebanho de Jerusalém nas suas solenidades, assim as cidades desertas se encherão de rebanhos de homens; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ὡς πρόβατα ἅγια ὡς πρόβατα Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς αὐτῆς οὕτως ἔσονται αἱ πόλεις αἱ ἔρημοι πλήρεις προβάτων ἀνθρώπων καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and brought me forth in the spirit of the Lord : and set me down in the midst of a plain that was full of bones.
text_la: Facta est super me manus Domini, et eduxit me in spiritu Domini, et dimisit me in medio campi qui erat plenus ossibus.
text_pt: Veio sobre mim a mão do SENHOR, e ele me fez sair no Espírito do SENHOR, e me pôs no meio de um vale que estava cheio de ossos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπ' ἐμὲ χεὶρ κυρίου καὶ ἐξήγαγέν με ἐν πνεύματι κύριος καὶ ἔθηκέν με ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ πεδίου καὶ τοῦτο ἦν μεστὸν ὀστέων ἀνθρωπίνων

text_en: And he led me about through them on every side: now they were very many upon the face of the plain, and they were exceeding dry.
text_la: Et circumduxit me per ea in gyro : erant autem multa valde super faciem campi, siccaque vehementer.
text_pt: E me fez passar em volta deles; e eis que eram mui numerosos sobre a face do vale, e eis que estavam sequíssimos.
text_el: καὶ περιήγαγέν με ἐπ' αὐτὰ κυκλόθεν κύκλῳ καὶ ἰδοὺ πολλὰ σφόδρα ἐπὶ προσώπου τοῦ πεδίου ξηρὰ σφόδρα

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man , do you think these bones shall live? And I answered: O Lord God , you know .
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, putasne vivent ossa ista? Et dixi : Domine Deus, tu nosti.
text_pt: E me disse: Filho do homem, porventura viverão estes ossos? E eu disse: Senhor DEUS, tu o sabes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰ ζήσεται τὰ ὀστᾶ ταῦτα καὶ εἶπα κύριε σὺ ἐπίστῃ ταῦτα

text_en: And he said to me: Prophesy concerning these bones; and say to them: You dry bones, hear the word of the Lord .
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Vaticinare de ossibus istis, et dices eis : Ossa arida, audite verbum Domini.
text_pt: Então me disse: Profetiza sobre estes ossos, e dize-lhes: Ossos secos, ouvi a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με προφήτευσον ἐπὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ ταῦτα καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς τὰ ὀστᾶ τὰ ξηρά ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord God to these bones: Behold, I will send spirit into you, and you shall live.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus ossibus his : Ecce ego intromittam in vos spiritum, et vivetis.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS a estes ossos: Eis que farei entrar em vós o espírito, e vivereis.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος τοῖς ὀστέοις τούτοις ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ φέρω εἰς ὑμᾶς πνεῦμα ζωῆς

text_en: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will cause flesh to grow over you, and will cover you with skin: and I will give you spirit and you shall live, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et dabo super vos nervos, et succrescere faciam super vos carnes, et superextendam in vobis cutem, et dabo vobis spiritum, et vivetis : et scietis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E porei nervos sobre vós e farei crescer carne sobre vós, e sobre vós estenderei pele, e porei em vós o espírito, e vivereis, e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ δώσω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς νεῦρα καὶ ἀνάξω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς σάρκας καὶ ἐκτενῶ ἐφ' ὑμᾶς δέρμα καὶ δώσω πνεῦμά μου εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ ζήσεσθε καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And I prophesied as he had commanded me: and as I prophesied there was a noise, and behold a commotion: and the bones came together, each one to its joint.
text_la: Et prophetavi sicut præceperat mihi : factus est autem sonitus, prophetante me, et ecce commotio : et accesserunt ossa ad ossa, unumquodque ad juncturam suam.
text_pt: Então profetizei como se me deu ordem. E houve um ruído, enquanto eu profetizava; e eis que se fez um rebuliço, e os ossos se achegaram, cada osso ao seu osso.
text_el: καὶ ἐπροφήτευσα καθὼς ἐνετείλατό μοι καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐμὲ προφητεῦσαι καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμός καὶ προσήγαγε τὰ ὀστᾶ ἑκάτερον πρὸς τὴν ἁρμονίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I saw, and behold the sinews, and the flesh came up upon them: and the skin was stretched out over them, but there was no spirit in them.
text_la: Et vidi, et ecce super ea nervi et carnes ascenderunt, et extenta est in eis cutis desuper : et spiritum non habebant.
text_pt: E olhei, e eis que vieram nervos sobre eles, e cresceu a carne, e estendeu-se a pele sobre eles por cima; mas não havia neles espírito.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐπ' αὐτὰ νεῦρα καὶ σάρκες ἐφύοντο καὶ ἀνέβαινεν ἐπ' αὐτὰ δέρμα ἐπάνω καὶ πνεῦμα οὐκ ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And he said to me: Prophesy to the spirit , prophesy , O son of man , and say to the spirit : Thus says the Lord God : Come, spirit , from the four winds, and blow upon these slain , and let them live again.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Vaticinare ad spiritum : vaticinare, fili hominis, et dices ad spiritum : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : A quatuor ventis veni, spiritus, et insuffla super interfectos istos, et reviviscant.
text_pt: E ele me disse: Profetiza ao espírito, profetiza, ó filho do homem, e dize ao espírito: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Vem dos quatro ventos, ó espírito, e assopra sobre estes mortos, para que vivam.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με προφήτευσον υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον ἐπὶ τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ εἰπὸν τῷ πνεύματι τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων πνευμάτων ἐλθὲ καὶ ἐμφύσησον εἰς τοὺς νεκροὺς τούτους καὶ ζησάτωσαν

text_en: And I prophesied as he had commanded me: and the spirit came into them, and they lived: and they stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
text_la: Et prophetavi sicut præceperat mihi : et ingressus est in ea spiritus, et vixerunt : steteruntque super pedes suos, exercitus grandis nimis valde.
text_pt: E profetizei como ele me deu ordem; então o espírito entrou neles, e viveram, e se puseram em pé, um exército grande em extremo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπροφήτευσα καθότι ἐνετείλατό μοι καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς αὐτοὺς τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἔζησαν καὶ ἔστησαν ἐπὶ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῶν συναγωγὴ πολλὴ σφόδρα

text_en: And he said to me: Son of man : All these bones are the house of Israel : they say: Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost, and we are cut off.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, ossa hæc universa, domus Israël est. Ipsi dicunt : Aruerunt ossa nostra, et periit spes nostra, et abscissi sumus.
text_pt: Então me disse: Filho do homem, estes ossos são toda a casa de Israel. Eis que dizem: Os nossos ossos se secaram, e pereceu a nossa esperança; nós mesmos estamos cortados.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρός με λέγων υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου τὰ ὀστᾶ ταῦτα πᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ ἐστίν καὶ αὐτοὶ λέγουσιν ξηρὰ γέγονεν τὰ ὀστᾶ ἡμῶν ἀπόλωλεν ἡ ἐλπὶς ἡμῶν διαπεφωνήκαμεν

text_en: Therefore prophesy , and say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Behold I will open your graves, and will bring you out of your sepulchres, O my people: and will bring you into the land of Israel .
text_la: Propterea vaticinare, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego aperiam tumulos vestros, et educam vos de sepulchris vestris, populus meus, et inducam vos in terram Israël.
text_pt: Portanto profetiza, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu abrirei os vossos sepulcros, e vos farei subir das vossas sepulturas, ó povo meu, e vos trarei à terra de Israel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο προφήτευσον καὶ εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀνοίγω ὑμῶν τὰ μνήματα καὶ ἀνάξω ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῶν μνημάτων ὑμῶν καὶ εἰσάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when I shall have opened your sepulchres, and shall have brought you out of your graves, O my people:
text_la: Et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum aperuero sepulchra vestra, et eduxero vos de tumulis vestris, popule meus,
text_pt: E sabereis que eu sou o Senhor, quando eu abrir os vossos sepulcros, e vos fizer subir das vossas sepulturas, ó povo meu.
text_el: καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἐν τῷ ἀνοῖξαί με τοὺς τάφους ὑμῶν τοῦ ἀναγαγεῖν με ἐκ τῶν τάφων τὸν λαόν μου

text_en: And shall have put my spirit in you, and you shall live, and I shall make you rest upon your own land: and you shall know that I the Lord have spoken, and done it, says the Lord God :
text_la: et dedero spiritum meum in vobis, et vixeritis : et requiescere vos faciam super humum vestram, et scietis quia ego Dominus locutus sum, et feci, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E porei em vós o meu Espírito, e vivereis, e vos porei na vossa terra; e sabereis que eu, o SENHOR, disse isto, e o fiz, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὸ πνεῦμά μου εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ ζήσεσθε καὶ θήσομαι ὑμᾶς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὑμῶν καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος λελάληκα καὶ ποιήσω λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E outra vez veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: And you son of man , take you a stick: and write upon it: Of Juda , and of the children of Israel his associates: and take another stick and write upon it: For Joseph the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel , and of his associates.
text_la: Et tu, fili hominis, sume tibi lignum unum, et scribe super illud : Judæ, et filiorum Israël sociorum ejus : et tolle lignum alterum, et scribe super illud : Joseph, ligno Ephraim, et cunctæ domui Israël sociorumque ejus.
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, toma um pedaço de madeira, e escreve nele: Por Judá e pelos filhos de Israel, seus companheiros. E toma outro pedaço de madeira, e escreve nele: Por José, vara de Efraim, e por toda a casa de Israel, seus companheiros.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου λαβὲ σεαυτῷ ῥάβδον καὶ γράψον ἐπ' αὐτὴν τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ τοὺς προσκειμένους ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ ῥάβδον δευτέραν λήμψῃ σεαυτῷ καὶ γράψεις αὐτήν τῷ Ιωσηφ ῥάβδον Εφραιμ καὶ πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ τοὺς προστεθέντας πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: And join them one to the other into one stick, and they shall become one in your hand.
text_la: Et adjunge illa unum ad alterum tibi in lignum unum : et erunt in unionem in manu tua.
text_pt: E ajunta um ao outro, para que se unam, e se tornem uma só vara na tua mão.
text_el: καὶ συνάψεις αὐτὰς πρὸς ἀλλήλας σαυτῷ εἰς ῥάβδον μίαν τοῦ δῆσαι αὐτάς καὶ ἔσονται ἐν τῇ χειρί σου

text_en: And when the children of your people shall speak to you, saying: Will you not tell us what you mean by this?
text_la: Cum autem dixerint ad te filii populi tui, loquentes : Nonne indicas nobis quid in his tibi velis?
text_pt: E quando te falarem os filhos do teu povo, dizendo: Porventura não nos declararás o que significam estas coisas?
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν λέγωσιν πρὸς σὲ οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ λαοῦ σου οὐκ ἀναγγελεῖς ἡμῖν τί ἐστιν ταῦτά σοι

text_en: Say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel that are associated with him, and I will put them together with the stick of Juda , and will make them one stick: and they shall be one in his hand.
text_la: loqueris ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego assumam lignum Joseph, quod est in manu Ephraim, et tribus Israël, quæ sunt ei adjunctæ, et dabo eas pariter cum ligno Juda, et faciam eas in lignum unum : et erunt unum in manu ejus.
text_pt: Tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu tomarei a vara de José que esteve na mão de Efraim, e a das tribos de Israel, suas companheiras, e as ajuntarei à vara de Judá, e farei delas uma só vara, e elas se farão uma só na minha mão.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ λήμψομαι τὴν φυλὴν Ιωσηφ τὴν διὰ χειρὸς Εφραιμ καὶ τὰς φυλὰς Ισραηλ τὰς προσκειμένας πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ δώσω αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὴν φυλὴν Ιουδα καὶ ἔσονται εἰς ῥάβδον μίαν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ Ιουδα

text_en: And the sticks whereon you have written, shall be in your hand, before their eyes.
text_la: Erunt autem ligna super quæ scripseris in manu tua in oculis eorum.
text_pt: E as varas, sobre que houve- res escrito, estarão na tua mão, perante os olhos deles.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται αἱ ῥάβδοι ἐφ' αἷς σὺ ἔγραψας ἐπ' αὐταῖς ἐν τῇ χειρί σου ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will take the children of Israel from the midst of the nations whither they have gone: and I will gather them on every side, and will bring them to their own land.
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego assumam filios Israël de medio nationum ad quas abierunt : et congregabo eos undique, et adducam eos ad humum suam.
text_pt: Dize-lhes pois: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu tomarei os filhos de Israel dentre os gentios, para onde eles foram, e os congregarei de todas as partes, e os levarei à sua terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ λαμβάνω πάντα οἶκον Ισραηλ ἐκ μέσου τῶν ἐθνῶν οὗ εἰσήλθοσαν ἐκεῖ καὶ συνάξω αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν περικύκλῳ αὐτῶν καὶ εἰσάξω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And I will make them one nation in the land on the mountains of Israel , and one king shall be king over them all: and they shall no more be two nations , neither shall they be divided any more into two kingdoms.
text_la: Et faciam eos in gentem unam in terra in montibus Israël, et rex unus erit omnibus imperans : et non erunt ultra duæ gentes, nec dividentur amplius in duo regna,
text_pt: E deles farei uma nação na terra, nos montes de Israel, e um rei será rei de todos eles, e nunca mais serão duas nações; nunca mais para o futuro se dividirão em dois reinos.
text_el: καὶ δώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς ἔθνος ἓν ἐν τῇ γῇ μου καὶ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν Ισραηλ καὶ ἄρχων εἷς ἔσται αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται ἔτι εἰς δύο ἔθνη οὐδὲ μὴ διαιρεθῶσιν οὐκέτι εἰς δύο βασιλείας

text_en: Nor shall they be defiled any more with their idols , nor with their abominations , nor with all their iniquities : and I will save them out of all the places in which they have sinned , and I will cleanse them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God .
text_la: neque polluentur ultra in idolis suis, et abominationibus suis, et cunctis iniquitatibus suis : et salvos eos faciam de universis sedibus in quibus peccaverunt, et emundabo eos : et erunt mihi populus, et ego ero eis Deus.
text_pt: E nunca mais se contaminarão com os seus ídolos, nem com as suas abominações, nem com as suas transgressões, e os livrarei de todas as suas habitações, em que pecaram, e os purificarei. Assim eles serão o meu povo, e eu serei o seu Deus.
text_el: ἵνα μὴ μιαίνωνται ἔτι ἐν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν καὶ ῥύσομαι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν ὧν ἡμάρτοσαν ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ καθαριῶ αὐτούς καὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ κύριος ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν

text_en: And my servant David shall be king over them, and they shall have one shepherd: they shall walk in my judgments, and shall keep my commandments , and shall do them.
text_la: Et servus meus David rex super eos, et pastor unus erit omnium eorum. In judiciis meis ambulabunt, et mandata mea custodient, et facient ea:
text_pt: E meu servo Davi será rei sobre eles, e todos eles terão um só pastor; e andarão nos meus juízos e guardarão os meus estatutos, e os observarão.
text_el: καὶ ὁ δοῦλός μου Δαυιδ ἄρχων ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν καὶ ποιμὴν εἷς ἔσται πάντων ὅτι ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασίν μου πορεύσονται καὶ τὰ κρίματά μου φυλάξονται καὶ ποιήσουσιν αὐτά

text_en: And they shall dwell in the land which I gave to my servant Jacob , wherein your fathers dwelt, and they shall dwell in it, they and their children, and their children's children, for ever: and David my servant shall be their prince for ever.
text_la: et habitabunt super terram quam dedi servo meo Jacob, in qua habitaverunt patres vestri : et habitabunt super eam ipsi, et filii eorum, et filii filiorum eorum, usque in sempiternum : et David servus meus princeps eorum in perpetuum.
text_pt: E habitarão na terra que dei a meu servo Jacó, em que habitaram vossos pais; e habitarão nela, eles e seus filhos, e os filhos de seus filhos, para sempre, e Davi, meu servo, será seu príncipe eternamente.
text_el: καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν ἣν ἐγὼ δέδωκα τῷ δούλῳ μου Ιακωβ οὗ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπ' αὐτῆς αὐτοί καὶ Δαυιδ ὁ δοῦλός μου ἄρχων αὐτῶν ἔσται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And I will make a covenant of peace with them, it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will establish them, and will multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for ever.
text_la: Et percutiam illis fœdus pacis : pactum sempiternum erit eis. Et fundabo eos, et multiplicabo, et dabo sanctificationem meam in medio eorum in perpetuum.
text_pt: E farei com eles uma aliança de paz; e será uma aliança perpétua. E os estabelecerei, e os multiplicarei, e porei o meu santuário no meio deles para sempre.
text_el: καὶ διαθήσομαι αὐτοῖς διαθήκην εἰρήνης διαθήκη αἰωνία ἔσται μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ θήσω τὰ ἅγιά μου ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And my tabernacle shall be with them: and I will be their God , and they shall be my people.
text_la: Et erit tabernaculum meum in eis : et ero eis Deus, et ipsi erunt mihi populus.
text_pt: E o meu tabernáculo estará com eles, e eu serei o seu Deus e eles serão o meu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ κατασκήνωσίς μου ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς θεός καὶ αὐτοί μου ἔσονται λαός

text_en: And the nations shall know that I am the Lord the sanctifier of Israel , when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for ever.
text_la: Et scient gentes quia ego Dominus sanctificator Israël, cum fuerit sanctificatio mea in medio eorum in perpetuum.
text_pt: E os gentios saberão que eu sou o Senhor que santifico a Israel, quando estiver o meu santuário no meio deles para sempre.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται τὰ ἔθνη ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ εἶναι τὰ ἅγιά μου ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Son of man , set your face against Gog , the land of Magog , the chief prince of Mosoch and Thubal: and prophesy of him,
text_la: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra Gog, terram Magog, principem capitis Mosoch et Thubal, et vaticinare de eo.
text_pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra Gogue, terra de Magogue, príncipe e chefe de Meseque, e Tubal, e profetiza contra ele.
text_el: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Γωγ καὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Μαγωγ ἄρχοντα Ρως Μοσοχ καὶ Θοβελ καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ' αὐτὸν

text_en: and say to him: Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I come against you, O Gog , the chief prince of Mosoch and Thubal.
text_la: Et dices ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad te, Gog, principem capitis Mosoch et Thubal.
text_pt: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó Gogue, príncipe e chefe de Meseque e de Tubal;
text_el: καὶ εἰπὸν αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ Γωγ ἄρχοντα Ρως Μοσοχ καὶ Θοβελ

text_en: And I will turn you about, and I will put a bit in your jaws: and I will bring you forth, and all your army, horses and horsemen all clothed with coats of mail, a great multitude, armed with spears and shields and swords.
text_la: Et circumagam te, et ponam frenum in maxillis tuis : et educam te, et omnem exercitum tuum, equos et equites vestitos loricis universos, multitudinem magnam, hastam et clypeum arripientium et gladium.
text_pt: E te farei voltar, e porei anzóis nos teus queixos, e te levarei a ti, com todo o teu exército, cavalos e cavaleiros, todos vestidos com primor, grande multidão, com escudo e rodela, manejando todos a espada;
text_el: καὶ συνάξω σε καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμίν σου ἵππους καὶ ἱππεῖς ἐνδεδυμένους θώρακας πάντας συναγωγὴ πολλή πέλται καὶ περικεφαλαῖαι καὶ μάχαιραι

text_en: The Persians , Ethiopians , and Libyans with them, all with shields and helmets.
text_la: Persæ, Æthiopes, et Libyes cum eis, omnes scutati et galeati.
text_pt: Persas, etíopes, e os de Pute com eles, todos com escudo e capacete;
text_el: Πέρσαι καὶ Αἰθίοπες καὶ Λίβυες πάντες περικεφαλαίαις καὶ πέλταις

text_en: Gomer, and all his bands, the house of Thogorma, the northern parts and all his strength, and many peoples with you.
text_la: Gomer et universa agmina ejus, domus Thogorma, latera aquilonis, et totum robur ejus, populique multi tecum.
text_pt: Gômer e todas as suas tropas; a casa de Togarma, do extremo norte, e todas as suas tropas, muitos povos contigo.
text_el: Γομερ καὶ πάντες οἱ περὶ αὐτόν οἶκος τοῦ Θεργαμα ἀπ' ἐσχάτου βορρᾶ καὶ πάντες οἱ περὶ αὐτόν καὶ ἔθνη πολλὰ μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: Prepare and make yourself ready, and all your multitude that is assembled about you, and be commander over them.
text_la: Præpara et instrue te, et omnem multitudinem tuam quæ coacervata est ad te : et esto eis in præceptum.
text_pt: Prepara-te, e dispõe-te, tu e todas as multidões do teu povo que se reuniram a ti, e serve-lhes tu de guarda.
text_el: ἑτοιμάσθητι ἑτοίμασον σεαυτὸν σὺ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή σου οἱ συνηγμένοι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἔσῃ μοι εἰς προφυλακήν

text_en: After many days you shall be visited: at the end of years you shall come to the land that is returned from the sword, and is gathered out of many nations , to the mountains of Israel which have been continually waste: but it has been brought forth out of the nations , and they shall all of them dwell securely in it.
text_la: Post dies multos visitaberis : in novissimo annorum venies ad terram quæ reversa est a gladio, et congregata est de populis multis ad montes Israël, qui fuerunt deserti jugiter : hæc de populis educta est, et habitabunt in ea confidenter universi.
text_pt: Depois de muitos dias serás visitado. No fim dos anos virás à terra que se recuperou da espada, e que foi congregada dentre muitos povos, junto aos montes de Israel, que sempre se faziam desertos; mas aquela terra foi tirada dentre as nações, e todas elas habitarão seguramente.
text_el: ἀφ' ἡμερῶν πλειόνων ἑτοιμασθήσεται καὶ ἐπ' ἐσχάτου ἐτῶν ἐλεύσεται καὶ ἥξει εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀπεστραμμένην ἀπὸ μαχαίρας συνηγμένων ἀπὸ ἐθνῶν πολλῶν ἐπὶ γῆν Ισραηλ ἣ ἐγενήθη ἔρημος δι' ὅλου καὶ οὗτος ἐξ ἐθνῶν ἐξελήλυθεν καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπ' εἰρήνης ἅπαντες

text_en: And you shall go up and come like a storm, and like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your bands and many people with you.
text_la: Ascendens autem quasi tempestas venies, et quasi nubes, ut operias terram : tu et omnia agmina tua, et populi multi tecum.
text_pt: Então subirás, virás como uma tempestade, far-te-ás como uma nuvem para cobrir a terra, tu e todas as tuas tropas, e muitos povos contigo.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβήσῃ ὡς ὑετὸς καὶ ἥξεις ὡς νεφέλη κατακαλύψαι γῆν καὶ ἔσῃ σὺ καὶ πάντες οἱ περὶ σὲ καὶ ἔθνη πολλὰ μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : In that day projects shall enter into your heart, and you shall conceive a mischievous design.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : In die illa, ascendent sermones super cor tuum, et cogitabis cogitationem pessimam :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: E acontecerá naquele dia que subirão palavras no teu coração, e maquinarás um mau desígnio,
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀναβήσεται ῥήματα ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ λογιῇ λογισμοὺς πονηροὺς

text_en: And you shall say: I will go up to the land which is without a wall, I will come to them that are at rest, and dwell securely: all these dwell without a wall, they have no bars nor gates:
text_la: et dices : Ascendam ad terram absque muro : veniam ad quiescentes habitantesque secure : hi omnes habitant sine muro; vectes et portæ non sunt eis :
text_pt: E dirás: Subirei contra a terra das aldeias não muradas; virei contra os que estão em repouso, que habitam seguros; todos eles habitam sem muro, e não têm ferrolhos nem portas;
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς ἀναβήσομαι ἐπὶ γῆν ἀπερριμμένην ἥξω ἐπὶ ἡσυχάζοντας ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ καὶ οἰκοῦντας ἐπ' εἰρήνης πάντας κατοικοῦντας γῆν ἐν ᾗ οὐχ ὑπάρχει τεῖχος οὐδὲ μοχλοί καὶ θύραι οὐκ εἰσὶν αὐτοῖς

text_en: To take spoils, and lay hold on the prey, to lay your hand upon them that had been wasted, and afterwards restored, and upon the people that is gathered together out of the nations , which has begun to possess and to dwell in the midst of the earth.
text_la: ut diripias spolia, et invadas prædam; ut inferas manum tuam super eos qui deserti fuerant, et postea restituti, et super populum qui est congregatus ex gentibus, qui possidere cœpit et esse habitator umbilici terræ.
text_pt: A fim de tomar o despojo, e para arrebatar a presa, e tornar a tua mão contra as terras desertas que agora se acham habitadas, e contra o povo que se congregou dentre as nações, o qual adquiriu gado e bens, e habita no meio da terra.
text_el: προνομεῦσαι προνομὴν καὶ σκυλεῦσαι σκῦλα αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι χεῖρά σου εἰς τὴν ἠρημωμένην ἣ κατῳκίσθη καὶ ἐπ' ἔθνος συνηγμένον ἀπὸ ἐθνῶν πολλῶν πεποιηκότας κτήσεις κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τὸν ὀμφαλὸν τῆς γῆς

text_en: Saba , and Dedan, and the merchants of Tharsis, and all the lions thereof shall say to you: Are you come to take spoils? Behold, you have gathered your multitude to take a prey, to take silver, and gold, and to carry away goods and substance , and to take rich spoils.
text_la: Saba, et Dedan, et negotiatores Tharsis, et omnes leones ejus, dicent tibi : Numquid ad sumenda spolia tu venis? ecce ad diripiendam prædam congregasti multitudinem tuam, ut tollas argentum et aurum, et auferas supellectilem atque substantiam, et diripias manubias infinitas.
text_pt: Sebá e Dedã, e os mercadores de Társis, e todos os seus leõezinhos te dirão: Vens tu para tomar o despojo? Ajuntaste a tua multidão para arrebatar a tua presa? Para levar a prata e o ouro, para tomar o gado e os bens, para saquear o grande despojo?
text_el: Σαβα καὶ Δαιδαν καὶ ἔμποροι Καρχηδόνιοι καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν ἐροῦσίν σοι εἰς προνομὴν τοῦ προνομεῦσαι σὺ ἔρχῃ καὶ σκυλεῦσαι σκῦλα συνήγαγες συναγωγήν σου λαβεῖν ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ἀπενέγκασθαι κτῆσιν τοῦ σκυλεῦσαι σκῦλα

text_en: Therefore, you son of man , prophesy and say to Gog : Thus says the Lord God : Shall you not know , in that day, when my people of Israel shall dwell securely?
text_la: Propterea vaticinare, fili hominis, et dices ad Gog : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Numquid non in die illo, cum habitaverit populus meus Israël confidenter, scies?
text_pt: Portanto, profetiza, ó filho do homem, e dize a Gogue: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porventura não o saberás naquele dia, quando o meu povo Israel habitar em segurança?
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο προφήτευσον υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου καὶ εἰπὸν τῷ Γωγ τάδε λέγει κύριος οὐκ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐν τῷ κατοικισθῆναι τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ ἐπ' εἰρήνης ἐγερθήσῃ

text_en: And you shall come out of your place from the northern parts, you and many people with you, all of them riding upon horses, a great company and a mighty army.
text_la: Et venies de loco tuo a lateribus aquilonis, tu et populi multi tecum, ascensores equorum universi : cœtus magnus, et exercitus vehemens.
text_pt: Virás, pois, do teu lugar, do extremo norte, tu e muitos povos contigo, montados todos a cavalo, grande ajuntamento, e exército poderoso,
text_el: καὶ ἥξεις ἐκ τοῦ τόπου σου ἀπ' ἐσχάτου βορρᾶ καὶ ἔθνη πολλὰ μετὰ σοῦ ἀναβάται ἵππων πάντες συναγωγὴ μεγάλη καὶ δύναμις πολλή

text_en: And you shall come upon my people of Israel like a cloud, to cover the earth. You shall be in the latter days, and I will bring you upon my land: that the nations may know me, when I shall be sanctified in you, O Gog , before their eyes.
text_la: Et ascendes super populum meum Israël quasi nubes, ut operias terram. In novissimis diebus eris, et adducam te super terram meam : ut sciant gentes me cum sanctificatus fuero in te in oculis eorum, o Gog!
text_pt: E subirás contra o meu povo Israel, como uma nuvem, para cobrir a terra. Nos últimos dias sucederá que hei de trazer-te contra a minha terra, para que os gentios me conheçam a mim, quando eu me houver santificado em ti, ó Gogue, diante dos seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβήσῃ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ ὡς νεφέλη καλύψαι γῆν ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἔσται καὶ ἀνάξω σε ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν μου ἵνα γνῶσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐμὲ ἐν τῷ ἁγιασθῆναί με ἐν σοὶ ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : You then are he, of whom I have spoken in the days of old, by my servants the prophets of Israel , who prophesied in the days of those times that I would bring you upon them.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Tu ergo ille es, de quo locutus sum in diebus antiquis in manu servorum meorum prophetarum Israël, qui prophetaverunt in diebus illorum temporum, ut adducerem te super eos.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Não és tu aquele de quem eu disse nos dias antigos, por intermédio dos meus servos, os profetas de Israel, os quais naqueles dias profetizaram largos anos, que te traria contra eles?
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος τῷ Γωγ σὺ εἶ περὶ οὗ ἐλάλησα πρὸ ἡμερῶν τῶν ἔμπροσθεν διὰ χειρὸς τῶν δούλων μου προφητῶν τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἔτεσιν τοῦ ἀγαγεῖν σε ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, in the day of the coming of Gog upon the land of Israel , says the Lord God , that my indignation shall come up in my wrath .
text_la: Et erit in die illa, in die adventus Gog super terram Israël, ait Dominus Deus, ascendet indignatio mea in furore meo.
text_pt: Sucederá, porém, naquele dia, no dia em que vier Gogue contra a terra de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS, que a minha indignação subirá à minha face.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἂν ἔλθῃ Γωγ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος κύριος ἀναβήσεται ὁ θυμός μου

text_en: And I have spoken in my zeal , and in the fire of my anger , that in that day there shall be a great commotion upon the land of Israel :
text_la: Et in zelo meo, in igne iræ meæ locutus sum, quia in die illa erit commotio magna super terram Israël :
text_pt: Porque disse no meu zelo, no fogo do meu furor, que, certamente, naquele dia haverá grande tremor sobre a terra de Israel;
text_el: καὶ ὁ ζῆλός μου ἐν πυρὶ τῆς ὀργῆς μου ἐλάλησα εἰ μὴν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται σεισμὸς μέγας ἐπὶ γῆς Ισραηλ

text_en: So that the fishes of the sea, and the birds of the air, and the beasts of the field, and every creeping thing that creeps upon the ground, and all men that are upon the face of the earth, shall be moved at my presence : and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the hedges shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
text_la: et commovebuntur a facie mea pisces maris, et volucres cæli, et bestiæ agri, et omne reptile quod movetur super humum, cunctique homines qui sunt super faciem terræ : et subvertentur montes, et cadent sepes, et omnis murus corruet in terram.
text_pt: De tal modo que tremerão diante da minha face os peixes do mar, e as aves do céu, e os animais do campo, e todos os répteis que se arrastam sobre a terra, e todos os homens que estão sobre a face da terra; e os montes serão deitados abaixo, e os precipícios se desfarão, e todos os muros desabarão por terra.
text_el: καὶ σεισθήσονται ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου οἱ ἰχθύες τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τὰ θηρία τοῦ πεδίου καὶ πάντα τὰ ἑρπετὰ τὰ ἕρποντα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς καὶ ῥαγήσεται τὰ ὄρη καὶ πεσοῦνται αἱ φάραγγες καὶ πᾶν τεῖχος ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν πεσεῖται

text_en: And I will call in the sword against him in all my mountains, says the Lord God : every man's sword shall be pointed against his brother.
text_la: Et convocabo adversus eum in cunctis montibus meis gladium, ait Dominus Deus : gladius uniuscujusque in fratrem suum dirigetur.
text_pt: Porque chamarei contra ele a espada sobre todos os meus montes, diz o Senhor DEUS; a espada de cada um se voltará contra seu irmão.
text_el: καὶ καλέσω ἐπ' αὐτὸν πᾶν φόβον λέγει κύριος μάχαιρα ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἔσται

text_en: And I will judge him with pestilence, and with blood, and with violent rain, and vast hailstones: I will rain fire and brimstone upon him, and upon his army, and upon the many nations that are with him.
text_la: Et judicabo eum peste, et sanguine, et imbre vehementi, et lapidibus immensis : ignem et sulphur pluam super eum, et super exercitum ejus, et super populos multos qui sunt cum eo.
text_pt: E contenderei com ele por meio da peste e do sangue; e uma chuva inundante, e grandes pedras de saraiva, fogo, e enxofre farei chover sobre ele, e sobre as suas tropas, e sobre os muitos povos que estiverem com ele.
text_el: καὶ κρινῶ αὐτὸν θανάτῳ καὶ αἵματι καὶ ὑετῷ κατακλύζοντι καὶ λίθοις χαλάζης καὶ πῦρ καὶ θεῖον βρέξω ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπ' ἔθνη πολλὰ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I will be magnified, and I will be sanctified : and I will be known in the eyes of many nations and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et magnificabor, et sanctificabor, et notus ero in oculis multarum gentium : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: Assim eu me engrandecerei e me santificarei, e me darei a conhecer aos olhos de muitas nações; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ μεγαλυνθήσομαι καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι καὶ ἐνδοξασθήσομαι καὶ γνωσθήσομαι ἐναντίον ἐθνῶν πολλῶν καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And you, son of man , prophesy against Gog , and say: Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I come against you, O Gog , the chief prince of Mosoch and Thubal.
text_la: Tu autem, fili hominis, vaticinare adversum Gog, et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego super te, Gog, principem capitis Mosoch et Thubal.
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, profetiza ainda contra Gogue, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó Gogue, príncipe e chefe de Meseque e de Tubal.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου προφήτευσον ἐπὶ Γωγ καὶ εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ Γωγ ἄρχοντα Ρως Μοσοχ καὶ Θοβελ

text_en: And I will turn you round, and I will lead you out, and will make you go up from the northern parts: and will bring you upon the mountains of Israel .
text_la: Et circumagam te, et educam te, et ascendere te faciam de lateribus aquilonis, et adducam te super montes Israël.
text_pt: E te farei voltar, mas deixarei uma sexta parte de ti, e far-te-ei subir do extremo norte, e te trarei aos montes de Israel.
text_el: καὶ συνάξω σε καὶ καθοδηγήσω σε καὶ ἀναβιβῶ σε ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τοῦ βορρᾶ καὶ ἀνάξω σε ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And I will break your bow in your left hand, and I will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
text_la: Et percutiam arcum tuum in manu sinistra tua, et sagittas tuas de manu dextera tua dejiciam.
text_pt: E, com um golpe, tirarei o teu arco da tua mão esquerda, e farei cair as tuas flechas da tua mão direita.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολῶ τὸ τόξον σου ἀπὸ τῆς χειρός σου τῆς ἀριστερᾶς καὶ τὰ τοξεύματά σου ἀπὸ τῆς χειρός σου τῆς δεξιᾶς καὶ καταβαλῶ σε

text_en: You shall fall upon the mountains of Israel , you and all your bands, and your nations that are with you: I have given you to the wild beasts, to the birds, and to every fowl, and to the beasts of the earth to be devoured.
text_la: Super montes Israël cades tu, et omnia agmina tua, et populi tui qui sunt tecum : feris, avibus, omnique volatili et bestiis terræ dedi te ad devorandum.
text_pt: Nos montes de Israel cairás, tu e todas as tuas tropas, e os povos que estão contigo; e às aves de rapina, de toda espécie, e aos animais do campo, te darei por comida.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη Ισραηλ καὶ πεσῇ σὺ καὶ πάντες οἱ περὶ σέ καὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ μετὰ σοῦ δοθήσονται εἰς πλήθη ὀρνέων παντὶ πετεινῷ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς θηρίοις τοῦ πεδίου δέδωκά σε καταβρωθῆναι

text_en: You shall fall upon the face of the field: for I have spoken it, says the Lord God .
text_la: Super faciem agri cades, quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Sobre a face do campo cairás, porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ἐπὶ προσώπου τοῦ πεδίου πεσῇ ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐλάλησα λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will send a fire on Magog , and on them that dwell confidently in the islands: and they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et immittam ignem in Magog, et in his qui habitant in insulis confidenter : et scient quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E enviarei um fogo sobre Magogue e entre os que habitam seguros nas ilhas; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστελῶ πῦρ ἐπὶ Γωγ καὶ κατοικηθήσονται αἱ νῆσοι ἐπ' εἰρήνης καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος

text_en: And I will make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel , and my holy name shall be profaned no more: and the Gentiles shall know that I am the Lord , the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Et nomen sanctum meum notum faciam in medio populi mei Israël, et non polluam nomen sanctum meum amplius : et scient gentes quia ego Dominus, Sanctus Israël.
text_pt: E farei conhecido o meu santo nome no meio do meu povo Israel, e nunca mais deixarei profanar o meu santo nome; e os gentios saberão que eu sou o Senhor, o Santo em Israel.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ ἅγιον γνωσθήσεται ἐν μέσῳ λαοῦ μου Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ βεβηλωθήσεται τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ ἅγιον οὐκέτι καὶ γνώσονται τὰ ἔθνη ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἅγιος ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: Behold it comes, and it is done, says the Lord God : this is the day whereof I have spoken.
text_la: Ecce venit, et factum est, ait Dominus Deus : hæc est dies de qua locutus sum.
text_pt: Eis que vem, e se cumprirá, diz o Senhor DEUS; este é o dia de que tenho falado.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἥκει καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἔσται λέγει κύριος κύριος αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἡμέρα ἐν ᾗ ἐλάλησα

text_en: And the inhabitants shall go forth of the cities of Israel , and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, the shields, and the spears, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves and the pikes: and they shall burn them with fire seven years.
text_la: Et egredientur habitatores de civitatibus Israël, et succendent et comburent arma, clypeum et hastas, arcum et sagittas, et baculos manuum et contos : et succendent ea igni septem annis.
text_pt: E os habitantes das cidades de Israel sairão, e acenderão o fogo, e queimarão as armas, e os escudos e as rodelas, com os arcos, e com as flechas, e com os bastões de mão, e com as lanças; e acenderão fogo com elas por sete anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὰς πόλεις Ισραηλ καὶ καύσουσιν ἐν τοῖς ὅπλοις πέλταις καὶ κοντοῖς καὶ τόξοις καὶ τοξεύμασιν καὶ ῥάβδοις χειρῶν καὶ λόγχαις καὶ καύσουσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς πῦρ ἑπτὰ ἔτη

text_en: And they shall not bring wood out of the countries, nor cut down out of the forests: for they shall burn the weapons with fire, and shall make a prey of them to whom they had been a prey, and they shall rob those that robbed them, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et non portabunt ligna de regionibus, neque succident de saltibus : quoniam arma succendent igni, et deprædabuntur eos quibus prædæ fuerant, et diripient vastatores suos, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E não trarão lenha do campo, nem a cortarão dos bosques, mas com as armas acenderão fogo; e roubarão aos que os roubaram, e despojarão aos que os despojaram, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ λάβωσιν ξύλα ἐκ τοῦ πεδίου οὐδὲ μὴ κόψωσιν ἐκ τῶν δρυμῶν ἀλλ' ἢ τὰ ὅπλα κατακαύσουσιν πυρί καὶ προνομεύσουσιν τοὺς προνομεύσαντας αὐτοὺς καὶ σκυλεύσουσιν τοὺς σκυλεύσαντας αὐτούς λέγει κύριος

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give Gog a noted place for a sepulchre in Israel : the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea, which shall cause astonishment in them that pass by: and there shall they bury Gog , and all his multitude, and it shall be called the valley of the multitude of Gog .
text_la: Et erit in die illa : dabo Gog locum nominatum sepulchrum in Israël, vallem viatorum ad orientem maris, quæ obstupescere faciet prætereuntes : et sepelient ibi Gog, et omnem multitudinem ejus, et vocabitur vallis multitudinis Gog.
text_pt: E sucederá que, naquele dia, darei ali a Gogue um lugar de sepultura em Israel, o vale dos que passam ao oriente do mar; e pararão os que por ele passarem; e ali sepultarão a Gogue, e a toda a sua multidão, e lhe chamarão o vale da multidão de Gogue.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ δώσω τῷ Γωγ τόπον ὀνομαστόν μνημεῖον ἐν Ισραηλ τὸ πολυάνδριον τῶν ἐπελθόντων πρὸς τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ περιοικοδομήσουσιν τὸ περιστόμιον τῆς φάραγγος καὶ κατορύξουσιν ἐκεῖ τὸν Γωγ καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος αὐτοῦ καὶ κληθήσεται τὸ γαι τὸ πολυάνδριον τοῦ Γωγ

text_en: And the house of Israel shall bury them for seven months to cleanse the land.
text_la: Et sepelient eos domus Israël, ut mundent terram septem mensibus.
text_pt: E a casa de Israel os enterrará durante sete meses, para purificar a terra.
text_el: καὶ κατορύξουσιν αὐτοὺς οἶκος Ισραηλ ἵνα καθαρισθῇ ἡ γῆ ἐν ἑπταμήνῳ

text_en: And all the people of the land shall bury him, and it shall be unto them a noted day, wherein I was glorified , says the Lord God .
text_la: Sepeliet autem eum omnis populus terræ : et erit eis nominata dies in qua glorificatus sum, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Sim, todo o povo da terra os enterrará, e será para eles memo-rável dia em que eu for glorificado, diz o Senhor Deus.
text_el: καὶ κατορύξουσιν αὐτοὺς πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῖς εἰς ὀνομαστὸν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐδοξάσθην λέγει κύριος

text_en: And they shall appoint men to go continually about the land, to bury and to seek out them that were remaining upon the face of the earth, that they may cleanse it: and after seven months they shall begin to seek.
text_la: Et viros jugiter constituent lustrantes terram, qui sepeliant et requirant eos qui remanserant super faciem terræ, ut emundent eam : post menses autem septem quærere incipient.
text_pt: E separarão homens que incessantemente percorrerão a terra, para que eles, juntamente com os que passam, sepultem os que tiverem ficado sobre a face da terra, para a purificarem; durante sete meses farão esta busca.
text_el: καὶ ἄνδρας διὰ παντὸς διαστελοῦσιν ἐπιπορευομένους τὴν γῆν θάψαι τοὺς καταλελειμμένους ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς καθαρίσαι αὐτὴν μετὰ τὴν ἑπτάμηνον καὶ ἐκζητήσουσιν

text_en: And they shall go about passing through the land: and when they shall see the bone of a man , they shall set up a sign by it, till the buriers bury it in the valley, of the multitude of Gog .
text_la: Et circuibunt peragrantes terram : cumque viderint os hominis, statuent juxta illud titulum, donec sepeliant illud pollinctores in valle multitudinis Gog.
text_pt: E os que percorrerem a terra, a qual atravessarão, vendo algum osso de homem, porão ao lado um sinal; até que os enterradores o tenham enterrado no vale da multidão de Gogue.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ διαπορευόμενος τὴν γῆν καὶ ἰδὼν ὀστοῦν ἀνθρώπου οἰκοδομήσει παρ' αὐτὸ σημεῖον ἕως ὅτου θάψωσιν αὐτὸ οἱ θάπτοντες εἰς τὸ γαι τὸ πολυάνδριον τοῦ Γωγ

text_en: And the name of the city shall be Amona, and they shall cleanse the land.
text_la: Nomen autem civitatis Amona : et mundabunt terram.
text_pt: E também o nome da cidade será Hamona; assim purificarão a terra.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως Πολυάνδριον καὶ καθαρισθήσεται ἡ γῆ

text_en: And you, O son of man , says the Lord God , say to every fowl, and to all the birds, and to all the beasts of the field: Assemble yourselves, make haste, come together from every side to my victim, which I slay for you, a great victim upon the mountains of Israel : to eat flesh, and drink blood.
text_la: Tu ergo, fili hominis, hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Dic omni volucri, et universis avibus, cunctisque bestiis agri : Convenite, properate, concurrite undique ad victimam meam quam ego immolo vobis, victimam grandem super montes Israël, ut comedatis carnem, et bibatis sanguinem.
text_pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, assim diz o Senhor DEUS, dize às aves de toda espécie, e a todos os animais do campo: Ajuntai-vos e vinde, congregai-vos de toda parte para o meu sacrifício, que eu ofereci por vós, um sacrifício grande, nos montes de Israel, e comei carne e bebei sangue.
text_el: καὶ σύ υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου εἰπόν τάδε λέγει κύριος εἰπὸν παντὶ ὀρνέῳ πετεινῷ καὶ πρὸς πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ πεδίου συνάχθητε καὶ ἔρχεσθε συνάχθητε ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν περικύκλῳ ἐπὶ τὴν θυσίαν μου ἣν τέθυκα ὑμῖν θυσίαν μεγάλην ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη Ισραηλ καὶ φάγεσθε κρέα καὶ πίεσθε αἷμα

text_en: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and you shall drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, and of lambs, and of he goats, and bullocks, and of all that are well fed and fat.
text_la: Carnes fortium comedetis, et sanguinem principum terræ bibetis : arietum, et agnorum, et hircorum, taurorumque et altilium, et pinguium omnium.
text_pt: Comereis a carne dos poderosos e bebereis o sangue dos príncipes da terra; dos carneiros, dos cordeiros, e dos bodes, e dos bezerros, todos cevados de Basã.
text_el: κρέα γιγάντων φάγεσθε καὶ αἷμα ἀρχόντων τῆς γῆς πίεσθε κριοὺς καὶ μόσχους καὶ τράγους καὶ οἱ μόσχοι ἐστεατωμένοι πάντες

text_en: And you shall eat the fat till you be full, and shall drink blood till you be drunk of the victim which I shall slay for you.
text_la: Et comedetis adipem in saturitatem, et bibetis sanguinem in ebrietatem, de victima quam ego immolabo vobis :
text_pt: E comereis a gordura até vos fartardes e bebereis o sangue até vos embebedardes, do meu sacrifício que ofereci por vós.
text_el: καὶ φάγεσθε στέαρ εἰς πλησμονὴν καὶ πίεσθε αἷμα εἰς μέθην ἀπὸ τῆς θυσίας μου ἧς ἔθυσα ὑμῖν

text_en: And you shall be filled at my table with horses, and mighty horsemen, and all the men of war , says the Lord God .
text_la: et saturabimini super mensam meam de equo, et equite forti, et de universis viris bellatoribus, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E, à minha mesa, fartar-vos-ei de cavalos, de carros, de poderosos, e de todos os homens de guerra, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐμπλησθήσεσθε ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης μου ἵππον καὶ ἀναβάτην γίγαντα καὶ πάντα ἄνδρα πολεμιστήν λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will set my glory among the nations : and all nations shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
text_la: Et ponam gloriam meam in gentibus : et videbunt omnes gentes judicium meum quod fecerim, et manum meam quam posuerim super eos.
text_pt: E eu porei a minha glória entre os gentios e todos os gentios verão o meu juízo, que eu tiver executado, e a minha mão, que sobre elas tiver descarregado.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὴν δόξαν μου ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ὄψονται πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὴν κρίσιν μου ἣν ἐποίησα καὶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἣν ἐπήγαγον ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God from that day and forward.
text_la: Et scient domus Israël quia ego Dominus Deus eorum, a die illa et deinceps.
text_pt: E saberão os da casa de Israel que eu sou o Senhor seu Deus, desde aquele dia em diante.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται οἶκος Ισραηλ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ ἐπέκεινα

text_en: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel were made captives for their iniquity , because they forsook me, and I hid my face from them: and I delivered them into the hands of their enemies, and they fell all by the sword.
text_la: Et scient gentes quoniam in iniquitate sua capta sit domus Israël, eo quod dereliquerint me, et absconderim faciem meam ab eis, et tradiderim eos in manus hostium, et ceciderint in gladio universi.
text_pt: E os gentios saberão que os da casa de Israel, por causa da sua iniqüidade, foram levados em cativeiro, porque se rebelaram contra mim, e eu escondi deles a minha face, e os entreguei nas mãos de seus adversários, e todos caíram à espada.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὅτι διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν ᾐχμαλωτεύθησαν οἶκος Ισραηλ ἀνθ' ὧν ἠθέτησαν εἰς ἐμέ καὶ ἀπέστρεψα τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ παρέδωκα αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔπεσαν πάντες μαχαίρᾳ

text_en: I have dealt with them according to their uncleanness , and wickedness , and hid my face from them.
text_la: Juxta immunditiam eorum et scelus feci eis, et abscondi faciem meam ab illis.
text_pt: Conforme a sua imundícia e conforme as suas transgressões me houve com eles, e escondi deles a minha face.
text_el: κατὰ τὰς ἀκαθαρσίας αὐτῶν καὶ κατὰ τὰ ἀνομήματα αὐτῶν ἐποίησα αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀπέστρεψα τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord God : Now will I bring back the captivity of Jacob , and will have mercy on all the house of Israel and I will be jealous for my holy name .
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Nunc reducam captivitatem Jacob, et miserebor omnis domus Israël, et assumam zelum pro nomine sancto meo.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Agora tornarei a trazer os cativos de Jacó, e me compadecerei de toda a casa de Israel; zelarei pelo meu santo nome.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος νῦν ἀποστρέψω τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Ιακωβ καὶ ἐλεήσω τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ καὶ ζηλώσω διὰ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιόν μου

text_en: And they shall bear their confusion, and all the transgressions wherewith they have transgressed against me, when they shall dwell in their land securely fearing no man :
text_la: Et portabunt confusionem suam, et omnem prævaricationem qua prævaricati sunt in me, cum habitaverint in terra sua confidenter, neminem formidantes :
text_pt: E levarão sobre si a sua vergonha, e toda a sua rebeldia, com que se rebelaram contra mim, quando eles habitarem seguros na sua terra, sem haver quem os espante.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται τὴν ἀτιμίαν ἑαυτῶν καὶ τὴν ἀδικίαν ἣν ἠδίκησαν ἐν τῷ κατοικισθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ἐπ' εἰρήνης καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἐκφοβῶν

text_en: And I shall have brought them back from among the nations , and shall have gathered them together out of the lands of their enemies, and shall be sanctified in them, in the sight of many nations .
text_la: et reduxero eos de populis, et congregavero de terris inimicorum suorum, et sanctificatus fuero in eis, in oculis gentium plurimarum.
text_pt: Quando eu os tornar a trazer de entre os povos, e os houver ajuntado das terras de seus inimigos, e eu for santificado neles aos olhos de muitas nações,
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέψαι με αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ συναγαγεῖν με αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God , because I caused them to be carried away among the nations ; and I have gathered them together unto their own land, and have not left any of them there.
text_la: Et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum, eo quod transtulerim eos in nationes, et congregaverim eos super terram suam, et non dereliquerim quemquam ex eis ibi.
text_pt: Então saberão que eu sou o Senhor seu Deus, vendo que eu os fiz ir em cativeiro entre os gentios, e os ajuntarei para voltarem a sua terra, e não mais deixarei lá nenhum deles.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ ἐπιφανῆναί με αὐτοῖς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: And I will hide my face no more from them, for I have poured out my spirit upon all the house of Israel , says the Lord God .
text_la: Et non abscondam ultra faciem meam ab eis, eo quod effuderim spiritum meum super omnem domum Israël, ait Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Nem lhes esconderei mais a minha face, pois derramarei o meu Espírito sobre a casa de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀποστρέψω οὐκέτι τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἀνθ' οὗ ἐξέχεα τὸν θυμόν μου ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος κύριος

text_en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity , in the beginning of the year, the tenth day of the month, the fourteenth year after the city was destroyed: in the selfsame day the hand of the Lord was upon me, and he brought me thither.
text_la: In vigesimo quinto anno transmigrationis nostræ, in exordio anni, decima mensis, quartodecimo anno postquam percussa est civitas, in ipsa hac die, facta est super me manus Domini, et adduxit me illuc.
text_pt: No ano vinte e cinco do nosso cativeiro, no princípio do ano, no décimo dia do mês, catorze anos depois que a cidade foi conquistada, naquele mesmo dia veio sobre mim a mão do SENHOR, e me levou para lá.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ πέμπτῳ καὶ εἰκοστῷ ἔτει τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ πρώτῳ μηνὶ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐν τῷ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει μετὰ τὸ ἁλῶναι τὴν πόλιν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐγένετο ἐπ' ἐμὲ χεὶρ κυρίου καὶ ἤγαγέν με

text_en: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel , and set me upon a very high mountain: upon which there was as the building of a city, bending towards the south.
text_la: In visionibus Dei adduxit me in terram Israël, et dimisit me super montem excelsum nimis, super quem erat quasi ædificium civitatis vergentis ad austrum.
text_pt: Em visões de Deus me levou à terra de Israel, e me pôs sobre um monte muito alto, sobre o qual havia como que um edifício de cidade para o lado sul.
text_el: ἐν ὁράσει θεοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἔθηκέν με ἐπ' ὄρους ὑψηλοῦ σφόδρα καὶ ἐπ' αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ οἰκοδομὴ πόλεως ἀπέναντι

text_en: And he brought me in thither, and behold a man , whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed in his hand, and he stood in the gate.
text_la: Et introduxit me illuc : et ecce vir cujus erat species quasi species æris, et funiculus lineus in manu ejus, et calamus mensuræ in manu ejus : stabat autem in porta.
text_pt: E, havendo-me levado ali, eis que um homem cuja aparência era como a do bronze, tendo um cordel de linho na sua mão e uma cana de medir, e estava em pé na porta.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με ἐκεῖ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνήρ καὶ ἡ ὅρασις αὐτοῦ ἦν ὡσεὶ ὅρασις χαλκοῦ στίλβοντος καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἦν σπαρτίον οἰκοδόμων καὶ κάλαμος μέτρου καὶ αὐτὸς εἱστήκει ἐπὶ τῆς πύλης

text_en: And this man said to me: Son of man , see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart upon all that I shall show you: for you are brought hither that they may be shown to you: declare all that you see, to the house of Israel .
text_la: Et locutus est ad me idem vir : Fili hominis, vide oculis tuis, et auribus tuis audi, et pone cor tuum in omnia quæ ego ostendam tibi, quia ut ostendantur tibi adductus es huc. Annuntia omnia quæ tu vides domui Israël.
text_pt: E disse-me o homem: Filho do homem, vê com os teus olhos, e ouve com os teus ouvidos, e põe no teu coração tudo quanto eu te fizer ver; porque para to mostrar foste tu aqui trazido; anuncia, pois, à casa de Israel tudo quanto vires.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ὁ ἀνήρ ἑώρακας υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ἰδὲ καὶ ἐν τοῖς ὠσίν σου ἄκουε καὶ τάξον εἰς τὴν καρδίαν σου πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ δεικνύω σοι διότι ἕνεκα τοῦ δεῖξαί σοι εἰσελήλυθας ὧδε καὶ δείξεις πάντα ὅσα σὺ ὁρᾷς τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And behold there was a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits and a handbreadth: and he measured the breadth of the building one reed, and the height one reed.
text_la: Et ecce murus forinsecus in circuitu domus undique : et in manu viri calamus mensuræ sex cubitorum et palmo : et mensus est latitudinem ædificii calamo uno, altitudinem quoque calamo uno.
text_pt: E havia um muro fora da casa, em seu redor, e na mão do homem uma cana de medir, de seis côvados, cada um dos quais tinha um côvado e um palmo; e ele mediu a largura do edifício, uma cana, e a altura, uma cana.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ περίβολος ἔξωθεν τοῦ οἴκου κύκλῳ καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς κάλαμος τὸ μέτρον πηχῶν ἓξ ἐν πήχει καὶ παλαιστῆς καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὸ προτείχισμα πλάτος ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ καὶ τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ

text_en: And he came to the gate that looked toward the east, and he went up the steps thereof: and he measured the breadth of the threshold of the gate one reed, that is, one threshold was one reed broad;
text_la: Et venit ad portam quæ respiciebat viam orientalem, et ascendit per gradus ejus : et mensus est limen portæ calamo uno latitudinem, id est, limen unum calamo uno in latitudine.
text_pt: Então veio à porta que olhava para o caminho do oriente, e subiu pelos seus degraus; mediu o umbral da porta, uma cana de largo, e o outro umbral, uma cana de largo.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πύλην τὴν βλέπουσαν κατὰ ἀνατολὰς ἐν ἑπτὰ ἀναβαθμοῖς καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὸ αιλαμ τῆς πύλης ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ

text_en: and every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad: and between the little chambers were five cubits:
text_la: Et thalamum uno calamo in longum, et uno calamo in latum : et inter thalamos, quinque cubitos.
text_pt: E cada câmara tinha uma cana de comprido, e uma cana de largo, e o espaço entre os aposentos era de cinco côvados; e o umbral da porta, ao pé do vestíbulo da porta, por dentro, era de uma cana.
text_el: καὶ τὸ θεε ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ τὸ μῆκος καὶ ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ τὸ πλάτος καὶ τὸ αιλαμ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θαιηλαθα πηχῶν ἓξ καὶ τὸ θεε τὸ δεύτερον ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ τὸ πλάτος καὶ ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ τὸ μῆκος καὶ τὸ αιλαμ πήχεων πέντε

text_en: And the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within, was one reed.
text_la: Et limen portæ, juxta vestibulum portæ intrinsecus, calamo uno.
text_pt: Também mediu o vestíbulo da porta, por dentro, uma cana.
text_el: καὶ τὸ θεε τὸ τρίτον ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ τὸ πλάτος καὶ ἴσον τῷ καλάμῳ τὸ μῆκος

text_en: And he measured the porch of the gate eight cubits, and the front thereof two cubits: and the porch of the gate was inward.
text_la: Et mensus est vestibulum portæ octo cubitorum, et frontem ejus duobus cubitis : vestibulum autem portæ erat intrinsecus.
text_pt: Então mediu o vestíbulo da porta, que tinha oito côvados, e os seus pilares, dois côvados, e este vestíbulo da porta, estava por dentro.
text_el: καὶ τὸ αιλαμ τοῦ πυλῶνος πλησίον τοῦ αιλαμ τῆς πύλης πηχῶν ὀκτὼ καὶ τὰ αιλευ πηχῶν δύο καὶ τὸ αιλαμ τῆς πύλης ἔσωθεν

text_en: And the little chambers of the gate that looked eastward were three on this side, and three on that side: all three were of one measure, and the fronts of one measure, on both parts.
text_la: Porro thalami portæ ad viam orientalem, tres hinc et tres inde : mensura una trium, et mensura una frontium ex utraque parte.
text_pt: As câmaras da porta para o lado do oriente eram três de um lado e três do outro; a mesma medida era a dos três; também os pilares de um lado e do outro tinham a mesma medida.
text_el: καὶ τὰ θεε τῆς πύλης θεε κατέναντι τρεῖς ἔνθεν καὶ τρεῖς ἔνθεν καὶ μέτρον ἓν τοῖς τρισὶν καὶ μέτρον ἓν τοῖς αιλαμ ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν

text_en: And he measured the breadth of the threshold of the gate ten cubits: and the length of the gate thirteen cubits:
text_la: Et mensus est latitudinem liminis portæ decem cubitorum, et longitudinem portæ tredecim cubitorum.
text_pt: Mediu mais a largura da entrada da porta, que era de dez côvados; e o comprimento da porta, treze côvados.
text_el: καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὸ πλάτος τῆς θύρας τοῦ πυλῶνος πηχῶν δέκα καὶ τὸ εὖρος τοῦ πυλῶνος πηχῶν δέκα τριῶν

text_en: And the border before the little chambers one cubit: and one cubit was the border on both sides: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side and that side.
text_la: Et marginem ante thalamos, cubiti unius, et cubitus unus finis utrimque : thalami autem sex cubitorum erant hinc et inde.
text_pt: E o espaço em frente das câmaras era de um côvado, e de um côvado o espaço do outro lado; e cada câmara tinha seis côvados de um lado e seis côvados do outro.
text_el: καὶ πῆχυς ἐπισυναγόμενος ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τῶν θεϊμ ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν καὶ τὸ θεε πηχῶν ἓξ ἔνθεν καὶ πηχῶν ἓξ ἔνθεν

text_en: And he measured the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another, in breadth five and twenty cubits: door against door.
text_la: Et mensus est portam a tecto thalami usque ad tectum ejus, latitudinem viginti quinque cubitorum, ostium contra ostium.
text_pt: Então mediu a porta desde o telhado de uma câmara até ao telhado da outra, vinte e cinco côvados de largo, porta contra porta.
text_el: καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὴν πύλην ἀπὸ τοῦ τοίχου τοῦ θεε ἐπὶ τὸν τοῖχον τοῦ θεε πλάτος πήχεις εἴκοσι πέντε αὕτη πύλη ἐπὶ πύλην

text_en: He made also fronts of sixty cubits: and to the front the court of the gate on every side round about.
text_la: Et fecit frontes per sexaginta cubitos, et ad frontem atrium portæ undique per circuitum.
text_pt: Fez também os pilares, de sessenta côvados, cada pilar, do átrio, em redor da porta.
text_el: καὶ τὸ αἴθριον τοῦ αιλαμ τῆς πύλης ἑξήκοντα πήχεις εἴκοσι θεϊμ τῆς πύλης κύκλῳ

text_en: And before the face of the gate which reached even to the face of the porch of the inner gate, fifty cubits.
text_la: Et ante faciem portæ quæ pertingebat usque ad faciem vestibuli portæ interioris, quinquaginta cubitos.
text_pt: E, desde a face da porta da entrada até à face do vestíbulo da porta interior, havia cinqüenta côvados.
text_el: καὶ τὸ αἴθριον τῆς πύλης ἔξωθεν εἰς τὸ αἴθριον αιλαμ τῆς πύλης ἔσωθεν πηχῶν πεντήκοντα

text_en: And slanting windows in the little chambers, and in their fronts, which were within the gate on every side round about: and in like manner there were also in the porches windows round about within, and before the fronts the representation of palm trees.
text_la: Et fenestras obliquas in thalamis et in frontibus eorum, quæ erant intra portam undique per circuitum : similiter autem erant et in vestibulis fenestræ per gyrum intrinsecus, et ante frontes pictura palmarum.
text_pt: Havia também janelas estreitas nas câmaras, e nos seus pilares, dentro da porta ao redor, e da mesma sorte nos vestíbulos; e as janelas estavam ao redor, na parte de dentro, e nos pilares havia palmeiras.
text_el: καὶ θυρίδες κρυπταὶ ἐπὶ τὰ θεϊμ καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ αιλαμ ἔσωθεν τῆς πύλης τῆς αὐλῆς κυκλόθεν καὶ ὡσαύτως τοῖς αιλαμ θυρίδες κύκλῳ ἔσωθεν καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ αιλαμ φοίνικες ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν

text_en: And he brought me into the outward court , and behold there were chambers, and a pavement of stone in the court round about: thirty chambers encompassed the pavement.
text_la: Et eduxit me ad atrium exterius : et ecce gazophylacia, et pavimentum stratum lapide in atrio per circuitum : triginta gazophylacia in circuitu pavimenti.
text_pt: E ele me levou ao átrio exterior, e eis que havia nele câmaras, e um pavimento que estava feito no átrio em redor; trinta câmaras havia naquele pavimento.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐσωτέραν καὶ ἰδοὺ παστοφόρια καὶ περίστυλα κύκλῳ τῆς αὐλῆς τριάκοντα παστοφόρια ἐν τοῖς περιστύλοις

text_en: And the pavement in the front of the gates according to the length of the gates was lower.
text_la: Et pavimentum in fronte portarum, secundum longitudinem portarum erat inferius.
text_pt: E o pavimento do lado das portas era proporcional ao comprimento das portas; o pavimento estava mais baixo.
text_el: καὶ αἱ στοαὶ κατὰ νώτου τῶν πυλῶν κατὰ τὸ μῆκος τῶν πυλῶν τὸ περίστυλον τὸ ὑποκάτω

text_en: And he measured the breadth from the face of the lower gate to the front of the inner court without, a hundred cubits to the east, and to the north.
text_la: Et mensus est latitudinem a facie portæ inferioris usque ad frontem atrii interioris extrinsecus: centum cubitos ad orientem et ad aquilonem.
text_pt: E mediu a largura desde a dianteira da porta inferior até a dianteira do átrio interior, por fora, cem côvados, do lado do oriente e do norte.
text_el: καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὸ πλάτος τῆς αὐλῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰθρίου τῆς πύλης τῆς ἐξωτέρας ἔσωθεν ἐπὶ τὸ αἴθριον τῆς πύλης τῆς βλεπούσης ἔξω πήχεις ἑκατόν τῆς βλεπούσης κατ' ἀνατολάς καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με ἐπὶ βορρᾶν

text_en: He measured also both the length and the breadth of the gate of the outward court , which looked northward.
text_la: Portam quoque quæ respiciebat viam aquilonis atrii exterioris, mensus est tam in longitudine quam in latitudine.
text_pt: E, quanto à porta que olhava para o caminho do norte, no átrio exterior, ele mediu o seu comprimento e a sua largura.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ πύλη βλέπουσα πρὸς βορρᾶν τῇ αὐλῇ τῇ ἐξωτέρᾳ καὶ διεμέτρησεν αὐτήν τό τε μῆκος αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ πλάτος

text_en: And the little chambers thereof three on this side, and three on that side: and the front thereof, and the porch thereof according to the measure of the former gate, fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
text_la: Et thalamos ejus tres hinc et tres inde, et frontem ejus et vestibulum ejus secundum mensuram portæ prioris, quinquaginta cubitorum longitudinem ejus, et latitudinem viginti quinque cubitorum.
text_pt: E as suas câmaras eram três de um lado, e três do outro, e os seus pilares e os seus arcos eram da medida da primeira porta: cinqüenta côvados era o seu comprimento, e a largura vinte e cinco côvados.
text_el: καὶ τὰ θεε τρεῖς ἔνθεν καὶ τρεῖς ἔνθεν καὶ τὰ αιλευ καὶ τὰ αιλαμμω καὶ τοὺς φοίνικας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐγένετο κατὰ τὰ μέτρα τῆς πύλης τῆς βλεπούσης κατὰ ἀνατολὰς πηχῶν πεντήκοντα τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς καὶ πηχῶν εἴκοσι πέντε τὸ εὖρος αὐτῆς

text_en: And the windows thereof, and the porch , and the gravings according to the measure of the gate that looked to the east, and they went up to it by seven steps, and a porch was before it.
text_la: Fenestræ autem ejus, et vestibulum, et sculpturæ secundum mensuram portæ quæ respiciebat ad orientem : et septem graduum erat ascensus ejus, et vestibulum ante eam.
text_pt: E as suas janelas, e os seus arcos, e as suas palmeiras, eram da medida da porta que olhava para o caminho do oriente; e subia-se para ela por sete degraus, e os seus arcos estavam diante dela.
text_el: καὶ αἱ θυρίδες αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ αιλαμμω καὶ οἱ φοίνικες αὐτῆς καθὼς ἡ πύλη ἡ βλέπουσα κατὰ ἀνατολάς καὶ ἐν ἑπτὰ κλιμακτῆρσιν ἀνέβαινον ἐπ' αὐτήν καὶ τὰ αιλαμμω ἔσωθεν

text_en: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate of the north, and that of the east: and he measured from gate to gate a hundred cubits.
text_la: Et porta atrii interioris contra portam aquilonis et orientalem: et mensus est a porta usque ad portam centum cubitos.
text_pt: E a porta do átrio interior estava defronte da porta do norte bem como da do oriente; e mediu de porta a porta cem côvados.
text_el: καὶ πύλη τῇ αὐλῇ τῇ ἐσωτέρᾳ βλέπουσα ἐπὶ πύλην τοῦ βορρᾶ ὃν τρόπον τῆς πύλης τῆς βλεπούσης κατὰ ἀνατολάς καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὴν αὐλὴν ἀπὸ πύλης ἐπὶ πύλην πήχεις ἑκατόν

text_en: And he brought me out to the way of the south, and behold the gate that looked to the south: and he measured the front thereof, and the porch thereof according to the former measures.
text_la: Et eduxit me ad viam australem : et ecce porta quæ respiciebat ad austrum : et mensus est frontem ejus et vestibulum ejus juxta mensuras superiores.
text_pt: Então ele me levou ao caminho do sul, e eis que havia ali uma porta que olhava para o caminho do sul, e mediu os seus pilares e os seus arcos conforme estas medidas.
text_el: καὶ ἤγαγέν με κατὰ νότον καὶ ἰδοὺ πύλη βλέπουσα πρὸς νότον καὶ διεμέτρησεν αὐτὴν καὶ τὰ θεε καὶ τὰ αιλευ καὶ τὰ αιλαμμω κατὰ τὰ μέτρα ταῦτα

text_en: And the windows thereof, and the porches round about, as the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
text_la: Et fenestras ejus, et vestibula in circuitu, sicut fenestras ceteras : quinquaginta cubitorum longitudine, et latitudine viginti quinque cubitorum.
text_pt: E havia também janelas em redor dos seus arcos, como as outras janelas; cinqüenta côvados era o comprimento, e a largura vinte e cinco côvados.
text_el: καὶ αἱ θυρίδες αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ αιλαμμω κυκλόθεν καθὼς αἱ θυρίδες τοῦ αιλαμ πηχῶν πεντήκοντα τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς καὶ πηχῶν εἴκοσι πέντε τὸ εὖρος αὐτῆς

text_en: And there were seven steps to go up to it: and a porch before the doors thereof: and there were graven palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side in the front thereof.
text_la: Et in gradibus septem ascendebatur ad eam, et vestibulum ante fores ejus : et cælatæ palmæ erant, una hinc, et altera inde, in fronte ejus.
text_pt: E de sete degraus eram as suas subidas, e os seus arcos estavam diante delas; e tinha palmeiras, uma de um lado e outra do outro, nos seus pilares.
text_el: καὶ ἑπτὰ κλιμακτῆρες αὐτῇ καὶ αιλαμμω ἔσωθεν καὶ φοίνικες αὐτῇ εἷς ἔνθεν καὶ εἷς ἔνθεν ἐπὶ τὰ αιλευ

text_en: And there was a gate of the inner court towards the south: and he measured from gate to gate towards the south, a hundred cubits.
text_la: Et porta atrii interioris in via australi : et mensus est a porta usque ad portam in via australi, centum cubitos.
text_pt: Também havia uma porta no átrio interior para o caminho do sul; e mediu de porta a porta, para o caminho do sul, cem côvados.
text_el: καὶ πύλη κατέναντι πύλης τῆς αὐλῆς τῆς ἐσωτέρας πρὸς νότον καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὴν αὐλὴν ἀπὸ πύλης ἐπὶ πύλην πήχεις ἑκατὸν τὸ εὖρος πρὸς νότον

text_en: And he brought me into the inner court at the south gate: and he measured the gate according to the former measures.
text_la: Et introduxit me in atrium interius ad portam australem : et mensus est portam juxta mensuras superiores.
text_pt: Então me levou ao átrio interior pela porta do sul; e mediu a porta do sul, conforme estas medidas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐσωτέραν τῆς πύλης τῆς πρὸς νότον καὶ διεμέτρησεν τὴν πύλην κατὰ τὰ μέτρα ταῦτα

text_en: The little chamber thereof, and the front thereof, and the porch thereof with the same measures: and the windows thereof, and the porch thereof round about it was fifty cubits in length, and five and twenty cubits in breadth.
text_la: Thalamum ejus, et frontem ejus, et vestibulum ejus eisdem mensuris, et fenestras ejus, et vestibulum ejus in circuitu, quinquaginta cubitos longitudinis, et latitudinis viginti quinque cubitos.
text_pt: E as suas câmaras, e os seus pilares, e os seus arcos eram conforme estas medidas; e tinham também janelas ao redor dos seus arcos; o comprimento era de cinqüenta côvados, e a largura de vinte e cinco côvados.
text_el: καὶ τὰ θεε καὶ τὰ αιλευ καὶ τὰ αιλαμμω κατὰ τὰ μέτρα ταῦτα καὶ θυρίδες αὐτῇ καὶ τῷ αιλαμμω κύκλῳ πήχεις πεντήκοντα τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ εὖρος πήχεις εἴκοσι πέντε

text_en: And the porch round about was five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
text_la: Et vestibulum per gyrum longitudine viginti quinque cubitorum, et latitudine quinque cubitorum:
text_pt: E havia arcos em redor; o comprimento era de vinte e cinco côvados, e a largura de cinco côvados.

text_en: And the porch thereof to the outward court , and the palm trees thereof in the front: and there were eight steps to go up to it.
text_la: et vestibulum ejus ad atrium exterius, et palmas ejus in fronte : et octo gradus erant quibus ascendebatur per eam.
text_pt: E os seus arcos estavam na direção do átrio exterior, e havia palmeiras nos seus pilares; e de oito degraus eram as suas subidas.
text_el: καὶ αιλαμμω εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐξωτέραν καὶ φοίνικες τῷ αιλευ καὶ ὀκτὼ κλιμακτῆρες

text_en: And he brought me into the inner court by the way of the east: and he measured the gate according to the former measures.
text_la: Et introduxit me in atrium interius, per viam orientalem : et mensus est portam secundum mensuras superiores.
text_pt: Depois me levou ao átrio interior, para o caminho do oriente, e mediu a porta conforme estas medidas;
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγέν με εἰς τὴν πύλην τὴν βλέπουσαν κατὰ ἀνατολὰς καὶ διεμέτρησεν αὐτὴν κατὰ τὰ μέτρα ταῦτα

text_en: The little chamber thereof, and the front thereof, and the porch thereof as before: and the windows thereof, and the porches thereof round about it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
text_la: Thalamum ejus, et frontem ejus, et vestibulum ejus, sicut supra : et fenestras ejus, et vestibula ejus in circuitu, longitudine quinquaginta cubitorum, et latitudine viginti quinque cubitorum.
text_pt: E também as suas câmaras, e os seus pilares, e os seus arcos, conforme estas medidas; e havia também janelas em redor dos seus arcos; o comprimento de cinqüenta côvados, e a largura de vinte e cinco côvados.
text_el: καὶ τὰ θεε καὶ τὰ αιλευ καὶ τὰ αιλαμμω κατὰ τὰ μέτρα ταῦτα καὶ θυρίδες αὐτῇ καὶ τῷ αιλαμμω κύκλῳ πήχεις πεντήκοντα μῆκος αὐτῆς καὶ εὖρος πήχεις εἴκοσι πέντε

text_en: And the porch thereof, that is, of the outward court : and the graven palm trees in the front thereof on this side and on that side: and the going up thereof was by eight steps.
text_la: Et vestibulum ejus, id est, atrii exterioris, et palmæ cælatæ in fronte ejus, hinc et inde : et in octo gradibus ascensus ejus.
text_pt: E os seus arcos estavam no átrio de fora; também havia palmeiras nos seus pilares de um e de outro lado; e eram as suas subidas de oito degraus.
text_el: καὶ αιλαμμω εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐσωτέραν καὶ φοίνικες ἐπὶ τοῦ αιλευ ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν καὶ ὀκτὼ κλιμακτῆρες αὐτῇ

text_en: And he brought me into the gate that looked to the north: and he measured according to the former measures.
